source: Claude Opus 5.5 по разделам мирового искусства + стили прежних таблиц промптов

styles.name: Catalan Romanesque apse fresco, Pyrenean churches of the Boí valley
styles.features: Thick black contour lines, flat zones of saturated red ochre, deep blue and yellow, frontal Christ in a mandorla, symmetrical stylised drapery folds, horizontal colour bands as background, large staring eyes, rough plaster surface

styles.name: Romanesque vault murals of Saint-Savin-sur-Gartempe
styles.features: Pale earthy palette of yellow ochre, red ochre, green earth and white; lively elongated figures in animated striding poses; wavy hemlines; continuous narrative friezes along a barrel vault; no depth

styles.name: Insular illumination, Hiberno-Saxon gospel books
styles.features: Dense interlace knotwork, spirals, trumpet patterns and biting zoomorphic creatures filling every surface; flat frontal figures with stylised hair; red-dot outlining; yellow, purple, green and red on vellum
styles.note: Keep any lettering decorative and illegible; carpet-page ornament works without text

styles.name: Carolingian pen drawing, Reims school (Utrecht Psalter manner)
styles.features: Quick nervous sketchy pen line in brown ink, small agitated figures with hunched shoulders and fluttering drapery, impressionistic hilly landscapes, many tiny scenes spread across one unframed page, no colour

styles.name: Ottonian manuscript illumination, Reichenau school
styles.features: Gold or purple grounds, tall elongated figures with large staring eyes and oversized gesturing hands, flat bands of soft colour behind, minimal setting, solemn frontal compositions, purple, green and burnished gold

styles.name: Mozarabic Beatus illumination, León and Girona
styles.features: Flat horizontal bands of saturated yellow, red, green and blue as background; stiff figures with almond eyes and patterned robes; horseshoe arches; dragons and many-headed beasts; bold outlines; no shadow or depth
styles.note: Includes the work of the woman painter Ende

styles.name: Anglo-Saxon illumination, Winchester school
styles.features: Agitated fluttering drapery drawn in nervous line, heavy gold frames bursting with lush acanthus leaves at the corners, elongated figures poised on tiptoe, pale tinted or fully painted colour on vellum

styles.name: Herrad of Landsberg
styles.features: Clear pen outlines with flat colour, crowded rows of small figures, circular cosmological diagrams, ladders and wheels, Byzantine-influenced drapery, lively armoured virtues and vices fighting, labelled schematic compositions
styles.note: Original destroyed in 1870; known from 19th-century tracings

styles.name: Rupertsberg Scivias illuminations (Hildegard of Bingen)
styles.medium: pigments, gold and silver on vellum
styles.features: Visionary cosmic diagrams: concentric egg- and wheel-shaped universes, flames, stars and winds, flat gold and silver grounds, deep blue and red bands, tiny figures, symbolic rather than spatial layout, rectangular framed panels
styles.note: Attribution to Hildegard's scriptorium; original lost in 1945, known from a facsimile

styles.name: English Romanesque Bible illumination (Winchester Bible manner)
styles.medium: pigments and burnished gold on vellum
styles.features: Monumental figures in clinging damp-fold drapery forming looped oval patterns, burnished gold grounds, deep blue and green, Byzantine faces with greenish underpaint, scenes framed in large initials with acanthus scrolls
styles.note: Historiated initials can be rendered as ornament without readable letters

styles.name: Matthew Paris
styles.features: Confident brown pen line with light washes of green, blue and ochre, much bare parchment, lively animals and figures, chronicle scenes and itinerary-like maps placed loosely in margins, delicate fluent drapery

styles.name: English Gothic bestiary illumination
styles.features: Single animals and fantastic beasts against burnished gold or diapered grounds in framed panels, flat bright colour, stylised trees, heraldic poses, symbolic rather than observed anatomy, crisp black outlines

styles.name: Gothic marginal drolleries, East Anglian psalters
styles.features: Page margins swarming with hybrid grotesques, rabbits, monkeys, snail-fighting knights and peasants ploughing or cooking, pen and bright colour, thin ivy-leaf border bars, playful distortions of scale
styles.note: Show margins with blank or illegible text blocks

styles.name: Parisian Gothic court illumination, Rayonnant style
styles.medium: pigments and burnished gold on vellum
styles.features: Slender swaying figures beneath painted Gothic gables and rose windows, burnished gold and red-blue diaper backgrounds, crisp black outlines, small heads, elegant gestures, cathedral-like architectural framing

styles.name: Jean Pucelle
styles.features: Figures modelled in delicate grey grisaille with touches of colour on faces and backgrounds, box-like architectural spaces, tiny marginal drolleries, fine ivy-leaf borders, miniature scale on vellum

styles.name: Limbourg brothers
styles.features: Calendar-like scenes in jewel-bright ultramarine and gold, castles with turrets under blue skies, elaborate courtly costume, elongated elegant figures, peasants at seasonal labour in fields, high horizons, semicircular zodiac lunettes above

styles.name: Boucicaut Master
styles.features: Deep interiors and landscapes receding into hazy blue skies that fade to white at the horizon, gold-starred backgrounds, solid figures in bright robes, ivy and acanthus borders

styles.name: Ghent-Bruges school illumination
styles.features: Trompe-l'oeil borders of scattered flowers, insects, jewels and pilgrim badges casting shadows on a tinted gold ground, framing miniatures with deep naturalistic landscapes, small figures and soft gradients

styles.name: Codex Manesse illumination
styles.features: Full-page courtly scenes in flat unshaded colour on bare parchment, heraldic shields and crested helmets, swaying elegant figures jousting, hawking or courting, simple tree and vine settings
styles.note: Name captions above figures can be omitted

styles.name: Cantigas de Santa Maria illumination, Alfonsine court
styles.features: Pages divided into six arched panels like a comic strip, small lively figures in Castilian costume, Gothic and horseshoe arches, cut-away buildings, bright red, blue and gold, musicians and sailors
styles.note: Panel captions are optional

styles.name: Tacuinum Sanitatis illumination, Lombardy
styles.features: Observed everyday scenes of peasants harvesting, cooks, merchants and plants with oversized leaves, simple ground strip, pale tinted backgrounds, fresh green, ochre and rose, Lombard dress, minimal framing

styles.name: Hungarian Anjou Legendarium illumination
styles.features: Pages divided into four square scenes, saints' life episodes with sturdy figures, red and blue backgrounds, simple box architecture, clear outlines, compact gesturing groups, sequential storytelling

styles.name: Jean Fouquet
styles.features: Solid sculptural figures in measured space, recognisable French towns and cathedrals behind, gold-hatched highlights, crowded ceremonial processions and battles, clear daylight, blue and gold dominant

styles.name: Medieval mappa mundi, Hereford type
styles.features: Circular world map with east at the top, Jerusalem at the centre, tiny cities drawn as towers, rivers and seas in green and red, monsters and strange peoples crowding the edges
styles.note: Labels should be illegible pseudo-script

styles.name: Cimabue
styles.features: Monumental enthroned figures on gold ground, Byzantine fine gold striations in drapery, elongated faces with dark shadows, stacked angels, ornate wooden thrones in angled perspective

styles.name: Duccio di Buoninsegna
styles.medium: tempera and gold leaf on panel
styles.features: Byzantine-inflected figures with long noses and almond eyes, gold-striated garments, delicate colour, small narrative panels with angled box-like buildings, punched gold halos, gentle emotional gestures

styles.name: Giotto di Bondone
styles.features: Solid block-like figures in simple heavy drapery, shallow stage-like spaces with box-shaped buildings and bare rocky hills, intense ultramarine skies, gold halos, grave gestures and emotional faces

styles.name: Simone Martini
styles.medium: tempera and tooled gold on panel
styles.features: Sinuous curving outlines, elegant elongated figures, burnished gold ground with tooled and punched patterns, richly detailed brocades, refined pale faces, decorative Gothic linearity

styles.name: Ambrogio Lorenzetti
styles.features: Panoramas of a walled city with crowded streets, dancers, shops and builders on rooftops, opening onto rolling hills with fields, roads and peasants; muted earth tones, sweeping bird's-eye space

styles.name: Papal Palace secular frescoes, Avignon (Chambre du Cerf)
styles.features: Walls covered by dense dark-green forest of individually drawn trees and foliage, small figures fishing at a pond, hawking and hunting stags, birds in branches, tapestry-like continuous surface

styles.name: Lorenzo Monaco
styles.features: Intensely saturated rose, lapis blue and acid yellow robes in long looping sinuous folds, attenuated figures, gold ground, pointed Gothic pinnacle frames, glowing unreal colour, minimal settings

styles.name: Gentile da Fabriano
styles.medium: tempera with raised gilding on panel
styles.features: Opulent raised gilded relief ornament on crowns and brocades, crowded processions of horses, leopards, monkeys and courtiers, winding roads to hilltop towns in arched lunettes, glowing night scenes

styles.name: Pisanello
styles.features: Precisely observed horses seen from behind, hunting dogs, deer and birds, courtiers in fur-trimmed costumes with huge hats, dark forest grounds, decorative gold accents, dense tapestry-like composition

styles.name: Cycle of the Months, Torre Aquila, Trento (Master Wenceslas)
styles.features: Calendar frescoes of courtly snowball fights, jousts and farm labour, high-viewpoint landscapes of mountains, castles and fields, bright greens and blues, tiny detailed figures in costume, International Gothic charm

styles.name: Master Theodoric
styles.features: Soft heavy-set figures with broad faces and gentle eyes, plump rounded modelling, bodies overlapping the frame, raised gilded backgrounds, velvety warm colour

styles.name: Master Bertram of Minden
styles.features: Naive sturdy figures and schematic animals on flat gold ground, strong red, blue and green, few props, abrupt storytelling scenes in square panels, simple stylised trees

styles.name: Master Francke
styles.features: Soft doll-like faces, deep ultramarine and vermilion, red or gold backgrounds patterned with stars, compact compositions crowded with mourners or tormentors, intense expressive emotion

styles.name: Stefan Lochner
styles.medium: oil and tempera with gold on panel
styles.features: Sweet rounded faces, crisp jewel-like colour, punched gold grounds, rose arbours, tiny angel musicians, flowery meadows, gentle soft-style drapery falling in rounded folds

styles.name: English International Gothic court panel painting
styles.medium: tempera and gold on oak panel
styles.features: Small portable panels, ultramarine-robed angels wearing flower wreaths, kneeling figures in gold brocade, punched gold grounds, delicate elongated figures, flower-strewn meadows, white hart badges

styles.name: Jaume Huguet
styles.medium: tempera and raised gilding on panel
styles.features: Raised gilded relief on armour, halos and brocades against gold, solemn dignified saints with carefully drawn faces, subdued colour, Gothic altarpiece frames with pinnacles

styles.name: Andrei Rublev
styles.medium: egg tempera on gessoed panel, fresco
styles.features: Weightless figures with soft rounded silhouettes, gently inclined heads, clear luminous blue, pale ochre and green, gold ground, harmonious circular compositions, inverse perspective

styles.name: Theophanes the Greek
styles.features: Bold rapid brushwork, swift white highlights slashed across dark ochre-brown faces and robes, near-monochrome palette, ascetic figures with intense gaze, energetic sweeping drapery

styles.name: Novgorod icon school
styles.features: Bright cinnabar-red backgrounds, bold contours, flat strong colours, compact sturdy saints, simple rhythmic silhouettes, sharp white highlights, stylised stepped hills and small buildings

styles.name: Albertus Pictor
styles.features: Flat outline figures in red, black, ochre and green on whitewashed vaults, leafy tendril ornament between scenes, lively popular storytelling with demons, sailors, hunters and everyday people

styles.name: Elmelunde Master
styles.features: Naive cartoon-like figures with large heads in simple outline, ochre, red and green on white limewash, compact biblical scenes fitted into vault segments, stars and tendrils filling gaps

styles.name: Norwegian painted altar frontals
styles.features: Central enthroned figure flanked by narrative scenes in arcades, flat red, green and yellow, silver foil glazed to look like gold, bold outlines, stylised drapery, symmetrical layout

styles.name: Bernt Notke
styles.medium: paint on linen canvas, wood sculpture
styles.features: Long frieze of shrouded skeletal Death figures dancing hand in hand with stiff figures of pope, emperor and merchant, before a low Hanseatic harbour town, muted earthy palette
styles.note: Verse inscriptions below the figures can be omitted

styles.name: Early Gothic stained glass, Chartres
styles.medium: stained and painted glass with lead
styles.features: Deep cobalt blue with ruby red, small medallions stacked vertically, tiny figures painted in brown-black line, thick lead lines, glowing translucent jewel-like colour, vine borders

styles.name: English Perpendicular stained glass with silver stain
styles.medium: painted white glass with silver stain
styles.features: Large areas of white glass touched with silver-stain yellow, standing figures under tall painted canopies of pinnacled architecture, delicate brush shading, tall rectangular lights, pale cool palette, thin leading

styles.name: Cistercian grisaille glass
styles.medium: colourless glass painted with grisaille, lead
styles.features: Colourless or greenish glass painted with geometric and foliate interlace, strapwork defined by lead lines, almost no colour, silvery diffused light, rhythmic repeated knots and palmettes

styles.name: Angers Apocalypse tapestry
styles.features: Long series of scenes on alternating red and blue grounds, angels, armies and seven-headed beasts, burning and ruined cities, strong outlines, faded indigo and madder tones, woven wool texture

styles.name: Millefleur tapestry
styles.features: Red or dark blue-green ground strewn with countless small flowering plants, rabbits, birds and dogs, flat decorative space, ladies in rich gowns, unicorn and lion, heraldic banners

styles.name: Franco-Flemish hunting tapestry, Arras and Tournai
styles.features: Wall hangings packed with tall courtly hunters, hounds, deer, boars and falcons, high horizon, dense foliage, flowing patterned costumes, no empty sky, woven texture

styles.name: Bayeux Tapestry embroidery
styles.features: Continuous narrative frieze on plain linen, outlined figures filled with laid-and-couched wool in terracotta, blue-green and mustard, horses, ships and soldiers, beasts in upper and lower borders, no depth
styles.note: Latin captions are optional and should be kept illegible

styles.name: Opus Anglicanum embroidery
styles.medium: silk and gold thread embroidery on linen and velvet
styles.features: Faces worked in spiralling split stitch, couched gold-thread backgrounds, figures in arcades or barbed quatrefoils, delicate shading in coloured silk, shimmering stitched textile surface

styles.name: Limoges champlevé enamel
styles.features: Glowing blue, turquoise, green and white enamel fields, engraved gilded figures with applied relief heads, rosettes and scrolling vermiculé ornament, flat decorative surface, metallic sheen

styles.name: Fra Angelico
styles.features: Clear radiant pastel colour—sky blue, pale rose, gold—serene gentle figures, simple cloister architecture with thin columns and round arches, flowering lawns, delicate gold haloes, calm symmetrical compositions, even luminous light.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters
styles.note: default subjects are religious; secular scenes adapt well

styles.name: Masaccio
styles.features: Weighty sculptural figures lit from a single side with strong cast shadows, rigorous one-point perspective, bare grey-green hills, heavy plain draperies in brick red, olive and slate, solemn faces, sober earthy palette.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Paolo Uccello
styles.features: Geometric toy-like horses and armoured riders, broken lances laid along perspective lines, dark hedges studded with orange fruit, faceted helmets, flattened patterned ground, red, gold, black and silver-grey, puppet-like stiffness.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Piero della Francesca
styles.medium: fresco; tempera and oil on panel
styles.features: Still monumental figures with egg-shaped heads, cool silvery daylight, pale blue, chalky pink and white, precise geometric architecture, wide clear skies, low hills with tiny trees, mathematically ordered calm space.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Fra Filippo Lippi
styles.features: Sweet pale young faces under fine transparent veils, softly modelled flesh, lively curly-haired children, round tondo compositions, rocky backdrops seen through windows, gentle linear contours, muted rose, blue and gold.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Benozzo Gozzoli
styles.features: Long processions of richly dressed riders winding through fairy-tale hills with cypresses and castles, gold-studded brocades and harnesses, hunting dogs and falcons, dense rows of portrait faces, bright tapestry-like colour.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Giovanni di Paolo
styles.medium: tempera and gold leaf on panel
styles.features: Elongated fragile figures, fields laid out like patchwork quilts, spiky stylised rocks, streaks of gold in the sky, concentric circular cosmos diagrams, dreamlike flattened space, vermilion, pink, gold and deep blue.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Andrea Mantegna
styles.medium: tempera on canvas and panel; fresco
styles.features: Hard sculptural figures like carved stone, steep worm's-eye foreshortening, classical Roman ruins and reliefs, crisp contour lines, stony rocky landscapes, hanging fruit festoons, cool grey and bronze tones, sharp metallic detail.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Carlo Crivelli
styles.medium: tempera and gold on panel with raised gesso
styles.features: Hard enamelled colour, raised gilded gesso jewels and brocade, hanging garlands of apples, pears and cucumbers, illusionistic flies and fruit on marble ledges, tense wiry hands, gold backgrounds, crisp ornament on every surface.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Cosmè Tura
styles.features: Metallic crinkled drapery like folded foil, gaunt bony figures with tense clawlike hands, fantastic sculpted thrones with shells and dolphins, glassy angular rocks, hard enamel colour under strange cool light.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Antonello da Messina
styles.features: Smooth glazed oil surface, compact geometric heads against dark backgrounds, three-quarter portraits with steady gaze, tiny Flemish-like detail, crisp light from the left, warm browns and deep red, still interiors with shelves and books.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Sandro Botticelli
styles.features: Flowing linear contours, slender pale figures with long golden wavy hair, wind-blown transparent drapery, flowers scattered over dark green meadows, flat decorative space, soft rose, gold and sea-green, matte tempera surface.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Domenico Ghirlandaio
styles.features: Orderly frescoes of Florentine rooms and streets, citizens in fashionable dress standing as onlookers, coffered ceilings and classical pilasters, household objects, balanced symmetrical groups, bright even daylight, warm rose and green.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Pinturicchio
styles.features: Lavish decorative frescoes with raised gilt highlights, crowded courtly scenes with turbaned figures, horses and banners, grotesque-ornamented frames, bright blue skies, pastel architecture, delicate miniature-like detail.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Luca Signorelli
styles.features: Muscular nude figures in twisting dramatic poses, hard anatomical contours, crowded energetic groups on bare stony ground, harsh side light, sculptural bodies, earthy flesh tones against blue-grey, strong foreshortening.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters
styles.note: heavy use of nudity

styles.name: Pietro Perugino
styles.medium: oil and tempera on panel; fresco
styles.features: Calm symmetrical figures with tilted heads and dreamy upturned eyes, wide airy valleys with thin feathery trees, open piazzas with domed temples, soft blue-green distance, gentle glowing light, sweet uniform faces.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Giovanni Bellini
styles.features: Warm luminous oil glazes, serene figures in soft golden daylight, detailed hilly landscapes with small towns and castles, clear cool skies with low clouds, rich red, blue and green, gentle tonal modelling.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Vittore Carpaccio
styles.features: Large narrative canvases of canal cities, gondolas, banners and Oriental costumes, crowded quays and loggias, small precise figures, red and white chimneys, clear daylight, storybook sequence of episodes across one wide view.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Florentine cassone painting
styles.medium: tempera and gold on wooden marriage-chest panels
styles.features: Long horizontal friezes of tiny figures in fashionable dress, continuous narratives repeating the same characters, gilded raised ornament, toy-like castles, tents and ships, processions, flat bright colour, tapestry-like spacing.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Piero di Cosimo
styles.features: Whimsical mythological scenes in wild woodland, satyrs, centaurs and early humans among naturalistic beasts and birds, soft atmospheric light, warm earthy oil tones, long horizontal panels, detailed plants and smoke.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Sofonisba Anguissola
styles.features: Intimate oil portraits of family members, children and court sitters, soft modelling, direct lively expressions, plain dark backgrounds, black dress with white lace ruffs, chessboards, books and instruments as props, warm muted palette.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Jan van Eyck
styles.features: Glossy transparent oil glazes, microscopic detail of brocade, fur, metal and jewels, reflections in convex mirrors and armour, saturated red and green, crisp window light, deep interiors with tiled floors, fully modelled faces.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Robert Campin
styles.features: Cramped domestic interiors packed with benches, brass pots, towels, candles and books, steeply tilted floors, heavy angular cloth folds, solid weighty figures, sharp shadows, window views onto a busy town, saturated colour.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Rogier van der Weyden
styles.features: Elongated emotional figures with long delicate fingers, sharp crisp drapery folds, shallow frieze-like space or gold ground, pale porcelain faces with restrained grief and tears, intense red, blue and white, linear precision.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Dieric Bouts
styles.features: Tall slender stiff figures with long sober faces, still poses, deep landscapes of soft green hills and winding paths toward a luminous horizon, ordered interiors with tiled floors, quiet muted palette, clear light.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Hugo van der Goes
styles.features: Large panels with rough-featured peasant faces beside angels in heavy brocade, deliberately varied figure scale, still life of flowers in glass and ceramic vessels, cool wintry landscapes, intense expressions, deep reds, greens and sombre greys.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Hans Memling
styles.features: Calm symmetrical compositions, smooth enamel-like finish, serene pale faces, oriental carpets, rich velvet and gold, gentle landscapes with swans, mills and castles, soft even light, polished detail.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Geertgen tot Sint Jans
styles.features: Doll-like figures with round egg-shaped heads and small mouths, intimate night scenes glowing from a central light, deep green landscapes dotted with tiny trees, deer and figures, simple quiet geometry, tender mood.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Hieronymus Bosch
styles.features: Teeming panoramas of tiny pale nude figures, hybrid creatures and fantastic machines, giant fruits, birds and glass spheres, burning night skies, pastel pink and blue structures, thin fluid paint over a light ground.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters
styles.note: tends toward grotesque and infernal imagery; request a lighter scene if needed

styles.name: Joachim Patinir
styles.features: Vast bird's-eye world landscapes with fantastic towering rocks, winding rivers and ships, tiny figures, strong colour layering of brown foreground, green middle ground and blue distance, high horizon, villages, dramatic sky.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Quentin Matsys
styles.features: Half-length figures at tables with coins, scales, books and convex mirrors, exact still-life detail, sharp characterful or caricatured faces, smooth glazes, rich fur and velvet, warm interior light.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Jan Gossaert
styles.features: Polished sculptural figures set in elaborate hybrid Gothic-Renaissance architecture, marble columns and ornate niches, glossy metallic surfaces, crisp detail, cool enamel colour, classical motifs with Flemish precision.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Lucas van Leyden
styles.features: Fine silvery engraved lines, crowded genre scenes of townsfolk, pedlars and card players, wide landscape vistas with small figures, expressive everyday faces, subtle tonal gradation from delicate hatching.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Pieter Aertsen
styles.features: Large market and kitchen scenes with heaped meat, cabbages, fish, bread and pots across the foreground, robust vendors and cooks, small background scenes, earthy browns, reds and greens, frank tactile texture.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Catharina van Hemessen
styles.features: Small sober half-length portraits against plain dark or greenish grounds, soft precise modelling, black dress with white collars and caps, quiet gaze, careful hands holding instruments, brushes or prayer books.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Simon Bening
styles.medium: tempera and gold on vellum (manuscript illumination)
styles.features: Miniature calendar scenes of village life through the seasons—snowy streets, harvest fields, skating—deep atmospheric perspective fading to soft blue, tiny lively figures, delicate stippled colour, illusionistic flower borders.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Pieter Bruegel the Elder
styles.features: High-viewpoint panoramas of peasant villages and seasonal landscapes, many small chunky figures in rounded clothes working, dancing and playing, snow and bare trees, earthy browns, greens and whites, clear outlines, encyclopedic detail.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Konrad Witz
styles.features: Stocky doll-like figures in heavy angular drapery, strong cast shadows, reflective water and polished armour, recognisable lakeside landscape with mountains and boats, saturated reds, clear daylight.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Martin Schongauer
styles.features: Crisp black-and-white engraving, fine curved parallel and cross-hatching, crumpled angular drapery, spiky Gothic thistles and twisted trees, scaly spiny demons, elegant slender figures on white paper.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Michael Pacher
styles.medium: oil and tempera on panel; carved altarpieces
styles.features: Steep plunging perspective in Gothic vaulted halls, figures set deep in sharply receding architecture, bright alpine colour, carved-altar sharpness, tall pinnacled canopies, strong light, Italian foreshortening joined to Gothic detail.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Albrecht Dürer
styles.medium: engraving, woodcut, watercolour, oil on panel
styles.features: Sharp precise line, dense hatching that models form, meticulous fur, grass and feathers, frontal self-assured portraits, crisp landscapes with castles and alpine rocks, clear contours, sober earth colours.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Matthias Grünewald
styles.features: Intense expressive colour, contorted pitted bodies, twisted splayed fingers, glowing haloes of yellow, orange and red against black night, tattered drapery, vivid green and scarlet, raw emotional distortion.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters
styles.note: imagery often harrowing; soften for general use

styles.name: Lucas Cranach the Elder
styles.features: Slender pale figures with small heads and narrow shoulders against black or dark green grounds, transparent veils, flat decorative contours, almond eyes, crisp portraits in black and red, forests with deer and hunters.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Albrecht Altdorfer
styles.features: Dense dark forests with hanging moss and feathery larches, tiny figures swallowed by trees, dramatic glowing sunsets, swirling skies over vast battle panoramas, warm golden light, sparkling highlights.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Hans Baldung Grien
styles.features: Eerie scenes of witches and death figures, pale nudes with flowing hair, macabre skeletons, high-contrast woodcuts printed in tone blocks, sinuous line, acid greens and pallid flesh against black.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters
styles.note: macabre and nude themes; adapt mood

styles.name: Hans Holbein the Younger
styles.features: Exact cool portraits with smooth enamel finish, sitters in black and fur against flat blue or green backgrounds, precise still life of instruments, books and textiles, sharp light, calm detached realism.
styles.section: Early Renaissance and Northern Renaissance painters

styles.name: Leonardo da Vinci
styles.features: Sfumato edges dissolving into smoky shadow, pyramidal figure groups, soft half-smiles, hazy blue-green rocky distances in aerial perspective, muted ochre, umber and olive palette, finely curling hair, thin translucent glazes.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Raphael
styles.features: Clear even light, balanced pyramidal groups, idealised oval faces with calm expressions, smoothly blended flesh, pure saturated red, blue and green, open airy landscapes or symmetrical classical architecture with coffered vaults.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Michelangelo Buonarroti
styles.features: Massive twisting muscular figures modelled like sculpture, strong contrapposto and steep foreshortening, shot colours shifting from pink to green, firm clean contours, bare backgrounds or painted stone architectural frames, crowded tumbling bodies.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Many nudes; specify drapery if needed.

styles.name: Andrea del Sarto
styles.features: Soft smoky modelling, warm muted harmonies of rose, dull gold and slate blue, dignified figures in heavy deeply folded drapery, restrained gestures, shallow niches or simple settings, stable pyramidal compositions.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Fra Bartolomeo
styles.features: Monumental symmetrical groups beneath arches, broad simplified drapery with deep sculptural folds, dark shadowed backgrounds, solemn still figures, deep red and blue garments, strong chiaroscuro and grave balanced spacing.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Mostly devotional altarpieces.

styles.name: Bernardino Luini
styles.features: Leonardo-like soft shading, gentle oval faces with downcast eyes and faint smiles, pale porcelain skin, calm uncluttered compositions, dark backgrounds or pastoral Lombard landscapes, tender subdued colour.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Correggio
styles.features: Melting soft flesh in golden luminous light, swirling cloud-filled domes with figures seen from directly below, playful putti, tender expressions, warm amber and pearly tones, steep upward foreshortening.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Giorgione
styles.features: Poetic pastoral landscapes under storm or evening light, quiet enigmatic figures blending into nature, velvety shadows without hard outlines, warm golden-green palette, luminous skies, still dreamlike mood.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Titian
styles.features: Form built in loose broken colour, glowing warm flesh, rich crimson, ultramarine and gold, deep warm shadows, dynamic diagonal compositions, textured fabrics, later works with smeared flickering impasto and dissolving edges.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Cima da Conegliano
styles.features: Crystalline cool daylight, detailed hilly Veneto landscapes with castles and trees, sharply defined calm figures, marble architecture, clear blues, reds and silvery greens, precise contours, tranquil symmetry.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Palma Vecchio
styles.features: Full-figured blonde women with soft rounded forms, broad horizontal groups seated in open landscape, warm golden flesh, rich blue, red and white garments, relaxed pastoral mood, gently blended brushwork.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Lorenzo Lotto
styles.features: Restless portraits with uneasy expressions, sharp cool light, acid greens, lilac and bright red, small symbolic details such as lizards, petals and keys, asymmetric compositions, crisp folded drapery.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Sebastiano del Piombo
styles.features: Massive sculptural figures with dark warm Venetian colouring, deep shadowy backgrounds and nocturnal skies, solid heavy drapery, sombre olive, crimson and brown, grave half-length portraits.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Giovanni Girolamo Savoldo
styles.features: Silvery satin draperies gleaming in cool light, dusky twilight and night scenes lit by lamp or fire glow, contemplative half-length figures, muted greys, blues and warm flesh, sober Lombard realism.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Dosso Dossi
styles.features: Fantastical mythological scenes in dense wooded landscapes, glowing jewel colours, flickering light through foliage, exotic costumes and turbans, whimsical magical figures, loose atmospheric brushwork.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Tintoretto
styles.features: Steep diagonal recession, lightning-like flickering highlights on dark grounds, elongated muscular figures in violent foreshortening, rapid summary brushwork, deep shadows, theatrical crowds and figures flying overhead.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Paolo Veronese
styles.features: Sumptuous banquets on marble terraces with colonnades, crowds in silk and brocade, silvery cool light, pale blue, rose, sage green and gold, clear daylight skies, dogs, servants and musicians.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Jacopo Bassano
styles.features: Rustic pastoral scenes crowded with peasants, cattle, sheep, dogs and copper pots, nocturnal glow with sparkling highlights, loose dabbed brushwork, earthy browns and deep reds, mountainous backgrounds.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Giovanni Battista Moroni
styles.features: Sober full- and half-length portraits of tradespeople and nobles, plain grey walls, cool silvery light, precise everyday realism, black, grey and muted earth tones, calm direct gaze.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Jacopo Pontormo
styles.features: Weightless elongated figures crowding without firm ground, acid pink, pale lemon, sky blue and lime green, anxious wide eyes, swirling interlocking poses, ambiguous shallow space, flat bright light.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Rosso Fiorentino
styles.features: Angular figures with faceted chiselled planes, sharp hatched shadows, harsh flaring orange, red and acid green, agitated crowded compositions, mask-like grimacing faces, jagged drapery folds.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Agnolo Bronzino
styles.features: Enamel-smooth porcelain flesh, cool aloof portraits in stiff elegant poses, sharp contours, deep ultramarine, black and crimson silks, polished marble-like surfaces, precise jewellery and lace, cold even light.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Parmigianino
styles.features: Extremely elongated figures with long necks, small heads and tapering fingers, silky fluid drapery, pearly pale flesh, muted rose, olive and grey, slightly distorted space, poised courtly gestures.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Domenico Beccafumi
styles.medium: oil on panel, inlaid marble pavement
styles.features: Flickering unreal light, shimmering iridescent colours against glowing golden voids, ghostly elongated figures, dissolving contours, dramatic contrasts of fiery light and deep shadow.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Giulio Romano
styles.features: Illusionistic painted rooms, colossal muscular giants tumbling among collapsing columns and rocks, bold sculptural forms, robust brick reds and earth tones, painted classical columns, rustication and coffered ceilings.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Federico Barocci
styles.features: Soft pastel colouring of pink, peach, pale blue and lemon, feathery blended brushwork, gently flushed faces, diagonal flowing compositions, hazy pastel-like edges, luminous sweet light.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Lavinia Fontana
styles.features: Detailed portraits of women in richly embroidered gowns with pearls and lace, small pet dogs and jewellery, warm red and gold fabrics, smooth finish, also mythological scenes in soft light.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Vincenzo Campi
styles.features: Large market and kitchen scenes heaped with fish, poultry, fruit and vegetables, robust smiling vendors close to the viewer, earthy browns with vivid produce colours, strong daylight, detailed textures.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Fede Galizia
styles.features: Quiet still lifes of a single bowl of fruit on a stone ledge, sharp raking light, dark plain background, precise fruit, leaves and small insects, restrained cool palette, calm symmetrical arrangement.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Jacopo Ligozzi
styles.features: Scientific studies of plants, birds, fish and insects, precise outlines, delicate naturalistic colour, single specimen isolated on a pale ground, minute textural detail of feathers, scales and petals.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Giuseppe Arcimboldo
styles.features: Composite profile heads assembled from fruits, vegetables, flowers, fish, books or tools, meticulous detail of each object, dark plain backgrounds, rich natural colours, faces readable both as portrait and as heap.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Giambologna
styles.features: Spiralling serpentine figures meant to be seen from all sides, elongated smooth polished bodies, twisting multi-figure groups, glossy dark bronze patina or white marble, upward movement, precise anatomy.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Sculptural look; frame as statue or bronze statuette.

styles.name: El Greco
styles.features: Flame-like elongated figures, flickering white highlights, acid green, sulphur yellow, carmine and cold blue, stormy grey skies, upward-surging compositions, distorted space, loose rapid brushwork.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Luis de Morales
styles.features: Intimate half-length figures with emaciated elongated features, sorrowful faces with glassy tears, smooth enamel finish, dark backgrounds, thin delicate hands, translucent pale flesh and fine wispy hair.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Mostly devotional subjects.

styles.name: School of Fontainebleau
styles.medium: fresco, stucco relief and oil on panel
styles.features: Elongated pale nymphs with small heads and long limbs, stucco strapwork frames with garlands, cool porcelain flesh, mythological and hunting scenes, muted silvery greens and blues, poised courtly gestures.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Frequent nudity; specify drapery if needed.

styles.name: Bartholomeus Spranger
styles.features: Sinuous mythological figures in twisting poses, porcelain flesh with pink highlights, dense intertwined groups, small sharp details, polished enamel-like surface, dark wooded settings.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Often nude and sensual; specify clothing.

styles.name: Hendrick Goltzius
styles.features: Swelling and tapering burin lines, hatching and cross-hatching building bulging muscular forms, exaggerated anatomy, dramatic foreshortened figures, dot-and-lozenge flesh modelling, black ink on white only.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Cornelis Cornelisz. van Haarlem
styles.features: Large mythological and biblical scenes of muscular figures in contorted poses, exaggerated anatomy, strong side lighting, cool pinkish flesh, foreground figures pressed against the picture plane.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Many nudes; specify drapery if needed.

styles.name: Antwerp Mannerism
styles.features: Crowded scenes with fluttering ornate costumes and exotic turbans, elongated twisting figures, fantastical ruined Gothic-Renaissance architecture, bright jewel colours, restless decorative detail.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Nicholas Hilliard
styles.features: Tiny oval portraits, flat bright blue backgrounds, delicate linear faces with little shadow, minutely detailed lace ruffs, pearls and jewels, Elizabethan costume, small gold inscriptions.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting
styles.note: Very small format; works best for single portraits.

styles.name: Italian chiaroscuro woodcut (Ugo da Carpi)
styles.medium: colour woodcut from several tone blocks on paper
styles.features: Key block with two or three tone blocks, layered monochrome tones of ochre, green or grey-blue, white highlights left as uncut paper, bold cut outlines, sculptural figures, strong light-dark contrast.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Marcantonio Raimondi
styles.features: Classical idealised figures, regular parallel hatching and cross-hatching, clear firm contours, blank or simple architectural backgrounds, black ink on white paper, calm balanced groups.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Domenico Campagnola
styles.medium: pen and brown ink on paper, woodcut
styles.features: Pastoral landscapes in pen, dense looping scribbled hatching for foliage, farmsteads, rocky hills and distant villages, small shepherds and travellers, brown ink on cream paper, sky left blank.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Italian istoriato maiolica, Urbino
styles.features: Narrative scenes covering the whole plate, opaque white glaze, bright cobalt blue, yellow, orange, green and manganese brown, small classical figures in landscapes, blue outlines, glossy ceramic sheen.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Limoges painted enamel
styles.features: Glossy vitreous surface on copper, white grisaille figures on black ground or brilliant translucent blue, green and turquoise, gold hatched highlights, mythological scenes on plates and caskets, slightly raised enamel layers.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Florentine sgraffito façade decoration
styles.medium: incised lime plaster on building façades
styles.features: Two-tone plaster with white top layer scratched to reveal grey beneath, grotesques, putti, garlands, classical figures and strapwork covering façades, flat graphic monochrome look, crisp scratched lines.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Renaissance grotesque wall decoration (Vatican Loggia type)
styles.medium: fresco and stucco on walls and vaults
styles.features: White or pale grounds, airy symmetrical vertical candelabra of hybrid creatures, sphinxes, vines, masks, birds and tiny landscapes, thin delicate lines, light red, ochre, green and blue, low stucco frames.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Florentine pietra dura (commesso)
styles.medium: inlaid hard stones on black marble
styles.features: Precisely cut polished semi-precious stones fitted seamlessly, flowers, birds, fruit and landscapes on glossy black ground, natural stone veining used as shading, lapis blue, jasper red, agate and chalcedony.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Italian Renaissance wood intarsia
styles.features: Pictures built from cut pieces of light and dark woods, illusionistic cupboards with open doors, books, instruments and geometric solids, strict linear perspective of city views, honey, brown and black tones, visible grain.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Brussels Renaissance tapestry
styles.medium: wool and silk tapestry with gold thread
styles.features: Visible woven texture, large multi-figure narrative scenes, wide borders of fruit, flowers and allegorical figures, rich red, blue, green and gold thread, dense foliage foregrounds, figures in classical costume.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Alonso Sánchez Coello
styles.features: Formal court portraits in stiff upright standing poses, black and silver costumes with high ruffs, pale detailed faces, dark plain backgrounds with curtain or chair, precise jewels, gloves and embroidery.
styles.section: High Renaissance, Mannerism and Venetian painting

styles.name: Caravaggio
styles.features: Dramatic tenebrism: figures emerge from a flat black background under a single raking light from upper left; earthy ochres, deep reds, creamy flesh; ordinary street models with dirty feet, half-length figures pressed close to the picture plane.

styles.name: Artemisia Gentileschi
styles.features: Strong raking light on powerful, muscular women in action against deep dark grounds; saturated golds, crimson and ultramarine satins with crisp folds; physical effort rendered close up; solid, sculptural flesh.
styles.note: Her best-known scenes are violent; keep the subject non-graphic.

styles.name: Orazio Gentileschi
styles.features: Cool silvery daylight instead of deep shadow; large luminous expanses of drapery in apricot, lemon yellow and pale blue silk; calm graceful figures; smooth porcelain finish; simple plain backgrounds.

styles.name: Annibale Carracci
styles.features: Idealised classical figures with firm drawing in balanced pyramidal groups, clear even light, warm Venetian colour; ceilings framed by painted fictive stucco, bronze-coloured medallions and nude caryatids; serene ideal landscapes with small figures.

styles.name: Guido Reni
styles.features: Pale silvery palette of pearl grey, lilac, light blue and rose; elegant elongated figures with upturned eyes; smooth porcelain flesh; fluttering drapery; clear even light; idealised serene faces.

styles.name: Guercino
styles.features: Broken, patchy light and deep brown shadows sweeping across figures; loose fluid brushwork; warm russet, olive and blue tones; fleshy naturalistic types with lively gestures; soft atmospheric skies behind half-shadowed faces.

styles.name: Pietro da Cortona
styles.features: Vast ceiling frescoes swarming with airborne figures on clouds; painted gilded frames and garlands; open golden sky; warm luminous colour; overlapping crowds spilling across fictive architecture in sweeping diagonal movement.

styles.name: Andrea Pozzo
styles.features: Painted columns, arches and cornices rising in strict one-point perspective seen from directly below, opening onto a bright sky filled with steeply foreshortened floating figures; fictive architecture seamlessly continues the real building.

styles.name: Salvator Rosa
styles.features: Wild rugged landscapes of jagged rocks, blasted tree stumps and stormy skies; brown and slate-grey palette with sudden flashes of light; small bandits, soldiers or hermits among crags; vigorous dashed brushwork.

styles.name: Luca Giordano
styles.features: Rapid fluent brushwork; luminous pastel blues, pinks and golds; vast compositions with dozens of swirling figures among clouds; soft atmospheric glow; sketch-like vivacity spread across huge surfaces.

styles.name: Bernardo Strozzi
styles.features: Thick creamy impasto laid in broad loaded strokes; warm rosy flesh; glowing reds and golds; robust plebeian figures such as cooks among heaps of fish, poultry and copper pans; lively textured paint surface.

styles.name: Elisabetta Sirani
styles.features: Soft Reni-derived modelling with deeper chiaroscuro; rapid fluid brushwork; half-length heroines and sibyls in turbans and loose drapery; warm subdued palette; quiet introspective faces lit from one side.

styles.name: Giovanna Garzoni
styles.features: Fine stippled tempera on pale vellum: fruits, vegetables and flowers in shallow porcelain dishes isolated on a bare cream ground, often with a small bird, snail or insect beside them; precise botanical detail; soft clear colour.

styles.name: Evaristo Baschenis
styles.features: Lutes, violins and mandolins stacked on tables draped with Turkish carpets or green velvet; curved instrument bodies in steep foreshortening; fine dust on wood; cool grey-brown light; dark plain background; geometric clarity.

styles.name: Giuseppe Recco
styles.features: Glistening heaps of fish, octopus, shellfish and copper pots on dark rocky ledges by the shore; deep shadow; wet silvery highlights; warm brown and coral tones; naturalistic single-source lighting.

styles.name: Monsù Desiderio
styles.features: Fantastic nocturnal architecture: towering Gothic and classical ruins, collapsing churches and colonnades picked out in pale ghostly highlights against black sky; tiny flickering figures; brittle linear detail; eerie greenish-brown tones.
styles.note: Pseudonym chiefly for François de Nomé, a Lorraine-born painter in Naples.

styles.name: Micco Spadaro (Domenico Gargiulo)
styles.features: Wide Neapolitan squares and streets seen from slightly above; hundreds of tiny animated figures set down in quick touches; pale buildings; hazy golden-grey sky; documentary panoramas of processions, markets and public events.

styles.name: Sassoferrato
styles.features: Smooth enamel-like finish; intense pure ultramarine mantles against white veils and rose gowns; gentle oval faces with lowered eyes; crisp sharp contours; plain dark background; quiet half-length devotional figures.

styles.name: Bamboccianti genre painting, Rome
styles.medium: oil on canvas and copper, small format
styles.features: Small cabinet scenes of Roman street life: beggars, peddlers, card players, horsemen and innkeepers among ancient ruins, arches and taverns; warm brown tonality; low earthy palette; chunky small figures in daylight.
styles.note: Group included Netherlandish and Italian painters active in Rome.

styles.name: Domenico Fetti
styles.features: Small narrative panels with loose, sparkling Venetian brushwork; rich warm colour; homely everyday-looking figures set in landscapes or simple interiors; flickering highlights on creamy, thickly handled paint.

styles.name: Alessandro Magnasco
styles.features: Nervous flickering brushstrokes; elongated wraith-like figures of monks, gypsies and soldiers in gloomy ruins, refectories or stormy landscapes; dark brown-green grounds slashed with flashes of white highlight.

styles.name: Diego Velázquez
styles.features: Loose, economical brushstrokes that resolve only at a distance; silvery grey-brown atmosphere; airy undefined backgrounds; black costumes with flicks of white and rose; direct natural poses; sober restrained palette.

styles.name: Francisco de Zurbarán
styles.features: Monumental still figures in heavy white habits with crisp sculptural folds against a dark void; hard clear light; meticulous textures of wool and earthenware; sparse still lifes of cups, fruit and jars lined up on a ledge.

styles.name: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo
styles.features: Soft vaporous modelling with feathery dissolving edges; warm golden-brown haze; tender rounded faces; ragged street children eating fruit; gentle pinks and blues in luminous clouds.

styles.name: Jusepe de Ribera
styles.features: Harsh single-source light on wrinkled weathered skin of old men and beggars; thick textured impasto describing every crease; dark brown grounds; uncompromising naturalism; half-length figures close to the viewer.
styles.note: Often painted martyrdoms; avoid gore.

styles.name: Juan Sánchez Cotán
styles.features: Geometric bodegón: a few vegetables and fruits, some hanging on strings, set in a stone window niche against pitch-black void; cold sharp light; extreme stillness and precision; sparse curving arrangement.

styles.name: Juan van der Hamen
styles.features: Stepped stone ledges of differing heights carrying glass vessels, pottery, boxes of sweets and fruit baskets; strong side light against dark ground; symmetrical tiered arrangement; crisp detailed surfaces.

styles.name: Juan de Valdés Leal
styles.features: Turbulent vanitas: skulls, crowns, books, armour and guttering candles in dim brownish gloom; nervous flickering brushwork; sudden streaks of light; agitated twisting forms.
styles.note: Macabre imagery; tone down for a general audience.

styles.name: Antonio de Pereda
styles.features: Vanitas tables crowded with clocks, armour, skulls, coins, playing cards and extinguished candles; deep reds and golds; polished metallic sheen; meticulous textures against a dark background.

styles.name: Juan Carreño de Miranda
styles.features: Full-length court figures in sombre black or rich brocade standing in dim palace rooms with red curtains, mirrors and consoles; loose Velázquez-derived brushwork; melancholic silvery tones.

styles.name: Josefa de Óbidos
styles.features: Densely packed still lifes of cakes, sweets, pottery, fruit and flowers on dark ledges; soft warm light; small devotional figures framed by flower garlands; glowing reds and golds; naive, tender charm.
styles.note: Seville-born, active in Portugal.

styles.name: Georges de La Tour
styles.features: A single candle flame lights still figures in darkness; geometric simplified volumes; smooth abstracted faces; warm red and amber glow; hands turning translucent against the light; hushed nocturnal interiors.

styles.name: Nicolas Poussin
styles.features: Frieze-like arrangement of statuesque classical figures in clear daylight; measured gestures; strong blues, reds and yellows; structured landscapes with temples, trees and distant hills; rational balanced geometry.

styles.name: Claude Lorrain
styles.features: Golden hazy light from a low sun on the horizon; framing dark trees; classical ruins and harbour palaces; receding planes of luminous atmosphere; small pastoral figures; calm seas and pale sky.

styles.name: Le Nain brothers
styles.features: Sober peasant families seated or standing motionless, facing the viewer in bare interiors or open fields; muted grey, brown and earth tones; grave dignified faces; quiet even light; minimal action.

styles.name: Philippe de Champaigne
styles.features: Austere clarity; sharp crisp drawing; cool restrained light; red cardinal robes and black or white habits; smooth surfaces; calm frontal or profile poses; minimal settings of stone and plain wall.

styles.name: Simon Vouet
styles.features: Graceful full-bodied figures in bright clear colour—sky blue, rose, gold; soft blond light; swirling silks; decorative ease; allegorical women with pearly complexions and gentle gestures.

styles.name: Charles Le Brun
styles.features: Grand decorative allegory: crowded ceiling compartments framed by gilded stucco; triumphant heroic figures; codified facial expressions of emotion; rich golds and deep blues; ordered, ceremonial compositions.

styles.name: Valentin de Boulogne
styles.features: Taverns and concerts by lamplight: soldiers, gypsies and musicians crowded round tables; deep shadow; melancholy introspective faces; warm reddish browns; dense half-length grouping close to the viewer.

styles.name: Jacques Callot
styles.features: Fine etched lines that swell and taper; hundreds of tiny spindly figures in fairs, sieges and processions; dark silhouetted figures in the foreground; wiry beggars and grotesque comic actors; wide shallow panoramas.

styles.name: Louise Moillon
styles.features: Baskets and dishes of apricots, plums, grapes and cherries on a bare wooden table; plain dark-brown ground; soft even light; velvety bloom on fruit skins; restrained, nearly symmetrical arrangement.

styles.name: Lubin Baugin
styles.features: Spare geometric still life: a few wafers, a glass of wine, a straw-covered flask and a checkerboard on the edge of a table; muted grey-brown palette; quiet cool light; austere stillness.

styles.name: Abraham Bosse
styles.features: Crisp even hatching and burin-like lines; elegant Parisian interiors and shops with men in lace collars and women in silk gowns; careful one-point perspective rooms; tables, tapestries and windows rendered precisely.

styles.name: Hyacinthe Rigaud
styles.features: Grand state portraits: figure in billowing ermine-lined velvet, cascading curled wig, heavy crimson curtains and columns; glittering silks and lace; assertive pose; lavish fabric textures.

styles.name: Peter Paul Rubens
styles.features: Exuberant swirling diagonals; fleshy pink-and-pearl bodies with bluish shadows; fluid translucent brushwork; glowing reds and golds; crowded energetic compositions; broad landscapes with rainbows and sunset light.

styles.name: Anthony van Dyck
styles.features: Elegant elongated aristocratic sitters with slender hands; shimmering silks and lace; fluent silvery brushwork; column-and-curtain backdrops opening onto sky; relaxed nonchalant poses.

styles.name: Jacob Jordaens
styles.features: Boisterous feasts of ruddy plump peasants and burghers crowded round tables; earthy warm reds and ochres; heavy rustic bodies; thick lively paint; cramped close-up groups filling the frame.

styles.name: Frans Snyders
styles.features: Huge market-stall and pantry pieces piled with game, fish, fruit and vegetables; live dogs and cats snatching food; vivid reds and greens; energetic broad brushwork; animal hunts in violent motion.

styles.name: Jan Brueghel the Elder
styles.features: Tiny jewel-like brushstrokes on copper; crowded bouquets of many flower species; paradise landscapes teeming with animals; receding blue distances; enamel-bright colour; meticulous miniature detail.

styles.name: Clara Peeters
styles.features: Laid tables of cheeses, bread, pretzels, gilded goblets and knives seen from slightly above; tiny reflected self-portraits in polished metal; dark plain backgrounds; cool exact light; precise tactile textures.

styles.name: Adriaen Brouwer
styles.features: Small panels of rowdy peasants in smoky taverns, brawling, smoking and drinking; fluid economical brushwork; dim brownish-green atmosphere; grimacing caricatured faces.

styles.name: David Teniers the Younger
styles.features: Silvery tonality; peasants dancing at village fairs and gathered at tavern doors; alchemists and monkeys in cluttered kitchens; sparkling small touches; clear airy village settings with many lively figures.

styles.name: Daniel Seghers
styles.features: Garlands of finely detailed flowers and leaves framing a stone-coloured grisaille cartouche; intense jewel-like colours against a dark ground; crisp petals; occasional butterflies and insects.

styles.name: Jan Fyt
styles.features: Dead hares, partridges and peacocks with soft feathers and fur in sumptuous loose brushwork; live hounds; warm golden-brown palette; dark landscape backgrounds; rich tactile textures.

styles.name: Antwerp gallery painting (Kunstkammer pictures)
styles.features: Interior walls hung floor to ceiling with tiny painted pictures; tables crowded with shells, coins, globes, statuettes and instruments; connoisseurs in black; precise miniature detail; receding tiled floors.
styles.note: Practised by Frans Francken the Younger, Willem van Haecht and others.

styles.name: Michaelina Wautier
styles.features: Robust naturalistic figures with strong modelling; ruddy children and youths; frank direct portraits; rich warm palette; loose confident brushwork; densely grouped figures in procession or celebration.

styles.name: Jan van Kessel the Elder
styles.features: Insects, butterflies, caterpillars, shells and small flowers scattered on pale grounds like specimen sheets; tiny precise brushwork; fresh bright colour; each creature isolated with a small cast shadow.

styles.name: Joos de Momper
styles.features: Fantastic panoramic mountain landscapes in three colour zones—brown foreground, green middle ground, blue distance; jagged rocks; winding paths; quick feathery brushwork; tiny travellers and riders.

styles.name: Jacob van Ruisdael
styles.features: Towering grey-white cumulus skies over low horizons; dark gnarled oaks, rushing waterfalls, dunes and windmills; heavy brown-green earth tones; shafts of sunlight crossing fields; thick textured foliage; tiny figures dwarfed by nature

styles.name: Meindert Hobbema
styles.features: Sunlit wooded landscapes with watermills and cottages under clustered trees; sandy tracks and tree-lined avenues receding to a central vanishing point; feathery dabbed foliage in olive and warm green; luminous blue sky; small strolling figures

styles.name: Jan van Goyen
styles.features: Near-monochrome tonal river and dune views in brown, ochre and grey-green; thin, fluid, sketchy brushwork; vast pale cloudy sky filling two thirds of the picture; low horizon; small boats, ferries, fishermen and church spires as silhouettes

styles.name: Salomon van Ruysdael
styles.features: River landscapes with a diagonal tree-lined bank receding into the distance; ferries crowded with cattle and passengers; feathery trees; calm reflecting water; silvery grey-green atmosphere and soft blue sky, warmer golden tones in later works

styles.name: Aelbert Cuyp
styles.features: Warm golden afternoon light bathing rivers and meadows; cows standing on riverbanks seen from a low viewpoint; hazy yellow-orange sky; glowing rim-lit outlines; calm water with sailing boats; soft atmospheric distance

styles.name: Hercules Segers
styles.medium: etching printed in coloured inks on tinted paper or cloth
styles.features: Strange rocky mountain valleys and barren plateaux; dense networks of tiny dotted and scratched lines; prints in green, blue or brown ink on coloured grounds, sometimes hand-touched with paint; eerie empty vastness; every impression differs
styles.note: experimental printmaker; impressions vary strongly in colour

styles.name: Philips Koninck
styles.features: Vast panoramic flat countryside seen from a high viewpoint; horizon near mid-height; alternating bands of sunlit and shadowed fields in browns and greens; winding rivers and roads; tiny farms and towns; enormous cloud-streaked sky

styles.name: Hendrick Avercamp
styles.features: Frozen rivers crowded with skaters, sledges, kolf players and townsfolk in colourful clothes; high horizon; pale pearl-grey wintry sky; bare trees; small figures fading into haze; precise anecdotal detail of everyday winter pastimes

styles.name: Aert van der Neer
styles.features: Moonlit rivers and canals with a silvery moon reflected in water between dark silhouetted trees and houses; also snowy winter scenes; warm brown and cool blue palette; glowing cloud edges; tiny figures

styles.name: Jan Both
styles.features: Italianate landscapes in golden southern evening light; tall trees framing a hazy valley; travellers with mules on dusty paths; warm amber and olive palette; rocky outcrops and distant blue mountains; soft atmospheric depth

styles.name: Paulus Potter
styles.features: Low-viewpoint pastures with cattle, sheep and goats painted with careful anatomical detail; bright even daylight; flat meadows and low horizon; crisp textures of hide, wool and grass; herders small beside the animals

styles.name: Adriaen van de Velde
styles.features: Bright beach scenes with strolling figures, carriages and tide pools; wide pale sky; soft sandy beige and clear blue palette; sunny pastures with resting cattle; delicate clear light and crisp small figures

styles.name: Allart van Everdingen
styles.features: Scandinavian wilderness: roaring waterfalls, fir forests, rocky gorges, log cabins and timber sawmills; dark greens, slate greys and white foam; stormy skies; rugged mountain terrain; small figures
styles.note: Dutch painter of Swedish and Norwegian scenery from his travels

styles.name: Frans Post
styles.features: Flat open Brazilian landscapes with sugar mills, chapels, palms, papaya trees and cacti; low horizon; clear pale sky; greens and ochres; meticulous foreground plants and animals; tiny figures in the middle ground
styles.note: colonial plantation imagery; avoid uncritical depiction of enslaved labour

styles.name: Johannes Vermeer
styles.features: Quiet interiors lit by a window on the left; pearly cool daylight; ultramarine blue and lemon yellow; small dotted highlights; tiled floors, wall maps and white plaster walls; single absorbed figures; soft focus; calm geometric composition

styles.name: Gerrit Berckheyde
styles.features: Sunlit town squares and canals with brick houses, town halls and great churches; crisp linear perspective; strong raking sunlight and long shadows; warm ochre and red brick against blue sky; small strolling figures

styles.name: Jan van der Heyden
styles.features: Meticulous townscapes where every brick, roof tile and leaf is rendered; quiet canals and streets; even clear light; muted reds, greys and greens; trees softening architectural lines; few small figures

styles.name: Pieter Saenredam
styles.features: Interiors of whitewashed Gothic churches; pale cream, grey and soft pink; precise measured perspective; tall columns and vaults; bare walls; tiny figures; serene empty space; flat even light

styles.name: Emanuel de Witte
styles.features: Church interiors with dramatic patches of sunlight on columns and floors; deep shadows; asymmetric oblique viewpoints; congregations, dogs and gravediggers; warm browns and creams; soft atmospheric depth

styles.name: Pieter de Hooch
styles.features: Brick courtyards and interiors opening through doorways onto further rooms or sunny streets; black-and-white tiled floors; warm sunlight; maids, mothers and children at chores; red-brown brick; clear receding perspective

styles.name: Gerard ter Borch
styles.features: Small quiet interiors with figures in shimmering silver-white satin gowns; dark neutral backgrounds; restrained greys, blacks and silvery whites with red accents; delicate faces; letters, lutes, mirrors; subdued intimate mood

styles.name: Gabriël Metsu
styles.features: Domestic interiors and market scenes with figures reading letters, tending birds or visiting; smooth fine brushwork; rich reds, blues and fur trims; carefully textured carpets and tableware; soft daylight; anecdotal gestures

styles.name: Gerrit Dou
styles.features: Tiny meticulously smooth panels; figures leaning out of an arched stone window niche; enamel-like surface; candlelight or soft daylight; detailed pots, books, hanging birds and carpets draped over the sill; warm brown tones

styles.name: Godfried Schalcken
styles.features: Small night scenes lit by a single candle; warm orange glow on faces and hands; deep black shadows; smooth porcelain-like finish; figures holding candles, reading or flirting; light glowing through fingers

styles.name: Jan Steen
styles.features: Crowded chaotic household and tavern scenes; merrymaking, overturned jugs, children and animals; lively gestures and comic faces; bright reds, yellows and blues among warm browns; cluttered narrative detail

styles.name: Adriaen van Ostade
styles.features: Peasant interiors and taverns with drinking, smoking and fiddling figures with stubby bodies and round faces; cavernous dim rooms; warm browns and dusky golds; light from a single window; rustic clutter

styles.name: Judith Leyster
styles.features: Lively genre figures caught mid-laugh, musicians and drinkers; loose bravura brushwork; warm earth tones with bright accents; strong side lighting; close half-length framing; some candlelit night scenes

styles.name: Frans Hals
styles.features: Rapid loose slashing brushstrokes visible up close; laughing, animated figures; blacks with many tonal nuances; crisp white collars; warm flesh; plain neutral backgrounds; spontaneous momentary expressions

styles.name: Rembrandt van Rijn
styles.features: Deep golden-brown darkness with figures emerging in warm pools of light; thick impasto in highlights, thin glazes in shadows; aged faces with rich texture; red, gold and umber palette; theatrical chiaroscuro

styles.name: Rembrandt van Rijn, etching and drypoint
styles.features: Free sketchy etched lines; velvety drypoint burr in dense black shadows; large areas left white for light; beggars, biblical scenes, village landscapes and portraits; rich tonal variation from ink left on the plate

styles.name: Nicolaes Maes
styles.features: Domestic interiors with women spinning, praying, sewing or eavesdropping; strong reds and deep blacks; dramatic chiaroscuro; staircases and doorways revealing further rooms; elderly women and children; warm window light

styles.name: Quiringh van Brekelenkam
styles.features: Modest workshop and kitchen interiors: tailors sewing cross-legged on tables, old women by hearths; grey-brown walls; quiet window light; plain clothes and humble tools; muted palette

styles.name: Utrecht Caravaggisti
styles.features: Life-size half-length musicians, drinkers and saints lit by a hidden candle or a single strong beam; dramatic chiaroscuro; ruddy faces; bright reds and yellows; feathered hats and slashed sleeves against dark backgrounds

styles.name: Willem Claesz. Heda
styles.features: Monochrome banquet still life: toppled silver goblets, pewter plates, half-peeled lemon, glass roemer; silvery grey-green and olive tones; folds of white tablecloth; reflections on metal; diagonal composition

styles.name: Pieter Claesz
styles.features: Vanitas and breakfast still lifes on a table: skull, guttered candle, books, pocket watch, quill, overturned glass, bread and herring; restrained brown, ochre and grey palette; soft window light reflected in glass

styles.name: Willem Kalf
styles.features: Lavish still life against deep black backgrounds; Chinese porcelain bowls, nautilus cups, silver-gilt vessels, Persian rugs, peeled lemons; glowing jewel-like colours emerging from shadow

styles.name: Jan Davidsz. de Heem
styles.features: Abundant banquet tables heaped with grapes, peaches, oysters, lobsters, crumpled cloths and gilded cups; bright saturated colours; glossy reflective surfaces; butterflies and insects; dark backgrounds; sweeping diagonals

styles.name: Rachel Ruysch
styles.features: Asymmetric cascading flower bouquets on marble ledges against dark backgrounds; roses, poppies, tulips, morning glory; curling stems; insects, snails and birds' nests; glowing petals rendered with minute botanical precision

styles.name: Maria van Oosterwijck
styles.features: Refined flower and vanitas still lifes; tulips, roses and irises in vases on stone ledges; dark backgrounds; butterflies, beetles, skull or hourglass; crisp petal edges; balanced vertical compositions

styles.name: Ambrosius Bosschaert the Elder
styles.features: Symmetrical dense bouquets in a vase set in a stone window niche with a distant landscape; each flower shown full-face and evenly lit; crisp outlines; bright saturated colours; insects and shells on the ledge

styles.name: Adriaen Coorte
styles.medium: oil on paper mounted on panel
styles.features: Very small still lifes of strawberries, asparagus, gooseberries or shells on a worn stone ledge; dark plain background; single soft beam of light; extreme simplicity; delicate textures

styles.name: Otto Marseus van Schrieck
styles.features: Dark forest-floor scenes: mosses, mushrooms, thistles, snakes, lizards, toads and moths; mysterious black backgrounds; close low viewpoint; cool greens and browns; precise textures of scales and wings

styles.name: Melchior d'Hondecoeter
styles.features: Poultry yards and parks with roosters, hens, peacocks, ducks and exotic birds in lively confrontation; richly textured feathers; classical park architecture behind; warm earthy tones with bright plumage

styles.name: Samuel van Hoogstraten
styles.features: Trompe-l'oeil letter rack: red leather straps nailed to a wooden board holding letters, combs, quills, scissors and small books; shallow space; crisp cast shadows; illusionistic paper, wood and leather textures
styles.note: also painted perspective interiors and peepshow boxes

styles.name: Willem van de Velde the Younger
styles.features: Calm seas with warships and fishing boats; glassy water reflecting sails; luminous silver-grey skies with towering clouds; precise rigging; also naval battles in gunsmoke; low horizon

styles.name: Willem van de Velde the Elder
styles.medium: pen and ink on white-primed panel or canvas (penschilderij)
styles.features: Monochrome pen paintings resembling engravings; fine hatching for waves and clouds; meticulously drawn ship rigging; fleets and naval battles; black ink on cream ground

styles.name: Ludolf Bakhuizen
styles.features: Stormy seas with ships pitching in heavy grey-green waves; churning white foam; dark threatening skies with breaking light; dramatic diagonals; jetties and coastal rocks; cold slate palette

styles.name: Jan van de Cappelle
styles.features: Becalmed estuaries with many sailing ships at anchor; vast luminous cumulus skies; mirror-still water reflecting hulls and sails; soft golden-grey light; quiet silhouettes

styles.name: Hendrick Cornelisz. Vroom
styles.features: Early marine panoramas of fleets and naval battles from a high viewpoint; many colourful ships with flags and pennants; stylised curling greenish-blue waves; detailed rigging; decorative bright palette

styles.name: Reinier Nooms (Zeeman)
styles.features: Crisp etched ships at anchor, under sail or under construction; harbour views; clear outlines with fine hatching; white paper sky; calm water drawn with horizontal lines; precise rigging; sober documentary clarity

styles.name: Delftware (Delft blue faience)
styles.features: Cobalt blue brushwork on glossy white tin glaze; loose outlines and diluted washes; windmills, ships, landscapes, tulips and Chinese-inspired figures; tiles with corner motifs; plates with decorative borders

styles.name: Dutch Golden Age atlas cartography, Blaeu workshop
styles.features: Finely engraved maps with hatched coastlines; ornate cartouches with putti and allegorical figures; sea monsters and ships; compass roses; watercolour washes along borders; Latin lettering

styles.name: Joanna Koerten
styles.features: Intricate white paper cut-outs on black backgrounds; lace-like openwork landscapes, flowers, coats of arms and portraits; fine scissor lines; crisp silhouette shapes; delicate symmetry

styles.name: Anna Roemers Visscher
styles.features: Fine scratched white lines on clear green or colourless roemer glass; flowers, fruit, insects and shells in delicate line and stipple; flowing calligraphic inscriptions; translucent airy look
styles.note: often paired with calligraphic mottos

styles.name: Maria Sibylla Merian
styles.features: Botanical plates showing insects through their life cycles on host plants: caterpillars, chrysalises, butterflies; tropical fruits, frogs and spiders; vivid precise colours; plants spread across a white page; delicate outlines

styles.name: Pieter Janssens Elinga
