styles.features: Quiet interiors with sunlight falling through tall leaded windows onto tiled floors in geometric patches; sparse furniture; women seen from behind; pictures on bare walls; restrained warm palette

styles.name: Gesina ter Borch
styles.medium: watercolour, gouache and pen in albums
styles.features: Album pages with delicate watercolour figures in fashionable dress, courting couples, soldiers and allegories; slightly stiff naive drawing; pale washes; decorative borders and emblematic motifs
styles.note: albums sometimes include handwritten verses

styles.name: Antoine Watteau
styles.features: Small elegant figures in shimmering silks lounging in hazy parkland; feathery trees; soft golden-green atmosphere; flickering brushstrokes on fabric; pale pinks, pearl greys, muted blues; wistful mood under a misty sky.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: François Boucher
styles.features: Plump pink-and-white nudes and cherubs on billowing clouds and blue drapery; candy-pink and powder-blue palette; smooth porcelain flesh; decorative pastoral settings with feathery trees, doves, garlands; airy curving compositions.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
styles.features: Rapid swirling brushstrokes; frothy foliage in golden and green tones; figures in pink and yellow silks on swings or in gardens; light bursting through mist; playful amorous scenes within vast overgrown parks.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Baptiste-Siméon Chardin
styles.features: Quiet still lifes and kitchen scenes; grainy, crumbly paint applied in soft dabs; muted browns, warm greys, creamy whites; a few humble objects such as copper pots, fruit, bread on a stone ledge; diffuse soft light; calm absorbed figures.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Baptiste Greuze
styles.features: Sentimental domestic dramas; families gathered in rustic interiors with theatrical gestures; young girls with moist upturned eyes, flushed cheeks, rumpled white linen; smooth soft modelling; warm brown and ochre palette.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Élisabeth Vigée Le Brun
styles.features: Luminous portraits of women in loose white muslin, gauzy scarves and straw hats; soft rosy complexions and glowing eyes; clear blue sky backgrounds; smooth delicate brushwork; intimate natural poses, mothers embracing children.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Adélaïde Labille-Guiard
styles.features: Formal portraits with crisp detail on satin dresses, lace and feathered hats; clear even light; studio settings with easels and drapery; precise handling; sober warm palette with silvery whites.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Anne Vallayer-Coster
styles.features: Still lifes of flowers, shells, corals, minerals, fruit and game on marble ledges; balanced pyramidal arrangements; smooth enamel-like finish; soft grey-green backgrounds; porcelain, feathers and silver rendered precisely.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
styles.features: Pastel head-and-shoulders portraits; lively faces with sparkling eyes and a half-smile; powdered wigs; velvety blended flesh against crisp strokes on lace and silk; plain blue-grey or neutral backgrounds.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Étienne Liotard
styles.features: Pastel portraits with porcelain-smooth, nearly shadowless faces; bright even daylight; sitters in Turkish or Levantine costume with fur-lined robes; flat pale backgrounds; meticulous detail and almost no visible strokes; crisp still lifes.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Rosalba Carriera
styles.features: Soft pastel portrait busts; misty, powdery, delicately blended flesh; pearls and flowers in powdered hair; pale blue, rose and ivory tones; dreamy allegorical young women; faint undefined background haze.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Hubert Robert
styles.features: Monumental classical ruins with broken colonnades, arches and collapsed vaults; tiny figures washing laundry or sketching; overgrown vegetation; warm golden light under blue-grey skies; loose fluent brushwork; imaginary capriccio mixes of monuments.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Claude-Joseph Vernet
styles.features: Seaports and rocky coasts with sailing ships; storms with crashing waves and shipwrecks, or calm harbours at sunset; fishermen and dockworkers in the foreground; luminous hazy skies; silvery and golden light; soft atmospheric distance.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Baptiste Oudry
styles.features: Hunting dogs, deer, game birds and dead hares; precise fur and feather textures; animals in parkland or hung against pale walls; tapestry-like decorative composition; muted greens, whites and browns.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Baptiste Pillement
styles.medium: pen, gouache and etched ornament designs
styles.features: Whimsical chinoiserie: spindly Chinese-style figures, parasols, pagodas, footbridges and fanciful flowers on curling stems; airy vignettes floating on blank ground; delicate pen line; pastel colours; asymmetric rocaille scrolls.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jacques-Louis David
styles.features: Severe neoclassical compositions; sculptural figures arranged in a frieze-like row; crisp outlines and smooth invisible brushwork; stark raking light against dark plain grounds; Roman arches, helmets, togas; accents of red, white and deep blue.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe
styles.note: Neoclassical history-painting manner

styles.name: Canaletto
styles.features: Panoramic city views; crisp ruler-straight architecture in precise perspective; bright clear daylight with strong cast shadows; sparkling green-blue canal water with gondolas; tiny lively figures flecked with white highlights; luminous blue sky with soft clouds.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Bernardo Bellotto
styles.features: City views of Dresden, Warsaw and Vienna; cooler, steelier light than Venetian views; meticulous architecture, wide squares and river embankments; long dark shadows; dense documentary detail of carts, workmen and market stalls; grey-green skies.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Francesco Guardi
styles.features: Venetian lagoon views with flickering, nervous brushwork; dissolving shimmering architecture; tiny figures as calligraphic squiggles; silver-grey atmosphere and pale turquoise water; loose sketchy capricci of ruins and gondolas.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
styles.features: Ceilings opening into luminous sky; steeply foreshortened figures soaring on clouds; pale blue, gold, rose and white palette; billowing silks and exotic costumes; dramatic upward perspective; ochre architecture framing the edges.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Giovanni Battista Piranesi
styles.features: Dense black etched line; colossal Roman ruins and imaginary vaulted prisons with stairs, bridges and chains; exaggerated scale with tiny figures; deep shadows against white paper; weeds sprouting from cracked masonry.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Pietro Longhi
styles.features: Small intimate Venetian interiors; doll-like figures in white masks, tricorns and cloaks; salons, gaming tables, dancing lessons; muted warm browns and soft greens; shallow stage-like space; gentle satirical observation.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Giovanni Paolo Panini
styles.features: Grand interiors and squares packed with Roman monuments; picture galleries crammed with framed views; warm golden light; crisp architecture; elegant visitors in small groups; soft blue sky over domes and columns.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Gaspar van Wittel
styles.features: Topographical views of Rome and Naples from elevated viewpoints; Netherlandish precision; cool clear light; riverbanks with barges; small carefully drawn figures; wide panoramic format; measured perspective.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Giuseppe Maria Crespi
styles.features: Earthy genre scenes in deep shadowy brown tones; warm light raking across peasants, washerwomen and musicians; soft fluid brushwork; dusty rough everyday interiors; intimate humble realism.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Neapolitan gouache vedute
styles.features: Small opaque views of the Bay of Naples and erupting Vesuvius; saturated blues, glowing red lava, plumes of smoke; tiny tourists and fishermen; neat descriptive detail; frequent night scenes with moonlight.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: William Hogarth
styles.features: Crowded satirical narrative scenes; stage-like interiors full of telling details; exaggerated characterful faces; cross-hatched engraved line or lively oil; moralising episodes set in London taverns, streets and drawing rooms.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Thomas Gainsborough
styles.features: Feathery shimmering brushstrokes; slender elegant figures in silks posed in wooded landscapes; silvery-blue and olive-green palette; soft dissolving foliage; rustic cottage scenes with children.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: George Stubbs
styles.features: Anatomically precise horses and wild animals; sleek glossy coats and tensed muscles; animals in frieze-like profile against plain grounds or quiet parkland; smooth finish; grooms and jockeys; calm balanced composition.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Joseph Wright of Derby
styles.features: Single hidden candle or lamp lighting rapt faces around scientific apparatus or glowing forges; deep surrounding shadow; warm amber glow; moonlit landscapes and erupting volcanoes; precise realism.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Angelica Kauffman
styles.features: Graceful neoclassical myth and history scenes; soft pastel colours; idealised figures in flowing antique draperies; smooth gentle modelling; shallow frieze-like arrangement; decorative oval and roundel formats.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Arthur Devis
styles.features: Conversation pieces: small stiff doll-like figures posed in sparse spacious interiors or tidy parkland; thin precise paint; cool greys and greens; formal family groups; careful furniture and costume detail.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Thomas Rowlandson
styles.features: Flowing curvy pen line with pale watercolour wash; plump bawdy figures, bustling inns, coaching scenes and crowds; caricatured faces; soft pink, blue and ochre tints.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: James Gillray
styles.features: Hand-coloured etched caricatures; grotesquely exaggerated politicians; dense speech balloons and captions; bright watercolour tints; chaotic crowded allegorical compositions.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe
styles.note: Lettering may render as garbled text

styles.name: Paul Sandby
styles.features: Topographical watercolours; clear washes over fine pen outline; castles, country houses, Highland views; neatly drawn trees; small figures going about daily tasks; soft cool blue-green palette.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: John Robert Cozens
styles.features: Melancholic landscapes of Alps and Italian lakes; restrained blue-grey and green washes; vast misty mountains; delicate tonal gradation; tiny figures; subdued poetic light.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: British mezzotint portrait print
styles.features: Velvety tonal print with deep rich blacks and soft gradations, almost no hard lines; portraits translated from oil paintings; glowing faces emerging from darkness; satin sheen on silks.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Francisco Goya, tapestry cartoons
styles.features: Bright cheerful popular scenes; majos and majas at picnics, games and fairs; clear blue skies; light airy colours of sky blue, pink and yellow; simplified decorative forms; outdoor Madrid settings.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe
styles.note: Early tapestry-cartoon manner only, not the dark late works

styles.name: Luis Meléndez
styles.features: Sharply lit still lifes on wooden tables; tightly packed fruit, bread, ceramic jugs, copper pots; dark plain backgrounds; strong sculptural modelling; crisp textures; earthy browns, reds and ochres.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Luis Paret y Alcázar
styles.features: Small sparkling scenes of Madrid shops, gardens and court festivities; delicate jewel-like colour; tiny elegant figures; fine feathery touch; harbour views with ships and quays.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Portuguese azulejo tile panels, 18th century
styles.features: Large blue-and-white glazed tile panels; figures, hunts, gardens and ports painted in cobalt; elaborate scroll borders; visible tile grid; glossy surface; fluent brush drawing with tonal washes.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Bavarian Rococo church decoration, Wessobrunn stucco and fresco
styles.features: Bright white interiors with gilded and pastel stucco scrolls and shell-like rocaille ornament; illusionistic ceilings in pale blue, pink and gold; swirling asymmetry; figures floating on clouds.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Franz Anton Maulbertsch
styles.features: Flickering restless figures in swirling clouds; sharp colours of lemon yellow, pink and turquoise; light flashing across draperies; deeply foreshortened skies; sketchy nervous brushwork.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Daniel Chodowiecki
styles.features: Tiny precise etched book illustrations; small bourgeois figures in tidy domestic interiors; fine hatching; narrative vignettes; quietly observed manners and gestures.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Cornelis Troost
styles.features: Comic theatrical scenes; Amsterdam burghers at drinking parties and stage plays; candlelit interiors; lively exaggerated gestures; soft dusty colour; stage-like space.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jan van Huysum
styles.features: Overflowing flower and fruit pieces against light luminous beige backgrounds; pale pinks, yellows and whites; dew drops, insects, birds' nests; terracotta urns with reliefs on marble ledges; porcelain-smooth finish.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Alexander Roslin
styles.features: Portraits with gleaming, nearly tangible satin, silk and lace; cool silver and blue tones; smooth porcelain faces; refined poses; meticulous fabric sheen and reflections.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Pehr Hilleström
styles.features: Quiet small domestic interiors with maids and family members at household tasks; ironworks and foundries with glowing furnaces; soft grey-green light; muted palette; modest detailed rooms.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Dmitry Levitsky
styles.features: Formal portraits with radiant smooth faces; silvery-pearl light; rich satin dresses and gold-braided uniforms; full-length figures with columns and drapery; warm olive backgrounds; animated expressions.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Vladimir Borovikovsky
styles.features: Sentimental portraits of young women in white dresses in garden settings; soft melting modelling; hazy green parkland; gentle melancholy poses; pale blue, lilac and pearl tones.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Fyodor Alekseyev
styles.features: Cityscapes of St Petersburg and Moscow; broad river embankments, palaces and fortress walls; clear even light; precise architectural perspective; small strolling figures; calm silvery-blue sky.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Russian lubok popular print
styles.features: Bold black outlines; flat bright patches of red, yellow and green applied by hand; folk heroes, jesters, cats, feasts; dense captions integrated into the picture; naive proportions; flat space.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe
styles.note: Lettering may render as garbled text

styles.name: Swedish Dala painting (dalmålning)
styles.medium: distemper on paper, linen or wood
styles.features: Folk wall paintings with scriptural scenes acted by figures in rural Swedish dress; large stylised gourd-like flower plants filling gaps; red, blue, green and yellow on bare ground; flat naive drawing.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Norwegian rosemaling
styles.medium: paint on wooden furniture and chests
styles.features: Flowing C- and S-scrolls, acanthus leaves and stylised flowers; soft brushstroke shading inside each stroke; warm red, blue-green and ochre on dark or painted grounds; symmetrical decorative panels.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Toile de Jouy
styles.features: Single-colour printing in red, blue or sepia on cream cotton; repeating pastoral vignettes of shepherds, lovers, ruins and trees; fine engraved hatching; scenes arranged as isolated floating islands.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: 18th-century silhouette portrait
styles.features: Solid black profile portraits with crisp edges; detailed outlines of wigs, bonnets and ruffles; white or cream ground; oval framing; no interior detail or modelling.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Jean-Baptiste Vanmour
styles.features: Ottoman court and city scenes; rows of figures in colourful turbans and robes; flat even light; costume-catalogue clarity; ambassadorial audiences and Bosphorus views; bright reds, greens and golds.
styles.section: Rococo, Enlightenment and 18th-century painting and vedute across Europe

styles.name: Caspar David Friedrich
styles.features: Smooth thin oil glazes with near-invisible brushwork; small solitary figures seen from behind facing vast misty distances; strict symmetrical compositions; Gothic ruins, bare oaks, Baltic shore; cool violet-grey dawn or moonlit palette.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: J. M. W. Turner
styles.medium: oil on canvas and watercolour on paper
styles.features: Light dissolving forms into a luminous vortex; thin washes, scumbled whites, scraped and knifed passages; sun blazing through steam, storm and spray; yellow, gold and pale blue dominate; ships, trains and buildings reduced to hazy silhouettes.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: John Constable
styles.medium: oil on canvas, oil sketches on paper
styles.features: English countryside in broken, flecked brushwork with dabs of white highlight; towering cumulus skies; glistening wet greens and browns; mills, locks, hay wains, church spires; low horizon, river foregrounds, small working figures.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Eugène Delacroix
styles.features: Turbulent diagonal compositions; vivid complementary colour, crimson against green, ochre against blue; loose hatched brushstrokes with flickering broken highlights; muscular figures, rearing horses, tigers, North African costume; dramatic smoke and sky.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Théodore Géricault
styles.features: Dark tonal history painting with sculptural, heavily modelled muscular bodies; strong chiaroscuro on brown bituminous grounds; pyramidal crowded compositions; straining horses, shipwrecks, soldiers; livid greenish flesh tones, stormy grey seas.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Francisco Goya, late dark manner
styles.features: Thick, rough, smeared oil, often knifed; black, ochre and earth palette; grotesque massed faces, witches, giants and nightmares; figures half-swallowed by gloom; flat empty grounds; harsh raking light.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting
styles.note: Refers to the late dark paintings, not the bright court portraits or tapestry cartoons.

styles.name: Henry Fuseli
styles.features: Theatrical nightmare scenes with elongated, contorted Mannerist figures; violent foreshortening; deep black shadows pierced by a single lurid light; pale glowing flesh with red and sulphur accents; demons, ghosts, Shakespearean phantoms.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: William Blake
styles.medium: relief etching hand-coloured, watercolour and tempera
styles.features: Flame-like flowing outlines; muscular, weightless nude figures spiralling through flattened visionary space; washes of gold, rose and deep blue; stippled cosmic radiance; vines, flames and clouds framing the scene.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting
styles.note: His illuminated books contain engraved script; ask for the painted visionary scenes if lettering is unwanted.

styles.name: Samuel Palmer, Shoreham period
styles.medium: sepia ink, watercolour and gum arabic glaze on paper
styles.features: Pastoral vision of dense swelling hills, wheat sheaves and blossoming trees; huge glowing harvest moons; patterned dots and hatching; tiny shepherds and cottages; warm brown-gold nocturnal palette under a glossy varnish-like glaze.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: John Martin
styles.features: Vast apocalyptic panoramas with tiny swarming figures dwarfed by colossal endless architecture and cliffs; lightning, fire and red-black skies; sharp perspective recession; stark contrasts of glare and darkness.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Thomas Girtin
styles.features: Broad watercolour washes on warm paper; restricted palette of browns, slate blues and dull greens; wide panoramic horizons; massive ruined abbeys and moorland under heavy cloud; bold simplified masses, sober mood.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: John Sell Cotman
styles.features: Watercolour built from flat, interlocking planes of clear colour like a mosaic; crisp edges, little blending; muted blue-greens, ochres and greys; still rivers, bridges and trees reduced to patterned shapes; calm geometric clarity.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Richard Parkes Bonington
styles.features: Rapid, fluid watercolour and oil; sparkling silvery light; flat sandy French coasts, fishing boats, Venetian and Norman streets; bright small figure accents in red and white; luminous pale skies.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Francis Danby
styles.features: Poetic landscape with glowing sunsets and moonlit lakes; deep enclosed valleys and still reflecting water; dark silhouetted foreground trees and rocks; small pensive figures; golden-orange fading to indigo; occasional cataclysmic floods.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Philipp Otto Runge
styles.features: Crisp, hard-edged drawing and smooth enamel-like oil; symbolic arrangements of children, flowers and lilies; plump rosy children with doll-like clarity; clear blue skies; ornamental symmetry; pale pinks, greens, cool even light.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Carl Blechen
styles.features: Free, sketchy oil in strong southern sunlight; bright ochre walls, deep shadows, intense blue skies; Italian gardens, coasts and German forests; also eerie dark gorges; vibrant loosely brushed paint, near-Impressionist light.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Joseph Anton Koch
styles.features: Heroic panoramic Alpine and Italian landscape; clearly delineated layered planes of mountain, waterfall and valley; sharp precise contours; small biblical or classical figures; clear daylight, cool greens and blues, carefully drawn rocks.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Nazarene movement
styles.features: Clear outlined drawing and flat, bright colour modelled on early Italian Renaissance; pious figures in medieval dress; calm frieze-like groups; pure blues, reds, greens; even lighting; gentle oval faces; idealised landscapes behind.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Moritz von Schwind
styles.features: Fairy-tale and legend scenes with gracefully outlined figures; delicate linear drawing; soft muted colour; moonlit woods, elves, knights, wandering youths; cyclical narrative frieze panels; lyrical, slightly faded tones.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Ludwig Richter
styles.features: Black-line wood-engraved vignettes with fine parallel hatching; cosy German village life, children, grandmothers, wanderers, fairy tales; blooming lime trees and cottages; rounded, kindly figures framed by foliage and arches.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Ferdinand Georg Waldmüller
styles.features: Sharp, glossy Biedermeier realism; intense sunlight casting crisp blue shadows; brilliant greens; Austrian peasant families, children, Vienna Woods; every leaf precise; porcelain-smooth faces; meticulous still-life detail.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Carl Spitzweg
styles.features: Small humorous genre scenes; eccentric lone figures, bookworms, poets, botanists, in cramped attics and sunlit old-town lanes; tall gabled houses; warm golden-green glazes; loose delicate brushwork; cosy Biedermeier intimacy.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Düsseldorf school of painting
styles.features: Highly finished landscape and genre painting with smooth glazed surfaces; dramatic mountain lakes, forests, waterfalls; theatrical golden or stormy light; carefully drawn rocks and trees; anecdotal small figures; warm brownish tonality.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Danish Golden Age painting
styles.features: Clear, calm daylight; precise drawing and smooth fine brushwork; quiet Copenhagen harbours, ramparts, interiors and portraits; pale blue skies, soft greens, warm whites; balanced horizontal compositions; still, intimate atmosphere.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Johan Christian Dahl
styles.features: Norwegian mountain and coastal scenery in fluid, energetic oil; dramatic skies and vivid cloud studies; birch trees, waterfalls, shipwrecks on rocks, moonlit harbours; cool greens and steel greys with warm sunset accents.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Peder Balke
styles.features: Spare, near-monochrome visions of the Arctic coast; thin grey and white paint scraped and wiped; looming dark cliffs, stormy seas, lone ships; brilliant pale light in dark skies; reductive, almost abstract simplicity.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Marcus Larson
styles.features: Violent seascapes and waterfalls; burning ships, crashing breakers, churning foam; thick energetic brushwork; deep blacks against fiery orange and moon-white; rocky Swedish coasts; high-contrast theatrical light.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Alexandre Calame
styles.features: Alpine scenery: jagged snow peaks, gnarled storm-bent fir trees, torrents and glaciers; precise cool rendering; grey-blue and green palette; strong side-light; dramatic weather; few or tiny figures.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Barend Cornelis Koekkoek
styles.features: Polished Dutch Romantic landscape; massive gnarled oaks, sunlit forest edges, castle ruins and rivers; minute, porcelain-smooth finish; warm golden light; meticulous foliage; small travellers and cattle.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Andreas Schelfhout
styles.features: Dutch winter landscapes; frozen canals with skaters, sledges and windmills; silvery pinkish skies; bare tree silhouettes; finely detailed small figures; delicate transparent glazes; low horizon over wide grey ice.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Francesco Hayez
styles.features: Italian Romantic history painting with smooth academic finish; medieval and Renaissance costume in glossy silks; saturated blue, crimson and gold; expressive tender poses; theatrical lighting; precise drawing; intimate couples and patriotic scenes.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Antoine-Jean Gros
styles.features: Vast Napoleonic battle and campaign scenes; crowded foregrounds of wounded soldiers and horses; plumes, sabres, smoke; rich reds, golds and gunpowder greys; central commanding figure; Baroque movement over Neoclassical drawing.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Anne-Louis Girodet
styles.features: Cold moonlit luminosity on smooth porcelain flesh; sinuous idealised nudes; ghostly warriors emerging from mist; strange silvery-blue and green lighting; precise Neoclassical drawing within an eerie atmosphere.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Paul Delaroche
styles.features: Polished theatrical history painting; smooth invisible brushwork; meticulously rendered velvets, armour and period interiors; tense moments before execution or downfall; muted dark backgrounds; spot-lit pale figures.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Troubadour style, French Restoration history genre
styles.medium: oil on panel, small cabinet pictures
styles.features: Small jewel-like pictures of medieval and Renaissance anecdotes; Gothic interiors lit through stained glass; knights, ladies and pages in tights and slashed sleeves; meticulous detail, glossy finish, sentimental poses.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Alexandre-Gabriel Decamps
styles.features: Orientalist scenes of North Africa and the Near East; thick crusty impasto on whitewashed walls; blazing sunlight and deep blue shadow; ochre, sand and umber palette; turbaned figures, children, dogs, narrow alleys.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Louise-Joséphine Sarazin de Belmont
styles.features: Clear, finely detailed topographic landscapes; Italian sites, Pyrenean valleys, Roman ruins; crisp daylight and bright blue skies; carefully drawn rock and foliage; small figures; luminous plein-air colour within orderly composition.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Marie Ellenrieder
styles.features: Gentle Nazarene-style painting; clear outlines and soft pastel colour; tender Madonnas, children and angels; calm frontal compositions; pale rose, sky blue and cream; delicate faces; luminous even light.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Ivan Aivazovsky
styles.features: Transparent waves glowing as if lit from within; moonlit or sunrise seas; storms with tiny ships and rescue boats; layered translucent glazes of emerald, turquoise, gold and pearl; foaming crests under vast luminous skies.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Karl Bryullov
styles.features: Grand academic Romanticism; crowded catastrophe compositions of idealised classical figures; dramatic red-orange glow of volcanic fire; brilliant glossy colour; elegant portraits in rich silks and velvets; theatrical gesture.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Alexander Ivanov
styles.features: Exacting academic figure drawing with sun-bleached plein-air colour; frieze-like crowds of biblical figures in varied robes; luminous Roman Campagna backgrounds; pale sandy light, olive and blue-green landscape.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Alexey Venetsianov
styles.features: Quiet Russian peasant life in soft, smooth brushwork; calm women and children in sarafans; flat open fields, harvests, threshing barns; gentle diffuse light; pale gold, green and blue; still, upright poses.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Orest Kiprensky
styles.features: Romantic portraiture with soft velvet shadows and warm glowing flesh; dreamy introspective gazes; dark muted backgrounds; loose cravats, cloaks and uniforms; warm brown-gold palette; delicate soft-edged modelling.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Silvester Shchedrin
styles.features: Sunlit Neapolitan and Sorrento coasts; vine-covered terraces and pergolas; fishermen on quays; warm golden light, transparent blue sea and sky; fresh plein-air observation; soft hazy distance; relaxed small figures.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Maxim Vorobiev
styles.features: Romantic city and landscape views; St Petersburg embankments, the Neva by moonlight, Near Eastern panoramas; precise architecture under evening light; silvery or warm golden glow; calm water reflections; small figures and boats.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Thomas Cole
styles.features: Dramatic American wilderness and allegorical landscapes; storm-blasted trees in the foreground; craggy mountains, rivers, autumn foliage; dark storm against bright clearing; detailed foliage; small figures; classical ruins in allegorical series.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Asher B. Durand
styles.features: Intimate forest interiors; tall birch and beech trunks with precise bark detail; dappled sunlight on mossy rocks and streams; soft hazy distances; calm golden-green palette; closely observed nature.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Frederic Edwin Church
styles.features: Panoramic, highly detailed landscapes on vast canvases; Andean volcanoes, tropical jungles, icebergs, great waterfalls; blazing sunsets in crimson and gold; botanical precision in the foreground; luminous atmospheric distances.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Albert Bierstadt
styles.features: Monumental American West panoramas; towering granite peaks, waterfalls, deep valleys; theatrical shafts of golden light through mist; glassy lakes; tiny wildlife and camps; smooth finish and dramatic scale contrast.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Fitz Henry Lane
styles.features: Luminist harbour scenes; glassy still water mirroring ships exactly; crisp clear rigging lines; invisible brushwork; serene sunrise or sunset glow in pale peach, lemon and blue; hushed horizontal compositions under vast calm skies.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: George Caleb Bingham
styles.features: American frontier river genre; boatmen and traders on flatboats in pyramidal groups; soft hazy golden light over calm water; smooth clear finish; characterful faces; busy election-day crowds in small towns.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Washington Allston
styles.features: Hazy, dreamy American Romantic painting; muted glowing colour built from Venetian-style glazes; moonlit landscapes, mysterious biblical and poetic figures; soft-edged forms; warm golden-brown and silvery tones; contemplative stillness.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Karl Bodmer
styles.features: Precise watercolour and aquatint views of the upper Missouri; carefully drawn portraits in detailed regalia; river bluffs, steamboats, earth-lodge villages; clean outlines; documentary accuracy; soft earth and sky colours.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting
styles.note: Depict Native American subjects with documentary respect; avoid costume clichés or caricature.

styles.name: John James Audubon
styles.medium: hand-coloured engraving and aquatint after watercolour
styles.features: Life-size birds in dynamic, sometimes contorted poses on white paper; crisp feather detail; plants and branches as habitat; sparse backgrounds; vivid naturalistic colour; precise outlines with soft aquatint tone.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: British picturesque topographical aquatint
styles.features: Soft grainy tonal washes in sepia, blue-grey and pale green; ruined abbeys, country houses, rivers and mountain passes; framing trees at the sides; tiny staffage figures; clean ruled border around the view.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: French Romantic lithographic travel views
styles.features: Tonal crayon lithographs with velvety blacks and soft greys; crumbling Gothic churches, ruined castles, medieval streets; dramatic skies; small figures; vignette edges fading into white paper.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Piotr Michałowski
styles.features: Vigorous, sketch-like painting of horses, cavalry and Polish peasants; rapid fluid brushstrokes; rich brown and red tones; dramatic motion of charging riders; expressive horse anatomy; loose, unfinished-looking backgrounds.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Károly Markó the Elder
styles.features: Idyllic Italian and Hungarian landscapes in a classicising Romantic manner; feathery trees framing calm valleys; tiny mythological or pastoral figures; soft golden light; meticulous foliage; serene blue distances.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Rosa Bonheur
styles.features: Robust, anatomically exact animal painting; ploughing oxen, horse fairs, sheep and deer; strong daylight; earthy browns and fresh greens; vigorous detailed brushwork; dust and motion; wide rural landscapes.
styles.section: Romanticism and early 19th-century landscape and history painting

styles.name: Gustave Courbet
styles.medium: oil on canvas, palette knife and heavy brush
styles.features: dense oil laid on with palette knife, dark earth-brown grounds, rugged rock cliffs and forest streams, life-size unidealised working people, sombre greens, ochres and blacks, solid sculptural masses
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Avoid his nudes; use landscapes, hunting scenes or labourers.

styles.name: Jean-François Millet
styles.features: muted earthy palette of ochre, olive and dusky blue, broad simplified peasant figures bent at labour, heavy rounded silhouettes against low horizons and wide fields, hazy evening light, rough matte paint surface
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Camille Corot
styles.features: silvery grey-green palette, feathery soft-edged trees dissolving into misty air, tiny figures marked with a single touch of red, calm lakes and pale skies, thin translucent dabbed foliage, hushed dawn light
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Théodore Rousseau
styles.features: dense oak forests and marsh edges, gnarled trunks built in crusted impasto, dark brown-green foliage against glowing amber sky, low horizon, sunset light breaking through massed trees, heavy varnished tones
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Charles-François Daubigny
styles.features: low river views seen from water level, long horizontal banks of poplars and willows, broad loose brushstrokes, still reflections, fresh greens and pale skies, sketchy plein-air freshness, small boats and grazing cattle
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Jules Breton
styles.features: statuesque peasant women in headscarves in wheat fields at twilight, idealised calm figures, golden-rose sunset sky with rising moon, smooth academic finish, warm amber and lilac palette, village religious processions
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Jules Bastien-Lepage
styles.features: plein-air naturalism under flat overcast light, sharply detailed faces and hands of country people, high horizon so the loosely brushed field fills the picture, square brushstrokes, cool greys and greens
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Honoré Daumier
styles.medium: lithograph on newsprint; oil on panel
styles.features: rapid nervous crayon lines, heavy black shadows, exaggerated caricatured heads and bulky bodies, lawyers, laundresses and third-class railway passengers, rough smudged tonal masses, minimal background
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Caricature; keep satire gentle and avoid real public figures.

styles.name: William-Adolphe Bouguereau
styles.features: porcelain-smooth flawless skin, invisible brushwork, idealised graceful figures with rosy cheeks, soft pearly light, peasant children and mythological maidens, pastel blues and flesh pinks, detailed drapery, shallow pastoral backdrop
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Many works are nudes; keep figures clothed.

styles.name: Jean-Léon Gérôme
styles.features: photographic crisp precision, smooth licked surface, brilliant raking sunlight, meticulously rendered tiled architecture, carpets and costumes, theatrical frozen moment, clear saturated colour, deep clean perspective
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Orientalist subjects; avoid exoticising stereotypes and nudity.

styles.name: Alexandre Cabanel
styles.features: glossy academic surface, pale luminous skin, sinuous posed figures, rich velvet and silk drapery, soft pastel sky tones, idealised faces, refined Salon portraits set against dark plain grounds
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Avoid his nudes; portraits and history scenes work best.

styles.name: Ernest Meissonier
styles.features: small-scale minutely detailed oil, microscopic precision of uniforms, buttons, harness and horses, muted greys and browns, cavaliers and soldiers in period costume, quiet tavern interiors or muddy campaign roads
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Military subjects; avoid violence.

styles.name: Lawrence Alma-Tadema
styles.features: gleaming white and veined marble terraces, polished bronze, intense azure Mediterranean sea and sky, flowering oleanders, languid figures in classical robes, crisp archaeological detail, warm sunlight, tight smooth finish
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Hans Makart
styles.medium: oil on canvas, large decorative scale
styles.features: deep crimson, gold and bronze colour, crowded processions of costumed figures, heavy brown glazes, swags of flowers and draperies, theatrical pageant compositions, decorative Baroque abundance
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Hudson River School
styles.features: vast panoramic wilderness views, golden atmospheric light, tiny human figures dwarfed by mountains, waterfalls and river valleys, carefully detailed foreground trees and rocks, glowing sky, blue-hazed receding distance, smooth glazed finish
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Luminism
styles.features: glassy still water, calm horizontal compositions, crystalline pale light, invisible brushstrokes, small sailboats and shoreline rocks, peach and lemon sunset skies, sharp edges, wide empty silent space
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Martin Johnson Heade
styles.features: close-up hummingbirds with iridescent feathers beside large orchids and passionflowers, misty rainforest background, smooth enamel finish, intense greens, magentas and pinks; also flat salt marshes with haystacks under storm light
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Andreas Achenbach
styles.features: storm-tossed North Sea coasts, heavy grey-green breaking waves, battered fishing boats and timber piers, dark churning clouds pierced by light, crisp wet rocks and planks, dramatic diagonal composition
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Hans Gude
styles.features: Norwegian fjords and mountain lakes, clear crystalline light, carefully drawn rocky shores, birch trees and wooden rowing boats, crisp clouds over blue-grey water, calm detailed realism, cool northern palette
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Ivan Shishkin
styles.features: dense pine and oak forests painted with botanical exactness, individual trunks, bark and needles, sunlit clearings, rye fields under tall clouds, warm green-gold palette, precise drawing, calm wide forest space
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Ilya Repin
styles.features: vigorous loose brushwork with sharply observed faces, crowded multi-figure compositions, strong light contrasts, ruddy flesh tones and earthy browns, expressive gestures, realist costumes of peasants, Cossacks, barge haulers and clergy
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Isaac Levitan
styles.features: quiet melancholic countryside, wide rivers under grey skies, birch groves, small wooden churches, spring thaw and golden autumn, fresh loose brushwork, soft muted palette, open horizons with lonely emptiness
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Arkhip Kuindzhi
styles.features: glowing moonlight and sunset effects, radiant luminous patches of light against deep dark masses, simplified flat shapes, river bends and steppe at night, intense emerald, silver and orange accents
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Vasily Vereshchagin
styles.features: hard brilliant sunlight, crisp documentary realism, Central Asian mosques with turquoise tiles, mud-brick walls and bazaars, soldiers in white uniforms, dusty yellow ground, high-contrast shadows, also wide snowy Balkan passes
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Many war scenes; avoid gore and battle aftermaths.

styles.name: Viktor Vasnetsov
styles.features: epic bogatyr warriors on heavy horses, fairy-tale princesses and firebirds, folk ornament woven into academic realism, dark mysterious forests, sombre twilight skies, rich red, gold and earthy green, solemn frontal figures
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Adolph Menzel
styles.features: sparkling candlelit ballrooms and crowded court interiors, flickering brushwork, iron rolling mills with workers and sparks, precise drawing, sunlit intimate rooms, warm golds against dark shadows, quick observant notation of people
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Wilhelm Leibl
styles.features: meticulous hard-edged realism of Bavarian peasants in church pews and farmhouse rooms, carefully drawn faces and hands, dense Old-Master finish, sober blacks, whites and earthen tones, still contemplative mood
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Skagen Painters
styles.features: blue-hour seashore with pale dunes and long beaches, silvery water merging with sky, fishermen in sou'westers hauling boats, summer evening gatherings at long tables, luminous lilac and turquoise twilight
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Anna Ancher
styles.features: quiet domestic interiors where shafts of sunlight fall across walls and floorboards, women sewing or reading, warm yellow light patches against blue shadows, loose brushwork, simplified figures, fishing-village life
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Kitty Kielland
styles.features: flat open moorland and peat bogs, very low horizons under broad sky, still dark pools reflecting pale light, bright summer-night glow, simplified quiet realism, muted greens, browns and pale blue
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Albert Edelfelt
styles.features: plein-air naturalism in fresh clear daylight, Finnish archipelago shores and rowing boats, fishermen, women and children by the sea, delicate grey-blue water, loose but accurate brushwork, cool airy palette
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood
styles.medium: oil on canvas over wet white ground
styles.features: jewel-bright saturated colour, hard sharp detail in every leaf and flower, flattened shallow space, medieval and Arthurian figures with long wavy hair, richly patterned fabrics, intense symbolic stillness
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: John Atkinson Grimshaw
styles.features: moonlit wet Victorian streets and docks, glowing gaslit windows, bare tree silhouettes against greenish-gold night sky, glossy reflections on cobbles, thin precise paint, autumn mist, small solitary figures
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: William Powell Frith
styles.features: crowded panoramic Victorian scenes packed with dozens of figures, railway stations, racecourses and seaside sands, small anecdotal episodes in every group, crisp detail, bright clear colour, wide deep perspective
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Elizabeth Thompson, Lady Butler
styles.features: cavalry and infantry seen head-on charging toward the viewer, red-coated soldiers, careful horse anatomy, smoke and churned dust, muted greens and browns, exhausted realistic faces, low dramatic viewpoint
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Military subjects; avoid wounds and violence.

styles.name: Winslow Homer
styles.medium: watercolour on paper; oil on canvas
styles.features: bold direct washes and strong silhouettes, crashing Atlantic surf on dark rocks, fishermen in oilskins, Adirondack woods and canoes, Caribbean turquoise water, broad flat shapes, limited dense palette
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Thomas Eakins
styles.features: sober dark-toned realism, anatomically precise bodies, rowers on still rivers with crisp reflections, interiors lit from above, browns and muted golds, introspective faces, carefully constructed perspective
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Mariano Fortuny
styles.features: glittering brushwork of tiny sparkling touches, brilliant Mediterranean light, Moroccan and Andalusian courtyards, ornate rococo interiors, embroidered costumes, jewel-like colour, small precise figures
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Macchiaioli
styles.features: small horizontal panels built from flat patches of colour, strong sunlit contrasts, white Tuscan roads, walls and fields, soldiers, peasants and oxen, simplified shapes, clear bright outdoor light
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Jan Matejko
styles.features: crowded monumental historical scenes packed with figures in rich Polish and medieval costume, theatrical gestures, jewel-dark palette of crimson, gold and black, dense overlapping composition, intense expressive faces
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Józef Chełmoński
styles.features: flat Polish plains and Ukrainian steppe, galloping horse teams kicking up snow and mud, partridges in snowy fields, wide low horizons, energetic loose brushwork, earthy browns and pale greys, rural carts and peasants
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Mihály Munkácsy
styles.medium: oil on canvas over bitumen ground
styles.features: dark bituminous ground, heavy brown-black shadows with sharp bright accents, dramatic light on faces, crowded peasant interiors, dense oil paint, sombre emotional realism
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Hague School
styles.features: silvery grey tonal palette, damp overcast skies, dunes and beaches with fishing boats drawn by horses, flat polders and windmills, loose wet brushwork, fisherfolk and shepherds, soft atmospheric haze
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Henri Fantin-Latour
styles.features: flowers and fruit on a table against a plain dark grey-brown background, soft velvety petals of roses, zinnias and peonies, subtle muted colour, quiet even light, slightly softened edges
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: José María Velasco
styles.features: sweeping panoramas of the Valley of Mexico, volcanoes on a distant horizon, clear high-altitude light, precise geological and botanical detail, dry ochre plains, cacti and eagles, deep blue sky with clouds
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Heidelberg School
styles.medium: oil on canvas and small cigar-box panels
styles.features: dry bush under harsh golden sunlight, eucalyptus trees with pale trunks, high-key blue and ochre palette, broad plein-air brushstrokes, shearers and drovers at work, wide open space, heat haze
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Cornelius Krieghoff
styles.features: lively snowy winter scenes, horse-drawn sleighs, habitants in red sashes and toques, log cabins and roadside inns, vivid orange maple forests, anecdotal genre detail, crisp light on snow
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Victorian fairy painting
styles.features: tiny fairies and goblins among oversized flowers, toadstools and grasses, minute detail, crowded jewel-like compositions, strange dreamlike lighting, fine crisp brushwork, rich greens, scarlets and gold
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools
styles.note: Keep fairies clothed.

styles.name: Lilly Martin Spencer
styles.features: warm domestic kitchen and nursery scenes, smiling women with flour, fruit or poultry, glossy rendered vegetables and crockery, polished finish, bright warm colour, gentle humour, close-up figures in mid-century dress
styles.section: Realism, academic and Salon painting, Barbizon, Düsseldorf, Hudson River and other 19th-c. schools

styles.name: Claude Monet
styles.features: Broken comma-like strokes of unmixed colour laid side by side; flickering light on water, haystacks and façades; violet-blue shadows; soft dissolving contours; high-key palette; figures reduced to a few dabs

styles.name: Pierre-Auguste Renoir
styles.features: Feathery, softly blended strokes; dappled sunlight spotting faces, hats and clothes; warm pinks, peach and cobalt blue; rounded figures with rosy skin; foliage melting into shimmering haze; lively outdoor dances and gatherings

styles.name: Camille Pissarro
styles.features: Dense woven network of small strokes; earthy greens and ochres; orchards, peasant women and village roads; elevated views of Paris boulevards in grey rain or winter light, with carriages and many tiny figures

styles.name: Alfred Sisley
styles.features: Large luminous skies filling half the canvas; quick horizontal strokes on rivers and floodwater; pale blues, silver greys and soft greens; poplars, bridges and village streets; small figures; cool calm daylight

styles.name: Edgar Degas
styles.medium: pastel on paper, oil on canvas
styles.features: Off-centre cropped compositions seen from above or the side; ballet dancers, laundresses, jockeys; layered pastel hatching in vivid strokes; firm drawn contours; artificial stage light; steeply tilted floors

styles.name: Berthe Morisot
styles.features: Rapid zig-zag strokes that look unfinished; pearly whites, pale blue and pink; women and children in gardens, boats and bright interiors; forms dissolving at the edges; bare canvas showing between touches

styles.name: Mary Cassatt
styles.medium: oil, pastel, colour drypoint and aquatint
styles.features: Intimate close-up mothers and children; firm drawing with flat patterned dresses and wallpapers borrowed from Japanese prints; clear pinks, greens and creams; cropped, tilted interiors; pastel strokes on skin

styles.name: Gustave Caillebotte
styles.features: Steep exaggerated perspective of wide Paris boulevards, bridges and balconies; smooth precise drawing with Impressionist light; wet grey paving stones; top-hatted men and umbrellas; plunging views from above; muted blues and greys

styles.name: Eva Gonzalès
styles.features: Restrained handling close to Manet; broad flat tonal areas with crisp blacks and creamy whites; single women in quiet interiors or theatre boxes; soft pastel modelling of faces; sparse plain backgrounds

styles.name: Marie Bracquemond
styles.features: Women on sunlit terraces and in gardens; dazzling open-air whites tinted with blue, green and lilac; loose parallel strokes; figures modelled by reflected colour; airy shade under trees

styles.name: Armand Guillaumin
styles.features: Intense, almost Fauve colour: violet, orange and acid green; vigorous thick strokes; Seine quays with barges and factory chimneys; rocky river valleys; blazing sunsets; strongly coloured shadows

styles.name: Eugène Boudin
styles.features: Low strip of beach crowded with tiny fashionable figures in crinolines; vast cloudy sky filling three quarters of the picture; quick touches of colour; silvery greys and whites with red and blue accents; harbours with boats

styles.name: Johan Barthold Jongkind
styles.features: Fluid watercolour washes over broken pencil outlines; canals, harbours, windmills and moonlit skies; quick calligraphic strokes for boats and figures; luminous atmospheric greys with golden horizons

styles.name: Édouard Manet
styles.features: Flat broad colour areas with abrupt light-dark transitions; bold true blacks; frontal figures with cool direct gazes; little half-tone modelling; quick sketchy backgrounds; Parisian cafés, bars and boating scenes
styles.note: Ally of the Impressionists; flatter and darker than them

styles.name: Giuseppe De Nittis
styles.medium: oil on canvas and panel, pastel
styles.features: Elegant Paris and London street scenes; pale grey-pink light, mist and drizzle; slender figures in fashionable dress; wide open squares and bridges; delicate fine brushwork; snowy and rainy pavements

styles.name: Federico Zandomeneghi
styles.features: Pastel scenes of women at the milliner, reading or dressing; soft hatching of complementary colours; red hair against turquoise and pink; close cropped views; intimate everyday gestures

styles.name: Frédéric Bazille
styles.features: Figures outdoors in strong southern sunlight; clear solid forms with crisp cast shadows; large flat areas of sunlit wall, terrace and dry grass; restrained greens, whites and ochres; posed family groups

styles.name: Peder Severin Krøyer
styles.features: Blue-hour beaches where pale violet-blue sea and sky merge; women in white dresses walking on sand; moonlight paths on water; festive gatherings at long garden tables; soft luminous evening light

styles.name: Michael Ancher
styles.features: Weather-beaten fishermen in oilskins and sou'westers on dunes; grouped figures watching a grey-green stormy sea; solid realist modelling with fresh outdoor light; boats hauled onto sand

styles.name: Anders Zorn
styles.features: Bravura wet-into-wet strokes in a limited palette of ochre, vermilion, black and white; sunlit nude bathers among rocks and rippling water; Dalarna peasants dancing by firelight; shimmering broken reflections

styles.name: Carl Larsson
styles.features: Crisp ink outlines filled with clear watercolour washes; bright farmhouse interiors in red, green and white; painted furniture, flowers and children; flat decorative patterns; cheerful family daily life and holidays
styles.note: Closer to illustration than to Impressionist brushwork

styles.name: Frits Thaulow
styles.features: Rivers of flowing dark water reflecting houses and lit windows; melting snow and ice in blue-violet tones; long rippling reflections; twilight; thick velvety paint; few or no figures

styles.name: Bruno Liljefors
styles.features: Wild animals and birds half-hidden in their habitat: foxes, capercaillie, eiders, hares; asymmetric compositions inspired by Japanese prints; fluid brushwork; muted forest greens, snow whites and golden dusk light

styles.name: Hanna Pauli
styles.features: Breakfast table set outdoors under trees; dappled sunlight scattering bright spots on white tablecloth, china and glass; loose broken brushwork; fresh greens and whites; relaxed figures in summer clothes

styles.name: Theodor Philipsen
styles.features: Cattle and horses grazing in open Danish pastures; strong daylight with luminous blue shadows; short broken strokes; flat wide landscape and high sky; fresh greens and warm hides

styles.name: Konstantin Korovin
styles.features: Juicy, slapdash strokes; Paris boulevards at night with electric lamps and wet reflections; Crimean cafés, roses and fruit on balconies; vibrant blues, emerald and orange; theatrical sketchy freedom

styles.name: Igor Grabar
styles.features: Russian winter built from many small divisionist strokes; hoarfrost on birches in blue, violet and gold; brilliant sunlight sparkling on snow; deep azure sky; looking up through branches

styles.name: Valentin Serov
styles.features: Sunlit rooms and gardens; fresh portraits lit by window light; translucent coloured shadows; peach, cream and leafy green; spontaneous fluid brushwork; young sitters in quiet natural poses
styles.note: Use his early plein-air manner

styles.name: Joaquín Sorolla
styles.features: Blazing Mediterranean sunlight; children and fishermen on beaches; white linen glowing with blue and violet reflections; large swift strokes; shimmering wet sand and sea; oxen hauling boats

styles.name: Darío de Regoyos
styles.features: Direct, slightly naive drawing; pointillist dabs; trains crossing bridges, rainy Basque villages, religious processions; vivid green hills and purple shadows; fresh unpolished observation

styles.name: Aureliano de Beruete
styles.features: Wide views of Madrid, Toledo and Castile from riverbanks; dry ochre plains under pale blue skies; silvery Velázquez-like tonality; quick loose strokes; city silhouettes on the horizon

styles.name: Santiago Rusiñol
styles.features: Formal Spanish gardens: cypress avenues, clipped box hedges, fountains, stone steps and terraces; soft evening light; deep greens with yellow and pink accents; empty of figures, quietly melancholic

styles.name: Giovanni Fattori
styles.features: Long narrow panels; harsh Tuscan light; flat sharp-edged colour patches; white oxen, cavalry and soldiers on dusty roads; cobalt sky over a low horizon; stark simplified figures

styles.name: Silvestro Lega
styles.features: Calm domestic scenes of women under pergolas, in gardens and at windows; clear outlines; flat colour patches; restrained greens, whites and browns; serene even light; quiet conversation

styles.name: Telemaco Signorini
styles.features: Florentine streets and steep Ligurian villages; sharp light-shadow contrast; narrow alleys, stairways and women on terraces; geometric wall planes; muted ochres and greys; plain social scenes

styles.name: Giovanni Segantini
styles.features: Alpine pastures painted in long thread-like strokes of pure colour; intense high-mountain light; peasants, cows and sheep; gold, blue and white; crisp snowy peaks
styles.note: Divisionist rather than strictly Impressionist

styles.name: Childe Hassam
styles.features: Flag-draped New York avenues; rainy evening streets with glowing reflections; quick small strokes; sunlit flower gardens and sea rocks; violet shadows; many small figures and carriages

styles.name: John Henry Twachtman
styles.features: Pale, nearly monochrome winter scenes; snow in white, grey and soft blue; misty pools and waterfalls among hemlocks; thin scumbled paint; flattened decorative compositions

styles.name: William Merritt Chase
styles.features: Sunlit dunes and scrubby hills with women and children in white; wide open sky; quick fluid strokes; city park scenes; also dark studio interiors full of glinting objects

styles.name: Frank Weston Benson
styles.features: Young women and children in white dresses on windy sunlit hilltops; dazzling sun dappling fabric; bright blue sky and sea; broad strokes; also wild ducks and geese in flight

styles.name: Lilla Cabot Perry
styles.features: Soft hazy gardens and fields; women and children in light interiors and outdoors; pale greens and violets; gentle broken strokes; Japanese landscapes with a distant snowy volcano

styles.name: Pennsylvania Impressionism, New Hope school
styles.features: Large snowy landscapes painted in one sitting; thick impasto and broad strokes; Delaware River valley; stone farmhouses, sycamores and creeks; brilliant whites with blue and violet shadows

styles.name: California Impressionism, plein-air school
styles.features: Sunlit eucalyptus groves, golden hills, fields of poppies and lupins; rocky Pacific coves; vivid blue sky; high-key colour; bold strokes; dry bright southern light

styles.name: John Singer Sargent
styles.features: Fast transparent watercolour; Venetian canals, gondolas and white marble; dazzling sun with deep wet shadows; bravura single strokes; figures resting in shade; reserved white paper for highlights
styles.note: Use his watercolour manner

styles.name: Tom Roberts
styles.features: Shearing sheds and drovers; warm golden light slanting through timber slats; muscular figures at work; dusty ochres and browns; busy crowded interiors; sheep and horses

styles.name: Arthur Streeton
styles.features: Sweeping panoramas, often in tall vertical formats; blue distances; golden pasture; sheer cliffs and harbour water; heat haze; deft fluent strokes; tiny figures and trains in vast terrain

styles.name: Frederick McCubbin
styles.features: Lost children and settlers in dense bush; tangled undergrowth and saplings; soft dappled green-gold light; feathery overlapping strokes; small contemplative figures absorbed into the forest

styles.name: 9 by 5 Impression sketch on cigar-box lid
styles.features: Tiny oil sketches with warm wood grain showing through; a few rapid strokes catch a moment of weather, street, beach or garden; pale high-key colour; unfinished edges

styles.name: Clarice Beckett
styles.features: Misty seaside roads and beaches at dawn or dusk; forms simplified into soft blurred shapes in haze; beach boxes, cars, headlights; muted pearl greys, blues and ochres

styles.name: Max Liebermann
styles.features: Beer gardens, bathing boys and riders on beaches; dappled sunlight spots on figures and tables; quick dark-light strokes; garden views by a lake; muted greens and flecked whites

styles.name: George Hendrik Breitner
styles.features: Rainy, dusky Amsterdam streets and canals; dark brown-grey palette; horse trams, workers and snow; rough quick strokes; photographic cropping; wet reflective cobbles

styles.name: Emile Claus
styles.features: Back-lit sunlight through trees along a river; peasants, children and cows in glowing haze; dense dabs of pure colour; golden light with long blue shadows

styles.name: Kuroda Seiki
styles.features: Soft plein-air light on women in kimono by a lake or garden; pale blue, violet and green; Western oil handling with Japanese subjects; folding fans; gentle haze

styles.name: Newlyn School
styles.features: Silvery grey overcast daylight; fishermen and women on wet beaches and quays; square-brush strokes; cobbled lanes and cottages; muted blues, greys and browns

styles.name: Vincent van Gogh
styles.features: thick impasto laid in short directional dashes; swirling rhythmic strokes in skies, fields and cypresses; strong dark outlines; cobalt blue, chrome yellow, emerald and orange; slightly tilted perspective; every surface textured with visible brush ridges

styles.name: Paul Cézanne
styles.features: parallel hatched brushstrokes building solid planes; forms simplified to blocks, cylinders and spheres; shifting viewpoints and tilted tabletops; ochre, slate blue and green; visible bluish contour lines; geometric hills, houses and fruit

styles.name: Paul Gauguin
styles.features: flat areas of saturated non-naturalistic colour bounded by dark contours; heavy simplified figures with brown skin; pink ground, orange, violet, deep green; shallow space without cast shadows; rough canvas weave showing through thin paint

styles.name: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
styles.medium: thinned oil on cardboard, colour lithography
styles.features: quick nervous outlines and streaky diluted oil on bare beige cardboard; acid green, orange and red accents; caricatural poses of dancers and drinkers; steep diagonal floors, cropped figures, flat silhouettes under gaslight
styles.note: His posters carry lettering; for painted scenes keep the image text-free.

styles.name: Henri Rousseau
styles.features: smooth meticulous naive painting; dense jungles of layered leaves each crisply outlined in countless greens; stiff frontal figures and wide-eyed animals; flat space without atmospheric haze; clear skies or a large full moon

styles.name: Odilon Redon
styles.medium: pastel and oil on paper and canvas
styles.features: glowing powdery pastel colour fields; dreamlike floating flowers, profiles, boats and butterflies; soft blurred edges against luminous ochre or blue grounds; scattered jewel tones; undefined mysterious space

styles.name: Georges Seurat
styles.features: tiny uniform dots of pure complementary colour that mix optically; still, geometric figures often in strict profile; hushed hazy light and soft edges; painted dotted border; ordered horizontal compositions of parks, riverbanks and promenades

styles.name: Paul Signac
styles.features: square mosaic-like strokes of pure colour set side by side; radiant Mediterranean harbours with sailboats, masts and rippling reflections; orange, violet, turquoise and gold; decorative rhythmic water; crisp luminous light

styles.name: Henri-Edmond Cross
styles.features: broad rectangular tessera-like strokes with gaps of ground between; saturated violet, pink, gold and ultramarine; sunlit umbrella pines, Mediterranean coves and idyllic bathers; decorative curving contours; intense warm afternoon light

styles.name: Maximilien Luce
styles.features: divisionist dots and dashes in deep blues against fiery orange; steelworks, foundries, quays and building sites; labourers as muscular silhouettes; gaslit night streets; strong tonal contrast of glow and shadow

styles.name: Théo van Rysselberghe
styles.features: fine regular pointillist dots over precise drawing; elegant portraits and family groups in light summer dresses; sunlit beaches and Mediterranean shores; pearly palette of pink, lilac, pale blue and cream

styles.name: Albert Dubois-Pillet
styles.features: delicate small dots in restricted tonal harmonies; near-monochrome nocturnes and twilight river views with bridges, quays and towers; soft halos around lamps; quiet empty spaces; muted blue, violet and grey

styles.name: Charles Angrand
styles.features: velvety black conté crayon on textured paper; forms emerge from soft tonal gradations without outlines; glowing halos of untouched paper around figures; farmyards, rural labourers, mothers with children; hushed silent atmosphere
styles.note: Monochrome black and white only.

styles.name: Hippolyte Petitjean
styles.medium: watercolour on paper, oil on canvas
styles.features: spaced round dots of watercolour leaving white paper between them; arcadian scenes of nymphs, bathers and quiet villages; soft pale greens, blues and rose; airy diffused light; gentle decorative rhythm

styles.name: Lucie Cousturier
styles.features: small juxtaposed mosaic dabs of clear bright colour; flower and fruit still lifes; women sewing or reading in sunny interiors; gardens; warm luminous palette; firm simplified forms and calm balanced arrangement

styles.name: Georges Lemmen
styles.features: fine pointillist dots over careful drawing; quiet domestic interiors, women sewing, family portraits, North Sea beaches; subdued pearly tones of grey-blue, rose and cream; calm ordered compositions

styles.name: Anna Boch
styles.features: luminous divisionist dabs of pure colour; Belgian and Breton coastlines, dunes, blossoming gardens and flower still lifes; fresh greens, sea blues and pinks; clear daylight; open airy compositions with high skies

styles.name: Jan Toorop (pointillist phase)
