styles.features: Bravura portraits in thick scraped and smeared paint, sharply drawn eyes and features emerging from abstract textured strokes, warm ochre, rose and grey, loose unfinished-looking edges.

styles.name: Kuzma Petrov-Vodkin
styles.features: Curved spherical perspective with tilted horizons, clean areas of pure red, blue and yellow, smooth matte surfaces, solemn figures with calm oval faces, icon-like clarity, still lifes seen from above.

styles.name: Suprematism
styles.features: Flat geometric shapes — squares, crosses, bars and circles — floating on white ground, pure black, red and yellow with occasional blue, diagonal tilts suggesting weightless motion, no perspective or horizon.
styles.note: Founded by Kazimir Malevich

styles.name: Kazimir Malevich, late peasant period
styles.features: Faceless doll-like peasant figures built from simple cylinders and cones, bands of pure colour striping clothes and fields, flat striped horizons, frontal static poses, smooth matte paint.

styles.name: El Lissitzky
styles.medium: oil and gouache on canvas and paper, lithograph
styles.features: Axonometric floating blocks, planes and beams in ambiguous space, ruled lines, black, red and grey on textured off-white, constructions seeming to drift and rotate, blueprint precision.

styles.name: Alexander Rodchenko, constructivist photography
styles.features: Black-and-white photographs at steep diagonal angles, extreme worm's-eye and bird's-eye views of balconies, stairs and radio towers, strong graphic shadows, figures cropped dynamically, sharp contrast.
styles.note: Photographic style, not painting

styles.name: Stenberg brothers film posters
styles.features: Painted faces enlarged from film stills in photomontage manner, dizzying diagonal compositions, spiralling and radiating lines, bold flat colour blocks, large sans-serif Cyrillic lettering built into the image.

styles.name: ROSTA Windows satirical posters
styles.features: Stencilled posters in sequential panels, crude flat silhouettes of workers, soldiers and caricatured bourgeois, two or three colours such as red, black and ochre, thick contours, short handwritten Cyrillic captions under each frame.

styles.name: Soviet propaganda poster, 1930s–1950s
styles.features: Heroic workers, soldiers and farmers seen from low angle, red banners and flags, smooth airbrushed modelling, dominant red, white and black, bold slogan lettering in Cyrillic, radiant sunrise behind figures.
styles.note: Avoid real political slogans; use neutral captions

styles.name: Alexandra Exter
styles.medium: oil on canvas; gouache stage designs
styles.features: Cubo-futurist dynamism, fractured coloured planes and spiralling rhythms, theatre costumes as geometric figures of swirling fabric, bright orange, cobalt, emerald and black, crisp edges, strong sense of stage movement.

styles.name: Varvara Stepanova
styles.medium: printed textile design, gouache on paper
styles.features: Constructivist textile patterns of repeating circles, stripes, triangles and interlocking grids, two or three flat colours, crisp machine-like precision, optical rhythm spreading evenly across the surface.

styles.name: Pavel Filonov
styles.features: Surfaces built from countless tiny crystalline cells painted with a fine brush, figures, animals and cities fused into dense mosaic-like structure, intense staring faces, jewel-like reds, blues and ochres.

styles.name: Marc Chagall
styles.features: Dreamlike figures floating over wooden houses, lovers, fiddlers, cows and roosters, upside-down and transparent forms, deep blues, emerald and crimson, loose naive drawing, folk-tale logic of scale.

styles.name: Wassily Kandinsky
styles.features: Explosive abstract compositions of colliding colour patches, black whiplash lines, circles and wedges, saturated primaries over loose washes, musical rhythm, faint traces of riders, hills and domes dissolving.

styles.name: Alexander Deineka
styles.features: Smooth simplified Soviet modernism, athletic bodies in motion, flat grey-blue and ochre colour fields, sharp silhouettes, wide empty space and low horizons, industrial and sport scenes, clean poster-like lines.

styles.name: Yuri Pimenov
styles.features: Lyrical urban realism, rainy Moscow streets, women with umbrellas and flowers, glinting windows and cars, soft wet pastel greys, blues and pinks, airy brushwork, ordinary modern city life.

styles.name: Alexander Samokhvalov
styles.features: Sportswomen and workers as strong healthy figures, clean contours, matte tempera-like surfaces, white athletic clothing, pale blues and pinks, airy outdoor light, calm monumental poses.

styles.name: Arkady Plastov
styles.features: Rural realism of collective-farm harvests, haymaking, children and horses, sunlit fields, juicy green and golden strokes, bright summer light on skin, lively everyday village figures.

styles.name: Socialist Realism, Stalin-era academic painting
styles.features: Large polished academic paintings, ceremonial gatherings and heroic labourers, glossy finish, warm theatrical light, crowds in formal poses, red banners and chandeliered halls, idealised optimistic faces.
styles.note: Avoid real political leaders

styles.name: Severe Style (Soviet painting)
styles.features: Restrained monumental figures of builders, geologists and fishermen, broad flat planes, heavy dark contours, muted earth browns, steel greys and dull reds, compressed space, stoic expressions, harsh northern landscapes.

styles.name: Viktor Popkov
styles.features: Large flat colour areas, strong red and black against grey, stylised dignified figures in rhythmic rows, workers or grieving village women, emotional restraint, simplified poster-like forms, northern wooden interiors.

styles.name: Gely Korzhev
styles.features: Massive sculptural figures in thick dense paint, close-up cropped compositions, war veterans and workers, deep reds and earthy browns, harsh lighting, raw texture, strong sense of weight.

styles.name: Georgy Nissky
styles.features: Modernist landscapes of wide snowy plains crossed by railways, power lines and highways, clean geometric shapes, simplified planes of white, blue and grey, distant trains, high open skies.

styles.name: Vladimir Lebedev
styles.features: Children's book illustration of flat cut-paper-like colour shapes, constructivist simplification, generous white space, animals, circus performers and toys built from geometric blocks, red, black and blue print colours.

styles.name: Yury Vasnetsov
styles.features: Bright folk-inspired children's illustrations, cheerful stylised animals in patterned clothes, toy-like houses and trees, floral ornament like painted wooden toys and trays, red, green and yellow on dark or white ground.

styles.name: Vladimir Konashevich
styles.features: Lively nursery-rhyme and fairy-tale illustrations, fluent springy ink line, transparent watercolour washes, charming animals and children, decorative floral motifs, light airy page layouts.

styles.name: Tatiana Mavrina
styles.features: Spontaneous gouache of old Russian towns and fairy tales, dense saturated colour, naive loose brush drawing, golden domes, sleighs and markets, red, blue and gold patterns, folk-art flatness.

styles.name: Evgeny Charushin
styles.features: Animal illustrations with fluffy fur built from soft velvety strokes, round innocent forms of cubs, chicks and kittens, minimal settings on blank paper, warm ochres, greys and soft blacks.

styles.name: Vladimir Favorsky
styles.features: Book wood engraving with fine parallel and cross-hatched lines, white-line cutting, rhythmic black and white, compact figures harmonised with the page, space built from contrasting tonal textures.

styles.name: Soviet hand-drawn cel animation, 1950s
styles.medium: ink and gouache on celluloid over painted backgrounds
styles.features: Smooth lifelike character motion, clean thin ink outlines, soft gouache backgrounds of birch forests and fairy-tale palaces, gently rounded characters, warm pastel palette, theatrical lighting.
styles.note: Describe as period technique; do not name any studio

styles.name: Palekh lacquer miniature
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold leaf on black-lacquered papier-mâché
styles.features: Jet-black glossy lacquer ground, small egg-tempera figures with elongated slender bodies and tiny heads, fine gold-leaf hatching on robes, stylised stepped rocky hills, toy-like onion-domed towns, warm red, ochre and green palette, ornamental gold borders
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Mstyora lacquer miniature
styles.features: Scene painted edge to edge so the black lacquer barely shows, soft tonal gradations, warm ochre, pink and pale-blue skies, panoramic rolling countryside with rivers and small figures, delicate gold ornamental frame
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kholui lacquer miniature
styles.features: Black lacquer boxes with tempera scenes in a softer, more naturalistic manner than Palekh, layered landscapes with birches and river views, many-figured folk and fairy-tale episodes, cool greens and blues, gold ornamental borders
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Fedoskino lacquer miniature
styles.medium: oil on lacquered papier-mâché with mother-of-pearl and metal-leaf underlay
styles.features: Realistic oil painting in thin translucent glazes over black lacquer, mother-of-pearl or gold leaf glowing through the colour, troika rides, tea-drinking and village genre scenes, naturalistic light and modelling, deep varnished gloss
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Khokhloma painting
styles.medium: oil-tempera on turned wood, tin powder under hardened varnish
styles.features: Glossy wooden bowls, spoons and dishes with a gleaming gold-coloured ground, vivid vermilion and black brushwork of curling grass stems, rowan berries, strawberries and leaves, free calligraphic strokes; also black grounds with gold and red plants
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Gzhel ceramics
styles.medium: cobalt underglaze painting on white porcelain and faience
styles.features: Pure white glazed ware painted only in cobalt blue, single-stroke brushmarks shading from deep to pale within one sweep, large blue roses, leaves, small figures and country houses, wavy borders, fine blue grids
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Zhostovo tray painting
styles.features: Black glossy tray with a central bouquet of large garden roses, peonies, daisies and leaves, dark muted underpainting lifted by bright overlaid highlight strokes and white glints, fine gold scrollwork around the rim
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Russian lubok print
styles.medium: hand-coloured woodcut and copper engraving on paper
styles.features: Thick, naive black woodcut outlines filled with blotchy hand-applied crimson, yellow and green, flat figures of jesters, heroes, animals and feasting peasants, crowded composition with lettered captions and text blocks filling the sheet
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery
styles.note: Captions are part of the look; keep lettering short or decorative

styles.name: Mezen painting
styles.medium: red and black paint on bare wood, distaffs and chests
styles.features: Only two colours, black and red-brown, on raw golden wood; rows of stylised horses, deer and birds in friezes, fine hatching and archaic geometric signs like script, sun rosettes and zigzag bands
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Permogorye painting (Northern Dvina)
styles.medium: tempera on wood, distaffs and household objects
styles.features: White ground, firm black outlines filled with red, green and yellow, large tulip-like flowers on curving stems, Sirin birds, small scenes of tea-drinking and sleigh rides set in tiers, flat decorative composition
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Rakula painting (Northern Dvina)
styles.features: Golden-ochre ground, large leaves and curled stems drawn with thick sweeping black contours, filled with green, red and brown, few small details, bold rhythmic monumental ornament covering the whole surface, occasional birds
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Borok painting (Northern Dvina)
styles.medium: tempera on wood with gilded accents
styles.features: Bright red, green and golden ochre with fine black outlines, dense tiers of tulips, leaves and scrolls framing small genre scenes of sleigh rides and village life, lively miniature figures, gilded touches
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Gorodets painting
styles.medium: oil-tempera on wood boards and furniture
styles.features: Black, ochre or bare wooden grounds, plump stylised roses with white highlight strokes, proud prancing horses, gentlemen in frock coats and ladies at tea, saturated blue, red and green, black ornamental flourishes, flat paint
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Polkhov-Maidan painting
styles.medium: aniline dyes on white-primed turned wood
styles.features: Turned wooden toys, boxes and nesting dolls with a white ground, large rose and poppy heads in vivid crimson, green, violet and yellow, bold black ink outlines, free loose contours, glossy varnish
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Dymkovo clay toy
styles.features: Chalk-white clay figures painted with saturated pink, red, blue, yellow and green circles, dots, stripes and checks, plump ladies in bell skirts, water carriers, turkeys with fanned tails, small gold-leaf squares
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Filimonovo clay toy
styles.features: Elongated clay figures with long necks and slim bodies: horses, deer, bell-skirted ladies, painted on whitish clay in stripes of crimson, yellow and green, simple dashes, triangles and sun rosettes
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kargopol clay toy
styles.features: Squat clay figures with thick limbs and archaic heavy forms: peasant women, bears, the centaur Polkan, white ground with simple red, green, ochre and black crosses, dots and stripes
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Abashevo clay toy
styles.features: Clay animal whistles with exaggerated sweeping horns, long necks and curly beards, rams, goats and deer painted in deep blue and green with silvery-metallic horns and faces, simple stylised curls
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Bogorodskoye wood carving
styles.features: Pale natural limewood figures and moving toys, bears hammering at an anvil, peasants at work on sliding slats, crisp faceted knife cuts, textured fur and clothing, humorous lively poses
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Vologda bobbin lace
styles.features: White linen lace with a continuous flowing tape forming large stylised flowers, snowflakes and birds against fine mesh grounds, crisp graphic white pattern shown against a dark background
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Pavlovo Posad printed shawl
styles.features: Fringed woollen shawls on black, scarlet or cream ground, dense clustered bouquets of roses, dahlias and leaves radiating from corners and centre, saturated reds, greens and blues, ornate symmetrical borders
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Russian matryoshka, Sergiev Posad type
styles.medium: gouache and lacquer on turned limewood
styles.features: Turned wooden nesting dolls, round smiling face with rosy cheeks, patterned headscarf and apron, sarafan with flowers, flat gouache colours on pale wood under glossy lacquer, simple costume details
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Semyonov matryoshka
styles.medium: aniline dyes and varnish on bare turned wood
styles.features: Nesting dolls on bare blonde wood, bright yellow scarf, scarlet sarafan, a huge bouquet of red roses on the apron, black ink outlines, much unpainted wood showing, glossy varnish
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Rostov finift enamel
styles.medium: painted enamel on copper, filigree frame
styles.features: Small white-enamel plaques with fine miniature brushwork in translucent luminous colours, flower bouquets, portraits and white churches with domes, smooth vitreous surface, framed by filigree metal
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kholmogory bone carving
styles.medium: carved and pierced bone and walrus tusk
styles.features: Creamy white bone with pierced openwork lace, low-relief plant scrolls and small scenes of reindeer, sledges, hunters and Arctic animals, delicate tinted engraving in green and brown
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Shemogoda birch-bark carving
styles.features: Golden-tan birch bark cut into lacelike openwork over a darker layer, scrolling stems, berries, leaves, small deer and birds, fine incised lines, warm monochrome
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Russian polychrome izraztsy tiles
styles.features: Moulded relief tiles glazed in emerald green, ochre-yellow, cobalt and white, stylised peacocks, lions, rosettes and vines set in friezes and window frames on red-brick walls
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Nizhny Tagil tray painting
styles.features: Black or deep-green lacquered iron trays with large oil-painted fruit, flowers and berries in broad free brushstrokes, deep luminous translucent lacquer glow, fine gold ornamental rim
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Ural-Siberian folk painting
styles.medium: oil-tempera on wooden chests, doors and house boards
styles.features: Big bold flowers built with double-loaded brushstrokes blending dark to light in a single stroke, red, blue and green on ochre or dark ground, scattered birds, airy free composition
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Torzhok gold embroidery
styles.medium: couched gold and silver thread on velvet or leather
styles.features: Raised gold and silver thread laid and couched in relief on deep red, blue or green velvet, dense floral scrolls and geometric rosettes, shimmering metallic texture
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Skopin ceramics
styles.features: Fantastic sculptural vessels and jugs shaped as dragons, lions, eagles and birds, multi-tiered moulded ornament, runny glazes of honey-brown, green and dark amber
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kasli cast iron
styles.features: Black cast-iron figures and openwork with crisp detailed naturalistic modelling, horses, riders, peasants, lace-like pierced panels, dull metallic sheen and fine surface texture
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Maria Prymachenko
styles.features: Flat bright gouache on white paper, fantastical beasts with flowery bodies, toothy grins and big eyes, vines and dotted flowers sprouting everywhere, no perspective, red, yellow, green, blue, naive joyful forms
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kateryna Bilokur
styles.features: Densely packed abundant flower bouquets and fields, every petal, ear of wheat and leaf painted meticulously, rich jewel tones, still-life heaps of blossoms against dark or open landscape backgrounds
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Hanna Sobachko-Shostak
styles.features: Decorative compositions of fantastical flowers and birds, energetic rhythmic sweeping strokes, bouquets rising from vases, saturated reds, blues, yellows and greens, flat ornamental floral fields
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Petrykivka painting
styles.medium: tempera or gouache on paper, wood and walls
styles.features: Flowing floral ornament of curled feathery strokes made with fine brush and fingertips, vivid red, yellow, orange, green and blue on white or black, guelder-rose berries, cockerels and firebirds, airy symmetry
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Ukrainian pysanka
styles.features: Wax-resist dyed eggs divided into bands and segments, eight-pointed stars, spirals, wheat ears, deer and stylised flowers, dense symmetrical patterns in red, black, yellow, orange and white
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery
styles.note: Has Easter associations; favour geometric and nature motifs

styles.name: Ukrainian vytynanka
styles.features: Symmetrical paper silhouettes folded and cut in one colour against contrasting ground, trees of life, birds, flowers in vases, couples and lacy openwork borders
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Polish wycinanki, Łowicz type
styles.features: Multi-layered glossy coloured paper cut-outs, round rosettes and tall panels with roosters, peacocks, flowers and costumed figures, bright pink, green, yellow, violet layers stacked over black
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Polish wycinanki, Kurpie type
styles.features: Single-colour symmetrical paper cuts, tall stylised lily-tree with branches, birds perched on stems, crisp jagged edges, bold silhouettes set on a contrasting background
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Belarusian vytsinanka
styles.features: White or red paper cut lace with symmetrical openwork, storks, sun signs, trees of life and dancing figures, repeated small notched motifs, delicate snowflake-like geometric fields
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Ukrainian rushnyk embroidery
styles.features: Long linen towels with red and black cross-stitch, geometric diamonds, stylised trees of life, birds and roses in symmetrical bands at the ends, visible pixel-like stitch grid
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kosiv ceramics
styles.features: Cream engobe with incised sgraffito lines, painted in ochre, green and brown, Hutsul figures, horsemen, deer, birds and flowers, glaze slightly running, lively rustic drawing
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Opishnia ceramics
styles.features: Earthenware vessels and animal-shaped jugs, rams, lions and horses, cream engobe with free brown, green and ochre floral painting under clear glaze, whimsical rounded forms
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Hutsul wood inlay
styles.medium: wood inlaid with beads, brass, mother-of-pearl
styles.features: Dark wood boxes, plates and staffs inlaid with beads, brass wire, bone and mother-of-pearl in dense geometric rhombuses, rosettes and zigzag bands, chip-carved borders
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Aleksandra Kish, Belarusian painted carpets
styles.features: Painted textile carpets with swans on a lake, lovers in a boat, paradise gardens and castles, naive flat forms, deep blue and green grounds, framed by wreath-like flower garland borders
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Slutsk sash
styles.medium: silk woven with gold and silver threads
styles.features: Long woven silk sashes glittering with gold and silver thread, Persian-style rosettes, carnations and flower sprays in end panels, fine rhythmic repeats, multicolour lustrous silk
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Belarusian straw weaving
styles.features: Shiny golden straw plaited into dolls, birds, horses and hanging geometric 'spider' ornaments, warm yellow sheen, layered angular forms, crisp braided textures
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Zalipie painted cottages
styles.medium: paint on whitewashed walls and stoves
styles.features: Whitewashed or pale-blue walls covered with scattered flowers, vines and birds, delicate flat petals in vivid pink, blue, red and green, wooden cottages, stoves and wells decorated
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Podhale glass painting
styles.features: Painted on the back of glass, bold black contours, flat bright red, blue, yellow and green fills, metallic foil accents, highland bandits and flowers, stiff frontal naive figures
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery
styles.note: Many historic pieces are religious; favour secular highland subjects

styles.name: Czech blueprint (modrotisk)
styles.medium: indigo resist print on cotton or linen
styles.features: Deep indigo cloth with crisp white resist patterns, small repeated flowers, sprigs, dots, stripes and birds, all-over textile repeats
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Slovak folk majolica, Modra
styles.features: White tin-glazed jugs and plates painted in blue, yellow, green and manganese brown, stylised flowers and leaves, small figures at work or celebration, soft glossy glaze
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Čičmany painted log houses
styles.medium: lime-white painting on dark timber walls
styles.features: Dark log houses covered with white lime ornament, geometric crosses, triangles, zigzags and stars aligned along timber joints, strong black-and-white graphic contrast, snowy village streets
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Hlebine school naive painting
styles.features: Painted on the back of glass, minutely detailed village life, flat bright colours, sharp precise outlines, stylised trees with every leaf drawn, snowy fields, harvests and fairs under luminous skies
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Chiprovtsi kilim
styles.features: Flatwoven wool rugs with stepped angular edges, stylised birds, trees of life and rhombic medallions, red, blue, ochre, green and black grounds, symmetrical rhythmic rows
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery

styles.name: Kozak Mamai folk painting
styles.medium: tempera and oil on canvas or wooden boards
styles.features: Naive folk paintings of a cross-legged seated Cossack with a kobza beneath a tree, horse tethered nearby, flat frontal figure, stiff drawing, earthy greens, reds and ochres, accessories hanging around
styles.section: Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian and other Slavic folk and decorative arts as imagery
styles.note: Traditional pieces often bear inscriptions; can be omitted

styles.name: Byzantine mosaic, Ravenna school
styles.medium: glass and gold smalti mosaic on walls and vaults
styles.features: Small glass tesserae set in visible rows on shimmering gold or deep blue grounds; frontal, elongated figures in white and purple robes with large dark eyes; flat space, stylised trees, lambs, starry vaults.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Middle Byzantine mosaic, Hosios Loukas and Daphni
styles.medium: glass and gold mosaic in domes and squinches
styles.features: Gold-ground mosaic following curved domes; solemn figures with classical proportions; crisp drapery picked out in light linear highlights; austere compositions with few figures against empty gold; deep blue, crimson, white.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Palaiologan mosaic and fresco, Chora Church, Constantinople
styles.features: Lively narrative scenes with small elongated figures, swirling drapery and agitated poses; fantastic stepped buildings and draped awnings behind figures; soft modelling in pale green, rose, ochre and gold; dense multi-figure compositions.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Macedonian Renaissance manuscript illumination, Constantinople
styles.features: Classicising full-page miniatures with draped figures and personifications in antique poses; atmospheric landscapes of hills, trees and pastel skies; soft modelling in blue and rose; gilded frames around each scene.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Byzantine cloisonné enamel
styles.features: Thin gold wire cells outlining faces and drapery, filled with glossy translucent emerald, lapis blue, red and white enamel; figures set on bare polished gold; small plaque format, flat, jewel-like surface.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Byzantine ivory carving, Macedonian period
styles.features: Cream-white ivory relief in shallow and high planes; slender figures in classical drapery under arches; triptych leaves framed with rosette borders; crisp undercutting casting soft shadows; monochrome warm surface.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Early Byzantine encaustic icons of Sinai
styles.medium: encaustic wax paint on wooden panel
styles.features: Thick translucent wax paint with visible, directional strokes; naturalistic half-length frontal figures with large eyes and asymmetric modelling; warm flesh tones, deep purple and gold; plain niche-like backgrounds.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Cappadocian rock-cut church frescoes, Göreme
styles.medium: fresco on carved tufa walls and vaults
styles.features: Paintings wrapping curved cave vaults and carved columns; linear figures with large eyes and red-brown outlines; ochre, red, green and blue grounds; continuous narrative friezes; worn, uneven rock surface.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Komnenian fresco, Nerezi
styles.features: Emotional figures with elongated limbs, expressive grieving faces and tearful eyes; long fluid drapery with sharp linear highlights; muted blue, ochre and green; sparse rocky landscapes behind tightly grouped mourners.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Manuel Panselinos
styles.features: Monumental, heavy-set figures with robust faces built from olive-green underpaint and bright highlights; voluminous drapery; calm classical poses; deep blue grounds, warm ochres, earthy reds; architectural backdrops.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Cretan school icon painting
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold leaf on panel
styles.features: Polished precise tempera with fine gold hatching on garments; dark olive flesh with linear white highlights; flat gold backgrounds; sharp-edged stepped rocks; small Italianate details; smooth enamel-like finish.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Theophanes the Cretan
styles.features: Ascetic elongated saints with dark faces and few sharp highlights on austere dark grounds; crowded narrative scenes in frieze-like rows with jagged mountains and buildings; restrained olive, ochre, deep red, black-blue.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Syriac Gospel illumination, Rabbula Gospels type
styles.features: Vivid miniatures and canon tables framed by painted arches and columns, with birds and plants in margins; stocky figures, bold outlines; saturated purple, green, red on bare parchment; striped, banded mountains.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Coptic tapestry textiles
styles.features: Woven roundels and bands with stylised dancers, hunters, animals, birds and vine scrolls; purple-brown monochrome or bright red, yellow, green wool; chunky stepped outlines; flat figures with large eyes.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Coptic monastic wall painting, Bawit and Saqqara
styles.features: Frontal saints and monks with oversized round eyes and heavy dark outlines; flat ochre, red and green fields; simple niches and arcades; geometric borders, interlace and painted columns framing figures.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Yuhanna al-Armani
styles.features: Bright naïve icons with flat red, blue and yellow fields; round faces with almond eyes and rosy cheeks; ornate floral backgrounds and curtains; equestrian saints on stiff, patterned horses.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Nubian church murals, Faras cathedral
styles.features: Large frontal figures with huge eyes and heavy lines; local bishops and rulers with dark skin, saints paler; ornate crowns and patterned robes in purple, orange, yellow; flat plain backgrounds.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art
styles.note: Keep skin tones as described, without caricature.

styles.name: Ethiopian manuscript illumination, early Solomonic period
styles.features: Flat, strongly patterned figures with oversized almond eyes and frontal faces; bold black outlines; bands of red, yellow and green; stripes and zigzags on garments; no depth, symmetrical compositions.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Fre Seyon
styles.features: Panel icons with soft oval faces and large eyes; Virgin in a blue mantle with gently folded drapery; flanking archangels holding swords; red, green and blue fields on flat yellow ground; delicate linear modelling.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Ethiopian church mural painting, Gondarine style
styles.medium: tempera on canvas fixed to church walls
styles.features: Rows of flat saints and riders; ceilings covered with winged angel heads with big eyes; bright yellow, red, green and blue; thick black contours; patterned costumes; good figures frontal, villains in profile.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Ethiopian processional cross metalwork
styles.medium: cast and chased brass, bronze or silver
styles.features: Openwork crosses with flaring arms filled by dense lattices of interlaced loops and geometric tracery; small incised figures; worn golden brass or silver surface; symmetrical lace-like silhouette.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Ethiopian popular painting, Addis Ababa
styles.features: Large flat compositions packed with small figures; battle scenes with Ethiopians shown frontally and enemies in profile; horsemen, banners, cannons; bright primary colours; stacked narrative bands with Amharic captions.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art
styles.note: Captions may come out garbled; they can be omitted.

styles.name: Toros Roslin
styles.features: Refined miniatures with graceful figures and naturalistic faces; fine gold, deep blue and vermilion; ornate headpieces and canon tables with peacocks, birds and foliage; marginal ornaments; delicate drapery modelling.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Armenian manuscript illumination, Vaspurakan school
styles.features: Naïve flat figures with large heads and staring eyes; bold contour lines; intense red, yellow, blue and green with little modelling; simplified compositions; ornamental borders with birds.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Armenian manuscript illumination, Gladzor school
styles.features: Expressive miniatures with elongated, energetic figures and dramatic gestures; strongly outlined faces; bright contrasting colours with gold accents; canon tables decorated with exotic animals and interlace.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Armenian khachkar stone carving
styles.medium: carved volcanic tuff or basalt stele
styles.features: Upright stone slab carved with a central cross rising from a rosette or sun disc, surrounded by deep lace-like interlace, knots and palmettes; shadowed openwork relief; grey, pinkish or ochre stone.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Georgian manuscript illumination, Gelati Gospels type
styles.features: Small narrative miniatures set into text columns; slender figures with lively gestures; gold grounds with deep blue, vermilion and green; ornamental headpieces and initials; Georgian capital script around images.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Georgian chased goldsmith icons
styles.medium: chased silver-gilt with enamel and gems
styles.features: Hammered relief figures on gold or silver-gilt sheet; small cloisonné enamel plaques and cabochon gems set into frames; dense vine-scroll borders; glinting metal with soft raised forms.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Svanetian church frescoes
styles.features: Linear figures with strong outlines and large eyes; deep blue grounds with earthy red and ochre; mounted saints slaying dragons; simplified rhythmic drapery; painted on small churches inside and outside.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Kievan Rus mosaic, St Sophia of Kyiv
styles.medium: glass and gold mosaic with fresco
styles.features: Solid monumental figures in blue and red robes on glittering gold; firmly outlined frontal faces; stylised drapery folds; mosaics in the upper zones, frescoes in ochre and red below.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Vladimir-Suzdal white-stone carving
styles.features: Pale limestone walls covered in shallow relief: lions, griffins, birds, centaurs, saints and stylised trees in rows between blind arcades; soft cream tone; flat repeating motifs.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Novgorod school icon painting
styles.medium: egg tempera on gessoed lime panel
styles.features: Bright cinnabar red grounds and fields with white and green; flat shapes with crisp contours; stocky figures with strong silhouettes; laconic compositions; riders on white horses against red.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Pskov school icon painting
styles.features: Dark intense palette of deep green, cherry red, orange and ochre; dynamic asymmetric figures; expressive faces with thick white highlights; vigorous brushwork; dense, emotional compositions.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Dionisius
styles.medium: fresco and egg tempera on panel
styles.features: Very elongated weightless figures with small heads; festive pale palette of light blue, pink, pistachio, white and ochre; flowing rhythmic compositions; airy architecture and slender hills; delicate highlights.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Northern Russian folk icons (severnye pis'ma)
styles.features: Simple folk-like icons with bright red and white grounds; large flat shapes and naïve proportions; broad green and ochre accents; rough, direct brushwork; robust, rustic saints.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Stroganov school icon painting
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold on small panels
styles.features: Small precious icons with minutely painted figures and gold and silver highlights; fragile elongated saints in elegant poses; detailed landscapes with fantastic hills, trees and towers; dark olive, crimson, gold.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Simon Ushakov
styles.features: Icons with volumetric, softly shaded faces approaching Western realism; warm flesh tones and deeper shadows; Baroque architectural backgrounds in perspective; gold ornament; heavy drapery with natural folds.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Yaroslavl church frescoes of the 17th century
styles.features: Walls covered in dense colourful narrative bands; many small figures in contemporary dress ploughing, building, fishing; bright blue, green, pink and gold; floral ornamental borders; lively carpet-like effect.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Russian pictorial church embroidery (litsevoe shitye)
styles.medium: silk, gold and silver thread on silk or velvet
styles.features: Figures in split-stitch silk with stitches following faces and drapery; couched gold-thread backgrounds and haloes; pearl-studded borders; soft sheen in muted rose, blue and ochre.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Pomorian cast brass icons
styles.features: Small cast brass panels and folding triptychs with low-relief figures; white, blue, green and yellow enamel filling backgrounds; worn golden metal highlights; raised Slavonic lettering on borders.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Rostov enamel (finift)
styles.features: Small oval miniatures on smooth glossy white enamel; delicately painted faces, flowers and churches in pastel and vivid colours; set in filigree silver or gilded metal frames.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Boyana Church frescoes, Tarnovo school
styles.features: Individualised faces with warm modelling and soft shadows; donor portraits in rich medieval dress; calm natural proportions; deep blue backgrounds with ochre, red and green; gentle, humane expressions.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Serbian Raška school frescoes, Mileševa and Sopoćani
styles.features: Monumental classicising figures on yellow backgrounds incised with grid lines imitating gold mosaic; calm noble faces; broad heavy drapery; large multi-figure scenes in rich colour.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Moldavian painted monasteries, Bukovina
styles.features: Entire outer church walls covered in fresco tiers under wide shingled eaves; intense blue or red-brown grounds; long bands of small figures, processions and sieges; weathered surfaces.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Romanian reverse-glass icons, Nicula
styles.medium: tempera painted on the reverse of glass
styles.features: Naïve frontal saints with bold black outlines; flat bright red, blue, yellow and green; flowers and dots filling the background; glossy glass surface; simple folk ornament borders.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Carpathian icon painting, Lemko and Boyko
styles.features: Bold red and white grounds; flat stylised figures with strong outlines; large haloes with incised decoration; folk ornament in borders; narrative scenes with simple hills and little wooden buildings.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Ivan Rutkovych
styles.medium: tempera and gilded gesso relief on panel
styles.features: Baroque-influenced icons with plump rosy faces; gilded raised gesso backgrounds with vine ornament; bright local colours; figures in contemporary costume; small side panels with narrative scenes.
styles.section: Byzantine, Orthodox and Eastern Christian art

styles.name: Christoffer Wilhelm Eckersberg
styles.features: crisp clear daylight, precise contours, exact linear perspective, smooth invisible brushwork, harbour views with rigged sailing ships, calm pale skies, small carefully drawn figures, cool blues and warm stone ochres

styles.name: Christen Købke
styles.features: soft even northern light, intimate views of ramparts, lakes and brick castles, delicate pinks, pale blues and greens, precise but gentle drawing, still water reflections, quiet figures, smooth finish

styles.name: Johan Thomas Lundbye
styles.features: gentle Danish countryside of low hills, open fields and dolmens, grazing cattle drawn with care, warm afternoon light, wide skies with soft clouds, clear contours, muted greens and golden browns

styles.name: Laurits Andersen Ring
styles.features: flat Zealand countryside, straight country roads receding to a low horizon, bare poplars, solitary labourers, cool greys and pale greens, precise clear drawing, sparse melancholic stillness, wide empty skies

styles.name: Asger Jorn
styles.features: thick gestural impasto, swirling smeared strokes in primary reds, yellows, blues and black, childlike grotesque creatures and faces emerging from tangled paint, spontaneous drips, no perspective
styles.note: semi-abstract; subjects appear only as rough creatures and faces

styles.name: Kay Nielsen
styles.medium: ink, watercolour and gouache on paper
styles.features: elongated stylised figures with flowing hair and robes, intricate ornamental patterning, vast snowy or starry backgrounds, fine ink line, jewel-like muted colours, Art Nouveau and Art Deco elegance, dramatic empty space

styles.name: Eero Järnefelt
styles.features: high viewpoints over blue lakes and forested ridges, endless layered hills fading into haze, clear northern light, autumn birch golds, naturalistic detail, peasants clearing land with smoke and fire

styles.name: Fanny Churberg
styles.features: wild untamed Finnish landscapes, stormy skies, dark rocks and moss, broken pines, thick loose brushwork, deep greens, browns and slate greys, dramatic light breaking through clouds, no figures

styles.name: Rudolf Koivu
styles.features: fairy-tale book illustration, flowing Art Nouveau line, gnomes, elves and children in mossy forests, soft translucent washes, pale greens, blues and rose, decorative borders of plants, gentle humour

styles.name: Finnish ryijy rug
styles.features: shaggy long wool pile with softly blurred edges, symmetrical geometric motifs, central tree of life, hearts, stars and stylised birds, deep reds, indigo, ochre and green, wide framing borders

styles.name: John Bauer
styles.features: huge lumpy-nosed trolls among towering dark pine trunks, small fair-haired princesses, mossy boulders, muted earthy greens, browns and gold, soft hazy forest light, delicate line, quiet mystery

styles.name: Eugène Jansson
styles.features: deep ultramarine and Prussian blue nocturnes of Stockholm, curving shorelines and bridges, rows of glowing gaslights, rhythmic undulating brushstrokes, high viewpoint over water and rooftops, mood of solitude

styles.name: Elsa Beskow
styles.features: children's picture-book illustration, clear gentle outlines, soft transparent watercolour, children and small forest folk under mushrooms and flowers, plants dressed as people, careful botanical detail, light pastel palette

styles.name: Dalecarlian kurbits painting (dalmålning)
styles.medium: distemper on linen, paper and wooden walls
styles.features: huge stylised gourd-like flowering plants with swirling leaves, biblical and wedding processions with figures in 18th-century coats and hats, flat bright reds, blues, greens and yellow, bold outlines, framed panels
styles.note: original hangings often carry painted captions; prompts can omit them

styles.name: Gustaf Fjæstad
styles.features: hoarfrost and fresh snow on stream banks, dark winding water with mirror reflections, dense mosaic-like small strokes, curving Art Nouveau rhythms, white, blue-grey and pale violet, no figures

styles.name: Ivar Arosenius
styles.features: whimsical fairy-tale watercolours, wobbly expressive line, knights, princesses, cats and trolls, small round figures, soft blended washes of red, ochre and green, naive humour, dreamy dark backgrounds

styles.name: Nikolai Astrup
styles.features: steep green mountains around a lake, midsummer bonfires, rhubarb and pussy willow, turf-roofed farmhouses, naive decorative shapes, rich greens and night blues, woodcut prints with layered hand-coloured blocks

styles.name: Theodor Kittelsen
styles.medium: pen and ink, watercolour on paper
styles.features: trolls the size of mountains, water spirits in dark lakes, forest beings among roots, dense pen hatching, moody muted watercolour, moonlit fjords, strange humorous creatures in vast landscapes

styles.name: Harriet Backer
styles.features: interiors by lamplight and window light, rich deep blues, greens and reds, women reading or playing piano, rural church interiors, glowing colour accents, thick soft brushwork

styles.name: Kristjan Raud
styles.medium: charcoal, ink and chalk on paper
styles.features: monumental heroic figures from Estonian epic legend, massive simplified bodies, dark velvety charcoal masses, stony boulders, archaic landscapes, strong silhouettes, monochrome black, grey and white

styles.name: Vilhelms Purvītis
styles.features: melting snow in spring forests, birch trunks reflected in meltwater, pale blue and lilac shadows, soft impressionist strokes, quiet rivers, low northern light, muted whites, ochres and greens

styles.name: Janis Rozentāls
styles.features: Latvian village life and churchyards, sturdy peasant figures, careful realism, bright plein-air light, later Art Nouveau portraits with decorative curving outlines, warm greens, ochres and whites

styles.name: Aleksandra Beļcova
styles.features: Latvian modernism, figures and still lifes built from geometric planes, cubist-constructive structure, firm outlines, muted ochres, reds, greys and blues, folk motifs on painted porcelain plates

styles.name: Eduard Wiiralt
styles.features: dense fine engraved lines, grotesque crowds and cabaret scenes, finely detailed animals and cats, Moroccan figures, black and white with velvety tonal depths, intricate hatching, unsettling expressions

styles.name: Estonian Muhu embroidery
styles.medium: wool and silk embroidery on wool cloth
styles.features: dense satin-stitch flowers, large stylised roses, tulips and leaves, vivid pink, orange, yellow and green on black or red wool, packed symmetrical sprays, glossy raised stitches

styles.name: Jóhannes Kjarval
styles.features: close-up lava fields and moss, thick textured paint, mottled muted greens, ochres, greys and violets, shallow ground-level space, faint faces and spirits half-hidden in rocks, flat high horizons

styles.name: John Savio
styles.features: bold black-and-white relief prints of Sami life, reindeer herds, sleds, lavvu tents, northern lights in carved rays, strong gouged lines, flat silhouettes, occasional blue and red hand colouring

styles.name: Nils Nilsson Skum
styles.medium: pencil, ink and watercolour on paper
styles.features: detailed drawings of reindeer herding and migration, hundreds of small reindeer with branching antlers, herders on skis, white open backgrounds, diagram-like overhead views, fine precise line, pale washes

styles.name: Sami duodji tin-thread embroidery and ribbon appliqué
styles.medium: pewter thread couched on leather and broadcloth
styles.features: silvery tin-thread couched in dense geometric bands, zigzags, diamonds and comb shapes on dark leather, bright broadcloth borders in red, yellow, blue and green, crisp repeating stripes
styles.note: secular dress and craft ornament only; avoid drum motifs

styles.name: Sami duodji engraved reindeer antler
styles.features: creamy antler knife handles and sheaths with fine incised lines filled with dark soot or reddish alder dye, geometric borders, plant scrolls and small reindeer herding scenes, polished smooth surface

styles.name: Aron of Kangeq
styles.features: naive watercolours of Greenlandic legends, kayaks and umiaks on icy water, turf houses, hunters in skin clothing, small simplified figures, pale washes of blue, brown and grey, flat icebergs

styles.name: Hannah Höch
styles.medium: photomontage, cut magazine photographs on paper
styles.features: Photographs cut from illustrated magazines and pasted into collisions of scale: female heads on mismatched bodies, machine parts, crowds and type scraps; flat paper ground, crisp scissor edges, grey and sepia halftones with sparse colour.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: John Heartfield
styles.features: Single seamless composite photograph in black-and-white halftone, real people and objects joined with airbrushed retouching into one absurd staged scene, bold headline and caption lettering, occasional strong red accent.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Political satire; keep the subject neutral and avoid political symbols.

styles.name: Kurt Schwitters, Merz collage
styles.medium: collage of paper and found scraps on card
styles.features: Small dense collages of torn tickets, wrappers, newsprint and coloured paper overlapping at angles; worn stained textures, type cut off mid-word; muted browns, ochres and faded blues with a red or yellow accent.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Lettering is fragmentary and illegible by design.

styles.name: Francis Picabia, mechanomorphic drawings
styles.features: Technical-diagram drawings of pistons, spark plugs, gears, coils and valves made with ruler and compass in thin black line on blank paper, sparse flat metallic colour, machines standing in for portraits.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Mechanomorphic period only.

styles.name: Jean Arp
styles.features: Smooth rounded biomorphic shapes like pebbles, navels and clouds, cut from wood in shallow layered relief, flat matte white, black, blue and ochre paint, soft continuous edges, loose arrangements as if placed by chance.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Sophie Taeuber-Arp
styles.medium: gouache on paper, painted wood relief, textile
styles.features: Strict grid of rectangles, circles and small squares in flat hand-painted gouache, primary colours with pink, grey and black on white, rhythmic balanced placement recalling woven textile and marionette costume.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Marcel Janco, Dada masks
styles.medium: painted cardboard, paper, wire and string
styles.features: Handmade masks with angular exaggerated features, triangular eyes and gaping mouths, cubist-like planes, rough cardboard and string surfaces, bold flat red, ochre, white and black paint.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Best for masked performers and costumed figures.

styles.name: George Grosz, Berlin Dada drawings
styles.medium: pen and ink with watercolour on paper
styles.features: Sharp scratchy pen line, crowded city streets seen as if through transparent walls, grotesque caricatured bourgeois figures, tilted buildings, thin watercolour washes of pink, ochre and grey.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Satirical; can turn grotesque.

styles.name: Rayograph (cameraless photogram), Man Ray
styles.features: Objects laid directly on photographic paper and exposed: glowing white silhouettes of keys, combs, spirals, glasses and hands on deep black ground, soft halos where objects lifted, translucent greys, no perspective.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Monochrome only.

styles.name: Giorgio de Chirico, metaphysical painting
styles.features: Empty Italian piazzas with arcades in steep conflicting perspective, long raking shadows, tiny distant figures, faceless tailor's mannequins and statues, a train on the horizon, deep green-black sky over warm ochre and brick, dry flat paint.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Carlo Carrà, metaphysical period
styles.features: Shallow box-like rooms with tilted floors holding mannequins, a ball, geometric solids and framed charts like stage props; heavy simplified volumes, quiet dry brushwork, muffled browns, greys and terracotta.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Alberto Savinio
styles.features: Human figures with bird, animal or toy heads posed in domestic or classical settings, oversized toys and building blocks, heaped ruins on distant shores, smooth flat modelling, acid candy pink, turquoise and lemon colours.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Giorgio Morandi, metaphysical period
styles.features: Crisp still lifes of bottles, boxes, a mannequin head and geometric solids set close on a tabletop against blank walls, hard contours, smooth even light, chalky greys, ivory and pale ochre, total stillness.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Use the crisp metaphysical phase, not the later soft-edged bottles.

styles.name: Salvador Dalí
styles.features: Smoothly blended precise oil with photographic detail, melting clocks and soft drooping objects, crutches, ants, double images, endless flat plain and Catalan cliffs under clear blue sky, long shadows, tiny distant figures.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: René Magritte
styles.features: Plain flat illustrative oil in even daylight, ordinary objects—bowler hats, apples, pipes, curtains, clouds—in impossible scale or juxtaposition, sky blue with white clouds, smooth surfaces, calm frontal compositions.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Max Ernst, frottage and grattage
styles.medium: oil with grattage on canvas, pencil frottage on paper
styles.features: Textures rubbed or scraped from wood grain, leaves and string into dense petrified forests, walls of trees, hidden bird shapes and a pale ring-shaped sun; rough granular surfaces, dark greens, umbers, ochres, cold blues.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Surrealist collage novel from cut 19th-century wood engravings
styles.medium: collage of wood-engraving illustrations on paper
styles.features: Black-and-white engraved book illustrations cut and joined seamlessly: dense parallel hatching, bourgeois interiors, gentlemen with bird or lion heads, dragons and floods, uniform fine line hiding the joins, melodramatic theatrical staging.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Strictly black and white.

styles.name: Yves Tanguy
styles.features: Vast misty plain without a horizon line fading from grey to blue, scattered smooth bone-like and pebble-like biomorphic objects casting sharp shadows, precise smooth finish, cool greys and pale blues with small red and yellow accents.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Joan Miró
styles.features: Flat colour fields with floating black-outlined signs: stars, eyes, crescent moons, ladders, spidery figures, wiry thin lines, red, yellow, blue and green spots, playful biomorphic shapes on ochre or blue grounds.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Paul Delvaux
styles.features: Moonlit classical temples, tram stops and railway stations in deep perspective, pale wide-eyed women in long gowns walking as in a trance, oil lamps, skeletons, cool blue night with warm lamplight, crisp smooth paint.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Often includes nudes; specify gowned figures.

styles.name: Leonora Carrington
styles.medium: oil and egg tempera on board
styles.features: Fine-brushed tempera with jewel-like colours on dark grounds, hooded elongated figures, horses, hyenas and hybrid creatures, alchemical kitchens and cauldrons, many small scattered details like a medieval panel.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Remedios Varo
styles.features: Delicate meticulously hatched oil, elongated figures with heart-shaped faces and large almond eyes, cloaks merging into furniture and vehicles, fantastical machines, towers and laboratories, warm amber, sienna and grey-blue.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Dorothea Tanning
styles.features: Smooth realistic oil of long hotel corridors with numbered doors ajar, figures with wind-blown hair, torn wallpaper, giant sunflowers, sculpted drapery, sharp light and deep shadow in dreamlike domestic interiors.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Kay Sage
styles.features: Desolate plains under grey skies with tall scaffold towers, lattices and planks, shapes draped like shrouded objects, strict geometry, crisp edges, muted grey, beige and faded blue, no people.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Leonor Fini
styles.features: Theatrical smooth oil with pale luminous women, sphinxes, cat-like eyes, masks and feathered costumes, tangled hair, layered drapery, decaying ruins, cool greens, violets and ochres.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Toyen
styles.features: Ghostly sparse compositions: empty garments, shadowy animals and hollow forms emerging from smooth dark grounds, sprayed soft-edged mist, silhouettes and thin lines, muted grey, ochre and black with a few bright accents.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Wolfgang Paalen, fumage
styles.medium: candle smoke and oil on canvas
styles.features: Soot traces from candle smoke on wet paint: feathery brown-black plumes and wispy branching shapes like spectral birds or plants, soft vaporous gradients over dark worn grounds with pale blank areas.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Surrealist decalcomania, Óscar Domínguez
styles.medium: gouache pressed and lifted on paper
styles.features: Dark gouache pressed between sheets and pulled apart, leaving spongy branching textures like coral, lichen, caves and eroded rock, mirrored symmetries, fine veins, a sparse added horizon or small figure.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Victor Brauner
styles.features: Flat stylised figures in profile with totem-like heads, merged human and animal bodies, almond eyes, clean contours, hieratic Egyptian-like poses, waxy matte surfaces on warm earth or sky-blue grounds.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Roberto Matta
styles.features: Cosmic interior space with no ground: transparent planes, vortices, thin whiplash lines and glowing orbs, thin rubbed paint in luminous yellow, orange, green and violet, later insect-like mechanical figures.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Wifredo Lam
styles.medium: oil and gouache on canvas or paper
styles.features: Dense vertical jungle of sugarcane, banana leaves and bamboo interlocked with mask-like faces and horse-headed hybrid figures, elongated limbs, crescent horns, thin outlines, greens, ochre, blue and charcoal.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Avoid depicting Afro-Cuban religious rites literally.

styles.name: André Masson, automatic drawing
styles.medium: pen and ink on paper; sand and glue on canvas
styles.features: Rapid tangled ink lines drawn without plan, fragments of birds, fish, hands and bodies surfacing from looping scribbles; in sand paintings, gritty glued patches lightly touched with colour.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Kurt Seligmann
styles.features: Tall figures wrapped in billowing ribbons and drapery, heraldic armour and carnival costumes, fluttering banners, twisting baroque motion, crisp modelling against dark skies, rich reds, ochres and steely greys.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Ithell Colquhoun
styles.medium: oil on canvas, decalcomania on paper
styles.features: Precise smooth oils of enlarged plants, flowers and rock formations that double as bodies and landscapes, Cornish standing stones, clear hard light, fleshy pinks, greens and earth tones.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Eileen Agar
styles.features: Light playful compositions of overlapping profile heads, seashells, fish, Greek sculpture fragments and patterned paper, flat colour shapes combined with line drawing, sea blue, ochre and coral.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Paul Nash
styles.features: English downland and coast with megaliths, tree stumps and geometric objects set in fields, clear ordered space, flat crisp planes, cool greens, chalky whites and pale blue under a low sun or moon.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Edward Burra
styles.features: Dense layered watercolour with near-opaque colour, sharply outlined exaggerated figures in nightclubs, Harlem streets and Spanish scenes, masks, skeletons and sailors, heavy shadows, strong pinks, olive greens and browns.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Harue Koga
styles.features: Crisp flat oil compositions assembling magazine-like motifs—modern women in swimsuits, submarines, factories, ocean liners, scientific diagrams—on clean grounds, collage-like juxtaposition, cool blues, greens and whites.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Halmstad Group surrealism, Sweden
styles.features: Bare west Swedish beaches and wide skies with strange objects, ropes, pebbles and statues on the sand, clear northern light, smooth precise paint, long shadows, pale blue, sand beige and grey.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Exquisite corpse drawing
styles.medium: pencil, ink, crayon and collage on folded paper
styles.features: One hybrid figure drawn in separate horizontal bands by different hands: mismatched head, torso and legs meeting at fold lines, abrupt changes of drawing style and scale, ink, crayon and cut paper on white.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Zdzisław Beksiński
styles.features: Smooth precise oil with fog and glowing haze, colossal decaying structures, cloaked skeletal figures, cathedral-like ruins and deserts of bones, burnt orange, ochre and dusty brown under sickly yellow light.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Bleak and macabre.

styles.name: Pavel Tchelitchew
styles.features: Metamorphic images in which trees, hands and veins hide children and faces, layered transparent figures, glowing anatomical networks, deep autumn orange, gold and blue-green dusk.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Alice Rahon
styles.features: Textured sand-mixed surfaces with fine lines scratched through the paint, childlike stick figures, stars, fantastic cities and creatures floating on deep blue, turquoise or ochre grounds with a starry shimmer.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Richard Oelze
styles.features: Finely painted grey crowds in hats and coats staring at an unseen event; tangled vegetation and cloud-like masses concealing ghostly faces; misty tonal modelling in muted grey-green and brown.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Frida Kahlo
styles.features: Small panels in flat naive-precise oil, frontal women with direct gaze, Tehuana dresses, flowers in braided hair, monkeys, parrots and tropical leaves, ex-voto plainness, saturated greens, reds and magentas.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: She rejected the Surrealist label; best for portraits and figures with plants and animals.

styles.name: Christian Schad
styles.features: Cool glassy oil with invisible brushstrokes, sharply outlined sitters close to the picture plane, translucent fabrics, pale skin, city rooftops or chimneys behind, enamel-smooth surface, restrained greens, greys and black.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Franz Radziwill
styles.features: North German coastal villages, harbours and brick houses under ominous green or sulphur skies, early aircraft and ships, small isolated figures, hard drawing, glossy precise paint, uncanny stillness.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Alexander Kanoldt
styles.features: Severe still lifes of potted rubber plants, cacti, jugs and folded cloths on tilted tables, and hill towns of cubic houses; simplified geometric volumes, dry smooth matte paint, olive, terracotta and white.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Antonio Donghi
styles.features: Frozen doll-like Roman figures—women at windows, circus performers, hunters—with porcelain-smooth faces and neatly ordered clothes, flat clear light, sharp contours, chalky pink, grey and blue.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Felice Casorati
styles.medium: oil and tempera on canvas or panel
styles.features: Calm frontal figures and still objects in bare rooms seen slightly from above, geometric arrangement, pale chalky flesh, smooth simplified volumes, soft dry light, muted ivory, grey, rose and blue.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Carel Willink
styles.features: Smooth old-master-like oil, lone figures in deserted city squares among classical buildings, statues and ruins under towering dramatic clouds, cold greys and blue-greens, ominous lowering light.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Pyke Koch
styles.features: Hard-edged hyper-sharp oil, close-up frontal figures from fairgrounds and back streets, sharply lit faces, crumbling walls, minutely painted textures, chilly greys and browns with acid colour accents.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Dick Ket
styles.features: Small tightly painted still lifes and close-up self-portraits, ordinary objects—bread, playing cards, cups, bottles—in airless shallow space, pale greenish light, smooth even modelling, muted green, ochre and grey.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Ivan Albright
styles.features: Obsessively detailed oil where every surface wrinkles, flakes and decays, swollen skin, worn doors, tarnished cluttered objects, flickering light from several directions, mottled purplish browns and greens.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Tends toward the grotesque.

styles.name: Peter Blume
styles.features: Crisp smooth oil panoramas packed with small figures and precise objects, fragmented buildings, ruins, quarries and machines, toy-like clarity, bright clean colours, deep airless space.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: George Tooker
styles.features: Egg tempera with fine hatching and soft even light, identical pale figures in grey coats repeated through subway corridors, offices and booths, deep cramped perspective, muted greys, beige and faded greens.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Paul Cadmus
styles.features: Egg tempera with cross-hatched modelling, muscular sharply drawn figures crowded on beaches, streets and parks, exaggerated satirical poses, sculptural anatomy, warm flesh tones, clear skies.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism
styles.note: Often nude or satirical; specify clothed figures.

styles.name: María Izquierdo
styles.features: Simple naive-looking figures and objects—circus horses, women in rebozos, home altars with candles and fruit—in flat dreamlike space, soft brushy paint, earthy pinks, terracotta, ochre and blue.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Vienna School of Fantastic Realism
styles.medium: egg tempera underpainting with oil glazes on panel
styles.features: Jewel-like detail built from tempera and oil glazes, biblical and mythic figures, ornate visionary architecture, crystalline textures, glowing gold, blue and red, old-master precision with dreamlike distortions.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Pierre Roy
styles.features: Meticulous trompe-l'oeil oil of unrelated objects—ribbons, shells, ladders, toys, snails, rope—arranged in shallow spaces or before an open sea, crisp light, soft pastel blues, browns and creams.
styles.section: Dada, Surrealism, Metaphysical painting, Magic Realism

styles.name: Otto Dix
styles.features: Enamel-smooth Old Master glazes, hard precise contours, caricatured ageing or maimed figures with sallow veined skin, acid greens and lurid pinks, shallow crowded stage-like space, relentless detail of wrinkles, makeup and fabric
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA
styles.note: Often grotesque or violent; keep subjects mild

styles.name: George Grosz
styles.medium: pen and ink with watercolour on paper
styles.features: Jagged nervous pen line, transparent overlapping figures and buildings, bloated bourgeois types and gaunt beggars, tilted crowded Berlin streets, thin washes of pink, ochre and grey, caricatured faces
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA
styles.note: Satirical and often harsh; avoid explicit content

styles.name: Rudolf Schlichter
styles.features: Crisp sober drawing, sitters posed frontally before plain Berlin tenements and grey streets, muted browns, blacks and slate greys, sharp-edged shadows, careful small brushwork, deadpan expressions and precise clothing
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Jeanne Mammen
styles.features: Loose confident pencil contours filled with fluid transparent washes, slender elongated women in Berlin cafés, bars and cabarets, layered ochres, rose pinks and smoky greys, glances and gestures caught mid-moment
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Anton Räderscheidt
styles.features: Stiff mannequin-like figures in dark suits and bowler hats standing isolated in empty geometric urban spaces, smooth flat paint, steep deep perspective, cold grey-green tones, eerie silence and distance between people
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Georg Schrimpf
styles.features: Rounded simplified doll-like women resting at windows or lying in calm rolling Bavarian landscapes, soft smooth gradations, earthy pastel palette, Italianate classical stillness, toy-like trees and fields under clear skies
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Carl Grossberg
styles.features: Spotless empty factory halls, boilers, pipes, steam engines and machine parts in bright clean colours, flat immaculate surfaces, steep exact perspective, no workers present, occasional surreal intrusion of an animal
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Lotte Laserstein
styles.features: Realist figures of modern young women in interiors and outdoors, natural daylight, warm muted palette, firm anatomical modelling with visible but controlled brushwork, introspective poses, calm direct gazes
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Albert Renger-Patzsch
styles.features: Sharp-focus black-and-white close-ups of plants, industrial products in repeated rows, factory chimneys and pylons, even neutral light, full grey tonal range, frontal isolated subjects, emphasis on texture and pattern
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: August Sander
styles.features: Frontal black-and-white portraits of people identified by trade, standing or seated in work clothes with tools, calm direct gaze at the camera, soft daylight, plain or local backgrounds, sober documentary clarity
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Grethe Jürgens
styles.features: Sober frontal depictions of working-class women and unemployed men in plain rooms and streets, clear outlines, muted grey-greens and browns, flat even light, quiet everyday props
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Charles Sheeler
