styles.features: Immaculate factories, silos, barns and Shaker interiors, hard edges, no visible brushwork, clear cool light, geometric order of pipes and conveyors, empty of people, muted greys, rust and pale blue
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Charles Demuth
styles.features: Transparent ray-like lines slicing across grain elevators, chimneys and water tanks into faceted planes, flat precise colour, or loose luminous watercolour flowers and fruit with white paper glowing through
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Niles Spencer
styles.features: Simplified flat buildings reduced to interlocking blocks, matte chalky surfaces, muted earth tones with slate blue and dull red, slight cubist overlapping, quiet unpeopled towns and industrial sites
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Ralston Crawford
styles.features: Hard-edged bridges, grain elevators and ships, flat unmodulated colour areas, crisp geometric planes, clean bright whites against clear blue sky, shadows treated as solid shapes, no surface texture
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Louis Lozowick
styles.features: Tilted soaring New York skyscrapers, bridges and machine parts, velvety blacks fading to silvery greys, sharp geometric forms, radiating diagonals, steep dramatic viewpoints, crisp light beams
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Elsie Driggs
styles.features: Tall cylindrical smokestacks and steel-mill structures rising from soft haze, smooth precise forms, almost monochrome greys and smoky beiges, vertical upward composition, quiet ordered industrial geometry
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: George Ault
styles.features: Rural crossroads and barns at night as simple geometric blocks, dark velvety blue-black sky, a single street lamp casting sharp-edged light, flat smooth paint, deep silence and stillness
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Georgia O'Keeffe
styles.features: Magnified flowers filling the whole canvas, smooth blended gradations, soft-edged sculptural forms, bleached bones and red desert hills, skyscrapers at night, clear saturated colour, simplified uncluttered compositions
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Gerald Murphy
styles.features: Enlarged everyday objects such as razors, pens, matchboxes and watch gears, flat hard-edged shapes, overlapping silhouettes, bright clean commercial colours, poster-like clarity, precise mechanical drawing
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA
styles.note: Very small body of work; rely on description

styles.name: Grant Wood
styles.features: Rounded sculpted rolling hills, lollipop-shaped trees in neat rows, patchwork fields, smooth meticulous finish, stiff frontal figures, decorative patterning, toy-like farmhouses under clear even light
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Thomas Hart Benton
styles.medium: egg tempera and oil on canvas
styles.features: Sinuous rhythmic elongated figures with muscular bodies, undulating swelling landscapes where hills, clouds and trees twist together, sculptural modelling, earthy browns and greens with bright accents, busy narrative murals
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: John Steuart Curry
styles.features: Dramatic Kansas weather with tornadoes, floods and vast skies, vigorous loose brushwork, heroic farmers and animals, sweeping horizons, dark storm greys against golden wheat and ochre earth
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Edward Hopper
styles.features: Broad flat planes of colour, strong raking sunlight or electric light, long geometric shadows, solitary figures in diners, offices and hotel rooms, empty streets, clapboard houses, quiet suspended stillness
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Charles Burchfield
styles.features: Vibrating repeated lines radiating from trees, flowers, insects and sun, hooked calligraphic marks suggesting sound and heat, swirling skies, bold opaque watercolour, or gloomy small-town houses with face-like windows
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Reginald Marsh
styles.features: Teeming crowds at Coney Island beaches, subways and the Bowery, Baroque full-bodied figures, energetic calligraphic contour lines, warm sepia-orange tonality, tangled limbs and jostling movement
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Isabel Bishop
styles.medium: oil and tempera on gessoed panel
styles.features: Young office workers and shop girls around Union Square, delicate layered brushwork, hazy atmosphere, soft muted greys and ochres, gentle everyday gestures, figures dissolving into warm luminous grounds
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Raphael Soyer
styles.features: Shop girls, dancers, idle men and artists in studios, sensitive drawing, soft muted brown and grey palette, loose painterly surface, subdued melancholic figures seen in quiet pauses
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Doris Lee
styles.features: Flattened folk-like perspective, small busy rounded figures at country chores and holiday feasts, patterned quilts and wallpaper, soft pastels and earthy tones, gentle humour, crowded domestic and village scenes
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Alexandre Hogue
styles.features: Dust Bowl plains with wind-sculpted sand drifts burying fences, eroded furrows and cracked earth, hard sharp clarity, surreal emptiness, ochres, rusty reds and bleached blue skies
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA
styles.note: Subjects are bleak

styles.name: Peter Hurd
styles.features: Wide New Mexico ranchland horizons, luminous dry light, fine hatched tempera strokes, dusty pinks, ochres and sage greens, adobe buildings, windmills, ranch hands on horseback under vast skies
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Rockwell Kent
styles.medium: wood engraving and oil on canvas
styles.features: Stark monumental figures and icy Arctic landscapes, crisp black-and-white contrast with fine parallel engraved lines, heroic silhouettes against star-filled or clear cold skies, simplified mountains and sea
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Archibald Motley
styles.features: Bronzeville nightlife with crowded dancing figures, saturated reds, purples and deep blues under artificial light, stylised elongated bodies, rhythmic overlapping movement, warm glowing street and club scenes
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Norman Rockwell
styles.features: Detailed anecdotal small-town scenes, highly expressive faces and gestures, meticulous textures of clothing and props, warm natural light, clear readable composition built around a single humorous or tender moment
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Ben Shahn
styles.features: Wiry nervous outlines, flat areas of muted colour, figures with oversized hands and sorrowful faces, sparse empty spaces, brick walls and playgrounds, occasional hand-drawn lettering
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: William Gropper
styles.features: Caricatured politicians and workers in rapid bold brushwork, exaggerated gesticulating poses, expressive distortion, swirling dynamic compositions, dark heavy outlines, earthy tones with strong reds
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA
styles.note: Political satire

styles.name: Philip Evergood
styles.features: Crowded busy compositions of distorted wide-eyed figures, naive-expressionist drawing, bright clashing colours, fantastical touches within everyday scenes, nervous uneven brushwork
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Elizabeth Catlett
styles.features: Bold carved lines with strong black-and-white contrast, stylised dignified Black women and workers, radiating gouged lines around figures, simplified sculptural faces, sometimes one added flat colour
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Charles White
styles.medium: charcoal and Wolff crayon on paper
styles.features: Monumental heroic Black figures with massive hands and sculpted faces, dense hatched tonal drawing, strong chiaroscuro, solid volumes filling the frame, warm sepia or deep black tones
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Hale Woodruff
styles.features: Vivid saturated historical murals with dramatic diagonals, crowded struggling figures, strong modelling, ships and courtroom scenes, bright reds, blues and ochres in a clear narrative frieze
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Aaron Douglas
styles.features: Flat silhouetted figures in profile with Egyptian-like poses, layered tones of a single hue such as lavender or olive, concentric translucent circles of light, Art Deco geometry, rhythmic dance and labour
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Jacob Lawrence
styles.features: Flat bright opaque colour with ochres, black and red, angular simplified figures, repeating rhythmic shapes, compressed space, bold pattern, narrative scenes conceived as numbered panels
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Dorothea Lange
styles.features: Black-and-white documentary portraits of migrant farm workers, weathered faces and hands, soft natural light, close intimate framing, tents, old cars and dusty roads, rich mid-grey tones
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Walker Evans
styles.features: Frontal deadpan black-and-white views of storefronts, hand-painted signs, clapboard churches, sharecropper houses and bare kitchens, sharp focus, even flat light, symmetrical composition, crisp textures of wood and paper
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Berenice Abbott
styles.features: Black-and-white New York cityscapes, skyscrapers from steep upward or downward angles, deep shadowed canyons, crisp detail of storefronts and elevated railways, strong geometric contrast
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Lynd Ward
styles.features: Wordless sequential images in dense black engraved fields, fine white lines carving light, dramatic chiaroscuro, expressive gesturing figures, looming skyscrapers and night streets, moody theatrical lighting
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: WPA Federal Art Project silkscreen poster
styles.features: Flat layered areas of three to six colours, simplified landscapes, figures and buildings, bold sans-serif lettering integrated into the design, crisp edges, slight ink texture, clear graphic hierarchy
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: New Deal post office mural, Treasury Section of Fine Arts
styles.medium: oil on canvas mounted on wall
styles.features: Horizontal panoramic scenes of local history and work, pioneers, farmers, loggers and miners, solid simplified figures, clear storytelling, earthy browns, greens and muted blues, calm even light
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Index of American Design watercolour rendering
styles.features: Meticulously precise watercolour studies of single folk objects such as quilts, weathervanes, carousel horses, toys and pottery, isolated on white paper, faithful texture, wear and patina, soft shadows
styles.section: New Objectivity, Precisionism, American Scene, Regionalism, Social Realism, WPA

styles.name: Piet Mondrian
styles.features: Flat white ground divided by thick black horizontal and vertical lines into rectangles, a few filled with pure red, yellow or blue; no curves, no diagonals, no depth, matte evenly brushed paint.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Strict orthogonal grid; reduce any subject to rectangles and primaries.

styles.name: Theo van Doesburg
styles.features: Grid of black lines and rectangles in red, yellow, blue, grey and white rotated 45 degrees into diagonal tension; hard flat edges, no modelling, crisp planar geometry on a square canvas.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Diagonal counter-composition distinguishes it from Mondrian's upright grid.

styles.name: Bart van der Leck
styles.features: Figures and animals broken into separate short flat bars, wedges and triangles of red, yellow, blue and black floating on white ground; no connecting outlines, the eye assembles the silhouette.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Kazimir Malevich, Suprematism
styles.features: Flat geometric shapes — squares, rectangles, crosses, thin bars — in black, red, yellow and blue floating at angles on a white void; clean edges, slightly cracked matte paint, no horizon or ground.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: El Lissitzky, Proun compositions
styles.medium: oil and gouache on canvas and board
styles.features: Axonometric floating blocks, planes and rods drawn in shifting perspectives, black, grey, red and beige on pale ground; weightless architectural volumes, precise ruled edges, faint textured washes.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Lyubov Popova, Painterly Architectonics
styles.features: Overlapping opaque and translucent tilted planes of brick red, black, ochre and blue-green, stacked at angles with sharp edges, visible brushwork and slight gradient shading suggesting thin sheets in shallow space.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Alexander Rodchenko, non-objective paintings
styles.features: Compositions built with compass and ruler: crisp intersecting circles, arcs and straight lines on dark or flat grounds, smooth even colour, mechanical precision, radiating linear constructions, no brush gesture.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Use the abstract paintings, not his lettered posters.

styles.name: Varvara Stepanova, Constructivist textile design
styles.features: Small repeating geometric motifs — interlocking circles, triangles, stripes and bars — in two or three flat colours, tightly tiled into all-over patterns with the mechanical regularity of printed cloth.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Vladimir Tatlin, counter-reliefs
styles.medium: wood, sheet metal, wire and glass assemblage
styles.features: Corner-hung assemblages of bent tin sheets, wooden planks, wire and glass held by taut cables, raw unpainted material textures in rust, grey and natural wood tones, projecting into real space with sharp shadows.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Suprematist porcelain, Petrograd State Porcelain Factory
styles.features: White glazed plates, cups and teapots painted with floating black, red, yellow and green squares, bars and circles in Suprematist arrangements; glossy surface, crisp enamel colours, much bare white porcelain left showing.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Władysław Strzemiński, Unism
styles.features: Uniform all-over field of one muted colour with low relief of thick textured paint forming interlocking curved, wave-like shapes; no focal point, no figure-ground contrast, near-monochrome surface.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Wassily Kandinsky, Bauhaus period
styles.medium: oil on canvas, watercolour on paper
styles.features: Precise circles, triangles, checkerboards and thin straight and curved lines floating on soft graded grounds; bright contrasting hues with black accents, layered transparent shapes, crisp edges, some sprayed haloes, musical rhythm.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Paul Klee
styles.medium: oil and watercolour on paper and board
styles.features: Soft-edged grid of glowing coloured squares and rectangles, chalky layered textures, thin scratchy linework weaving in arrows, moons, stick figures, fish and little houses; childlike yet ordered pictographic fantasy.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: László Moholy-Nagy
styles.medium: oil and lacquer on canvas, aluminium, plexiglass
styles.features: Transparent overlapping discs, bars and segments in clear colours that change hue where they intersect, floating diagonally on light or dark ground; glassy light effects, machine-smooth surfaces, crisp edges.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Josef Albers, Homage to the Square
styles.features: Three or four flat squares nested concentrically and shifted toward the bottom edge, each one evenly applied colour; close hues interact so borders vibrate; no texture, no line, frontal square format.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Very rigid format; subject can only be implied through colour.

styles.name: Oskar Schlemmer
styles.features: Stylised doll-like human figures with rounded heads, columnar bodies and profile poses set in deep geometric architectural spaces with stairs and railings; smooth matte modelling, muted ochres, blues and pinks.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Anni Albers
styles.features: Woven wall hangings with tight rectilinear grids of small stacked rectangles and stripes in black, white, grey and earth tones; visible thread texture, slight loom irregularity, interrupted bands and floating supplementary threads.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Gunta Stölzl, Bauhaus weaving
styles.features: Dense woven tapestry with stepped zigzags, chequered blocks, stripes and diamond lattices in warm reds, oranges, blues and yellows; textured weave, interlocking geometric rhythms across a rectangular field.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Sonia Delaunay, Orphism
styles.medium: oil on canvas, gouache, printed textiles
styles.features: Concentric discs and arcs split into wedge segments of contrasting colours — orange against blue, red against green — vibrating side by side; flat opaque paint, rhythmic circular motion, also applied to fabrics and garments.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Naum Gabo
styles.features: Transparent curved sheets of perspex strung with taut nylon threads forming fine luminous ruled surfaces; delicate lines catching light, floating volumes defined only by edges, colourless or pale tones against dark ground.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Sculptural; render as a lit object in space.

styles.name: Max Bill, Concrete art
styles.features: Mathematically ordered flat colour bands, squares and triangles in systematic sequences, often on a diamond-oriented square canvas; spectral hues stepping in progression, pristine machine-flat surfaces, no gesture.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Victor Vasarely, Op art
styles.features: Optical grids of modular squares and circles that swell and shrink to suggest spheres bulging from a flat surface; black-and-white or saturated colour gradients, hard flat edges, vibrating illusions.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Joaquín Torres-García, Constructive Universalism
styles.features: Earth-toned grid of irregular hand-drawn compartments in brown, ochre and black, each holding a simple pictogram — fish, anchor, clock, sun, house, figure; rough brushwork, archaic rustic feel.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Hélio Oiticica, Metaesquemas
styles.features: Small rectangles and squares of one colour — red, black or white — slightly tilted out of a grid as if dancing, flat gouache on cream card, narrow gaps, restless rhythmic misalignment.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Gego, Reticulárea
styles.medium: steel and aluminium wire, metal clamps
styles.features: Webbed nets of thin linked metal rods and triangles hanging in space, irregular cell-like modules, drawing-like lines in air, grey metallic tones, layered transparency and soft cast shadows.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Carmen Herrera, hard-edge painting
styles.features: Two flat colours meeting along one sharp straight or diagonal edge — a white field cut by a black wedge or green triangle; razor-hard edges, no texture, extreme economy, high contrast.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Mark Rothko
styles.medium: oil on canvas, thin stained layers
styles.features: Two or three soft-edged stacked rectangles of glowing colour hovering on a coloured field; thin layered washes, feathered blurred borders, deep maroon, orange, yellow, black; tall canvas, no line.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Works best when a subject is suggested as horizon bands of light.

styles.name: Barnett Newman
styles.features: Vast flat field of one saturated colour — cadmium red, deep blue — divided by one or more narrow vertical stripes with masked straight or hand-ragged edges; no texture, immersive wall scale.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Clyfford Still
styles.features: Large dark fields of thick troweled paint torn by jagged, flame-like vertical shapes of contrasting black, ochre, red and white; rough crusted matte texture, edges like ripped paper or cliff faces.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Helen Frankenthaler, soak-stain painting
styles.medium: thinned oil and acrylic on unprimed canvas
styles.features: Paint poured and soaked into raw canvas, translucent stains of pink, blue, green and ochre with soft blotted edges, watery pooling shapes, large areas of bare canvas, airy lyrical lightness.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Kenneth Noland
styles.features: Concentric rings or nested chevrons of crisp flat colour stained into raw canvas, symmetrical centred targets or V-shapes, bright saturated bands, sharp edges, generous bare canvas margins.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Jackson Pollock, drip painting
styles.medium: enamel and aluminium paint dripped on canvas
styles.features: Dense all-over web of dripped and flung paint — looping skeins, splatters and pools of black, white, silver and ochre — no focal point, layered tangled lines spreading edge to edge.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Subject can only appear as overall texture, e.g. tangled grass or branches.

styles.name: Willem de Kooning
styles.features: Violent sweeping brushstrokes of fleshy pink, yellow, blue and white, smeared, scraped and repainted; fragmented shapes with a faint figure or landscape torn apart by gesture, thick wet oil.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Franz Kline
styles.medium: oil and house paint on canvas
styles.features: Massive black brushstrokes like girders or giant calligraphy slashing across white ground; broad house-painter brush, dynamic diagonals and beams, dry-brush edges, stark high contrast.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Lee Krasner
styles.features: Rhythmic large-scale curving brushstrokes and eye-like ovals, organic plant-like forms, umber, cream and magenta palette, energetic interlocking swirls, cut-and-reassembled collage fragments in some works.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Joan Mitchell
styles.features: Energetic tangled brushstrokes of cobalt, lime green, yellow and violet clustered against white ground; loose scribbled marks, drips and airy gaps evoking trees, water and sunflowers.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Robert Motherwell, Elegies
styles.features: Large black ovals and vertical bars pressed between upright slabs on white or ochre ground, flat yet brushy edges, solemn rhythmic repetition, occasional strips of red or blue.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Hans Hofmann
styles.features: Thick slabs of saturated rectangles — red, yellow, blue, green — floating on loose brushy painterly fields, push-pull spatial tension, impasto, knife-applied blocks against gestural ground.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Arshile Gorky
styles.features: Soft biomorphic shapes like bones, petals and organs outlined in fine black line, thin washes of colour bleeding beyond contours, luminous pale grounds, drips, forms floating in ambiguous space.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Alma Thomas
styles.features: Rhythmic rows of small irregular rectangular dabs of bright colour like mosaic tesserae over white ground showing between, arranged in concentric or vertical bands, dense joyful palette evoking flowers and light.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Norman Lewis
styles.features: Tiny calligraphic marks and slender figure-like strokes clustered into flowing processions across dark or blue grounds, delicate shimmering lines suggesting crowds, birds or music.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Agnes Martin
styles.features: Pale square canvas of faint hand-drawn pencil grid lines and soft horizontal bands in washed pink, blue and cream; thin gesso, lines with slight wavers, quiet near-monochrome surface.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Ellsworth Kelly
styles.features: Single flat shapes of pure saturated colour — curves, wedges, rectangles — against white or as shaped canvases; crisp hard edges, forms derived from shadows and architectural fragments, no texture.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Richard Diebenkorn, Ocean Park series
styles.features: Large luminous pale fields of blue, aqua, cream and ochre divided by ruled diagonal and vertical lines near the edges; visible pentimenti, scraped and overpainted translucent layers, aerial coastal light.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Zao Wou-Ki
styles.features: Vast swirling fields of oil paint thinned like ink washes, sweeping brushstrokes and calligraphic fragments dissolving into light; deep blues, blacks, ochres and reds, misty voids, cosmic landscape feeling.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Kazuo Shiraga, Gutai foot painting
styles.medium: oil on canvas, applied with feet
styles.features: Thick oil paint swept by bare feet across a large canvas: viscous swirling arcs, gouges and smears in deep red, black and white, glossy heavy impasto, explosive rotating physical traces.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Nicolas de Staël
styles.features: Thick slabs of oil paint laid with palette knife and spatula into flat blocks of grey, white, ochre, red and blue; rough trowelled surfaces, landscapes and still lifes reduced to stacked colour masses.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Pierre Soulages, outrenoir
styles.features: Large canvases entirely in black, ridged and furrowed by broad tools into parallel striations and grooves; light reflecting off glossy and matte textures turns black into shifting greys.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism
styles.note: Monochrome black; the subject must emerge only through texture and reflected light.

styles.name: Mohammed Melehi
styles.features: Bold undulating wave bands in saturated contrasting stripes — blue, red, green, yellow, orange — flat glossy paint, rhythmic repeated curves, crisp hard edges, occasional sun and flame motifs.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: S. H. Raza, Bindu paintings
styles.features: Central black circle surrounded by concentric squares, triangles and bands of saturated red, yellow, blue, green and black; flat acrylic with slight texture, symmetrical cosmic geometric diagrams.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Fahrelnissa Zeid
styles.features: Kaleidoscopic dense fields of fragmented coloured cells outlined in black, like stained glass or shattered mosaic; vibrant blues, reds and yellows, swirling energy filling the entire large canvas.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Serge Poliakoff
styles.features: Interlocking irregular flat shapes fitted together like puzzle pieces, each one matte colour with layered undertones showing through; earthy reds, ochres, deep blues and blacks filling the canvas edge to edge.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Etel Adnan
styles.medium: oil on small canvas, palette knife
styles.features: Small canvases of flat palette-knife blocks of bright colour — a red square sun, ochre and green bands, a blue mountain silhouette — landscape reduced to simple geometric patches of smooth thick paint.
styles.section: Abstract and geometric abstraction, De Stijl, Bauhaus painting, Suprematism, Constructivism, Colour Field, Abstract Expressionism

styles.name: Andy Warhol
styles.medium: silkscreen ink and acrylic on canvas
styles.features: Flat silkscreened photographic image repeated in a grid, slightly misregistered black halftone printed over arbitrary flat colour blocks, uneven ink density, hot pink, turquoise and lemon yellow, consumer products and celebrity faces.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Roy Lichtenstein
styles.medium: oil and Magna acrylic on canvas
styles.features: Enlarged comic-book panel with thick black outlines, hand-painted Ben-Day dot screens for skin and shading, flat primary red, yellow and blue with white, speech balloons, simplified dramatic close-ups of faces and objects.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Tom Wesselmann
styles.medium: oil and collage on canvas, shaped canvas
styles.features: Hard-edged flat colour areas in saturated red, pink and blue, collaged real product labels, domestic interiors with branded goods, smooth simplified forms without modelling, crisp contours, still lifes of fruit, bottles and telephones.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Best known for nudes; keep to interiors and still life.

styles.name: James Rosenquist
styles.features: Billboard-painter technique, giant fragmented close-ups of food, cars, faces and machinery spliced side by side, smooth airbrush-like gradients, glossy advertising colour, abrupt jumps of scale, wide panoramic horizontal format.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Robert Indiana
styles.features: Hard-edged stencil letters and numbers set in circles, stars and diamonds, flat unmodulated red, green, blue and yellow, sign-painter precision, bold symmetrical emblem-like compositions, no visible brushwork.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Lettering-based; works only with a short word or number.

styles.name: Richard Hamilton
styles.medium: collage, screenprint and oil on panel
styles.features: Cut-and-pasted magazine imagery assembled into domestic interiors, glossy appliances and product photography mixed with hand-painted passages, blurred photographic stills, cool commercial palette, fragmented collage perspective.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Pauline Boty
styles.features: Bright flat colour, painted film-star portraits framed by decorative borders of roses and stripes, collaged photo fragments, simplified graphic faces, saturated reds, pinks and greens, layered panel compositions.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Evelyne Axell
styles.features: Cut-out translucent Plexiglas silhouettes, smooth enamel colour fields in candy orange, violet and mint, figures reduced to flat curving outlines, glossy reflective surface, landscape elements as layered shapes.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Often nudes; keep figures clothed.

styles.name: Patrick Caulfield
styles.features: Flat even colour fields with uniform black outlines describing interiors and objects, a single photorealistically painted detail inserted, saturated orange, blue and olive, empty rooms, lamps, wine glasses, restaurant corners, no people.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Wayne Thiebaud
styles.features: Creamy impasto like frosting, rows of cakes, pies and gumball machines on white counters, strong diagonal blue shadows, halo lines of orange, blue and green along contours, steep vertiginous city streets.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Corita Kent
styles.features: Vivid layered serigraph colour, overlapping translucent inks, handwritten and cropped advertising lettering, slogans and poetry fragments, wavy distorted words, hot pink, orange, yellow and blue, handmade graphic look.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Lettering-based; needs a short phrase.

styles.name: Mimmo Rotella
styles.features: Layers of torn street posters peeled back, ragged white paper edges, fragments of film-star faces and printed lettering, faded offset colour, rough glued paper surface, accidental overlaps of images.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Sigmar Polke
styles.medium: acrylic and lacquer on printed fabric
styles.features: Hand-painted enlarged halftone raster dots, blurred newspaper images, transparent line drawings layered over patterned printed fabrics, deliberately clumsy overlaps, muted greys with sudden pink and yellow, stains and pours.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Allan D'Arcangelo
styles.features: Empty highway receding to a central vanishing point, flat dark asphalt, white and yellow lane stripes, road signs and route shields as hard-edged emblems, night-blue or dusk skies, no texture.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Keiichi Tanaami
styles.features: Dense psychedelic collage, fluorescent pink, green and yellow, swirling pine trees, goldfish, cranes and skulls outlined in black like manga, endlessly repeated motifs, explosive all-over patterning.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Avoid pin-up figures.

styles.name: Chuck Close
styles.medium: acrylic and oil on canvas, gridded
styles.features: Colossal frontal head-and-shoulders portrait built on a square grid, each cell filled with small concentric loops and lozenges of colour that resolve into a face at a distance, mosaic-like pixelated surface.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Ralph Goings
styles.features: Photorealist diner interiors and pickup trucks, chrome napkin dispensers and ketchup bottles on counters, crisp even daylight, sharp reflections, invisible brushwork, everyday colours of formica, vinyl and enamel.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Robert Bechtle
styles.features: Photorealist suburban California streets, parked family cars in driveways, flat bright midday sun, pale stucco houses, crisp cast shadows, muted pastel palette, snapshot framing, quiet scenes with few figures.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Audrey Flack
styles.features: Airbrushed photorealist vanitas tabletop crowded with jewels, lipsticks, fruit, candles, mirrors, playing cards and hourglasses, high-key saturated colour, glossy reflections, shallow tilted space, theatrical spotlight.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Charles Bell
styles.features: Monumental close-ups of gumball machines, pinball machines, marbles and tin toys, glassy reflections, jewel-bright candy colours, hard spotlight against dark background, perfectly smooth illusionistic finish.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Tom Blackwell
styles.features: Photorealist chrome motorcycles and shop windows, tight cropping on engine parts, layered reflections of the street in glass and metal, saturated enamel colours, hard sunlight, sharp edges, no visible brushstrokes.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Malcolm Morley, 1960s superrealism
styles.features: Superrealist enlargement of a postcard or brochure image, crisp white border framing the scene, ocean liners and beach resorts, saturated travel-poster blue sea and sky, smooth gridded painting with tiny holiday figures.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Victor Vasarely
styles.features: Geometric grid of squares and circles swelling into convex and concave bulges, hard-edged flat colour units graded from dark to bright, intense blue, violet, red and green, optical depth illusion, no brushwork.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Non-objective; subject appears only as a geometric echo.

styles.name: Carlos Cruz-Diez
styles.medium: acrylic on aluminium and PVC strips
styles.features: Dense vertical parallel bands of thin colour lines, saturated red, green and blue interleaved, colour shifting optically as the eye moves, moiré effects, crisp edges, rhythmic repetition across the surface.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Non-objective; use for facades or floors as pattern.

styles.name: Richard Anuszkiewicz
styles.features: Concentric squares and radiating thin lines in complementary colours, vibrating edges, glowing centre, red against green, orange against blue, strict symmetry, flat hard-edged paint.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Non-objective.

styles.name: Julian Stanczak
styles.features: Fine taped parallel stripes laid over colour gradients, translucent veils of one hue over another, luminous grids, soft shifting optical waves, cool blues and greens, mechanical precision.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Non-objective; landscape only as light and colour bands.

styles.name: Edna Andrade
styles.features: Hard-edged black-and-white or two-colour geometric patterns, radiating triangles, diamonds and spirals that seem to rotate or pulse, crisp tape-masked edges, flat matte paint, strict symmetry.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Non-objective.

styles.name: Wojciech Fangor
styles.features: Soft-edged concentric circles and waves of colour with blurred haloed edges, colour hovering in front of the canvas, red, blue and yellow glowing on a white ground, no line, smooth diffuse transitions.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Non-objective; treat sun or moon as a glowing halo.

styles.name: Francis Bacon
styles.features: Smeared twisting figures with blurred faces, flat raw grounds of orange, violet or pink, figures enclosed in thin linear cage-like structures, swipes and sweeps of paint, bare light bulbs.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Distortion can read as horror.

styles.name: Lucian Freud
styles.medium: oil on canvas, heavy lead-white impasto
styles.features: Dense crusty impasto modelling of flesh, greenish, grey and mauve skin tones, sitters in sparse studio rooms with bare floorboards and worn sofas, close unflattering scrutiny, short heavy directional brushstrokes.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Often nudes; keep sitters clothed.

styles.name: Alice Neel
styles.features: Loose expressive portraits with bold blue contour lines, large heads and hands, slightly elongated seated bodies, thin washy backgrounds left partly unfinished, acid greens, blues and pinks.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Fairfield Porter
styles.features: Sunny shingled houses, porches and family breakfasts, broad flat brushwork, clear summer light, fresh greens and blues, simplified forms without fussy detail, calm gardens and seaside meadows.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: David Park
styles.features: Thick loaded brushstrokes, chunky simplified figures and bathers, faces as a few strokes, saturated ochre, orange and blue, heavy paint, figures pressed close to the picture plane.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Philip Guston, late figurative period
styles.features: Cartoon-like lumpy pink and red forms outlined in black, cyclopean heads, piled shoes, bare bulbs, clocks and brick walls, thick pinkish-grey brushwork, deliberately clumsy comic drawing.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Avoid hooded figures.

styles.name: Balthus
styles.features: Chalky matte fresco-like surface, still timeless interiors and village streets, stiff doll-like figures, muted ochre, terracotta and dusty green, geometric clarity, cats.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Avoid adolescent subjects; use streets, landscapes, adults.

styles.name: Andrew Wyeth
styles.medium: egg tempera on panel, drybrush watercolour
styles.features: Meticulous fine hatched strokes of dry grass, bleached winter fields, weathered clapboard farmhouses, muted ochre, umber and grey, sparse lonely figures, low horizons, cold clear light.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Romare Bearden
styles.medium: collage and photomontage with paint on board
styles.features: Cut-paper and photomontage collage, faces assembled from magazine fragments, flat coloured paper planes, musicians and neighbourhood street life, fragmented cubist space, vivid red, blue and green.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Bernard Buffet
styles.features: Spiky black graphic outlines, elongated gaunt figures, thin angular lines, grey, black and ochre with sharp colour accents, rigid frontal compositions, clowns, cityscapes and brittle still lifes.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Fernando Botero
styles.features: Inflated volumes: plump rounded figures, animals, fruit and objects, smooth seamless modelling, tiny features on large faces, bright Latin American colour, provincial interiors with small accessories.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Paula Rego
styles.features: Large dense pastel drawings, sturdy women and girls in staged theatrical scenes, strong contours, heavy chalky colour, folk-tale and fairy-tale dramas, claustrophobic interiors, props and costumes.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art
styles.note: Themes can be dark.

styles.name: Frank Auerbach
styles.medium: oil on board, very heavy impasto
styles.features: Extremely thick sculptural impasto, ridges and furrows of paint, rapid gestural strokes in earth colours with yellow and red, urban building sites and heads, scraped and repainted surfaces.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Alex Colville
styles.features: Paint built from tiny stippled dots, precise geometric composition, still figures and animals in a suspended moment, cool clear light, flat coastal landscapes, muted greys and blues, eerie calm.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Jeffrey Smart
styles.features: Precise flat geometric urban landscapes, motorways, shipping containers, overpasses and car parks, clean hard light, small isolated figures, saturated yellow, blue and orange signage colours, empty skies.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Sidney Nolan
styles.features: Thin fluid enamel, naive flat outback landscapes, scorched ochre plains and pale blue skies, black square armoured rider, simplified horses, dreamlike floating forms.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: L. S. Lowry
styles.features: Industrial towns with mills and smoking chimneys, white-grey sky, crowds of small stick-like figures in dark coats, flattened perspective, muted black, red, ochre and white.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Stanley Spencer
styles.features: Densely packed compositions of chunky rounded figures, village life mixed with biblical episodes, sharp detail, tilted perspective, shipyards and gardens, earthy colours with pink and green.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Ernie Barnes
styles.features: Elongated muscular rubbery figures in motion, closed eyes, dancing crowds, sports and church scenes, swirling flowing lines, warm saturated colours, exaggerated stretched limbs.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Faith Ringgold, story quilts
styles.medium: acrylic on canvas with pieced fabric borders
styles.features: Painted central scene framed by patchwork fabric borders, flat bold figures and city rooftops, handwritten text panels, bright saturated colours, figures flying over bridges and skylines.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Jean-Michel Basquiat
styles.medium: acrylic, oilstick and spray paint on canvas
styles.features: Raw graffiti-like drawing, skeletal heads and crowns, scrawled crossed-out words and arrows, bright patches of red, yellow and blue on rough ground, anatomical diagrams, layered energetic marks.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Keith Haring
styles.medium: acrylic and marker on canvas, chalk drawing
styles.features: Bold continuous black outlines, faceless dancing figures with radiating motion lines, barking dogs and crawling babies, flat bright primary fills, all-over interlocking compositions, no shading.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Tetiana Yablonska
styles.features: Sunlit open-air figurative painting, village women in fields, broad fluent strokes, later flat decorative folk-inspired colour, saturated reds, yellows and blues recalling embroidery and painted ceramics.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Bhupen Khakhar
styles.features: Flat naive figurative painting, shopkeepers, barbers and watch repairers in their stalls, bright pastel colours, many small scenes within one frame, miniature-like tilted space, calendar-print references.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Vicente Manansala
styles.features: Transparent cubism: overlapping translucent planes, vendors and mothers broken into angular facets, layered glazes, warm browns, greens and ochre, market scenes, rhythmic geometric structure.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Ben Enwonwu
styles.features: Elongated graceful figures, dancers in mid-movement, loose fluid brushstrokes, masquerade costumes, deep browns with saturated blue, red and gold, rhythmic vertical compositions.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Candido Portinari
styles.features: Monumental heavy figures with large hands and feet, coffee plantation workers and migrants, earthy reds, browns and dusty blues, simplified sculptural modelling, sparse arid landscapes, cubist-influenced geometry.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Kai Fjell
styles.features: Dreamlike decorative figuration, women, horses and cows in rural interiors, softly flattened shapes, lyrical deep blue and red with pastel passages, patterned surfaces, folk-art echoes.
styles.section: Mid-century and later 20th-century figurative painting, Pop art, Photorealism, Op art

styles.name: Niko Pirosmani
styles.features: Matte black oilcloth ground left showing between forms; limited palette of white, ochre, green and red; flat frontal figures at long feast tables; solitary deer, giraffes and animals with large calm eyes; simple broad strokes
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Polina Raiko
styles.medium: oil and enamel paint on house walls
styles.features: Murals covering whole walls of a small rural house; flat bright figures, birds, fish and flowering trees; blue, orange and green on white plaster; childlike outlines; scenes crowded edge to edge with no perspective
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Séraphine Louis
styles.medium: house and enamel paint on canvas
styles.features: All-over compositions of leaves, fruit, feathers and flowers radiating like trees or bouquets; glossy layered paint; deep reds, golds, greens; tiny white dots and veining on each petal; dark grounds; no horizon or figures
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Louis Vivin
styles.features: Paris monuments and streets with every brick and stone outlined individually in white; frontal façades with flattened, tilting perspective; muted greys, beiges and soft blues; tiny stiff passers-by; clean pale skies
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Camille Bombois
styles.features: Heavy, rounded fleshy bodies of nudes, circus strongmen and wrestlers; firm modelling with pinkish flesh tones; crisp, polished surfaces; rural French riverbanks and villages with sharply drawn trees and clear daylight
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: André Bauchant
styles.features: Small stiff figures from myth and history set in wide airy landscapes; bunched, separately painted flowers in foreground; soft greens, earthy browns and pale blue skies; slightly clumsy proportions; theatrical frieze-like groupings
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Grandma Moses (Anna Mary Robertson Moses)
styles.features: High-viewpoint panoramas of farm life in upstate New York through the seasons; many tiny figures sledding, haying, gathering; white snowy fields, soft greens; sponged trees; houses and barns scattered across rolling hills
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Horace Pippin
styles.features: Thickly built paint with dry, scraped textures; restrained palette of browns, greys and blacks punctuated by bright reds and whites; flat interiors with patterned rugs and doilies; sturdy simplified figures; strong silhouettes
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Clementine Hunter
styles.features: Flat, faceless or minimal-featured figures picking cotton, washing, dancing and gathering at baptisms; bright unmodulated colour fields; figures stacked in rows without perspective; red, blue, yellow clothing against green or brown ground
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Edward Hicks
styles.features: Lions, leopards, lambs and oxen gathered peacefully with children in a wooded clearing; large solemn animal faces with staring eyes; smooth varnished surface; warm browns and greens; distant river landscape with small figures
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Ammi Phillips
styles.features: Itinerant folk portraits with flat, elongated figures set against plain dark backgrounds; precise faces with smooth pale skin; strong red, black and white costume colours; stiff poses; patterned dresses and lace rendered as flat shapes
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Morris Hirshfield
styles.features: Symmetrical flattened women, cats, lions and birds; surfaces filled with repetitive short strokes resembling textile stitching or fur; heavy curtains and patterned fabrics; bright pinks, oranges and greens; figures shown frontally against decorative backdrops
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Alfred Wallis
styles.medium: ship paint on scraps of cardboard
styles.features: Sailing ships, lighthouses and harbour cottages on irregular cardboard pieces with bare ground visible; muted greens, browns, blacks and whites; scale set by importance rather than distance; tilting horizons; sea as flat coloured field
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Antonio Ligabue
styles.features: Tigers, leopards and eagles in violent close-up attack with open jaws; Po Valley farmhouses and cattle behind; intense yellows, greens and reds; dense nervous brushwork; figures pushed against the foreground plane
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Orneore Metelli
styles.features: Small Italian town streets and squares with houses drawn in uneven perspective; bright ochres, blues and terracottas; tiny doll-like inhabitants, carnival processions and bands; outlines firm; sky as flat blue band
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Ivan Generalić
styles.features: Glossy colours seen through glass; Podravina village scenes with peasants, red cows and haystacks; bare trees with lace-like branches against snow or dark skies; very fine drawn detail; flat stacked space and clear contours
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Ivan Rabuzin
styles.features: Rounded hills and ball-shaped trees built from tiny dots and loops; cloud-like flowers floating in symmetrical rows; soft pastel blues, pinks and greens; smooth rhythmic ordered landscapes without people; dreamy even light
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Ivan Lacković Croata
styles.medium: ink drawing and oil on reverse glass
styles.features: Wide snowy plains with fine black branching trees; thin precise linework; small hunched figures and village houses; muted whites, greys and touches of red; low horizon and large pale sky; cold, quiet emptiness
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Emerik Feješ
styles.features: Frontal façades of European cathedrals and city squares with windows in neat repetitive rows; bright pinks, yellows, greens and blues; no shadows; dot-like tiny people; buildings flattened into colourful ornamental patterns
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Nikifor (Epifaniusz Drowniak)
styles.medium: watercolour on scrap paper and card
styles.features: Small watercolours of wooden Orthodox churches, spa pavilions and imagined towns; transparent pastel washes; fine pencil outlines; symmetrical frontal buildings; occasional robed self-portrait figures; soft greens, pinks and blues
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Teofil Ociepka
styles.features: Fantastic dragons, mythical beasts and flowering cosmic landscapes; rich deep greens, blues and reds; scales and feathers rendered as dense patterns; flattened decorative forest and sky; mysterious nocturnal mood
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Pavel Leonov
styles.features: Panoramic scenes of village and town life crowded with tiny stylised figures; buildings, tractors, parades and animals in rows; bright flat colours; bird's-eye view without perspective; repeated rhythmic shapes
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Russian lubok
styles.medium: hand-coloured woodcut and engraving on paper
styles.features: Bold black outlined woodcut figures with patches of red, yellow and green colour applied loosely; flat space; heroes, jesters, animals and fairy-tale scenes; blocks of Cyrillic text integrated around images
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide
styles.note: Requires lettering; keep text minimal or decorative

styles.name: Swedish Dalarna painting (dalmålning)
styles.medium: distemper on paper and wall panels
styles.features: Biblical and village scenes with figures in 18th-century Swedish dress; huge stylised flower-gourds sprouting between them; red, green and blue on pale ground; flat friezes with arched frames
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Hector Hyppolite
styles.features: Frontal heraldic spirit figures, mermaids and kings with vases of flowers; glossy brushy enamel; strong reds, blues, greens; feathered and dotted decoration; flat backgrounds; figures arranged symmetrically
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Philomé Obin
styles.features: Meticulous historical scenes and street parades with many small upright figures; buildings drawn frontally with clear outlines; smooth even colour; detailed uniforms and flags; ordered composition
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Préfète Duffaut
styles.features: Vertical imaginary cities climbing mountains with spiral roads; tiny houses and churches stacked; clear blues, pinks and greens; dense detail; figures on winding paths; cosmic tower compositions
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Haitian naïve painting, Port-au-Prince Centre d'Art
styles.features: Crowded markets, cockfights and village life with bright flat figures; tropical foliage with patterned leaves; banana trees; vivid reds, yellows and greens; space stacked upward; repeated shapes
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Mexican ex-voto painting
styles.features: Small tin panels showing an accident or illness; sickbed or road scene; saint appearing in a cloud in a corner; flat architecture; handwritten text band at bottom
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide
styles.note: Devotional imagery and lettering are central

styles.name: Amate bark painting of Guerrero
styles.features: Brown bark paper covered with brightly coloured birds, flowers and village festivals; dense flat patterns; black outlines; small figures; pinks, greens, oranges; no perspective
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Solentiname primitivist painting
styles.features: Lush island landscapes with every leaf painted separately; bright greens and blues; small villagers, boats and birds; dense trees; clear skies; space stacked vertically
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Heitor dos Prazeres
styles.features: Samba dancers and favela gatherings with figures heads tilted upwards; flat bright clothing; simple facial features; rhythmic group compositions; colourful houses on hills
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Tingatinga painting
styles.features: Glossy enamel animals with flat colour fields and patterned skins; elephants, giraffes, birds; black outlines; bright backgrounds; repeated shapes
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Moke (Monsengo Kejwamfi)
styles.features: Street life of Kinshasa with bars, dancers and markets; bright colours; crowds; stylised figures; lively energy; flat space with bold outlines
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Mithila (Madhubani) painting
styles.features: Double outlines filled with hatching and patterns; fish, peacocks and figures; borders framing scenes; bright pinks, yellows, greens; flat space
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Kalighat painting
styles.features: Bold sweeping outlines; figures shaded with tonal modelling; plain backgrounds; satirical scenes; strong blacks and soft colours
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Jangarh Singh Shyam
styles.features: Animals and trees filled with dots and dashes; bright colours; flat forms; patterned surfaces; stylised creatures
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Shalom of Safed
styles.features: Biblical stories in horizontal registers; small figures; bright colours; patterned borders; flat space
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Kiyoshi Yamashita
styles.features: Landscapes and fireworks built from torn coloured paper; dense mosaic texture; soft edges; bright colours
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Bill Traylor
styles.medium: pencil and poster paint on cardboard
styles.features: Flat silhouettes of people and animals; bare cardboard; limited colours; simple shapes; energetic poses
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Martín Ramírez
styles.medium: crayon and pencil on pieced paper
styles.features: Parallel lines forming tunnels and arches; horsemen and trains; repetitive patterns; muted colours
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Henry Darger
styles.features: Panoramic scenes of children in landscapes; traced figures; pastel colours; flowers; battles
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide
styles.note: Often includes captions

styles.name: Adolf Wölfli
styles.features: Dense ornament with musical notation and text; symmetrical patterns; faces; bright colours
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Aloïse Corbaz
styles.features: Voluptuous couples with blue eyes; bright colours; flat figures; decorative patterns
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Madge Gill
styles.features: Women's faces in mazes of checkerboard patterns; black ink; intricate lines
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Minnie Evans
styles.features: Symmetrical faces with plants and eyes; bright colours; decorative patterns
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Sister Gertrude Morgan
styles.features: Figures with text from Revelation; bright colours; flat forms
styles.section: Naïve, folk, self-taught and outsider painters worldwide

styles.name: Arthur Rackham
styles.medium: pen and ink with watercolour washes
styles.features: Fine wiry pen line over thin tinted washes of sepia, olive and dusty rose; gnarled trees with faces and twisting roots; wizened gnomes and slender maidens; muted parchment-toned atmosphere; silhouettes against pale skies

styles.name: Edmund Dulac
styles.features: Glowing jewel-toned washes dominated by deep night blues and gold, stippled textures, flattened ornamental compositions influenced by Persian and Chinese miniatures, moonlit palaces, robed figures with delicate faces, soft luminous edges

styles.name: Howard Pyle
styles.medium: oil on canvas; pen and ink
styles.features: Two modes: archaic pen-and-ink with dense cross-hatching and medieval decorative borders, or dramatic oils of pirates and knights in strong raking light, earthy reds and ochres, theatrical poses, detailed period costume

styles.name: N. C. Wyeth
styles.features: Thick confident brushwork, bold silhouettes against bright skies, strong backlight and long shadows, heroic muscular figures in adventure costume, saturated warm ochres, blues and reds, low viewpoints for drama

styles.name: Maxfield Parrish
styles.features: Smooth layered glazes, luminous cobalt-blue skies, glowing amber light on rocks and columns, towering cumulus clouds, androgynous figures on classical terraces, crisply detailed foliage, enamel-like stillness

styles.name: Jessie Willcox Smith
styles.medium: charcoal, watercolour and oil on board
styles.features: Soft rounded children and mothers in domestic scenes, strong dark contours filled with muted flat colour, warm cream, rose and sage palette, cosy interiors and gardens, gentle chalky textures

styles.name: Elizabeth Shippen Green
styles.features: Decorative patterning of fabrics and wallpaper, firm outlines with flat muted watercolour, women and children in Edwardian dress, compressed shallow space, soft greens, golds and dusty pinks

styles.name: W. Heath Robinson
styles.medium: pen and ink with grey wash
styles.features: Absurdly elaborate contraptions of pulleys, string, planks and kettles worked by solemn bald men in spectacles; clean economical pen line, grey washes, deadpan precise detail

styles.name: Kate Greenaway
styles.features: Delicate pale washes, children in high-waisted Regency smocks and bonnets, apple-blossom gardens, thin fine outlines, generous white space, friezes of figures in rows, gentle pastel greens and yellows

styles.name: Randolph Caldecott
styles.medium: pen and ink with colour wood engraving
styles.features: Lively economical pen line, galloping horses and hounds, rotund squires and country folk in Georgian dress, light flat tints, open English countryside, movement suggested with very few strokes

styles.name: Beatrix Potter
styles.features: Small precise watercolours of animals wearing tiny clothes, botanically accurate plants, soft natural browns and greens, Lake District cottages and gardens, delicate fine pen lines, white paper margins

styles.name: E. H. Shepard
styles.medium: pen and ink with light watercolour
styles.features: Loose sketchy pen line, minimal hatching, airy edges fading into the white page, small stuffed-toy animals and children in woodland, light dappled tints, intimate small scale

styles.name: W. W. Denslow
styles.medium: pen and ink with flat colour printing
styles.features: Heavy bold outlines, flat limited colour areas, chunky cartoonish figures, poster-like simplicity, decorative borders, scenes tinted in a single dominant hue, humorous exaggerated characters

styles.name: John R. Neill
styles.features: Elegant flowing pen line with Art Nouveau curls, fine hatching, slim girls with bobbed hair and bows, whimsical machines and creatures, decorative endpapers, occasional flat colour plates

styles.name: Winsor McCay
styles.medium: pen and ink with flat colour, newspaper Sunday page
styles.features: Precise architectural pen line, panels that grow and shrink with dream logic, vast Art Nouveau palaces, walking beds and giant figures in city streets, flat bright newspaper colours, speech balloons

styles.name: Sidney Sime
styles.features: Bold black masses with fine spidery lines, vast shadowy cosmic architecture, monstrous gods beside tiny figures, eerie voids, dramatic contrast, grotesque humour, weird mythological landscapes

styles.name: Warwick Goble
styles.features: Pale clear watercolour influenced by Japanese prints, flat delicate washes, elegant figures in Indian, Japanese or Italian dress, soft pastel blues and pinks, open airy compositions, fine outlines

styles.name: Virginia Frances Sterrett
styles.features: Elongated ethereal figures, intricate decorative detail, pale washed palette with touches of blue and pink, Art Nouveau ornament, Arabian Nights and fairy-tale settings, airy dreamlike compositions

styles.name: Willy Pogány
styles.features: Rhythmic decorative line, stylised figures, Art Nouveau and Celtic interlaced borders, flat colour areas or pure black and white, heroes of Norse and Greek myth, pattern favoured over depth

styles.name: J. C. Leyendecker
styles.features: Crisp hatched oil strokes like chiselled facets, glossy highlights, square-jawed men in tailored clothes, flat plain backgrounds, unfinished vignette edges, strong cool and warm contrast

styles.name: Charles Dana Gibson
styles.features: Fluid assured pen line, tall poised women with upswept hair and high collars, gentlemen in evening dress, dense parallel hatching for darks, bare paper for light, society drawing-room scenes

styles.name: Jenny Nyström
styles.features: Rosy plump children and small grey-bearded tomte gnomes in red caps, snowy farmyards, warm candlelit Christmas scenes, soft realistic watercolour, red, white and pine-green palette

styles.name: Thomas Theodor Heine
styles.medium: pen and ink with flat colour, magazine print
styles.features: Flat poster-like colour, sharp clean contours, sardonic caricature of stiff officers and bourgeois figures, a snarling red bulldog motif, strong silhouettes, Jugendstil economy

styles.name: Olaf Gulbransson
styles.features: Very economical caricature built from one unbroken bold contour, large bare white areas, bulky rounded figures, almost no hatching, occasional flat colour, wit carried by simplified silhouette

styles.name: Heinrich Kley
styles.medium: pen and ink with sepia wash
styles.features: Virtuoso nervous pen line, satirical scenes of elephants, crocodiles and devils behaving like humans, industrial furnaces and giants, energetic movement, cross-hatching, light sepia wash

styles.name: Gerda Wegener
styles.medium: watercolour and ink, fashion magazine illustration
styles.features: Elegant almond-eyed women with bobbed hair in Art Deco fashion, flat watercolour within sinuous outlines, pastel and coral palette, playful flirtatious poses, decorative backgrounds

styles.name: George Barbier
styles.features: Crisp ink outlines filled with flat brilliant stencilled colour, slender Art Deco figures in Ballets Russes and Orientalist costume, lacquer-like blacks, gold accents, stylised fountains and gardens

styles.name: Louis-Maurice Boutet de Monvel
styles.features: Pale flat washes with fine precise outlines, long frieze-like rows of soldiers and knights, minimal backgrounds of open sky, delicate pastel palette, clear silhouettes, careful medieval armour

styles.name: Benjamin Rabier
styles.features: Bold clean outlines, flat bright colour, cheerful humanised farm animals with expressive grins, minimal backgrounds, clear graphic simplicity, comic situations

styles.name: Albert Robida
styles.features: Busy humorous pen drawings of imagined future cities, airships filling the sky, crowded balconies, Belle Époque costume, flat tints, dense small figures, caricatured faces

styles.name: Henry Justice Ford
