styles.features: Detailed Victorian pen line, romantic medieval costume, knights, dragons and fairies, decorative hatching, Pre-Raphaelite faces, dense narrative compositions, some plates in soft colour

styles.name: Cicely Mary Barker
styles.features: Realistic children dressed as fairies in petal costumes with translucent insect wings, botanically exact flowers, clear delicate watercolour, soft natural light, gentle portrait-like faces

styles.name: Mabel Lucie Attwell
styles.features: Chubby round-faced toddlers with big eyes and rosy cheeks, simple bold outlines, flat pastel colour, cheeky sentimental humour, minimal backgrounds

styles.name: Hugh Thomson
styles.medium: pen and ink with light watercolour
styles.features: Delicate lively pen line with fine hatching, Regency and Georgian figures in bonnets and tailcoats, drawing-room and village scenes, gentle humour, airy vignettes on white

styles.name: Franklin Booth
styles.features: Pen lines laid like steel engraving in thousands of parallel strokes, monumental architecture and towering trees dwarfing tiny figures, vast skies with billowing clouds, luminous greys from line density alone

styles.name: Joseph Clement Coll
styles.features: Dramatic pen-and-ink with bold spotted blacks and flickering hatching, exotic adventure settings, swirling smoke and flames, strong light and shadow, energetic figures in action

styles.name: Coles Phillips
styles.features: Fadeaway design where figure and background share one flat colour so the silhouette dissolves, elegant young women, crisp graphic shapes, pure flat colour fields, patterned detail only where needed

styles.name: John Held Jr.
styles.medium: pen and ink with flat colour
styles.features: Lanky stick-limbed flappers and college boys with tiny heads and big feet, flat bright colour, crisp outlines, Charleston dance poses, Jazz Age parties

styles.name: Will H. Bradley
styles.medium: colour relief print, poster and magazine cover
styles.features: Flat interlocking colour shapes, sweeping black curves, swirling hair and drapery, bold decorative lettering woven into the design, limited two- or three-colour palette

styles.name: Wanda Gág
styles.features: Rhythmic swelling black-and-white line, rolling hills and houses that seem to breathe, soft lithographic greys, folk-tale simplicity, sculptural rounded forms, curving paths across the page

styles.name: Frans Masereel
styles.features: Bold black woodcut with chunky gouged white lines, expressionist city scenes of factories, chimneys and crowds, heavy contrast, angular simplified figures, wordless picture sequences

styles.name: Yuri Vasnetsov
styles.features: Folk-toy imagery in bright red, ochre, green and blue, animals decorated with dots, flowers and stripes, naive frontal figures, symmetrical compositions, wooden log houses, dense ornamental borders and patterned backgrounds
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Vladimir Suteev
styles.features: Clean rounded cartoon outlines, simple anthropomorphic animals with expressive poses and big eyes, flat light watercolour fills, white background, sequences of small vignettes showing actions step by step
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Boris Dekhterev
styles.features: Academic realistic drawing, soft tonal watercolour modelling, carefully detailed period costumes, theatrical stage-like lighting, graceful figures in palaces and gardens, warm muted palette of ochre, rose and grey-blue
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Gennady Kalinovsky
styles.features: Intricate fine pen line with dense crosshatching, elongated grotesque figures, surreal metamorphic details, Victorian-like ornament, sepia and grey toning with sparse colour accents, crowded fantastical compositions
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Lev Tokmakov
styles.features: Large flat colour areas with folk-toy simplicity, chunky stylised people and animals, bright red, ochre, green and black, naive frontal poses, little depth, wooden-toy and clay-figurine shapes
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: May Miturich
styles.features: Loose calligraphic brush lines, sparse transparent watercolour, quick sketch-like animals, birds and northern landscapes, lots of empty white paper, spontaneous unfinished edges
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Heorhiy Narbut
styles.features: Precise black silhouettes and fine ink line, heraldic and Ukrainian folk ornament, flat decorative colour, symmetrical page layouts, elegant stylised animals and costumed figures, 18th-century engraving echoes
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Josef Lada
styles.features: Thick even black outlines, flat bright colour fills, round simplified figures with round faces, Czech village with ponds, snowy roofs, chapels and geese, cheerful naive composition with little shading
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Jiří Trnka
styles.features: Soft glowing watercolour and gouache, doll-like figures with large oval heads and tiny features, dreamy muted blues, greens and gold, stage-like depth, misty backgrounds, delicate fairy-tale ornament
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Helena Zmatlíková
styles.features: Loose lively brush line, splashed transparent watercolour, energetic children with rosy cheeks and tousled hair, quick gestures, minimal backgrounds, bright warm accents on white paper
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Kamil Lhoták
styles.features: Naive precise drawing of old bicycles, early cars, balloons and airships in wide empty landscapes, low flat horizons, pale washed skies, quiet melancholic atmosphere, small hatted figures
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Květa Pacovská
styles.medium: mixed media, collage and cut paper
styles.features: Bold flat primary colours, red, black, yellow and green, geometric shapes and cut-outs, collage, stamped letters and numbers, abstracted figures made of circles and triangles, playful layered paper surfaces
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century
styles.note: Often uses letters and numbers as shapes; keep lettering optional.

styles.name: Adolf Born
styles.features: Scratchy pen line with hatching and loose watercolour, caricatured figures with long noses, exotic animals, crowded humorous scenes, dandified costumes, warm ochres and blues
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Jan Marcin Szancer
styles.features: Romantic fairy-tale watercolour, slender elegant figures, princesses, knights and dwarfs, soft pastel washes, decorative flourishes, airy compositions with delicate ink contours
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Bohdan Butenko
styles.medium: pen and ink with spot colour
styles.features: Scratchy minimal pen line, comic-like stick-limbed figures with big noses, flat spot colour, lots of white page, absurd humour, hand-drawn lettering woven into pictures
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century
styles.note: Lettering is typical but can be omitted.

styles.name: Janusz Grabiański
styles.features: Splashy wet watercolour with blots, drips and spatter, animals and children drawn in quick gestural brushstrokes, white paper, bright red and yellow accents, rough lively texture
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Zbigniew Rychlicki
styles.features: Decorative flat gouache, stylised folk-inspired figures in patterned costumes, rich saturated colour, symmetrical fairy-tale compositions, ornamental flowers and birds, little perspective
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Olga Siemaszko
styles.medium: pen and ink with light watercolour
styles.features: Delicate flowing pen line, light transparent watercolour, slender lyrical children and animals, gentle contours, generous white space, soft green, blue and rose accents
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Tove Jansson
styles.features: Fine pen crosshatching, dense dark forests and stormy seas, round soft-bodied creatures, small wooden houses, muted blue-green washes, moody lamplit and twilight atmospheres
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century
styles.note: Do not name or reproduce her copyrighted characters; describe the drawing manner only.

styles.name: Ingrid Vang Nyman
styles.features: Flat bold colour areas without shading, strong graphic outlines, simple round faces with dot eyes, red, yellow, green and blue, decorative patterned clothes, poster-like clarity
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Ib Spang Olsen
styles.features: Lively nervous pen line with loose watercolour, crowded Copenhagen streets, rooftops and courtyards, round-faced children, humorous everyday detail, soft muted colour
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Gustaf Tenggren
styles.features: Softly modelled gouache, warm golden palette, rounded realistic animals, Nordic fairy-tale woods with gnarled trees, cosy cottages, gentle light with deep shadows
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Takeo Takei
styles.features: Flat stylised shapes with fine decorative line, whimsical modernist figures, Art Deco patterns, bright clear colours, fantasy animals and children, ornamental borders, playful geometric simplification
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Chihiro Iwasaki
styles.features: Wet-in-wet watercolour with bleeding edges, pale pastel washes, children with soft round faces and minimal features, almost no line, much white paper, flowers and rain
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Suekichi Akaba
styles.medium: sumi ink and watercolour on paper
styles.features: Sumi ink brushwork with muted earthy washes, rough textured paper, wide empty grasslands and skies, horses and folk-tale figures, emaki-like horizontal spreads
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Mitsumasa Anno
styles.features: Fine pen line with soft watercolour, high bird's-eye panoramas of European villages, fields and towns, hundreds of tiny figures at work and play, hidden details, wordless calm order
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Gyo Fujikawa
styles.features: Clean fine line, soft pastel colour, chubby round-faced children of many backgrounds, flowers and small animals, simple white backgrounds, some pages in black-and-white line alternating with colour
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Maurice Sendak
styles.medium: pen and ink crosshatching with watercolour
styles.features: Fine crosshatched pen with soft watercolour, chunky big-headed figures, hairy horned monsters, moonlit forests, night blues and greens, picture gradually filling the page
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Ezra Jack Keats
styles.features: Collage of patterned, marbled and newspaper papers with gouache, snowy city streets, brick tenements, a small Black child in a red snowsuit, flat shapes and simple silhouettes
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Leo Lionni
styles.features: Torn and cut paper collage, stamped and marbled textures, small simple creatures like mice, fish and inchworms, generous white backgrounds, soft-edged shapes, gentle colour
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Eric Carle
styles.features: Hand-painted tissue paper cut into shapes and layered, visible brush streaks and textures, bold saturated colours on white, large simple insects, animals, fruit and suns
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Virginia Lee Burton
styles.features: Rhythmic flowing curves, winding roads and rolling hills, small houses and machines, symmetrical decorative layouts, seasons and cities shown changing, soft flat colour or bold black-and-white
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Feodor Rojankovsky
styles.features: Rich textured lithographic crayon colour, robust animals with grainy fur, lush meadows, sturdy rosy children, warm earthy palette with bright accents, lively naturalism
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Nathalie Parain
styles.features: Flat modernist lithographic colour, simplified geometric forms, constructivist clarity, children's games and crafts shown as clean silhouettes, muted and primary colours on white
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Mary Blair
styles.features: Flat bold mid-century gouache, unexpected colour combinations of pink, turquoise, chartreuse and orange, stylised children with round heads, geometric flowers and houses, no shading
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century
styles.note: Describe her flat mid-century look, not studio film work.

styles.name: Ludwig Bemelmans
styles.medium: pen and ink with gouache and wash
styles.features: Loose quick pen line, Paris streets, monuments and parks, flat yellow wash backgrounds, small schoolgirls in rows, airy sketchy architecture, bright gouache patches
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Tomi Ungerer
styles.features: Sharp wiry pen line, flat watercolour, deep night blues and blacks, darkly humorous robbers and giants, angular caricatured figures, bold simple compositions
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Bruno Munari
styles.medium: die-cut paper, tracing paper, printed card
styles.features: Die-cut holes and layered translucent pages, flat abstract shapes, simple signs and stripes, black, red and pale colours, tactile textured papers, minimal suggestions of insects, grass and night
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Edward Ardizzone
styles.medium: pen and ink crosshatching with watercolour
styles.features: Quick loose crosshatched pen line, small figures in rain and wind, harbours, ships and stormy seas, soft watercolour washes, sketchy cosy interiors
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Pauline Baynes
styles.features: Delicate pen line, medieval-manuscript-like borders and miniature-scale figures, heraldic detail, small knights, castles and beasts, jewel-bright flat colour, decorative maps
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Brian Wildsmith
styles.features: Explosive saturated colour, patchwork and harlequin patterns, textured gouache layers, animals and birds built from colourful fragments, rich jewel tones, dense decorative compositions
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Ernst Kreidolf
styles.features: Anthropomorphic flowers and insects in botanically accurate watercolour, Alpine meadows, small costumed beetles and butterflies, delicate fine outline, fresh greens and soft floral colours
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: May Gibbs
styles.features: Australian bush plants rendered closely, eucalyptus gum nuts and blossoms, banksia cones, tiny nature-spirit children, fine ink line with soft watercolour, eucalypt greens and ochres
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Fiep Westendorp
styles.features: Black ink silhouette-like figures with spidery limbs and round heads, white dot eyes, sparse expressive gesture, flat black against white or with a single bright colour
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Károly Reich
styles.features: Delicate light watercolour with fine pen line, pastel colour, children and small animals, gentle meadows, lyrical airy compositions with lots of white space
styles.section: Children's book illustration worldwide in the 20th century

styles.name: Hergé
styles.medium: ink and flat colour on paper, printed album
styles.features: Ligne claire: uniform black outlines of constant weight, flat bright colour fills without shading or hatching, rare cast shadows, precise realistic cars, ships and buildings, simplified round-faced figures, even daylight clarity everywhere
styles.note: Describe as ligne claire; do not reproduce Tintin or other trademark characters

styles.name: Edgar P. Jacobs
styles.medium: ink and flat colour on paper, printed album
styles.features: Ligne claire with theatrical staging: crisp even outlines, flat saturated colours dominated by deep blues and ochres, dramatic night skies and lamp-lit interiors, meticulous Art Deco machinery and London architecture, stiffly posed realistic figures

styles.name: Yves Chaland
styles.medium: ink and flat colour on paper
styles.features: Retro 1950s 'atom style' ligne claire: bouncy rounded figures with oval heads, clean brush outlines, flat muted pastel colours, streamlined cars, boomerang-shaped furniture and mid-century ornaments, nostalgic postwar Belgian magazine look

styles.name: Alain Saint-Ogan
styles.medium: pen and ink with flat colour, magazine print
styles.features: Early ligne claire: thin even pen outlines, large unshaded colour areas, simple geometric figures with dot eyes, airy uncluttered backgrounds, Art Deco aeroplanes and ocean liners, neat rectangular panels with early speech balloons

styles.name: André Franquin
styles.medium: brush and ink with flat colour on paper
styles.features: Marcinelle school: energetic rubbery brush line with swelling and tapering strokes, exaggerated elastic bodies in motion, speed lines and dust clouds, cluttered lively offices and streets, rounded 1950s–60s cars, bright flat colours
styles.note: Avoid reproducing Gaston, Spirou or Marsupilami characters

styles.name: Morris
styles.medium: brush and ink with flat colour on paper
styles.features: Economical Western caricature: clean confident brush outlines, lanky elongated figures, deserts reduced to mesas, cacti and dust, flat bold colours, frequent single-colour background panels in yellow, red or blue with silhouetted figures
styles.note: Avoid reproducing Lucky Luke characters

styles.name: Albert Uderzo
styles.medium: brush and ink with flat colour on paper
styles.features: Rounded lively caricature: big-nosed stocky figures, expressive hands, detailed Roman camps and villages of thatched huts, forest greens and earthy browns, crowded brawl scenes with flying bodies, dust clouds and scattered helmets
styles.note: Do not reproduce Asterix characters; use for generic ancient or village comedy scenes

styles.name: Moebius (Jean Giraud)
styles.medium: pen and ink with watercolour or flat colour on paper
styles.features: Fine pen line with dense parallel hatching and stippling, vast empty deserts and alien landscapes under open skies, pale luminous colour in pastel pinks, cyans and sand, intricate organic architecture, small lone travellers

styles.name: Jean-Claude Mézières
styles.medium: ink and flat colour on paper
styles.features: Lively science-fiction comic line: crowded alien cities, spaceports and markets, inventive odd creatures, warm saturated colours, cartoon-realist human figures, dense busy backgrounds packed with machines, vehicles and signage shapes

styles.name: Claire Bretécher
styles.medium: pen and ink with light colour wash
styles.features: Loose scratchy pen line, minimal or empty backgrounds, gangly figures with big noses and slumped postures, expressive hands and gestures, sparse flat colour washes, satirical everyday middle-class conversations in sofas and kitchens

styles.name: Willy Vandersteen
styles.medium: ink and flat colour, newspaper and album print
styles.features: Flemish popular strip style: round-headed cartoon figures with simple dot eyes, clear brush outlines, Flemish towns, castles and countryside, flat bright colours, adventures through historical and fairy-tale settings

styles.name: Rodolphe Töpffer
styles.features: Loose spontaneous pen sketches in thin wavering line, caricatured long-nosed figures, minimal settings, strips of horizontal panels with handwritten captions beneath each image, no colour, no balloons

styles.name: Wilhelm Busch
styles.medium: pen drawings reproduced as wood engraving, later hand-coloured
styles.features: Crisp economical pen line, rhythmic sequences of small pictures, round-headed mischievous figures with exaggerated slapstick motion, sparse village settings, simple flat colouring, rhymed verses printed beneath the images

styles.name: Imagerie d'Épinal
styles.medium: stencil-coloured woodcut, later lithograph, on paper sheets
styles.features: Popular picture sheets: bold black outlines, flat bright patches of red, yellow, blue and green slightly off-register, grids of small numbered pictures with printed captions, soldiers in rows, saints and moral tales

styles.name: Marie Duval
styles.medium: pen drawing printed in magazine, black and white
styles.features: Rapid spontaneous pen line, sketchy crowded London streets, theatres and seaside resorts, gangly caricatured figures with bulbous noses, top hats and bustles, chaotic comic compositions in black-and-white Victorian print

styles.name: George Herriman
styles.medium: pen and ink, newspaper strip and Sunday page
styles.features: Scratchy loose pen line with crosshatching, surreal desert of mesas and buttes that change shape between panels, small cartoon animals, irregular panel shapes, zigzag Southwestern borders, flat ochre, pink and blue Sunday colour

styles.name: Richard F. Outcault
styles.features: Crowded tenement-alley panoramas packed with ragged cartoon children, hand-painted signs and slogans on walls and clothes, broad slapstick action, flat newspaper colour with prominent yellow, one large busy panel

styles.name: Cliff Sterrett
styles.medium: ink and colour newspaper Sunday page
styles.features: Modernist strip abstraction: angular stylised figures, checkered floors and patterned wallpaper, tilted Cubist-influenced furniture, dotted and striped textures, flat bright colour, decorative geometric backgrounds for domestic comedy

styles.name: George McManus
styles.features: Elegant Art Nouveau and Deco linework, tall slim society women and squat caricatured men, ornate interiors with patterned rugs, framed pictures and drapery, clean outlines, flat colour, theatrical staging

styles.name: Frank King
styles.medium: ink and colour newspaper Sunday page
styles.features: Gentle naturalistic cartoon line, small-town Midwest streets, gardens and back yards, warm seasonal colour; one continuous landscape split into grid panels, figures moving through it like a stroll

styles.name: Nell Brinkley
styles.medium: pen and ink with spot colour, newspaper illustration
styles.features: Swirling Art Nouveau pen line, dense fine curls of hair, willowy young women in flowing gowns, floral garlands and arabesque borders, delicate pink and pastel spot colour, romantic whimsical newspaper pages

styles.name: Hal Foster
styles.medium: pen, brush and ink with colour, newspaper Sunday page
styles.features: Realistic illustrative drawing, anatomically accurate figures in medieval armour, detailed castles, forests and longships, fine feathered hatching, large captioned panels without speech balloons, earthy subdued colour

styles.name: Alex Raymond
styles.medium: brush and ink with colour, newspaper Sunday page
styles.features: Elegant feathered brush inking, glamorous athletic figures, sweeping science-fiction landscapes with rocket ships and ornate alien palaces, rich saturated colour, illustration-grade anatomy and heroic poses

styles.name: Milton Caniff
styles.features: Heavy chiaroscuro brush inking: large spotted black shadows, cinematic close-ups and silhouettes, exotic harbours, jungles and airfields, glamorous figures, loose drapery folds, economical suggestive detail

styles.name: Chester Gould
styles.medium: pen and brush ink, newspaper strip
styles.features: Stark angular black-and-white inking, grotesque caricatured villains, square-jawed heroes in profile, bold solid blacks, rain-slick city streets, gadgets and guns, hard geometric shapes and flat graphic composition

styles.name: Roy Crane
styles.features: Craftint duotone: mechanical grey line and dot tones over black ink, bold cartoon-realist figures, rousing fist-fight action, seaports, warships and jungles, crisp two-tone black, white and grey adventure drawing

styles.name: Walt Kelly
styles.features: Lush flexible brush line, round expressive swamp animals in human clothes, cypress swamp with hanging moss, flat-bottomed boats and lily pads, rich black inking, dense detailed foliage, warm folksy texture

styles.name: Jackie Ormes
styles.medium: pen and ink, newspaper strip and panel
styles.features: Fashion-illustration elegance in newspaper comics: stylish African-American women in tailored 1940s–50s clothing, sharp poised figures, period hairstyles, hats and interiors, clean confident ink line

styles.name: Will Eisner
styles.medium: brush and ink with wash, comic book and graphic novel
styles.features: Fluid atmospheric brush inking, rain-soaked New York tenements, stoops and fire escapes, expressive gestural figures, deep shadows, panels dissolving into the page, sepia-grey wash moodiness

styles.name: Jack Kirby
styles.medium: pencil and brush ink, four-colour comic book
styles.features: Explosive blocky drawing, massive square-jawed figures in extreme foreshortening, crackling black energy dots, colossal machinery and cosmic vistas, thick confident contours, flat primary four-colour printing
styles.note: Avoid reproducing trademark superhero characters

styles.name: Golden-age American comic book printing, 1940s
styles.features: Coarse yellowed newsprint, flat limited colours from cyan, magenta, yellow and black, visible Ben-Day dot tints, slight misregistration halos, bold black inking, primary-coloured costumed figures in action

styles.name: Hugo Pratt
styles.features: Economical brush inking with large black masses, suggestive minimal detail, open white space, soft watercolour washes in later work, sea horizons, tropical islands and steppes, lean figures in long coats

styles.name: Dino Battaglia
styles.medium: pen, ink wash and textured tones on paper
styles.features: Literary illustration-comics: delicate textured pen line, ink washes and spattered grey tones, ghostly atmospheric light, Gothic houses and maritime settings, elongated figures half-dissolving into fog, sepia and grey palette

styles.name: Sergio Toppi
styles.features: Dense decorative pen hatching against vast white areas, panel borders abandoned, figures and landscapes woven into ornamental compositions, bold geometric patterns, ethnographic costumes, monumental elongated figures

styles.name: Guido Crepax
styles.medium: pen and ink, black and white
styles.features: Elegant fashion-like line, fragmented layouts of many thin vertical panels, 1960s modernist interiors and Op Art patterns, tall slender women with dark bob haircuts, cinematic close details of eyes and hands
styles.note: Much of the work is erotic; keep subjects non-explicit

styles.name: Benito Jacovitti
styles.medium: ink and flat colour on paper
styles.features: Crowded absurd panels packed with tiny gags, worms, salami and stray objects scattered on the ground, rubbery cartoon figures with oversized feet, bright flat colours, chaotic busy Western and village parodies

styles.name: Antonio Rubino
styles.medium: ink and flat colour, children's magazine print
styles.features: Art Nouveau children's comics: ornate symmetrical compositions, decorative flat patterns, stylised children, toy soldiers and garden creatures, curling floral borders, bright flat colour, rhymed lines beneath images

styles.name: Andrea Pazienza
styles.features: Restless virtuoso drawing mixing pen, brush, marker and watercolour, shifting between scratchy caricature and realist portraiture, 1970s–80s Italian youth, university streets and cafés, vivid saturated colour, expressive distortion
styles.note: Avoid drug-related themes

styles.name: Alberto Breccia
styles.medium: ink, collage, monotype and scraped textures
styles.features: Experimental high-contrast black and white: collage, monotype and scratched textures, faces broken into abstract masses, deep blacks with harsh light, gestural ink smears and razor-cut highlights, eerie horror atmosphere

styles.name: Francisco Solano López
styles.medium: brush and ink, black and white
styles.features: Solid realistic brush inking, Buenos Aires streets and suburbs, ordinary men in coats and improvised protective gear, wrecked vehicles, dense black shadows, cinematic camera angles, sober black-and-white adventure realism

styles.name: Quino
styles.medium: pen and ink, strip and single-panel cartoon
styles.features: Clean economical pen line, round-headed children with large heads and small bodies, sparse domestic interiors; later fine-hatched single panels with detailed crowds, offices and city streets, dry observational humour
styles.note: Do not reproduce Mafalda characters

styles.name: Oski (Óscar Conti)
styles.medium: pen and ink with wash on paper
styles.features: Scratchy naive pen line, grotesque caricatured figures with tiny heads, parody of old chronicles and engravings, wobbly hand-drawn borders, conquistadors, explorers and colonial life, sepia and black ink

styles.name: Yoshihiro Tatsumi
styles.features: Gekiga realism: plain unglamorous ink line, cramped apartments, factories, alleys and sewers, working-class figures with tired faces, heavy screentone shadows, cinematic panel pacing, bleak black-and-white urban mood

styles.name: Goseki Kojima
styles.medium: brush and ink, black and white
styles.features: Brush-drawn period gekiga: sweeping calligraphic ink strokes, rain, mist and wind over Edo-period roads and forests, lone ronin figures, sudden violent sword motion, dry-brush textures, wide quiet empty panels

styles.name: Sanpei Shirato
styles.medium: pen and brush ink, black and white
styles.features: Dense ink gekiga of feudal Japan: ninja and peasant crowds, brushed battle scenes, detailed rice villages, forests and mountains, naturalistically drawn animals, heavy black shadows, sweeping crowd panoramas

styles.name: Shigeru Mizuki
styles.medium: pen and ink with stippling and screentone

styles.name: Utagawa Hiroshige
styles.features: Vertical or horizontal landscape views with bokashi colour gradients, fine slanting lines of rain, soft snow, travellers on roads and bridges, deep blues and greens, flat colour planes and low horizons

styles.name: Kitagawa Utamaro
styles.medium: colour woodblock print on paper, mica ground
styles.features: Half-length portraits of women with elongated pale faces, slit eyes and tiny mouths, hair carved in hairline-fine strands, elaborate combs, patterned kimono, muted pinks and greys on a shimmering mica background

styles.name: Kawase Hasui
styles.medium: colour woodblock print on paper, shin-hanga
styles.features: Quiet villages, temple gates and canals at dusk, in rain or snow, with soft bokashi gradients, lantern glow against deep blue, visible wood-grain texture, delicate keylines and a calm, almost photographic perspective

styles.name: Shikō Munakata
styles.medium: black-ink woodcut, sometimes hand-coloured from the reverse
styles.features: Bold, energetic carving with heavy black masses and gouged white lines, rounded voluminous figures crammed edge to edge, flat round faces, sometimes patches of colour brushed from behind the thin paper

styles.name: Gyotaku fish rubbing
styles.medium: sumi ink impression from a real fish on washi
styles.features: Life-size print of a fish taken directly from its body, every scale, fin ray and gill line recorded in soft graded black ink, an eye sometimes painted in by hand, a plain paper ground
styles.note: Best for a single fish or small marine creature

styles.name: Chiaroscuro woodcut, Italian and German Renaissance
styles.features: Several blocks printed in graded shades of one hue such as ochre, sage green or grey-blue, with white highlights left as bare paper, bold contour block on top, and muscular Mannerist figures in dramatic poses

styles.name: German Expressionist woodcut, Die Brücke
styles.medium: woodcut on paper, black and colour
styles.features: Raw, splintered wood grain, angular jagged gouges, distorted mask-like faces, nudes and city street scenes, harsh blacks with patches of red or acid green, deliberately crude and unpolished carving

styles.name: Edvard Munch, woodcuts
styles.features: Blocks sawn into pieces and inked separately, coarse wood grain printed as texture, wavy flowing contours, solitary or paired figures on a shoreline, muted greens, blacks and blood reds, melancholy mood

styles.name: Paul Gauguin, woodcuts
styles.features: Rough gouged and scratched blocks, smudgy uneven hand printing, dark velvety fields, ochre and black tones, solid stylised figures among tropical plants and idols, a mysterious nocturnal atmosphere
styles.note: Avoid exoticising depictions of Polynesian women

styles.name: Thomas Bewick
styles.features: Small precise white-line engravings of birds and animals closely observed, and tiny rural vignettes whose edges fade into the white paper, rich silvery tonal textures in feathers, fur and foliage
styles.note: Small vignette format

styles.name: Gustave Doré
styles.features: Dramatic chiaroscuro built from dense fine parallel lines, vast vertiginous spaces, towering rocks and gothic architecture, swarms of tiny figures, theatrical shafts of light and stormy skies

styles.name: Eric Ravilious
styles.features: Playful decorative patterns of stipple, dashes and fine lines, crisp white textures on black, garden tools, fireworks, cricketers and downland villages, tidy rhythmic compositions with a gentle sense of humour

styles.name: Gwen Raverat
styles.features: English riverbanks, willows, punts and quiet field workers, tone built from fine cross-cut lines and stippled textures, soft silvery light, small intimate scale and gentle observation

styles.name: Chinese New Year print, Yangliuqing school
styles.medium: woodblock outline, hand-painted colour on paper
styles.features: Printed outlines filled with hand-painted bright pink, green, yellow and gold, chubby babies with carp and lotus, door guardians, auspicious symbols, symmetrical festive compositions and fine facial painting

styles.name: Chinese Modern Woodcut Movement
styles.features: Rough expressive gouges, heavy shadows, workers, peasants and refugees, strong social-realist contrasts, simplified faces with deep-cut features, influenced by German Expressionist prints

styles.name: Brazilian cordel woodcut
styles.features: Small naive black woodcuts with simple gouging, frontal figures of cowboys, bandits, saints and devils, cacti and sun, flat white ground, slightly uneven printing on thin cheap paper

styles.name: José Guadalupe Posada
styles.features: Lively black line work with cross-hatching, dressed skeletons acting as townsfolk, dandies and dancers, dramatic broadsheet scenes, dense crowds and vigorous caricature

styles.name: Taller de Gráfica Popular
styles.features: Bold black-and-white linocuts with strong gouged lines, peasants, workers and revolutionary scenes, dramatic contrasts, expressive massed crowds, sometimes one accent colour such as red

styles.name: Grosvenor School linocut
styles.features: Swirling dynamic rhythms, elongated figures in motion, rowers, cyclists, harvesters and escalators, three or four flat colours overlapping, speed lines and Vorticist-Futurist curves

styles.name: Blanche Lazzell, Provincetown white-line woodcut
styles.features: Single block with carved grooves leaving thin white outlines, each area brushed by hand with watercolour, visible wood grain, harbour views, flowers and still lifes, gentle Cubist simplification

styles.name: Kenojuak Ashevak
styles.medium: stonecut and stencil print on paper
styles.features: Stylised owls and birds with radiating fanned plumage, bold flat colours on white paper, symmetrical shapes, crisp edges, and black outlines combined with stencilled colour
styles.note: Secular studio prints; do not mix with sacred imagery

styles.name: Rembrandt van Rijn, etchings
styles.features: Free sketchy etched lines, deep velvety drypoint burr and selective plate tone, dramatic chiaroscuro, crowds of beggars, preachers and onlookers, flat Dutch landscapes and expressive faces

styles.name: Wenceslaus Hollar
styles.features: Fine precise etched lines, wide bird's-eye panoramas of cities with spires and rivers, meticulous costume studies, furs and shells, a delicate even silver-grey tone

styles.name: Francisco Goya, aquatints
styles.features: Grainy aquatint tones from pale grey to black, sparse etched contours, nightmarish figures, witches, bats and owls, stark pools of light, satirical and brutal scenes against empty dark backgrounds

styles.name: James McNeill Whistler, etchings
styles.features: Sparse nervous lines concentrated in the centre, wide areas of blank paper, selectively wiped plate tone, river wharves, bridges, Venetian doorways and canals, airy shimmering atmosphere

styles.name: Anders Zorn, etchings
styles.features: Bold parallel diagonal strokes building tone, sunlight on skin and water, women bathing at lakesides, peasant life in Dalarna, lively portraits and quick confident modelling

styles.name: Giorgio Morandi, etchings
styles.features: Bottles, jars and boxes grouped closely on a table, tone built entirely with dense cross-hatching, quiet greys, soft light and sparse hill landscapes with simple houses

styles.name: Martin Lewis
styles.features: Night streets, rain and snow, lamplight casting long shadows, velvety drypoint burr in deep blacks, pedestrians in coats and hats, wet reflective pavements and tenement facades

styles.name: Mary Cassatt, colour prints
styles.features: Japanese-inspired flat colour areas, delicate drypoint contours, mothers and children, women at domestic tasks, soft pinks, ochres and blues, patterned fabrics and tilted interior space

styles.name: John Martin, mezzotints
styles.features: Velvety blacks with glowing highlights, colossal architecture and abysses, lightning and fire, tiny figures dwarfed by cataclysm, deep tonal gradations and theatrical perspective

styles.name: Yozo Hamaguchi
styles.features: Small objects like cherries, walnuts, lemons and butterflies floating on deep velvety black, finely grained rocker texture, subtle glowing colour, minimalist sparse composition

styles.name: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, posters
styles.features: Flat colour shapes, bold silhouettes, spatter texture, cabaret dancers and singers, dramatically cropped compositions, sinuous outlines and hand-drawn lettering integrated into the image

styles.name: Odilon Redon, lithographs
styles.features: Velvety charcoal-like blacks, luminous floating heads, eyes and spiders, strange dreamlike creatures, glowing points of light emerging from darkness and soft, smoky textures

styles.name: M. C. Escher
styles.features: Interlocking tessellations of birds, fish and lizards, impossible architecture and staircases, metamorphosis bands, mirrored spheres and meticulous precise hatching

styles.name: Ernst Haeckel, natural history plates
styles.features: Symmetrical ornamental arrangements of radiolarians, jellyfish, diatoms and orchids on plain grounds, fine scientific detail, muted greens, blues and ochres and Jugendstil decorative balance

styles.name: Andy Warhol, screenprints
styles.features: Flat saturated colour fields under a black photographic halftone layer, slight misregistration, repetition in grids, celebrity faces, consumer products and acid pinks, oranges and turquoises

styles.name: WPA silkscreen posters
styles.features: Flat layered colours, simplified geometric shapes, national parks and public campaigns, bold sans-serif lettering, smooth sky gradients and strong graphic composition

styles.name: Risograph print
styles.features: Bright spot colours like fluorescent pink, teal and yellow overlapping into new hues, grainy halftones, visible misregistration and slightly uneven ink coverage
styles.note: Named after a duplicator brand; describe it as a print technique

styles.name: Anna Atkins
styles.features: White silhouettes of algae, ferns and plants on deep Prussian blue ground, fine translucent fronds, delicate edges and scientific placement

styles.name: Edgar Degas, monotypes
styles.features: Smudged ink wiped from the plate, ghostly figures emerging from dark fields, café and theatre scenes, dancers and landscapes, visible rag and finger marks
styles.note: Avoid brothel subjects

styles.name: Pochoir, Art Deco fashion plates
styles.features: Flat vivid colours with crisp stencilled edges, slight brush texture, elongated elegant figures in fashionable dress, decorative patterns and stylised interiors

styles.name: Yamato-e, Heian court narrative painting (tsukuri-e)
styles.medium: opaque mineral pigments and ink on paper handscroll
styles.features: Flat layered mineral colours over ink underdrawing, roofless interiors seen from steep diagonal overhead (fukinuki yatai), stiff cascading court robes, tiny faces with slit eyes and hook noses, sliding screens dividing space
styles.note: Keep pigments matte and slightly faded; faces deliberately expressionless

styles.name: Japanese narrative handscroll (emakimono), late Heian–Kamakura period
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper handscroll
styles.features: Continuous scenes unrolling right to left, energetic flowing ink outlines, lightly tinted figures, crowds running in swirls, burning palaces with red flames, oxcarts and armoured horsemen, gold-brown paper ground, mist bands separating episodes
styles.note: Horizontal panoramic format works best

styles.name: Chōjū-giga animal caricature handscroll
styles.features: Pure black ink line drawing without colour, quick supple brush outlines, frogs, hares and monkeys acting like humans, wrestling and parading, sparse grass tufts and streams on blank paper, humorous gestures
styles.note: Monochrome only; no shading or background fill

styles.name: Tosa school court painting
styles.medium: ink, mineral pigments and gold on silk or paper
styles.features: Precise fine outlines, bright opaque malachite green, azurite and vermilion, gold-leaf cloud bands, small refined courtiers, quails among autumn grasses, cherry blossoms, meticulous flat decorative surfaces

styles.name: Rakuchū-rakugai city panorama screens, Kyoto
styles.medium: ink, colour and gold leaf on paper folding screens
styles.features: Bird's-eye view of a city across six panels, streets and rooftops glimpsed between drifting gold-leaf clouds, hundreds of tiny colourful figures, festival floats, temples and shops, oblique parallel perspective
styles.note: Needs a wide format; figures should stay tiny

styles.name: Nanban byōbu, Momoyama–early Edo folding screens
styles.medium: ink, colour and gold leaf on paper folding screens
styles.features: Black-hulled Portuguese carracks arriving at port, foreigners in puffed trousers and hats, exotic animals, processions, gold-leaf clouds framing scenes, bright mineral colours, flat oblique architecture

styles.name: Kanō Eitoku
styles.medium: ink, colour and gold leaf on paper sliding doors and screens
styles.features: Monumental gnarled cypresses and pines with massive twisting trunks, bold thick ink contours, flat glowing gold-leaf ground, swirling gold clouds, lions and hawks, strong green and white mineral pigments

styles.name: Kanō Tan'yū
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper sliding doors
styles.features: Restrained elegant ink with wide empty areas, slender pines and tigers or herons placed at edges, pale washes, light gold dust, calm horizontal compositions, controlled crisp brushstrokes

styles.name: Hasegawa Tōhaku
styles.features: Groves of pine trees dissolving into fog, soft wet ink strokes ranging from deep black to pale grey, vast untouched paper as mist, no horizon, quiet asymmetrical spacing across panels

styles.name: Sesshū Tōyō
styles.features: Angular jagged mountain outlines in sharp dark strokes, splashed-ink (haboku) wet blots, tall vertical landscapes, tiny huts and boatmen, stacked rocks and cliffs, grey washes, monochrome

styles.name: Hakuin Ekaku, Zen painting (zenga)
styles.features: Thick blunt brushstrokes, oversized heads of bearded monks with bulging eyes, rough simplified figures, heavy black ink against bare paper, humorous folk energy, deliberately clumsy lines
styles.note: Originals often carry calligraphic inscriptions; keep lettering optional

styles.name: Sengai Gibon
styles.features: Loose cartoonish ink sketches, round chubby monks, frogs and dogs, wobbly carefree lines, minimal pale washes, much empty paper, playful simple geometric shapes

styles.name: Tawaraya Sōtatsu
styles.medium: ink, colour and gold leaf on paper folding screens
styles.features: Plump dynamic figures floating on flat gold leaf, pooled puddled colour (tarashikomi) bleeding into wet ink, bold green and white shapes, broad swirling cloud forms, large empty gold space

styles.name: Ogata Kōrin
styles.medium: ink, colour and gold leaf on paper folding screens
styles.features: Repeated stylised flowers like irises in rhythmic patterns, flat ultramarine and green on gold ground, stylised wave and stream curls, plum trees with tarashikomi trunks, decorative design-like simplification

styles.name: Sakai Hōitsu, Edo Rimpa
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk or silver and gold leaf
styles.features: Delicate seasonal plants on silver or gold ground, autumn grasses bending in wind, morning glories and maples, refined thin lines, soft pooled colours, poetic sparse arrangement

styles.name: Kamisaka Sekka
styles.features: Rimpa motifs reduced to modern flat graphic shapes, puddled colour gradations printed from woodblocks, bold bright greens, blues and pinks, waves, flowers and figures cropped dramatically, generous empty paper

styles.name: Ike no Taiga, nanga literati painting
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Playful rounded mountains built from dots and short strokes, cheerful pale blues and greens, tiny scholars and huts, airy rhythmic textures, loose relaxed brushwork, occasional finger-painted marks

styles.name: Yosa Buson
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper or silk
styles.features: Gentle literati landscapes and haiga sketches, soft blurred snow scenes, quick abbreviated figures of travellers, muted ink washes with pale colour, intimate rustic villages under evening sky
styles.note: Haiga versions include haiku script; keep lettering optional

styles.name: Uragami Gyokudō
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Dense trembling mountains of dry scratchy brushstrokes, heavy layered ink dots, wild expressive texture, rain-soaked forests, small isolated hermitages, monochrome with touches of pale wash

styles.name: Tomioka Tessai
styles.features: Vigorous splashy literati brushwork, thick wet black ink with bright unexpected colour blots, crowded mountains, legendary sages and immortals, rough exuberant strokes

styles.name: Itō Jakuchū
styles.features: Meticulously detailed roosters and hens with fan-like feathers, vivid crimson, white and black, densely patterned plants, fish and insects, crisp outlines, flat decorative backgrounds, obsessive precise rendering

styles.name: Soga Shōhaku
styles.features: Eccentric wild ink, grotesque immortals and sages with distorted faces, twisting dragons, slashing aggressive strokes, stark black contrasts, dramatic swirling compositions

styles.name: Nagasawa Rosetsu
styles.features: Bold playful ink, fluffy round puppies, giant tigers drawn with soft furry strokes, oversized forms filling panels, quick expressive brushwork, humorous animal expressions

styles.name: Maruyama Ōkyo, Maruyama-Shijō school
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk or paper
styles.features: Naturalistic observation, soft-shaded puppies and carp, smooth tonal ink gradations, gently modelled pines in snow, realistic yet airy compositions, restrained colour, careful fur and feather textures

styles.name: Kawanabe Kyōsai
styles.features: Frenzied energetic line, dancing skeletons, demons and ghosts, caricature crowds, crows in bold black ink, chaotic busy compositions, theatrical gestures, vivid colour accents

styles.name: Ōtsu-e folk painting
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, stencilled
styles.features: Naive quick folk pictures, horned demons, wisteria maidens, monkeys and catfish, thick black outlines, flat red, yellow and green fills, simple plain backgrounds, cheerful humorous figures

styles.name: Hishikawa Moronobu, early ukiyo-e sumizuri-e
styles.features: Black outline woodblock line without colour or with simple hand tinting, flowing robes, full-bodied figures, everyday Edo scenes, bold calligraphic contours, plain paper ground

styles.name: Uki-e perspective prints
styles.features: Western one-point perspective adopted in woodblock prints, deep receding interiors and theatres, converging floorboards, tiny audiences, flat pale colours, slightly awkward exaggerated depth

styles.name: Suzuki Harunobu
styles.features: Delicate doll-like slender figures, tiny hands and feet, soft pastel colours, blind embossing, dreamy interiors and gardens, gentle romance, uniform flat backgrounds

styles.name: Torii Kiyonaga
styles.features: Tall statuesque women in groups, outdoor promenades along rivers and verandas, clear horizontal settings, cool harmonious colours, balanced calm composition, realistic proportions

styles.name: Tōshūsai Sharaku
styles.medium: colour woodblock print with dark mica ground
styles.features: Exaggerated kabuki actor portraits, grimacing faces with crossed eyes and hooked noses, claw-like hands, dark sparkling mica background, bold black contours, strong colour blocks

styles.name: Katsushika Ōi
styles.features: Dramatic night lighting, glowing lanterns casting deep shadows, strong chiaroscuro unusual for Japanese painting, women in richly patterned robes, warm amber light against darkness

styles.name: Utagawa Kuniyoshi
styles.features: Heroic warriors in combat, giant skeletons and sea monsters spanning three panels, dense tattoo patterns, muscular contorted bodies, vivid colours, dynamic diagonal compositions

styles.name: Utagawa Kunisada
styles.features: Theatrical kabuki actors, bold expressive poses, lavishly patterned costumes, strong black outlines, saturated reds and blues, crowded stage compositions

styles.name: Surimono privately printed woodblock
styles.medium: colour woodblock print with metallic pigments and embossing
styles.features: Small square luxury prints, gold, silver and bronze pigment, blind embossing, still lifes of ceremonial objects, refined detail, poetry inscriptions in flowing calligraphy

styles.name: Tsukioka Yoshitoshi
styles.features: Intense taut lines, dramatic figures from history and ghost stories, muted subtle colours, emotional faces, cinematic cropping, expressive poses under moonlight

styles.name: Kobayashi Kiyochika, kōsen-ga light-ray prints
styles.features: Meiji Tokyo at night and dusk, gas lamps and fireworks, glowing windows, silhouettes against twilight sky, Western-style shading, deep blues and blacks

styles.name: Kawase Hasui, shin-hanga
styles.features: Quiet atmospheric landscapes, snow, rain and evening light, deep indigo skies, glowing yellow windows, soft gradations, temples and canals, lone figures

styles.name: Yoshida Hiroshi, shin-hanga
styles.features: Mountain and sea landscapes, same scene printed in shifting times of day, subtle overlapping colour layers, Western realism, sailboats, alpine peaks, calm clear light

styles.name: Itō Shinsui, shin-hanga bijin-ga
styles.features: Graceful women in close-up, soft modelling of faces, pale skin against coloured backgrounds, intimate daily actions, fine hair lines, delicate textures

styles.name: Hashiguchi Goyō
styles.features: Elegant Taishō women, refined elongated figures, clean contour lines, luxurious mica backgrounds, delicate patterned kimono, calm seated poses

styles.name: Ohara Koson, kachō-e
styles.features: Birds and flowers in vertical format, softly graded backgrounds, moonlit herons, crows in snow, gentle realistic shading, quiet poetic moods

styles.name: Munakata Shikō, sōsaku-hanga
styles.features: Bold black woodcut lines, voluptuous Buddhist figures and women, dense rhythmic patterns, gouged textures, monochrome with occasional hand colouring

styles.name: Hiratsuka Un'ichi, sōsaku-hanga
styles.features: Strong black-and-white contrasts, temples and bridges, carved lines resembling stone carving, minimal shading, architectural silhouettes, bold clarity

styles.name: Kawakami Sumio, sōsaku-hanga
styles.features: Nanban and Meiji nostalgia themes, foreign ships and Western dress, simplified naive figures, hand-coloured woodcut tones, playful decorative forms

styles.name: Yokoyama Taikan, nihonga mōrōtai
styles.features: Hazy atmospheric landscapes without outlines, soft colour washes, misty mountains, glowing sky gradients, dreamy diffuse forms, Mount Fuji in clouds

styles.name: Hishida Shunsō, nihonga mōrōtai
styles.features: Soft atmospheric technique, animals in delicate settings, muted tones, misty backgrounds, refined realism, subtle shading

styles.name: Uemura Shōen, nihonga bijin-ga
styles.features: Graceful women in traditional dress, smooth fine contour lines, pale faces, subtle pastel colours, elegant poses, plain backgrounds

styles.name: Takeuchi Seihō, Kyoto nihonga
styles.features: Lively animal paintings, soft fur textures, quick confident brushwork, blending of Western realism and Japanese line, airy compositions

styles.name: Hayami Gyoshū, nihonga
styles.features: Meticulous detailed flowers and insects, smooth jewel-like colours, dark backgrounds, sharp clarity, symbolic mood, careful realism

styles.name: Takehisa Yumeji, Taishō romanticism
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, design prints
styles.features: Slender melancholic women with large eyes, graceful curved lines, soft colours, decorative patterns, romantic mood, simplified figures

styles.name: Kuroda Seiki, Meiji yōga
styles.features: Plein-air light, soft pastel colours, gentle brushstrokes, women outdoors, French Impressionist influence, natural poses, bright clear atmosphere

styles.name: Serizawa Keisuke, katazome stencil dyeing
styles.features: Bold stencil patterns, flat bright colours, simplified figures and motifs, folk-inspired designs, rhythmic repetition, crisp outlines
styles.note: Designs sometimes include lettering; keep optional

styles.name: Maki-e lacquer decoration
styles.medium: lacquer with gold and silver powder
styles.features: Glossy black lacquer surface, sprinkled gold and silver powder designs, raised relief, delicate flowers, waves and birds, rich reflective decorative patterns

styles.name: Gu Kaizhi
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, handscroll
styles.features: Even, unbroken gossamer-thin ink outlines; slender elongated figures in long flowing robes with streaming sashes and ribbons; pale mineral tints; little background; small schematic hills and trees beside large figures
styles.note: Works survive only as later copies

styles.name: Tang dynasty court ladies painting (Zhang Xuan and Zhou Fang manner)
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk, handscroll
styles.features: Plump full-figured women with high piled chignons and flower hairpins; layered silk robes in vermilion, green and ochre; fine even outlines; blank backgrounds; loose groups of figures at leisure or household tasks
styles.note: Attributions mostly rest on Song copies

styles.name: Dunhuang Mogao cave murals
styles.medium: mineral pigments on dry plaster, cave walls
styles.features: Flying celestial figures with long fluttering scarves; lapis blue, malachite green, ochre, and cinnabar darkened to brown-black; flowing outlines; registers of pavilions and processions; rows of repeated small seated figures; worn, flaking plaster surface
styles.note: Historical Buddhist murals; render as secular decorative mural look

styles.name: Chinese blue-green landscape (qinglü shanshui)
styles.medium: mineral pigments and ink on silk
styles.features: Mountains outlined in fine ink and filled with opaque azurite blue and malachite green over ochre-brown lower slopes; occasional gold lines; stacked peaks, waterfalls, tiny pavilions, bridges and boats; flat decorative layering along long horizontal scrolls

styles.name: Fan Kuan
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, hanging scroll
styles.features: Towering central mountain filling the upper picture; dense raindrop-like dotted texture strokes; dark ink on browned silk; thin thread of waterfall; layered boulders and trees in the foreground; tiny mule caravan at the base

styles.name: Guo Xi
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, hanging scroll
styles.features: Swirling mountain masses like rising clouds built with curling cloud-head texture strokes; bare crab-claw tree branches; soft graded ink mist; several viewpoints combined, high, deep and level distance in one picture

styles.name: Zhang Zeduan
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, long handscroll
styles.features: Long continuous panorama in oblique bird's-eye view; hundreds of tiny people, shops, carts, camels and boats; crowded arched wooden bridge over a river; fine ink lines with pale brown and ochre tints

styles.name: Emperor Huizong of Song and the Song academy
styles.medium: ink and mineral colour on silk, gongbi
styles.features: Meticulous gongbi bird-and-flower painting: fine even outlines filled with flat layered colour; a single bird on a blossoming branch against empty silk; lacquer-dot eyes; feathers drawn one by one; sparse composition
styles.note: Many works are by his academy painters

styles.name: Ma Yuan
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, fan and album leaf
styles.features: One-corner composition: cliffs and angular pines crowded into a lower corner, vast misty emptiness beyond; sharp axe-cut texture strokes; small scholar figure gazing out over water; pale ink wash on silk

styles.name: Muqi Fachang
styles.features: Spare monochrome ink; a few persimmons or fruits in graded tones from black to pale grey; soft wet washes; gibbons, cranes and misty lakes; abbreviated brushstrokes; large areas of untouched paper

styles.name: Huang Gongwang
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper, handscroll
styles.features: Dry hemp-fibre texture strokes; long river with rounded rolling hills repeated across a horizontal scroll; pale layered ink with light ochre; sparse trees, small huts; calm rhythmic composition

styles.name: Ni Zan
styles.features: Near bank with a few thin trees and an empty thatched pavilion, wide blank river, low distant hills; very dry pale ink applied with a slanted brush; no figures; austere sparse composition

styles.name: Wang Meng
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper, hanging scroll
styles.features: Tall mountains packed edge to edge; writhing ox-hair and unravelled-rope texture strokes; heavy dark dotting; tiny scholar huts tucked into folds of rock; almost no empty space; restless dense surface

styles.name: Guan Daosheng
styles.features: Ink bamboo groves: slender jointed culms, crisp leaves made with single tapered strokes in graded black and grey ink; stream banks and rocks; plain unpainted ground; quiet horizontal rhythm
styles.note: Few attributions are secure

styles.name: Qiu Ying
styles.medium: ink and mineral colour on silk
styles.features: Fine-line blue-green landscapes with crisp azurite and malachite; garden pavilions with red lacquered pillars; elegant scholars and court ladies; peach and willow trees; careful precise drafting of architecture and furniture

styles.name: Xu Wei
styles.features: Wild xieyi ink: wet splashed and blotted strokes; grape vines, peonies, banana leaves, bamboo; dripping, ragged edges; abrupt shifts from black to pale grey; loose cursive inscriptions running beside the plants

styles.name: Chen Hongshou
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk; woodblock designs
styles.features: Elongated archaic figures with large heads and stiff deliberate poses; angular wiry drapery lines with sharp folds; antique bronzes, vases and rocks; muted mineral colours; quirky, deliberately old-fashioned look

styles.name: Dong Qichang
styles.features: Landscapes assembled from stacked geometric mountain blocks; flattened space; abrupt shifts in scale; repeated tree clusters; alternating dry and wet ink; deliberately awkward structure; little or no colour

styles.name: Wen Shu
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper, album leaves and fans
styles.features: Close-up studies of wild flowers, grasses, rocks, butterflies and insects; delicate fine lines; pale translucent colour; quiet natural detail; small album and fan formats with much empty paper
styles.note: Woman painter

styles.name: Huizhou woodblock book illustration, late Ming
styles.medium: woodblock print on paper, black ink
styles.features: Hairline-fine carved black lines; detailed interiors with lattice screens, tiled roofs, furniture and garden rocks; costumed figures from plays and novels; patterned textiles; dense full-page scenes with tilted ground plane

styles.name: Douban polychrome woodblock printing, Ten Bamboo Studio, Nanjing
styles.medium: multi-block colour woodcut on paper, with blind embossing
styles.features: Many small carved blocks printed in sequence; soft watercolour-like gradients; no outlines; fruit, flowering branches, rocks and scholar's objects on plain paper; uncoloured embossed relief for clouds and water

styles.name: Jingdezhen blue-and-white porcelain painting
styles.features: Cobalt blue on glossy white glaze; darker pooled spots where cobalt gathers; dragons, lotus scrolls, waves, peony bands, figures in gardens; concentric decorative borders wrapping curved vessel surfaces

styles.name: Bada Shanren (Zhu Da)
styles.features: Lone fish, birds or ducks with large oval eyes and dot pupils glaring upward; hunched bodies on precariously balanced rocks; rounded soft-edged wet strokes; vast blank paper; spare odd compositions

styles.name: Shitao
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Free varied brushwork; wet clustered dots; bright light washes of blue, green and pink; unconventional compositions with swirling or tilted mountains; tiny figures in boats; crumbly ink outlines

styles.name: Gong Xian
styles.features: Landscapes built from many layers of accumulated ink dots; very dark velvety masses of hills and trees set against bright white mist and water; empty villages; strong light-and-dark contrast

styles.name: Yun Shouping
styles.medium: colour and ink on paper, boneless technique
styles.features: Boneless flowers without ink outlines: peonies, lotus and chrysanthemums in soft wet blended colour; translucent pinks and fresh greens; naturalistic petals and leaves; light album-leaf compositions

styles.name: Yangzhou Eccentrics
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Quick ink bamboo, orchids and plum blossoms; oddly shaped rocks; unconventional cropping; quirky calligraphic inscriptions filling empty space; light washes of colour; deliberately unpolished brushwork
styles.note: Includes Zheng Xie, Jin Nong, Huang Shen, Luo Pin

styles.name: Giuseppe Castiglione (Lang Shining)
styles.features: European modelling and perspective merged with Chinese line; glossy horses and hounds with shaded musculature and detailed fur; imperial hunts and portraits; soft shadowless faces; flat or lightly sketched landscape backgrounds
styles.note: Italian Jesuit working at the Qing court

styles.name: Jiehua ruled-line architectural painting
styles.features: Buildings drawn with ruler-guided straight lines; bracketed tiled roofs, multistorey palaces, balustrades and terraces in oblique parallel projection without vanishing point; tiny figures; blue-green and ochre colour

styles.name: Qing court processional and inspection-tour scrolls
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk, very long handscrolls
styles.features: Enormous panoramas of imperial tours and ceremonies; thousands of tiny figures in ranked processions, banners, horses, city walls, canals with boats; meticulous colour with gold accents; consistent oblique bird's-eye view

styles.name: Canton export painting on pith paper
styles.features: Opaque vivid gouache on velvety pith paper; single figures in trades and costumes, boats, birds and flowers; plain backgrounds; small album-card format; light Western-style shading

styles.name: Ren Bonian (Ren Yi)
styles.features: Quick confident outlines; bright saturated colour mixed with ink; figures from legends in billowing robes; birds on branches in lively poses; dynamic diagonal compositions

styles.name: Wu Changshuo
styles.features: Plum, wisteria, peonies and gourds in thick heavy strokes like carved seal script; saturated red, yellow and green against black ink; dense diagonal compositions; long calligraphic inscriptions

styles.name: Xugu
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Dry angular broken brushstrokes; squirrels, goldfish with squarish bodies, loquats and plum branches; pale cool colours; sharp jerky lines; sparse quirky compositions

styles.name: Qi Baishi
styles.features: Shrimps with translucent grey bodies and long fine antennae, crabs, chicks, vegetables and lotus; few bold ink strokes on bare paper; bright red accents for flowers and fruit; playful simplicity

styles.name: Huang Binhong
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Heavy dark ink built from repeated layers of dots and scribbled lines; night-like mountains with small glinting gaps of light; tiny houses and paths; subtle touches of colour

styles.name: Xu Beihong
styles.features: Galloping horses in wet ink with accurate anatomy; manes and tails in dry flying strokes; tonal modelling of muscles; minimal background; white paper

styles.name: Zhang Daqian, splashed-colour period
styles.medium: ink and mineral colour on paper
styles.features: Pools of mineral blue and green poured and spread, merging into black ink; small precise houses, trees and figures added with fine brush; misty, semi-abstract mountains
styles.note: Describes his late splashed-colour manner, not his earlier fine-line work

styles.name: Pan Tianshou
styles.features: Massive angular rocks with bold squared outlines; close-up mountain flowers and grasses; eagles perched on boulders; heavy ink; strong structural compositions with large blocks of space

styles.name: Fu Baoshi
styles.features: Rainstorms, waterfalls and mountains in rough broken brushstrokes; wet atmospheric washes; slanted rain streaks; small figures in classical dress from poems; misty blue-grey tones

styles.name: Li Keran
styles.features: Dense black layered ink mountains with backlight; glowing white mist and waterfalls; villages in valleys; also herd boys on water buffalo drawn with simple strokes

styles.name: Lin Fengmian
styles.medium: ink and gouache on paper, square format
styles.features: Square compositions; bold black brush lines; autumn forests in bright reds and ochres; herons over reeds; women with oval faces; still lifes; flat modernist colour

styles.name: Feng Zikai
styles.medium: brush and ink with light colour on paper
styles.features: Simple brush line drawings of children and everyday life; faces with few or no features; light colour washes; small cartoon-like vignettes; plain background
styles.note: Often carry a short handwritten caption

styles.name: Lingnan school
styles.features: Chinese ink combined with Japanese-style washes; realistic birds, insects and flowers; rainy, misty landscapes; gentle colour gradation; lively naturalism
styles.note: Gao Jianfu, Gao Qifeng, Chen Shuren

styles.name: Jiang Zhaohe
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Realistic ink portraits and long scrolls of refugees and the poor; tonal modelling of faces and hands; groups of figures in tattered clothing; minimal background

styles.name: Pan Yuliang
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper; oil on canvas
styles.features: Female nudes and portraits outlined in sinuous ink lines with flat colour fills; almond-shaped eyes; decorative patterned backgrounds; strong outlines
styles.note: Woman painter

styles.name: Wu Guanzhong
styles.features: Jiangnan villages: whitewashed walls and black tiled roofs reduced to geometric planes; flowing ink lines and scattered colour dots; wide white space

styles.name: Shanghai yuefenpai calendar poster
styles.medium: carbon-powder rubbing and watercolour, printed by lithography
styles.features: Soft airbrush-like shading from rubbed carbon powder under watercolour; glamorous women in qipao with permed hair and rosy cheeks; pastel colour; ornamental borders with calendar panels and product names
styles.note: Calendar dates and brand names were part of the format

styles.name: Zhang Guangyu
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, printed illustration
styles.features: Art Deco–influenced illustration; flat stylised figures with angular geometric outlines; bold decorative patterns and stylised clouds; caricatured faces

styles.name: Yangliuqing nianhua New Year print
styles.medium: woodblock outline print with hand-painted colour on paper
styles.features: Printed outlines finished by hand; chubby babies holding carp and lotus; beauties and opera scenes; soft pink faces; delicate colour gradations

styles.name: Taohuawu nianhua New Year print
styles.features: Bright saturated colour blocks in pink, green and yellow; flat symmetrical compositions; gods, auspicious symbols and opera scenes; dense decorative fill

styles.name: Mianzhu nianhua New Year print
styles.medium: woodblock print with hand-painted colour on paper
styles.features: Paired warrior door guardians in armour; vivid red, yellow and green; loose hand-applied brushstrokes; gold highlights; bold frontal figures

styles.name: Northern Shaanxi folk papercut
styles.features: Red paper cut into bold blocky silhouettes; folded symmetrical designs; sawtooth and crescent cuts as interior patterns; lions, fish, roosters and figures

styles.name: Yuxian dyed papercut
styles.features: Thin paper carved with a chisel, then dyed in bright magenta, green, yellow and orange; opera masks and figures; translucent window decorations

styles.name: Chinese shadow puppets
styles.features: Translucent leather figures with intricate cut-out lattice; jointed limbs; profile faces; dyed red, green and black; lit from behind on a white screen

styles.name: Jinshan farmer painting
styles.features: Bright flat gouache; bird's-eye patterned views of village life, fishing and festivals; textile-inspired decorative patterns; no perspective

styles.name: Korean minhwa folk painting, late Joseon
styles.medium: mineral and organic pigments on mulberry paper, folding screen panels
styles.features: Flat bright colours with dark ink outlines, naive flattened perspective, oversized peonies, lotus, carp, cranes and birds in pairs, symmetrical decorative arrangement, cheerful red, pink, green and blue on cream paper

styles.name: Chaekgeori, Korean scholar's books and objects screen
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper or silk, multi-panel folding screen
styles.features: Shelves or stacks of books in bright wrapped covers, vases, brushes, inkstones, fruit and bronzes; trompe-l'oeil shading mixed with reverse perspective, crisp ruled lines, rich blue, green, red and ochre

styles.name: Munjado, Korean ideograph painting
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, eight-panel screen
styles.features: One large Chinese character per panel whose strokes are filled with or replaced by carp, shrimp, birds, bamboo, flowers and pavilions; flat folk colour, bold outlines, playful hybrid of lettering and picture

styles.name: Kkachi horangi, Korean magpie and tiger folk painting
styles.features: Comic tiger with huge round goggling eyes, grinning mouth and patterned striped or spotted fur, seated under a gnarled pine where a small magpie perches; flat colours, bold ink contours, naive scale

styles.name: Irworobongdo, Joseon court Sun, Moon and Five Peaks screen
styles.medium: mineral pigments on silk, folding screen
styles.features: Strictly symmetrical composition: five stylised blue-green peaks, red sun and white moon discs, paired red-trunked pines, cascading waterfalls and scalloped waves; heavy opaque malachite, azurite, vermilion, flat, ceremonial

styles.name: Sipjangsaengdo, Korean Ten Longevity Symbols screen
styles.medium: mineral pigments on silk, folding screen
styles.features: Panoramic blue-green landscape with red sun, swirling clouds, rocky peaks, waterfalls, pines, white cranes, spotted deer, turtles and fungus of immortality; opaque malachite and azurite, gold accents, crisp outlines

styles.name: Jeong Seon (Gyeomjae)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: True-view Korean landscapes: crowded white granite peaks drawn with rapid vertical sweeping strokes, contrasting soft earthen hills of wet dark dots, misty valleys, small pavilions and figures, ink with pale blue and ochre washes

styles.name: Kim Hong-do (Danwon)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper, album leaves
styles.features: Everyday Joseon village life: wrestlers, smiths, schoolboys, dancers grouped in a circle; quick confident ink lines, faces with humorous expressions, almost no background, pale washes of ochre, blue and green

styles.name: Sin Yun-bok (Hyewon)
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, album leaves
styles.features: Slender women in voluminous hanbok skirts, wide-brimmed gentlemen, outings, music and courtyard scenes; fine thin elegant lines, bright accents of red, indigo and jade, tiled walls, willows and gates as backdrop
styles.note: Some originals are erotic; keep to outings, music and courtyard scenes.

styles.name: Jang Seung-eop (Owon)
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper or silk
styles.features: Vigorous fluent brushwork, birds and flowers, eagles, horses and still lifes of antique vessels; strong ink tonal contrast, swift calligraphic strokes, soft washes of colour, lively dynamic compositions

styles.name: Kim Jeong-hui (Chusa)
styles.features: Austere literati ink painting: sparse dry-brush strokes, a bare simple house between stark pine and cypress trees, wide empty paper, wiry orchid leaves, archaic angular brush rhythm, monochrome black ink

styles.name: Shin Saimdang
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, album leaves
styles.features: Plants and insects close up: eggplants, watermelons, poppies, grasses with butterflies, mantises, beetles and frogs; delicate fine outlines, soft natural colour, single plant centred on plain ground

styles.name: Joseon royal protocol painting, uigwe banchado procession
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, long horizontal scroll or book
styles.features: Bird's-eye processions in long horizontal bands: rows of tiny officials, soldiers, horses, flags and palanquins, identical repeated figures, flat bright colours, no background, ordered parade-like rhythm

styles.name: Dongguoldo, Joseon palace panorama painting
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk, album panels
styles.features: Vast bird's-eye view of palace compounds in parallel oblique projection, hundreds of grey tiled roofs, red pillars, courtyards, walls and gates, blue-green rounded hills with trees, minute precise ruled linework

styles.name: Joseon court portrait painting (chosang)
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk, hanging scroll
styles.features: Seated official in full-length three-quarter or frontal view, black gauze hat, dark robe with embroidered rank badge, patterned mat or animal skin on chair; minutely hatched face with pockmarks and wrinkles, flat body

styles.name: An Gyeon
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk, handscroll
styles.features: Fantastic landscapes read left to right: towering cloud-like curling rocks, contorted crags, deep gorges, a hidden valley of pink peach blossoms; fine ink texture strokes, pale colour, monumental scale

styles.name: Byeon Sang-byeok
styles.features: Cats and hens with chicks: cat clinging to a tree trunk glancing at sparrows, fur built of countless fine hair strokes, alert eyes, gnarled branches, soft muted colour, empty silk background

styles.name: Goguryeo tomb mural painting
styles.medium: mineral pigments on lime plaster walls
styles.features: Mounted archers galloping after deer and tigers among wavy striped mountain bands, dancers in polka-dot robes, flowing outlines, flat red, ochre, black and green on pale plaster, figures sized by rank

styles.name: Goryeo inlaid celadon (sanggam)
styles.medium: stoneware with black and white slip inlay under celadon glaze
styles.features: Translucent jade-green glaze with fine crackle, inlaid white and black cranes flying among clouds in round medallions, willows, chrysanthemums and reeds, crisp thin inlaid lines, elegant curved vessels

styles.name: Korean najeon chilgi, mother-of-pearl lacquerware
styles.medium: mother-of-pearl inlay on black lacquered wood
styles.features: Glossy black lacquer ground inlaid with iridescent shell cut into peonies, scrolling vines, cranes, turtles and arabesques; crackled shell mosaic, pink-green shimmer, thin metal wire stems, boxes and cabinets

styles.name: Korean hwagak, ox-horn painting
styles.medium: reverse-painted thin translucent ox-horn sheets on wood
styles.features: Grid of small square panels on boxes, each with a bright folk motif: tigers, cranes, phoenixes, flowers; saturated red, yellow, green and white showing through glossy amber horn, thin dark outlines

styles.name: Korean bojagi patchwork wrapping cloth
styles.features: Translucent cloth of irregular rectangles and triangles joined with fine visible seams, light passing through, soft jade, rose, indigo and undyed beige blocks, grid-like abstract composition

styles.name: Korean dancheong, painted architectural decoration
styles.medium: mineral paint on wooden brackets, beams and eaves
styles.features: Dense polychrome bands on wooden eaves and brackets: green-blue ground, vermilion, white and yellow lotus rosettes and geometric bands, five-colour scheme, rhythmic repeated patterns under curving tiled roofs

styles.name: Lee Jung-seop
styles.medium: oil on paper and board; incised drawings on silver foil
styles.features: Powerful bulls built of thick sweeping black strokes on scraped earthy grounds, children tangled with fish and crabs, simplified bodies, incised lines on crumpled silver foil, warm ochre, red-brown and white

styles.name: Park Soo-keun
