styles.medium: oil on canvas, thick layered impasto
styles.features: Granite-like gritty surface of many dry layers, muted beige, grey and brown, flattened frontal figures of women pounding grain, carrying bundles or sitting by bare trees, simple dark outlines, no depth

styles.name: Na Hye-sok
styles.features: Early Korean Western-style painting: broad loose post-impressionist strokes, landscapes of villages, gates and trees, warm earthy greens and browns, bright sunlight patches, simplified forms

styles.name: Chun Kyung-ja
styles.medium: mineral colour and gouache on paper
styles.features: Melancholy women with large dark eyes and flowers in their hair, coiling snakes, tropical blossoms and butterflies; flat saturated layered colour, turquoise, rose, ochre, dreamlike decorative space

styles.name: Mongol zurag
styles.features: Panoramic nomadic life: gers, horses, herders, wrestlers and camels across rolling steppe, fine precise outlines, flat unshaded colour, high viewpoint, many small figures, soft greens, ochres, blues and reds

styles.name: Balduugiin Sharav (Marzan Sharav)
styles.features: Encyclopaedic panorama of one day of nomadic life: hundreds of tiny vignettes of milking, felt-making, races, weddings and funerals scattered across green hills, fine line, flat bright colour, no single focus
styles.note: Some original vignettes are erotic; keep to work and festival scenes.

styles.name: Urjingiin Yadamsüren
styles.medium: mineral pigments and tempera on canvas
styles.features: Portraits of herders and musicians in traditional deel and fur hats, in Mongol zurag manner: crisp fine outlines, flat calm colour, detailed ornament on clothing and instruments, plain soft background

styles.name: Mongolian painted ger furniture
styles.medium: mineral and tempera paint on wooden chests, doors and lattice
styles.features: Bright orange-red grounds painted with endless-knot (ulzii) patterns, scrolling clouds, hammer-like interlocking key borders, stylised flowers, blue, green, gold and white, symmetrical dense ornament

styles.name: Central Asian rock art (Tamgaly, Mongolian Altai petroglyphs)
styles.medium: pecked and engraved images on dark patinated rock
styles.era: Bronze Age to Iron Age, 2nd–1st millennium BCE
styles.features: Light pecked silhouettes on dark rock faces: ibexes with long curved horns, deer, horses, chariots, archers and dancing figures, simplified stick bodies, scattered across boulders without ground line

styles.name: Scytho-Siberian animal style, Pazyryk
styles.medium: felt appliqué, carved wood, gold and leather
styles.features: Contorted stags, griffins, elk and big cats with twisted hindquarters and scrolled antlers, comma and volute shapes filling bodies, bold flat felt cut-outs in red, blue and ochre, intertwined combat scenes

styles.name: Tibetan knotted wool carpet
styles.medium: hand-knotted wool pile, Tibetan loop knot
styles.features: Thick wool pile with bold stylised tigers in stripes, dragons, phoenixes, lotus medallions and cloud bands, coin and swastika-key borders, indigo, madder red, apricot and ivory, gentle colour variation

styles.name: Tibetan painted wooden chest
styles.medium: mineral pigments over gesso on wood
styles.features: Front panels framed by borders, painted with snow lions, dragons, scrolling clouds, lotus and peony blooms; red, green, blue, ochre and gold on worn crackled gesso, raised outlines

styles.name: Tibetan medical paintings, Lhasa 17th-century school
styles.features: Charts of many small framed vignettes in rows: plants, herbs, animals, physicians, patients, anatomical figures with fine red and blue lines of channels, crisp outlines, flat bright colours on cream ground
styles.note: Some panels show deities; choose herbal, anatomical and daily-life panels.

styles.name: Kamāl ud-Dīn Behzād
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Crowded yet balanced miniatures, high viewpoint, figures busy building, serving and talking, tilework walls and arched doorways, jewel-bright lapis, vermilion and green, gold skies, varied individualised poses

styles.name: Bukhara school of miniature painting, Shaybanid period
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Compact miniatures with relatively large figures in turbans and robes, simplified lilac or salmon hills, flat gold or blue skies, saturated contrasting colours, decorative flowering shrubs, crisp outlines

styles.name: Sogdian wall painting, Afrasiab and Panjakent
styles.features: Processions of envoys, horsemen, elephants, camels and boats on deep ultramarine grounds, figures outlined in dark red, narrative friezes in registers, ochre, red and white, flat profile-and-frontal poses

styles.name: Timurid glazed tilework, Samarkand
styles.medium: glazed tile mosaic and carved terracotta
styles.features: Facades and domes covered in cobalt, turquoise and white glazed tiles, interlacing geometric stars, arabesque vines, ribbed turquoise domes, bannai brick patterns, deep shaded portals

styles.name: Uzbek suzani embroidery
styles.features: Large round rosettes and flower heads in crimson, madder and plum, vines and leaf sprays spreading across ivory ground, couched and chain stitches, bold symmetrical dense floral layout

styles.name: Central Asian ikat (abrbandi)
styles.features: Bold abstract motifs with feathered blurred edges, shield, comb and pomegranate shapes, vertical repeats, vivid magenta, yellow, indigo, green and white, glossy silk sheen

styles.name: Rishtan ceramics, Fergana Valley
styles.features: Wide plates and bowls brush-painted with almond, pomegranate, cotton boll and floral motifs in deep turquoise, cobalt and white, glassy blue-green glaze, radial and concentric symmetrical layouts

styles.name: Turkmen carpet weaving
styles.features: Deep madder-red field with rows of repeated octagonal gul medallions, quartered in indigo, ivory and orange, geometric hooked borders, fine dense knotting, sober rhythmic grid

styles.name: Kyrgyz shyrdak mosaic felt
styles.medium: inlaid wool felt with cord outlines
styles.features: Two contrasting felt colours cut together in interlocking ram's-horn spirals and curls, outlined with stitched cord, red against blue or black, bold symmetric borders, thick soft matte surface

styles.name: Usto Mumin (Alexander Nikolaev)
styles.medium: tempera and watercolour on paper and canvas
styles.features: Flat slender youths in striped robes and skullcaps, almond eyes, icon-like stillness, blend of Persian miniature and early Italian painting, gilded or pale skies, ornamental flowers and pomegranates
styles.note: Keep subjects to costume, music and daily scenes.

styles.name: Alexander Volkov
styles.features: Faceted crystalline planes, figures in robes and turbans at teahouses and caravans broken into angular shapes, glowing pomegranate reds, ochre and gold, rhythmic interlocking composition, decorative cubo-futurist surface

styles.name: Pavel Benkov
styles.features: Sunlit plein-air impressionism, women in colourful ikat robes and veils, courtyards and old madrasa walls, dappled light, violet shadows, broken loose strokes, warm ochre and turquoise

styles.name: Ural Tansykbaev
styles.features: Decorative landscapes of mountain valleys, reservoirs and cotton fields, saturated violet, orange, emerald and pink, broad flat colour areas, clear outlines of poplars, intense sunlight

styles.name: Abylkhan Kasteev
styles.medium: watercolour and oil on paper and canvas
styles.features: Naive-realist scenes of Kazakh steppe life: yurts, horsemen, herds, mountain lakes, railway construction; clear simple drawing, bright fresh watercolour, sincere detail, high open skies

styles.name: Salikhitdin Aitbayev
styles.features: Soviet 'severe style': monumental simplified figures of herders and families, large flat planes of deep red, blue and ochre, strong contours, frieze-like arrangement against steppe and sky

styles.name: Gulfairus Ismailova
styles.features: Decorative scenes of Kazakh women in national dress with tall feathered headdresses and embroidered coats, dancing and gathering, bright jewel colours, flowing rhythms, theatrical staged composition

styles.name: Semyon Chuikov
styles.features: Bright realist scenes of Kyrgyz valleys, foothills and lakes, young herders and girls in open landscape, clear light, broad soft strokes, warm ochre fields, blue mountains, calm horizons

styles.name: Pavel Kuznetsov, steppe paintings
styles.features: Dreamlike steppe mirages with yurts, sheep shearing and resting herders, rhythmic rounded figures, pale blue, pink, lilac and sand tones, flattened horizontal bands, soft matte tempera haze

styles.name: Vasily Vereshchagin, Turkestan series
styles.features: Crisp academic realism under harsh sun, ethnographic detail of robes, turbans and carved doors, tiled madrasa walls, dusty bazaars and fortress gates, sharp shadows, bleached sky
styles.note: Avoid war atrocity scenes; prefer bazaars, portals and portraits.

styles.name: Persian miniature, Ilkhanid Tabriz school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink, gold and silver on paper
styles.features: Chinese-influenced landscapes with gnarled trees, curling clouds and wave-like rocks, dramatic gesturing figures in Mongol dress, sombre browns and ochres with blackened silver, wide horizontal compositions, strong expressive outlines
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Persian miniature, Injuid Shiraz school
styles.features: Flat backgrounds of brick red or ochre, stocky figures with large heads, sketchy plants and simple hillocks, bold dark outlines, limited palette of red, yellow, brown and green, frieze-like strip compositions
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Jalayirid painting, Baghdad and Tabriz
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Small slender figures in tall lyrical landscapes, high horizon, delicate flowering trees, pale lavender, blue and gold skies, tiled pavilions with patterned facades, fine precise line, airy balanced compositions
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Persian miniature, Timurid Herat school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Jewel-like mineral colours, high horizon under gold sky, flowered meadows, coral-like outlined rocks, tiled pavilions with dense geometric patterns, small graceful figures, no cast shadows, depth built by stacked layers
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Persian miniature, Safavid Tabriz school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Crowded court and epic scenes, men in turbans wrapped around tall red batons, richly patterned carpets and tiled pavilions, gold skies, swirling multicoloured rocks, saturated blues, oranges and greens, dense ornament
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Sultan Muhammad
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Swirling pastel rocks hiding faces and creatures, dense many-coloured landscapes, vivid lapis and malachite, minutely painted foliage and animals, crowds of small figures with humorous expressive faces, gold skies, exuberant rhythm
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Persian miniature, Safavid Qazvin school
styles.medium: ink, light colour and gold on paper
styles.features: Elongated willowy youths with round faces and tilted heads, calligraphic swinging drapery, sparse landscapes on pale ground, tinted drawing with pastel and gold accents, languid lyrical poses
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Muhammadi of Herat
styles.medium: ink and light colour washes on paper
styles.features: Tinted line drawings on pale paper, faint washes of colour, rural scenes with shepherds, ploughmen and picnickers, fluent calligraphic outlines, slender figures, sparse delicate trees, open empty ground
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Reza Abbasi
styles.medium: ink, opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Single figures on plain or gold-sprinkled ground, swelling and tapering calligraphic ink line, loose fluttering sashes and turbans, languid courtiers, lovers and dervishes, muted browns, purples, olive and gold, sparse grass tufts
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mu'in Musavvir
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and ink on paper
styles.features: Bold saturated colours and sturdy compact figures in epic narrative scenes, also brisk lightly tinted ink sketches of animals and people, nervous energetic line, flat ground with few stylised trees
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Bukhara school, Shaybanid period
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Compact Herat-derived compositions, bright saturated blues, oranges and greens, squat figures in tall turbans, flat simplified landscapes with stylised flowering sprays, tiled arches, crisp dark outlines
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Safavid haft-rangi tile panels, Isfahan
styles.features: Painted glazed tile panels of garden picnics with figures holding flasks and cups, yellow, ochre, turquoise, cobalt and green outlined in dark lines, stylised cypress and flowering trees, flat ground, visible square tile grid
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mina'i ware, Seljuk Kashan
styles.medium: overglaze enamel and gilding on fritware
styles.features: Cream or turquoise glazed bowls painted with small moon-faced figures, riders and enthroned rulers in polychrome enamel and gold, fine black outlines, concentric bands, figures on plain ground without depth
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Qajar court painting
styles.features: Life-size flat frontal figures, wasp-waisted women and long-bearded kings in jewel-encrusted robes, almond eyes and joined eyebrows, deep reds, black and gold, arched niche backgrounds, minimal shading, lavishly patterned textiles
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Abu'l-Hasan Ghaffari (Sani' al-Mulk)
styles.features: Precise realistic watercolour portraits with fine stippled modelling and individualised faces, also panoramic court scenes with rows of dozens of figures, restrained palette of browns, black, muted reds and greens
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Qajar lacquer painting
styles.medium: oil-based paint under varnish on papier-mâché
styles.features: Glossy varnished pen boxes and mirror cases, dense rose-and-nightingale motifs, deep black or red grounds, small portrait medallions, very fine brushwork, warm golden-brown varnish tone over everything
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Qahveh-khaneh coffeehouse painting
styles.features: Large crowded canvases of epic battles and heroes, bright flat colours, figures scaled by importance, armoured warriors, rearing horses, dragons and demons, no linear perspective, vigorous folk drawing
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art
styles.note: Use epic and legendary subjects; avoid depicting holy figures.

styles.name: Persian lithographed book illustration, Qajar period
styles.medium: lithograph in black ink on paper
styles.features: Monochrome black ink, dense hatching and stippling, compact figures in panels framed by columns of handwritten script, crisp outlines, crowded scenes, decorative ruled borders
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Kamal-ol-molk
styles.features: Academic oil realism, precise linear perspective, palace interiors with mirror mosaics, chandeliers and carpets, sober earth tones, naturalistic light, unidealised portraits of ordinary craftsmen and villagers
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Safavid hunting and animal carpet
styles.features: Central medallion within a dense field of scrolling vines, lions attacking deer, birds, dragons and qilins, mounted hunters, deep red, indigo, ivory and gold, wide borders, slightly stepped pixel-like knotted edges
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Persian qalamkar block-printed textile, Isfahan
styles.features: Hand-stamped cotton in madder red, indigo, black and ochre, repeated cypress, boteh and arch motifs, small stylised figures and animals in borders, slight misregistration, matte faded fabric texture
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Nakkaş Osman
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Flat bright compositions without shadow, rows of uniformed soldiers and officials in tall white caps, bird's-eye sieges and ceremonies, plain green or pink grounds, clearly outlined architecture, documentary clarity
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Matrakçı Nasuh
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Topographic bird's-eye city views without people, buildings shown flattened in plan and elevation, domes, minarets, walls and gardens in bright reds, blues and greens, rivers as ribbons, stylised trees, map-like density
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Levni
styles.medium: opaque watercolour, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Graceful single figures and lively festival processions, light pastel palette, softly modelled faces, fluttering garments, acrobats, musicians and guild floats, pale open grounds, delicate fluent line
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Şahkulu, Ottoman saz style
styles.medium: ink with light colour and gold on paper
styles.features: Ink drawings of long curving serrated saz leaves, coiling dragons, phoenix-like birds, lotus blossoms and winged figures, brush line of swelling thickness, sparse tint and gold, dense rhythmic movement
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Kara Memi
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper (manuscript illumination)
styles.features: Naturalistic flowers in gold-framed panels, tulips, hyacinths, carnations, roses and blossoming fruit trees, some stems bent or drooping, lapis, coral red, green and gold, flat crisp outlines
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Iznik pottery
styles.features: Brilliant white ground under clear glaze, cobalt blue, turquoise, sage green and raised tomato red outlined in black, tulips, carnations, hyacinths and saz leaves in rhythmic symmetric sprays
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Kütahya pottery
styles.features: Small cream-ground ceramics with bright yellow, green, cobalt, purple and red, black outlines, loosely drawn flowers, winged heads and naive small figures, playful informal designs, slightly runny glaze
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Ottoman ebru paper marbling
styles.medium: marbled paper (pigments floated on thickened water)
styles.features: Swirled floating colours transferred to paper, veined stone patterns, combed feathered waves, tulips and carnations formed from dropped colour pulled by stylus, soft feathered edges, earthy and pastel palette
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Karagöz shadow theatre
styles.medium: translucent painted leather puppets on a backlit screen
styles.features: Translucent dyed leather figures glowing against a white cloth screen, flat jointed profile figures with visible rivet holes, bright transparent colours, perforated patterns, single-plane staging, comic stock characters
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Osman Hamdi Bey
styles.features: Academic oil realism, detailed interiors with glazed tiles, carpets and carved wood, single robed figures in quiet contemplative poses, warm controlled light, crisp textures of fabric, ceramic and metal
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Ottoman costume album painting
styles.features: One standing figure per page on blank paper, full-length costume of officials, tradesmen and women, flat bright colours, carefully patterned robes and headgear, simple ground line, no setting
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Abdullah Buhari
styles.features: Single women and youths in relaxed intimate poses, soft pastel colours, gentle shading of faces and drapery, sprays of naturalistic flowers, plain light backgrounds, delicate line
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Ottoman provincial wall painting
styles.medium: tempera on plaster and wood panels
styles.features: Idealised waterfront townscapes with mosques, kiosks, cypresses and sailing boats, flower vases and fruit bowls, no people, soft blues, greens and ochres, naive perspective, framed by baroque scrolls and curtains
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Damascus ajami painted interiors
styles.medium: raised gesso, tempera, gilding and glaze on wood panelling
styles.features: Wooden wall and ceiling panels with raised gesso relief, gold leaf and coloured glazes, dense floral bouquets, fruit bowls and vases in arched cartouches, deep red, green and gold, warm darkened varnish
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mughal painting, Akbar period
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper or cotton
styles.features: Dense dynamic compositions with many figures, vigorous gestures, Persian flat pattern mixed with rounded modelling and receding landscapes, bright reds, greens and ochres, rocky hills, architecture in tilted perspective
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Basawan
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Rounded volumetric figures with soft modelling, convincing recession into misty distant landscapes, crowds of individualised faces, earthy warm palette, strong narrative drama and natural body weight
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Ustad Mansur
styles.features: Precise natural history studies of single birds, animals and flowers on plain ground, every feather and scale rendered, accurate anatomy, subtle naturalistic colour, a few ground tufts, scientific clarity
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Abu'l Hasan (Nadir al-Zaman)
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Finely finished portraits with subtle modelling and intense individual faces, allegorical court scenes, gold halos, rich jewel-toned textiles, soft shading, small precise figures on pale grounds
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Bichitr
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Formal profile portraits with polished enamel-like finish, gold-haloed rulers, minutely painted jewels and textiles, cool clear palette, symmetrical courtly arrangements, tiny distant landscapes in soft European-style recession
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Govardhan
styles.features: Warm naturalistic portraits of ascetics, musicians and holy men gathered under trees at dusk, soft modelling, earthy flesh tones, low gentle light, intimate quiet atmosphere
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mughal album border painting
styles.medium: gold and colour on tinted paper
styles.features: Wide margins of flowering plants painted in fine gold line with touches of colour, roses, irises and poppies in delicate sprays, cream, buff and salmon paper, symmetrical layout around a central panel
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mughal pietra dura inlay (parchin kari)
styles.medium: semi-precious stone inlay in white marble
styles.features: Flowering plants and vases formed from inlaid carnelian, lapis, jade and onyx in white marble, flat glossy colour with natural stone veining, fine seamless joints, symmetrical scrolling borders
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Company painting
styles.features: Single tradespeople, servants and festival scenes on plain ground, careful costume detail, European-style shading and perspective, muted sepia, ochre and pale greens, also precise architectural views of monuments
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Late Mughal painting, Muhammad Shah period
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Night terraces with women, candles and fireworks, symmetrical palace gardens with fountains, cool whites, pale greens and soft blues, gentle shading, quiet lyrical mood, stiff elegant figures
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Deccani painting, Bijapur school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Dreamlike lyrical scenes, lavish gold, deep purples, lilacs and greens, tall elongated figures in transparent veils, lush fantastical flowering trees and rocks, sinuous line, mystical twilight atmosphere
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Deccani painting, Golconda school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Large formal courtly figures on flat monochrome grounds, abundant gold and white, boldly patterned textiles, stylised flowering plants, decorative surface over depth, crisp profiles
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Yahya ibn Mahmud al-Wasiti
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Lively everyday crowds, caravans, villages, mosques and camels, figures with decorative gold halos, expressive hands, flat ground with stylised plants, horizontal strip compositions, warm earthy palette with gold
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mamluk Kalila wa-Dimna manuscript painting
styles.features: Animal fable scenes with lions, jackals, crows and hares on plain paper, flat bright colours, symmetrical stylised trees, simple ground line, compact panels set between lines of script
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: al-Jazari automata manuscript drawings
styles.medium: ink and opaque colour on paper
styles.features: Technical drawings of water clocks and automata shown flat in elevation, pipes and tanks drawn as if transparent, figures of musicians, elephants and peacocks, flat bright colours, script labels on parts
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: al-Sufi constellation drawings (Book of Fixed Stars)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Constellations drawn as outlined human and animal figures in period costume, red dots marking the stars, minimal colour, figures isolated on plain paper, lively contour line
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Fatimid lustreware
styles.features: Golden-brown metallic lustre on white glaze, single animals, musicians, wrestlers and courtiers in silhouette with scratched-through details, swirling background fill, quick lively drawing
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Mamluk enamelled and gilded glass
styles.medium: enamel and gilding on blown glass
styles.features: Clear glass lamps and beakers with large bands of blue, red and white enamel script, gold outlines, heraldic roundels and arabesque scrolls, translucent glow through the vessel
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Abu Subhi al-Tinawi
styles.features: Paint applied behind glass, flat bright colours with bold black outlines, folk heroes on horseback with swords and lances, lions, symmetrical arrangements, glossy surface, naive frontal faces, written name captions
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Moroccan zellige
styles.features: Small hand-chiselled glazed tiles fitted into interlocking star and rosette patterns, green, blue, white, black and ochre, slightly uneven glossy surfaces, thin grout lines, radiating geometric symmetry
styles.section: Persian, Ottoman, Arab and Mughal art

styles.name: Rajput painting, Mewar school (Udaipur)
styles.features: Flat saturated grounds of red, yellow and deep blue; scenes split into compartments by walls and pavilions; stocky figures in profile with large fish-shaped eyes; several episodes of one story shown inside a single frame.

styles.name: Large-format court painting, Udaipur (Mewar)
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Wide horizontal sheets seen from a bird's-eye view: palaces, lakes, gardens and processions filled with hundreds of small figures in white robes; flat green, white and ochre architecture; little shading; the ruler repeated across the scene.

styles.name: Rajput painting, Bundi school
styles.features: Lush vegetation of banana and mango trees; monsoon skies with coiling dark clouds and gold lightning; lotus ponds with birds; women with round faces, receding foreheads and sharp noses; deep greens, oranges and reds; white palace pavilions.

styles.name: Rajput painting, Kota school hunting scenes
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and ink on paper
styles.features: Dense jungle on rocky hills with swirling trees; tigers, lions and boar charging; hunters with guns on raised platforms; energetic calligraphic line; greens, ochres and grey rocks, often left as lightly washed drawings.

styles.name: Rajput painting, Kishangarh school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Elongated figures with sharply upturned lotus-petal eyes, pointed noses and chins, S-curved profiles; lovers on marble terraces beside wide lakes receding into panoramic distance; soft greens, whites and pinks; fine jewellery detail.
styles.note: Associated with the painter Nihal Chand; the stylised profile is the key trait.

styles.name: Rajput painting, Bikaner school
styles.features: Refined thin line with Mughal and Deccani influence; cool pale palette of mauve, grey and soft green; slender figures in transparent white muslin; precise outlined architecture; intricate floral borders; restrained modelling of faces.

styles.name: Rajput painting, Marwar school (Jodhpur)
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Bold flat colour on strong yellow, green or red grounds; men with huge turbans, upturned moustaches and long sideburns; prancing horses in decorative profile; stiff frontal court groupings; gold highlights; almost no depth.

styles.name: Malwa painting
styles.features: Flat bands of colour on black or deep red grounds; small doll-like figures in simple profile; architecture reduced to rectangular boxes; rows of stylised trees; naive, rhythmic, entirely two-dimensional layout.

styles.name: Pichhwai painting, Nathdwara
styles.medium: mineral pigment and gold on cloth
styles.features: Large painted textile hanging; frontal dark-skinned Krishna figure flanked by rows of devotees, cows, lotus ponds and kadamba trees in strict symmetry; dense repetition of motifs; rich gold, red, green and indigo; flat decorative space.

styles.name: Phad scroll painting
styles.medium: vegetable colours on long cotton cloth
styles.features: Long horizontal cloth packed with many episodes; flat bright yellow, orange, red and green outlined in bold black; mounted hero shown large at centre, smaller figures around; profiles with large eyes; no perspective.

styles.name: Kavad painted storytelling box
styles.features: Portable wooden box with hinged folding doors; glossy red ground; doll-like figures with round eyes in flat primary colours and black outline; stacked registers of small narrative scenes revealed panel by panel.

styles.name: Pahari painting, Basohli school
styles.medium: opaque watercolour on paper with beetle-wing inlay
styles.features: Hot flat grounds of mustard yellow, chocolate brown or green; fiery red borders; figures with huge lotus-shaped eyes and sloping foreheads; iridescent beetle-wing fragments as emerald jewels; raised white dots for pearls.

styles.name: Nainsukh of Guler
styles.features: Delicate naturalistic painting with large calm empty pale grounds; quiet observed figures such as musicians, horsemen and courtiers smoking; subtle shading on faces; fine precise line; muted earth and pastel colour.

styles.name: Pahari painting, Kangra school
styles.features: Fine lyrical line; rolling green hills, flowering trees and rivers receding softly into distance; slender graceful women with oval faces; soft greens, pinks and pale blues; gentle modelling; Krishna legends in quiet countryside.

styles.name: Chamba rumal embroidery
styles.features: Square cloth with figures drawn in fine black outline then filled with untwisted silk in double satin stitch, identical on both sides; bright reds, greens, yellows and blues on white muslin; dances, weddings, hunts; floral border.

styles.name: Deccani painting (Bijapur and Golconda)
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Gold-flecked skies in lavender, mauve and turquoise; tall elegant figures with Persian-influenced faces; lush stylised gardens and flowering trees; heavy gold highlights; dreamlike, slightly mysterious atmosphere.

styles.name: Company painting, Patna school
styles.features: Muted sepia, brown and soft grey palette; single figures or small groups showing trades, crafts and festivals; careful realistic shading; no sky or horizon, figures placed on plain paper ground.

styles.name: Trichinopoly mica painting
styles.features: Brilliant saturated colours with a glassy translucent sheen; single figures of occupations, dancers and festival processions; flat plain backgrounds; neat sharp outlines; small uniform format.

styles.name: Sheikh Zain al-Din
styles.features: Large natural-history studies: a single bird, animal or plant on blank paper perched on one branch; meticulous feather and fur detail in fine brushwork; botanical accuracy; soft natural colours; quiet empty ground.

styles.name: Ghulam Ali Khan
styles.features: Precise portraits of villagers, soldiers and officials standing in rows; careful individual faces; softly indicated landscape; earthy muted palette; meticulous costume detail; monuments drawn in European perspective.

styles.name: Delhi miniature painting on ivory
styles.features: Tiny ovals and rectangles with minute stippled detail; white marble tombs, mosques and palaces in precise perspective; small portraits of rulers; creamy luminous bone-white surface; set in gilt or carved frames.
styles.note: Describe the support as a polished cream-white panel.

styles.name: Kalighat pat painting
styles.features: Bold sweeping outlines in single confident strokes; plain empty background; volume shown by dark tonal shading along the contours; flat bright colour with silver highlights; gods, dandies, courtesans, cats holding fish.

styles.name: Bengal patua scroll painting
styles.medium: natural pigments on paper backed with cloth
styles.features: Long vertical scroll divided into stacked frames read top to bottom; bold black outlines; flat bright yellow, red, blue and green; large-eyed figures in profile; decorative floral bands separating episodes.

styles.name: Battala woodcut prints
styles.medium: relief print from wood or metal block on paper
styles.features: Stark black line on cheap paper; dense cross-hatching; sometimes hand-coloured pink, yellow and green; gods, mythic battles and satirical townsfolk; crude energetic figures in flattened space.

styles.name: Jamini Roy
styles.features: Thick rounded brush outlines; flat earthy colour of brick red, ochre, slate grey and black on cream; frontal figures with large elongated almond eyes; simplified volumes; rhythmic folk-like repetition.

styles.name: Abanindranath Tagore
styles.features: Wash technique: colour laid and rinsed repeatedly, giving a misty veiled softness; muted browns, greens and dim gold glow; delicate elongated figures; faint outlines dissolving into tinted haze.

styles.name: Nandalal Bose
styles.features: Bold calligraphic brush outlines; flat tempera colour; villagers, musicians, craftsmen and animals in simple monumental poses; earthy reds, ochres and greens; plain unshaded decorative backgrounds.

styles.name: Gaganendranath Tagore
styles.features: Cubist-influenced fractured space of stairways, doorways and lamp-lit rooms; translucent overlapping prismatic planes; glowing violets and ambers against inky black; small silhouetted figures; theatrical light.

styles.name: Rabindranath Tagore (paintings)
styles.medium: ink and coloured ink on paper
styles.features: Dark brooding faces and mask-like heads; strange beasts and twilight landscapes; heavy black, sienna and deep green; scribbled and blotted marks; expressionist mood with glowing light behind silhouettes.

styles.name: Sunayani Devi
styles.features: Soft translucent washes; frontal figures with oval faces and large elongated eyes like folk dolls; gentle palette of pinks, ochres and muted greens; mythological and domestic women; simple, naive, flat space.

styles.name: Amrita Sher-Gil
styles.features: Flattened heavy figures of village women with melancholy faces; warm earthy reds, ochres, browns and deep greens; simplified forms with Post-Impressionist modelling; compositions echoing ancient cave murals and Pahari painting.

styles.name: Benode Behari Mukherjee
styles.medium: fresco and tempera on wall; ink on paper
styles.features: Linear mural compositions with many small figures of saints, villagers and craftsmen in long horizontal bands; muted sandy, terracotta and grey fresco tones; flattened space; East Asian-inspired calligraphic line.

styles.name: Raja Ravi Varma
styles.features: Academic oil painting with smooth glossy finish; idealised women in draped saris with rounded faces; theatrical lighting; rich crimson, gold and deep green fabrics; European perspective and chiaroscuro applied to Hindu myths.

styles.name: Calcutta Art Studio chromolithographs
styles.features: Gods, goddesses and theatre scenes with Victorian-style modelling and pink flesh tones; ornate stage-like settings with curtains and columns; vivid pinks, greens and blues; slightly misregistered colour; decorative borders.

styles.name: Madhubani (Mithila) painting, bharni style
styles.medium: natural pigments on paper or mud wall
styles.features: Double black outlines filled with flat bright crimson, yellow, blue and green; no empty space, gaps filled with fish, peacocks, flowers and vines; figures in profile with big eyes; patterned decorative borders.

styles.name: Madhubani (Mithila) painting, kachni line style
styles.medium: black and red ink on paper
styles.features: Line-only drawing in black and red; dense fine hatching and parallel strokes fill every shape instead of colour; fish, elephants, plants and deities in symmetrical layouts; intricate borders; no empty space.

styles.name: Ganga Devi
styles.features: Mithila kachni line style extended into large narrative cycles; neat parallel hatching in black and red; boxed panels showing hospital wards, fairground rides, journeys and city streets; diagrammatic flattened architecture.

styles.name: Gond painting
styles.medium: acrylic or ink on paper or canvas
styles.features: Bold silhouettes of animals, birds and trees filled with patterns of dots, dashes, fish-scales and fine lines; bright saturated colours on plain light ground; animals merge into roots and branches.

styles.name: Warli painting
styles.medium: white rice paste on mud or red-brown ground
styles.features: Stick figures built from a circle and two triangles; spiral circles of linked dancers; harvests, hunts, trees and village huts scattered across the field; white only on earth-brown; no perspective, repetitive rhythm.

styles.name: Odisha pattachitra
styles.medium: mineral colours on chalk-primed cloth, lacquered
styles.features: Bright mineral colours on deep red grounds; elegant elongated figures with sharp noses and fish-shaped eyes; fine black line; ornate costume and jewellery; dense floral and vine borders; glossy lacquer finish.

styles.name: Odisha palm-leaf engraving
styles.medium: stylus incision on palm leaf, lamp-black filled
styles.features: Images incised into narrow strips of dried palm leaf, cuts darkened with rubbed lamp-black; fine dense line; strips stitched into panels or folding books; occasional colour accents; tall narrow format.
styles.note: Often combined with script; image can be shown without lettering.

styles.name: Tanjore painting
styles.medium: pigment, gesso relief, gold leaf and glass stones on wood panel
styles.features: Raised gesso relief covered in gold leaf; embedded coloured glass stones; chubby rounded deities centred frontally; bright red, green and blue; ornate arches and pillars framing a flat background.

styles.name: Mysore painting
styles.medium: pigment, thin gesso and gold leaf on paper or board
styles.features: Low gesso relief with subtle gold; muted refined palette; finely drawn deities and court scenes; delicate detailed faces; gentle shading; balanced symmetrical compositions; less ornamented than Tanjore work.

styles.name: Kerala mural painting
styles.medium: natural pigments on lime plaster wall
styles.features: Five-colour scheme of red ochre, yellow ochre, green, white and black; densely packed figures with towering crowns and heavy jewellery; sinuous outlines; long eyes; bodies modelled with tonal shading; almost no empty space.

styles.name: Cheriyal scroll painting
styles.features: Long vertical cloth with stacked horizontal panels; bright red background; flat primary colours; figures with large round eyes and black outlines; simple shading; decorative borders dividing episodes.

styles.name: Kalamkari, Srikalahasti style
styles.features: Hand-drawn with bamboo pen; madder red, indigo, ochre yellow and black; narrative panels of epic battles and processions; dense floral borders; flattened figures with large eyes and patterned garments.

styles.name: Sanjhi paper stencil cutting
styles.features: Intricate lacy paper cut with scissors; silhouettes of Krishna, cows, peacocks, trees and temples; strict symmetry; fine pierced ornament; shown against a contrasting colour or used to stencil coloured powder.

styles.name: Ajanta cave murals
styles.features: Warm ochres, reds, earthy greens and lapis blue; graceful figures modelled with tonal gradations; crowded overlapping compositions; elongated eyes and supple bodies; fragments of pavilions; flaking aged surface.

styles.name: Pala manuscript painting
styles.features: Small square panels set between lines of script on long narrow leaves; deities in flat red, yellow, green and blue; sinuous line; rounded bodies with subtle shading; figures seated in arched niches.

styles.name: Western Indian (Jain) manuscript painting
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Brilliant red grounds with gold and ultramarine; angular figures in three-quarter view with the far eye projecting beyond the face; sharp pointed noses; crowded flat registers beside panels of script.

styles.name: Sohrai and Khovar wall painting
styles.features: Khovar made by scraping a comb or fingers through a dark top layer to reveal pale earth beneath; Sohrai painted with brush; animals, birds and plants built from dense rhythmic line patterns in brown, black and cream.

styles.name: Tholu bommalata leather shadow puppets
styles.features: Large jointed figures of dyed translucent leather glowing red, green, yellow and black against a backlit white screen; pierced perforated patterns; elaborate crowns and ornaments; bold profiles.

styles.name: Vijayanagara mural painting, Lepakshi
styles.features: Earthy palette of ochre, terracotta, black and green; figures in profile with long eyes; heavy black outlines; elaborately patterned textiles; flat friezes of courtly and mythic scenes in long bands.

styles.name: Bengal kantha embroidery
styles.features: Fine running stitch rippling across layered old cotton; central lotus with scattered fish, elephants, chariots, birds and village figures; no perspective; red, blue and black thread on white.

styles.name: Balinese Kamasan painting
styles.features: Flat figures in shadow-puppet profile with frontal torsos, fine black outlines, palette of ochre, brick red, indigo blue and black on cream cloth, episodes stacked in horizontal registers divided by rock and flame borders, no shadows or perspective
styles.note: keep faces in strict puppet profile; no naturalistic modelling

styles.name: Batuan school painting, Bali
styles.features: Dense all-over compositions packed with hundreds of small figures, layered grey and black ink washes building shadowy jungle foliage, fine pen line, muted greys and browns with pale accents, demons, ceremonies and village life side by side

styles.name: Ubud school painting, Pita Maha era
styles.features: Slender graceful figures with soft modelled anatomy, rice fields, markets and temple offerings, rhythmic repeated leaves and stylised trees framing the scene, earthy greens, ochres and browns, smooth careful finish, shallow layered space

styles.name: Pengosekan school painting, Bali
styles.features: Close views of herons, butterflies, frogs and dragonflies among lotus, banana and hibiscus leaves, soft pastel greens, pinks and creams, crisp outlines, gentle flat gradations, decorative overlapping foliage filling the frame, no horizon line

styles.name: Young Artists style, Penestanan, Bali
styles.features: Naive flat colour without shading, hot pink, lime, turquoise and orange, simplified outlined figures, terraced rice fields, palms and temple processions arranged as patterned bands stacked up the picture, childlike cheerful directness

styles.name: Sanur school painting, Bali
styles.features: Fine black ink line with dense hatching and stippled textures, fish, crabs, monkeys, deer and birds arranged in rhythmic patterned fields, mostly black and white or pale washes, playful flattened space, decorative repetition of waves and leaves

styles.name: I Gusti Nyoman Lempad
styles.medium: ink with touches of red and gold on paper
styles.features: Sparse energetic black ink line on bare paper, elongated figures with puppet-derived profiles and expressive hands, faint red and gold washes, almost no background, a few actors in lively gestures

styles.name: Walter Spies
styles.features: Dreamlike tropical landscapes built in receding layers of silhouetted trees, terraces and hills, tiny figures and animals, cool blue-green twilight light with glowing patches, smooth precise glazes, slightly naive enchanted stillness

styles.name: Javanese wayang kulit shadow puppet imagery
styles.medium: carved and painted buffalo hide, gold leaf
styles.features: Flat silhouettes in strict profile with lace-like punched perforations, very long thin arms on horn rods, long pointed noses and slanted eyes, gilded, black or red faces, intricate patterned costumes and headdresses, dramatic shadow against lit screen
styles.note: keep proportions puppet-like, not realistic anatomy

styles.name: Wayang beber scroll painting
styles.medium: natural pigments on bark paper or cotton scroll
styles.features: Long horizontal scroll scenes with flat puppet-profile figures in rows, earthy reds, ochres, white and black, bold outlines, background crowded with floral and leaf motifs, pavilions and trees as flat emblems, no depth

styles.name: Javanese court batik, Yogyakarta and Surakarta
styles.features: All-over repeating patterns of diagonal blade bands, interlocking circles and stylised wings, palette of soga brown, deep indigo and cream, fine dotted wax lines, faint crackle veins where dye seeped, flat cloth surface
styles.note: pattern-based; figures appear only as stylised motifs

styles.name: Pekalongan coastal batik (batik pesisir)
styles.features: Bright bouquets of roses and lilies, birds, butterflies and phoenixes on pale grounds, pinks, reds, sky blues and greens, scalloped lace-like borders, fine wax dot fills, crackle lines, dense floral scatter

styles.name: Cirebon reverse glass painting
styles.medium: paint on the back of glass
styles.features: Glossy flat colour seen through glass, crisp black outlines, puppet figures and mythical creatures, layered cloud bands in graded blues and reds, metallic gold and silver accents, symmetrical framed compositions

styles.name: Raden Saleh
styles.features: Romantic dramatic compositions, wild animals locked in combat, erupting volcanoes, stormy skies and flood scenes, glowing chiaroscuro, detailed fur, smoke and foliage, small figures dwarfed by vast tropical scenery

styles.name: Mooi Indië landscape painting
styles.features: Sunny idealised tropical vistas, a cone volcano behind terraced rice fields, coconut palms, calm blue sky with white clouds, smooth academic realism, soft greens and blues, tiny peasants on dykes

styles.name: Affandi
styles.medium: oil squeezed from the tube on canvas, fingers
styles.features: Thick writhing ropes of paint pressed straight from the tube, swirling looping lines, fierce oranges, reds, yellows and deep blues, distorted faces, fighting cocks, fishing boats and beggars dissolving in turbulent texture

styles.name: S. Sudjojono
styles.features: Gritty expressive realism, heavy visible brushstrokes, earthy browns, olive greens and dusty reds, ordinary workers, fighters and village people with weathered faces, rough unglamorous surfaces

styles.name: Hendra Gunawan
styles.features: Blazing saturated vermilion, pink, turquoise and yellow, elongated sinuous figures with exaggerated feet and hands, market vendors and folk dancers in patterned cloth, flattened crowded space, decorative curling rhythms

styles.name: Lee Man Fong
styles.features: Smooth thin oil handled like Chinese ink, koi, horses, egrets and Balinese women, large empty pale backgrounds, soft tonal gradations, elegant economical brushwork, vertical scroll-like formats

styles.name: Emiria Sunassa
styles.features: Naive flattened figures with mask-like faces and stiff frontal poses, simplified folk costumes and ornaments from the eastern archipelago, muted earthy tones against dark backgrounds, quiet slightly uncanny stillness

styles.name: Borobudur relief carving
styles.features: Grey volcanic stone carved in shallow rectangular panels, rounded serene figures in graceful swaying poses, ships, trees, pavilions and animals packed in horizontal friezes, weathered pitted surface, no colour

styles.name: Thai temple murals, Rattanakosin period
styles.medium: distemper and gold leaf on plaster
styles.features: Dark red or deep green grounds, gilded tiered palaces, zigzag lines dividing episodes, slender flat figures with curling fingers and pointed crowns, no shadows, crowded multi-scene walls, rows of seated deities above

styles.name: Lanna temple murals, Nan
styles.features: Narrative scenes mixed with everyday life, figures in local dress with tattooed legs, couples, boats and wooden houses placed freely, indigo, red and ochre on pale ground, loose relaxed drawing

styles.name: Khrua In Khong
styles.features: Thai mural painted with Western perspective and atmospheric haze, misty blue-green landscapes, dark tonal skies, European-style buildings, ships and carriages, shaded volumes replacing flat Thai convention

styles.name: Thai lai rot nam gold-on-black lacquer
styles.features: Brilliant flat gold silhouettes on deep glossy black, no shading, dense flame-tipped scrolls, mythical birds, lions and celestial figures, palace and forest scenes on cabinet doors, fine incised gold details

styles.name: Thai nang yai shadow puppet panels
styles.features: Large leather panel with a single figure in dance pose enclosed by foliage or palace frame, lacy pierced perforations, dark translucent silhouette glowing against firelight, stylised crowns and weapons

styles.name: Thai Benjarong porcelain
styles.features: Dense repeating flame and flower motifs in green, yellow, rose, black and gold enamel, small medallions with celestial figures, raised enamel outlines, every surface filled, lidded bowls and jars

styles.name: Thawan Duchanee
styles.features: Violent black brush marks, horned bulls, skulls, serpents and monstrous muscular figures, stark black-and-white contrast with blood red and gold, writhing spiky forms, dark mythic intensity

styles.name: Burmese parabaik painting
styles.features: Horizontal strip of scenes read across folding pages, small flat figures in court dress with flared costumes, bright red, green and gold on white ground, tiered-roof pavilions and elephants, sparse background, short captions

styles.name: Bagan temple murals
styles.features: Grids of small repeated narrative panels, slender figures outlined in black or white, earthy red ochre, yellow ochre, green and black, dense floral scroll borders, flaking aged plaster surface

styles.name: Burmese kalaga sequined tapestry
styles.medium: appliqué velvet, sequins and metallic thread
styles.features: Padded raised figures cut from felt and velvet, glittering sequins and glass beads, metallic thread outlines, dark velvet ground, dancers, elephants, peacocks and court scenes in a single shallow band

styles.name: Burmese incised lacquerware (yun)
styles.features: Hairline engraved patterns filled with red, green and yellow lacquer on black or red ground, scrolling floral bands with small figures, glossy curved surfaces of boxes and bowls

styles.name: Bagyi Aung Soe
styles.features: Bold black calligraphic brush lines, figures broken into angular cubist facets, flat zones of bright red, yellow and blue, faces reduced to graphic signs, loose energetic drawing

styles.name: Vietnamese lacquer painting (sơn mài)
styles.medium: layered polished lacquer, gold and silver leaf, eggshell on wood panel
styles.features: Deep glossy black and vermilion grounds, gold and silver leaf shimmering under translucent layers, crushed eggshell mosaics for whites, flattened decorative figures and trees, sanded-back luminous depth

styles.name: Đông Hồ woodblock print
styles.medium: woodblock on dó paper coated with seashell powder
styles.features: Shimmering pearly off-white ground, flat blocks of natural red, yellow, green and black, chunky black key line, plump children, pigs, roosters, frogs and mouse weddings, simple symmetrical compositions

styles.name: Hàng Trống print, Hanoi
styles.medium: woodblock outline with hand painting on paper
styles.features: Thin printed black outlines filled with hand-brushed colour gradations, saturated pinks, blues and bright greens, tigers, carp, elegant ladies and guardian figures, finer and more ornate than village prints

styles.name: Kim Hoàng woodblock print
styles.medium: woodblock and hand colour on red or yellow paper
styles.features: Black printed lines on bright vermilion or yellow paper, hand-dabbed white, green and pink touches, roosters, pigs, carp and auspicious figures, loose spontaneous colouring

styles.name: Nguyễn Gia Trí
styles.features: Large lacquer panels with slender women in long tunics among stylised trees and gardens, gold and silver leaf glowing through dark reds and blacks, eggshell highlights, dreamy layered depth

styles.name: Nguyễn Phan Chánh
styles.features: Rural women and children at simple tasks, muted browns, ochres and black, soft washes letting silk weave show, simplified gentle figures, plain empty backgrounds, calm domestic mood

styles.name: Mai Trung Thứ
styles.features: Delicate thin outlines, porcelain-pale faces, women and children in long tunics, pastel blues, pinks and creams, flat decorative or plain backgrounds, small intimate format

styles.name: Lê Thị Lựu
styles.features: Hazy pastel tones, mothers and children in tender gestures, softly blurred contours, luminous pale pinks, blues and creams, airy unfinished-looking backgrounds

styles.name: Bùi Xuân Phái
styles.medium: oil and gouache on board or paper
styles.features: Narrow old Hanoi streets with crooked tile-roofed houses, nearly empty lanes, muted greys, browns and dull blues, wobbly dark outlines, a few tiny figures, quiet melancholy mood

styles.name: Nguyễn Tư Nghiêm
styles.features: Flattened angular figures derived from village carvings and folk prints, ancient dancers and zodiac animals in rhythmic repetition, red, gold and black, bold simplified silhouettes

styles.name: Angkor bas-relief galleries
styles.features: Long continuous low-relief friezes, densely interlocked marching armies, chariots and elephants, celestial dancers with ornate tiered headdresses, fine patterned background, polished dark grey stone

styles.name: Fernando Amorsolo
styles.features: Backlit golden sunlight, rim-lit figures, rice planters and women in light blouses and long skirts, green fields and mango trees, warm glowing palette, loose sunny dabs of paint

styles.name: Tipos del País watercolour, Manila
styles.features: Single costumed figure standing on plain ground, precise outlines, carefully rendered fabrics, embroidery and folds, delicate clear colours, small occupational props, no background scenery

styles.name: José Honorato Lozano, letras y figuras
styles.features: Names spelled with ornate letters formed by tiny people, animals, boats and plants, surrounded by small landscape vignettes of town life, bright clear watercolour, fine detail

styles.name: Carlos 'Botong' Francisco
styles.features: Rhythmic stylised figures with elongated limbs and flowing curved contours, interlocking crowds, earthy reds, greens and ochres, festive and historical pageantry, decorative leafy frames

styles.name: Anita Magsaysay-Ho
styles.medium: egg tempera and oil on canvas
styles.features: Groups of working women in wide-brimmed hats with hidden faces, angular stylised bodies, chickens, baskets and fish, muted earth tones with bright accents, rhythmic repeated poses

styles.name: H. R. Ocampo
styles.features: Interlocking flame-like biomorphic forms, curling shapes packed edge to edge, saturated reds, oranges, yellows and greens, rhythmic curved contours, no recognisable objects

styles.name: Ang Kiukok
styles.features: Fractured cubist figures, anguished faces, snarling dogs, fish and crucifixions, heavy black contours, bold reds, yellows and blues, violent angular shapes

styles.name: Nena Saguil
styles.medium: oil and ink on canvas or paper
styles.features: Fields of tiny dots, circles and cells forming orbs, spheres and cosmic clusters, mostly blues and whites, delicate repetitive marks, quiet floating space

styles.name: Maranao okir carving
styles.features: Flowing curvilinear scrolls and fern-tip spirals, stylised bird with fish in beak, leaf and vine motifs, bright reds, yellows and greens on carved wood, symmetrical ornamental bands

styles.name: Chuah Thean Teng
styles.features: Wax-resist dyed cloth with fine crackle veins, flat stylised village figures, mothers and children, fishermen and fruit sellers, bold outlines, warm browns, oranges and blues

styles.name: Abdullah Ariff
styles.features: Transparent watercolour washes, Penang street scenes, stilt houses and coconut palms, loose wet-into-wet skies, white paper sparkle, quick sure brushstrokes

styles.name: Nanyang Style
styles.features: European modernist flattening and bold colour applied to tropical subjects, women at market, river villages and fishing boats, elongated figures, Chinese ink-like line rhythms, warm earthy palette

styles.name: Cheong Soo Pieng
styles.features: Elongated slender figures with almond eyes and tiny heads, flattened planes, calligraphic ink outlines on canvas, muted ochres, blues and greys, gauze-like layering of forms

styles.name: Georgette Chen
styles.features: Post-impressionist still lifes of rambutans, mangosteens and durians, crisp outlined forms, bright clear colour, firm brushwork, tablecloths and baskets, gentle tropical light

styles.name: Ethiopian Orthodox church painting, Gondarine style
styles.medium: tempera on cloth mounted on walls, wooden panels
styles.features: Flat unmodulated colour in red, yellow, green and indigo, bold black contours, large almond eyes in frontal faces, villains shown in profile, horizontal coloured background bands, patterned robes, stacked narrative registers
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Ethiopian illuminated manuscript painting
styles.features: Frontal evangelists and saints with wide staring eyes, geometric striped drapery, flat red, yellow and green fields, interlace arches framing canon tables, columns of black and red Ge'ez script, no shading or perspective
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters
styles.note: Ge'ez script is usually garbled by generators; keep lettering decorative

styles.name: Ethiopian popular secular painting, Addis Ababa
styles.features: Crowded battle and legend scenes in bright flat colour, Ethiopian heroes frontal with large eyes, enemies in profile, rows of horsemen and soldiers, stacked comic-strip panels, simple outlines, sky as plain band
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters
styles.note: Often carries short Amharic captions under scenes

styles.name: Afewerk Tekle
styles.features: Elongated stylised figures in flowing white shamma robes, crisp contours, saturated jewel colours, flat decorative planes merging Ethiopian church painting with modern simplification, solemn frontal faces, patterned borders
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Gebre Kristos Desta
styles.features: Non-objective compositions of heavy textured paint, scraped and layered surfaces, vivid reds, ochres and deep blues against dark grounds, jagged gestural shapes, occasional circular forms suggesting suns or eyes
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Skunder Boghossian
styles.medium: oil and mixed media on canvas, bark cloth
styles.features: Swirling cosmic fields of interlocking organic forms, scroll-like amulet motifs, small mask faces and seeds floating in deep space, earthy browns with glowing turquoise and gold, finely textured granular surfaces
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Tingatinga painting, Dar es Salaam
styles.medium: enamel paint on square masonite panels
styles.features: Glossy enamel in flat saturated colours, plain monochrome backgrounds, animals and birds outlined in black with dotted and striped body patterns, frontal or profile silhouettes, no shadows, symmetric decorative plants
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: George Lilanga
styles.medium: enamel and acrylic on board, painted wood
styles.features: Crowded friezes of rubbery dancing figures with huge ears, round eyes and spindly limbs, bright flat colours in black outlines, dotted skin patterns, figures interlocking edge to edge, cheerful chaotic movement
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Ndebele house painting
styles.medium: earth pigments and acrylic on plastered house walls
styles.features: Large geometric panels on white walls, thick black outlines, stepped and chevron shapes, symmetrical facades, bright red, yellow, blue and green fills, stylised razor-blade and gable motifs, hard edges, no shading
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Kassena painted houses, Tiébélé
styles.medium: earth pigments and relief on adobe walls
styles.features: Rounded and rectangular mud houses covered in red, black and white ochre, triangles, chevrons and checkerboards, low-relief lizards and snakes, burnished matte surfaces, small doorways, compounds under strong sun
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Kuba raffia textiles, Shoowa cut-pile embroidery
styles.features: Velvety cut-pile raffia on woven beige ground, interlocking geometric mazes, lozenges and zigzags in dark brown, black and rust, patterns deliberately shifting and breaking mid-field, soft fibrous texture
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Bogolanfini mud cloth, Bamana
styles.medium: fermented mud dye on hand-woven cotton strips
styles.features: Narrow cotton strips sewn together, dark brown-black ground with cream negative-painted motifs, dots, crosses, zigzags and dashes in grid bands, ochre accents, irregular hand-drawn lines, coarse matte weave
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Adinkra cloth stamping, Asante
styles.medium: bark-based dye stamped with carved calabash on cotton
styles.features: Cloth divided into square grid by comb-drawn or stitched lines, each square filled with repeated black stamped symbols such as spirals, hearts and ladders, slight ink irregularities, white, red or russet ground
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Kente strip weaving, Asante and Ewe
styles.features: Narrow woven strips sewn edge to edge, alternating blocks of warp stripes and weft-faced motifs, checkerboard rhythm, bright gold-yellow, green, red, blue and black, crisp geometric bars, glossy silk threads
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Adire indigo resist cloth, Yoruba
styles.medium: cassava-paste resist and tie-dye on cotton, indigo
styles.features: Deep indigo cloth with pale blue negative patterns, dense grid of small hand-painted or stencilled motifs, birds, leaves, spirals and concentric circles, tie-dyed rings and pleats, slightly blurred edges
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Fon appliqué banners, Abomey
styles.medium: cut cotton appliqué stitched on cloth
styles.features: Flat cut-cloth silhouettes of lions, sharks, buffaloes, warriors and royal emblems on black or gold grounds, bright red, green, yellow and white, no perspective, figures floating separately, visible stitched edges
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Asafo flags, Fante
styles.medium: cotton appliqué and embroidery, double-sided flags
styles.features: Bright cut-cloth figures illustrating proverbs, animals, warriors, ships and cannons on solid coloured cotton, small Union Jack or Ghana flag in corner, fringed border, flat shapes, playful scale shifts
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Benin bronze plaques, Edo Kingdom
styles.features: Rectangular high-relief panels, rigidly frontal figures with hierarchical scale, ruler flanked by attendants, coral bead collars, incised river-leaf pattern on background, Portuguese soldiers with muskets, dark brown-gold patina
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Ife copper-alloy and terracotta heads
styles.features: Naturalistic idealised life-size heads, calm faces with full lips and almond eyes, fine vertical parallel striations across cheeks, tall beaded crowns, smooth green-bronze or reddish clay surfaces
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Olowe of Ise
styles.medium: carved and painted wood: doors, veranda posts
styles.features: Yoruba carving with figures projecting in deep high relief from door panels, elongated necks and tall coiffures, interlocking horsemen and attendants, chip-carved geometric borders, traces of blue, white and red paint
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Nok terracotta sculpture
styles.features: Large stylised heads with triangular or D-shaped eyes and pierced pupils, flared nostrils, open lips, elaborate buns and braided coiffures, gritty reddish-orange clay, cylindrical bodies with beaded ornaments
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Twins Seven-Seven
styles.medium: ink, gouache and varnish on cut plywood panels
styles.features: Densely packed spirit creatures and humans from Yoruba tales, bodies filled with cross-hatching, dots and scales, composite beings with many heads, muted ochre, olive and maroon, layered cut-wood relief edges
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Uche Okeke
styles.medium: pen and ink on paper, oil
styles.features: Sparse flowing linear drawings derived from Igbo uli body painting, thin curving lines, spirals and crescent motifs, large areas of empty white paper, figures and spirits reduced to rhythmic contours
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Ancient Egyptian tomb painting, New Kingdom Thebes
styles.features: Figures in composite view with profile head, frontal eye and shoulders, arranged in horizontal registers on ground lines, hierarchical scale, flat ochre, red-brown, yellow, blue and green, crisp outlines, hieroglyph columns
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Ancient Egyptian papyrus vignettes, Book of the Dead
styles.medium: ink and pigment on papyrus scroll
styles.features: Thin black-outlined profile figures and animal-headed deities in pale washes of red, blue, green and ochre, beige fibrous papyrus, columns of cursive hieroglyphs in black and red framing small scenes
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters
styles.note: Hieroglyphs will be decorative, not legible

styles.name: Fayum mummy portraits
styles.medium: encaustic wax or tempera on wooden panels
styles.features: Frontal head-and-shoulders portraits, large dark luminous eyes, naturalistic modelling with light and shadow, waxy textured brushwork, warm flesh against grey-green ground, gold wreaths, jewellery and draped tunics
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Nubian Christian wall painting, Faras
styles.features: Large frontal saints, bishops and royal figures with almond eyes, rich patterned robes and jewelled crowns, purple, yellow, red and white, dark-skinned Nubian portraits beside pale holy figures, flat gold-ochre grounds
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Nubian village house painting, Aswan
styles.medium: lime and pigment on mud-brick walls
styles.features: Whitewashed or bright blue and ochre facades, decorated arched doorways with painted crescents, stars, palm trees, crocodiles and geometric bands, inset ceramic plates, flat cheerful colours under harsh sunlight
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Upper Egyptian Hajj house murals
styles.features: Naive flat paintings across house fronts, ships, aeroplanes, trains and camels carrying pilgrims, simple figures in white, bold primary colours, scale freely mixed, scenes scattered around doors and windows
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters
styles.note: Usually includes painted Arabic inscriptions with names and dates

styles.name: Mahmoud Said
styles.features: Rounded sculptural figures with heavy volumes, women with almond eyes and coloured headscarves, golden-amber light against dark stormy blue skies, smooth modelling, Nile sails and Alexandria coast, warm copper skin tones
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Abdel Hadi El-Gazzar
styles.medium: oil on board, ink on paper
styles.features: Hallucinatory scenes of Cairo popular life, mask-like faces with fixed stares, talismans, amulets and folk symbols, finely hatched dense detail, earthy brown, ochre and dark green, figures crowded in shallow airless space
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Inji Efflatoun
styles.features: Short separate brushstrokes with bare white canvas glowing between them, luminous vibrating light, peasant women in fields, palm groves and orchards, soft greens, pinks and ochres, outlines dissolved into flickering marks
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Tahia Halim
styles.medium: oil on canvas, thick textured paint
styles.features: Heavy rough impasto surfaces like plaster, Nubian villagers and boats rendered as flattened dark silhouettes, earthy brown, ochre and dull gold, thick outlines, simplified rounded forms, static frieze-like groupings
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Moke, Kinshasa popular painting
styles.features: Bustling street, bar and nightclub scenes, many small lively figures with exaggerated gestures, bright flat colours, crisp outlines, humorous observation, night lights, cars and dancers, simple comic-like perspective
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Tshibumba Kanda Matulu
styles.features: Plain storytelling history scenes, stiff figures in uniforms and suits, simple flat colour areas, low horizons, clear outlines, crowds and officials staged frontally like a schoolbook illustration
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters
styles.note: Often includes painted caption strip; disappeared c. 1981, presumed dead

styles.name: Pilipili Mulongoy, Lubumbashi Hangar school
styles.medium: gouache and oil on paper and board
styles.features: Birds, fish, snakes and flowers rendered with thousands of tiny dots and fine hatching, decorative symmetry, flat stippled backgrounds, soft greens, ochres and blues, no shadows, tapestry-like surface
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Poto-Poto school, Brazzaville
styles.medium: gouache and oil on paper and board
styles.features: Tall stick-thin silhouetted figures in rows, hunters, dancers and market women with elongated limbs, dark figures over flat bright yellow, orange or blue grounds, rhythmic repetition, minimal detail
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Irma Stern
styles.features: Expressionist portraits and still lifes, thick vigorous impasto, bold dark outlines, saturated oranges, greens and violets, sitters in patterned robes and headwraps, abundant flowers and fruit, loose energetic brushwork
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Gerard Sekoto
styles.features: Township street scenes with rounded simplified figures, warm ochres, rusts and blues, rhythmic groups walking or waiting, low houses and dusty roads, soft blocky brushwork, quiet everyday gestures
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Maggie Laubser
styles.features: Simplified rural figures, farm workers, geese and swans in flat bright colour, glowing haloed light, blue-violet shadows, pink and yellow skies, softened contours, naive calm compositions
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Gladys Mgudlandlu
styles.features: Dreamlike Eastern Cape landscapes with round huts, hills and flocks of birds, bold sweeping brushstrokes, dense blues, greens and ochres, imaginary viewpoint from above, rhythmic flowing contours
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Alexis Preller
styles.features: Surreal monumental figures and heads with smooth porcelain surfaces, hard-edged forms, mythic symbols, Ndebele and Mediterranean motifs, deep blues, golds and whites, crisp shadows, dreamlike stage-like space
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Walter Battiss
styles.features: Small calligraphic glyph-like figures and animals scattered across the surface, influenced by rock painting, flat warm ochre and red grounds, playful pictographic marks, bright accents, lively rhythmic spacing
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: John Muafangejo
styles.features: Stark black and white linocuts, flat figures with large eyes, dense patterned clothing and ground, hand-carved captions integrated into the image, churches, homesteads and biblical scenes, vigorous gouged lines
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Dumile Feni
styles.features: Contorted, stretched and swollen human bodies, monochrome charcoal with deep blacks and smudged greys, tangled limbs merging with animals and objects, tortured gestures, empty pale paper around figures
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: George Pemba
styles.features: Realist township genre scenes, families, street vendors and gatherings, warm earthy colours, solid naturalistic figures, soft light, small houses and dirt roads, straightforward narrative composition
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Peter Clarke
styles.features: Coastal and Cape Flats life, figures flying kites or gazing over fences, clean cut lines, stylised wind-bent grasses, flat areas of colour, strong diagonals, quiet poetic everyday scenes
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: J. H. Pierneef
styles.features: Highveld landscapes reduced to geometric planes, stylised layered clouds, lone flat-topped trees, koppies and plains in ordered bands, muted ochre, olive, blue-grey and rose, crisp edges, monumental calm
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Saharan rock painting, Tassili n'Ajjer
styles.medium: ochre and white pigments on sandstone
styles.features: Herds of cattle with patterned hides, many small herders, dancers and hunters, elongated silhouettes, red ochre, white and yellow on weathered orange rock, figures scattered without ground line
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Senegalese reverse glass painting, sous-verre
styles.medium: paint on the reverse of glass
styles.features: Glossy flat colours behind glass, bold black outlines, women in patterned boubous, wrestlers, markets and village scenes, decorative borders, bright reds, yellows and blues, no shading, naive frontal figures
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Ghanaian hand-painted movie posters
styles.medium: oil paint on stitched flour sacks
styles.features: Lurid exaggerated scenes of monsters, heroes and explosions, oversized faces, dripping blood and glowing eyes, saturated garish colours, hand-painted titles and taglines, rough canvas texture, wild scale jumps
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Malangatana Ngwenya
styles.features: Densely crowded compositions of interlocking figures with bulging white eyes and bared teeth, limbs and faces filling every space, intense reds, blues and ochres, heavy dark outlines, nightmarish energy
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Swahili carved doors, Zanzibar and Lamu
styles.features: Heavy dark teak doors with deeply carved frames of lotus, vine, fish and chain motifs, arched or rectangular lintels, protruding brass bosses, framed by whitewashed coral-stone walls in narrow alleys
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Baya Mahieddine
styles.features: Flat bright gouache, women in long patterned dresses with large almond eyes and flowing hair, birds, butterflies, vases and musical instruments, no shadows or depth, decorative symmetry, pink, blue, orange and green
