styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Mohammed Racim, Algerian miniature
styles.features: Persian-Ottoman miniature precision, tiny detailed figures on terraces and in courtyards, Casbah rooftops and harbour, ornate gilded borders and illuminated margins, jewel-like blues, greens and gold, fine stippled skies
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Seydou Keïta
styles.features: Black-and-white studio portraits, sitters posed frontally or seated, boldly patterned cloth backdrops clashing with patterned clothing, props like radios and scooters, rich mid-greys, crisp natural light
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters
styles.note: Photographic style, not painting

styles.name: Chaïbia Talal
styles.medium: oil and gouache on canvas and paper
styles.features: Spontaneous naive figures with simplified faces and wide eyes, thick unmixed pure colours, red, yellow, blue and green in bold patches, energetic brush and finger marks, villages and festive gatherings
styles.section: African art traditions and modern African painters

styles.name: Egyptian tomb painting, New Kingdom Thebes
styles.features: Flat mineral colours on smooth white or ochre plaster; composite figures with head and legs in profile, eye and shoulders frontal; crisp dark outlines; stacked registers on ground lines; hierarchical scale; ochre, Egyptian blue, malachite green, black.
styles.note: Columns of hieroglyphs often appear between figures; generators render them as pseudo-glyphs.

styles.name: Egyptian painted relief, Old Kingdom Saqqara mastabas
styles.features: Very low raised relief in fine white limestone, delicately carved and lightly painted; long horizontal registers of farmers, boatmen, herdsmen, cattle and offering bearers; composite profile figures; calm repetition; red-brown skin, pale ochre, blue-green accents.

styles.name: Amarna period art
styles.medium: painted limestone relief and plaster painting
styles.features: Elongated heads and necks, slender limbs, full hips and bellies; relaxed intimate family poses; sun disk with long rays ending in small hands; looser naturalistic marsh plants and birds; warm ochres, soft modelling within sunk relief.

styles.name: Egyptian Book of the Dead papyrus vignettes
styles.medium: ink and mineral pigment on papyrus
styles.features: Cream papyrus with columns of black cursive hieroglyphs and red rubrics; framed vignettes of profile figures, balance scales, animal-headed deities, boats; thin black outlines filled with flat ochre, green, red and white.
styles.note: Script is integral; expect pseudo-hieroglyphs.

styles.name: Egyptian sunk relief, Ramesside temple walls
styles.medium: sunk relief in sandstone, traces of paint
styles.features: Figures cut into sandstone walls with deep sharp contours catching raking sunlight; vast battle and procession scenes; colossal king in chariot above tangled small enemies, rearing horses and fortresses; faded red, yellow and blue paint.

styles.name: Coptic textiles
styles.features: Woven wool on undyed linen; roundels, bands and squares filled with stylised dancers, hares, birds, vines and fruit baskets; bold purple-brown silhouettes with ochre, red, green accents; flattened forms, wide staring eyes, heavy outlines.

styles.name: Minoan fresco, Knossos
styles.features: Fluid curving outlines; figures with wasp waists, long black curls and large almond eyes; red-brown men, white-skinned women; flat backgrounds of blue, yellow and red; leaping bulls, dolphins, lilies, undulating band borders.

styles.name: Theran wall painting, Akrotiri
styles.features: Bright flat colour on white ground; rolling multicoloured rocks with red lilies and darting swallows; miniature friezes of ships, harbour towns and tiny figures; graceful outlined profiles, boys with blue-painted shaved heads, fishermen holding fish.

styles.name: Kamares ware, Middle Minoan pottery
styles.features: Eggshell-thin vessels with dark lustrous ground; white, red and orange painted spirals, rosettes, whorls and stylised plant tendrils; dense swirling rhythmic decoration covering the whole surface; light-on-dark contrast.

styles.name: Minoan Marine Style pottery
styles.medium: dark slip painting on buff clay
styles.features: Lustrous dark brown-black paint on pale buff clay; octopuses with sprawling curling tentacles, argonauts, seaweed, rocks and coral spread across the whole vessel; flowing organic movement, no frames or registers.

styles.name: Mycenaean palace fresco
styles.features: Processions of women in flounced skirts carrying offerings, chariots, boar hunts with spotted hounds; stiffer and more schematic than Minoan work; flat red, blue, yellow and black on white; patterned border bands.

styles.name: Greek Geometric pottery, Dipylon style
styles.features: Dark brown-black glaze on pale buff clay; dense horizontal bands of meanders, zigzags, lozenges and hatched triangles; tiny stick-like silhouette figures with triangular torsos in funeral processions, chariots and mourners; every gap filled.

styles.name: Corinthian animal-frieze pottery
styles.features: Pale yellow clay with stacked friezes of lions, panthers, goats, boars, sphinxes and sirens marching in bands; incised details; added purple-red and white; scattered rosette fillers between animals; crisp miniature drawing.

styles.name: Attic black-figure vase painting
styles.medium: black gloss and incision on terracotta
styles.features: Glossy black silhouettes on orange-red clay; interior details incised with a fine point revealing the clay; added purple and white; profile figures of warriors, gods, chariots; meander and palmette borders; flat background, no depth.

styles.name: Exekias
styles.medium: black-figure on terracotta amphorae and cups
styles.features: Black-figure painting with extremely fine incised detail in cloaks, hair and armour; quiet, tense compositions of few figures; strong silhouettes on orange clay; densely patterned textiles; balanced symmetry, gestures held in stillness.
styles.note: Ancient potter-painter; models rarely know the name, rely on features.

styles.name: Attic red-figure vase painting
styles.medium: black gloss with relief lines on terracotta
styles.features: Figures left in orange-red clay against glossy black background; interior details in fine black relief lines and diluted brown washes; foreshortened anatomy, drapery folds, three-quarter views; athletes, banquets, myths; meander and palmette borders.

styles.name: Greek white-ground lekythos painting
styles.medium: white slip with line and wash on terracotta
styles.features: White slip ground on slim oil flasks; delicate thin outlines in red, black or brown; soft washes of red, blue, green and mauve; quiet scenes of mourners and youths beside a grave stele; sparse composition, much empty white.

styles.name: Apulian red-figure vase painting
styles.medium: red-figure with added colour on large vases
styles.features: Crowded multi-level compositions with figures scattered on dotted ground lines; abundant added white, yellow and golden-brown; elaborate floral tendrils, palmettes and small shrine facades; theatrical drapery, frontal heads, ornate jewellery.

styles.name: Macedonian pebble mosaic, Pella
styles.medium: river pebbles set in mortar with lead strips
styles.features: Natural river pebbles in white, cream, ochre and dark tones; thin lead or clay strips tracing contours; light figures and animals on dark ground; lion and stag hunts; muscular bodies shaded by pebble gradation; floral scroll borders.

styles.name: Macedonian tomb painting, Vergina
styles.features: Rapid, sketchy expressive brushstrokes; hatching and loose shading build volume and motion; foreshortened horses and chariots, windswept hair and drapery; muted reds, violets, ochres and greys; dramatic diagonal compositions.

styles.name: Lucanian tomb painting, Paestum
styles.features: Clear outlines and flat warm colours on white ground; banquets, chariot races, duels, horsemen, women mourning; sparse settings; boldly coloured garments, red-brown men; border bands of ivy, pomegranates and fillets.

styles.name: Tanagra terracotta figurines
styles.features: Small statuettes of elegant standing women wrapped in mantles, holding fans, wearing broad-brimmed sun hats; soft pastel paint of pale blue, pink and rose over white slip; gentle sway, fine flowing drapery folds.

styles.name: Thracian tomb painting, Kazanlak
styles.medium: tempera on plaster in domed tomb
styles.features: Ring frieze around a beehive dome: chariots, horses and attendants processing toward a seated couple; elongated graceful figures with soft modelling; restrained ochre, red, black and white on pale ground; ornamental bands of egg-and-dart.

styles.name: Etruscan tomb painting, Tarquinia
styles.features: Lively outlined profile figures with almond eyes and pointed shoes; dancers, flute players, banqueters on couches, hunters, fishermen; dark red-brown men, pale women; slender trees hung with ribbons; bright red, blue, green, ochre.

styles.name: Etruscan engraved bronze mirrors
styles.features: Fine incised lines on the back of polished bronze discs; mythological figures in profile and three-quarter view fitted into a circular field; ivy or laurel wreath borders; pure linear drawing, no colour, warm bronze sheen.

styles.name: Pompeian First Style (masonry style)
styles.features: Moulded stucco imitating blocks of marble and alabaster; raised panels painted with faux-marble veining in yellow, red, black and purple; drafted margins and cornices; no figures, purely architectural masonry effect.

styles.name: Pompeian Second Style (architectural style)
styles.features: Painted architecture opening the wall: columns, receding porticoes, theatrical masks, garlands; deep cinnabar red, ochre and green; life-size figures on a painted podium before red panels; strong light-shade modelling and perspective.

styles.name: Pompeian Third Style (ornamental style)
styles.features: Flat monochrome fields of black, red or white; attenuated candelabra columns, filigree ornament, tiny floating figures and small framed landscape vignettes; elegant, linear, miniature detail; closed walls rather than illusionistic openings.

styles.name: Pompeian Fourth Style (intricate style)
styles.features: Large coloured panels with central mythological pictures and airy fantastic architectural vistas in thin perspective; stage-set structures, swags, flying figures; yellow, red and white grounds; rapid impressionistic brushwork.

styles.name: Roman garden painting, Villa of Livia
styles.features: An unbroken painted garden wrapping the room: dense fruit trees, laurel, oleander, roses, quinces and perching birds against a turquoise sky; low lattice fence and stone wall in front; soft atmospheric depth, rich greens.

styles.name: Roman sacro-idyllic landscape painting
styles.features: Small landscapes painted with quick loose dabs; shrines, sacred trees, rustic bridges, villas by water, shepherds and goats; hazy blue-green and ochre; figures as tiny strokes; light flicked in white; dreamy atmospheric distance.

styles.name: Roman xenia still life
styles.features: Still lifes on painted shelves or ledges; glass bowls of fruit, eggs, game birds, fish, jars, coins; transparent glass shown with white highlights; directional light and cast shadows; plain dark or pale backgrounds.

styles.name: Roman opus vermiculatum mosaic emblema
styles.features: Panel of tiny tesserae laid in curving rows following contours; painterly shading, highlights and subtle gradation; realistic doves, fish, cats, theatre masks, portraits; framed central picture set into a coarser floor.

styles.name: Roman black-and-white mosaic, Ostia
styles.features: Floor mosaic of black silhouettes with white interior lines on white ground; sea creatures, tritons, ships, lighthouses, athletes, merchant emblems; bold graphic shapes without shading; geometric meander borders.

styles.name: Roman Nilotic landscape mosaic
styles.features: Bird's-eye panorama of the flooding Nile winding through marsh, papyrus and reeds; tiny boats, hunters, crocodiles, hippos, ibises, temples, towers and huts stacked toward a high horizon; many small figures.

styles.name: Roman North African floor mosaic
styles.features: Stone tesserae in warm ochres, reds and greens on white; lively hunts, farm estates, arena games, harvests and fish-filled seas; figures scattered across the surface; bold outlines, flattened space, lush vegetal borders.

styles.name: Roman mosaics of Antioch and Zeugma
styles.features: Floor panels in a painterly Hellenistic manner; illusionistic shading, three-quarter faces with large expressive eyes; mythological figures, personifications, banquets; framed panels within perspective meander and wave borders.

styles.name: Roman continuous narrative relief, Trajan's Column
styles.features: Continuous spiral band of shallow marble relief; soldiers marching, building forts, crossing rivers on boat bridges, fighting; hundreds of small overlapping figures; schematic trees and walls; tilted bird's-eye ground.

styles.name: Early Christian catacomb painting
styles.features: Quick sketchy brush outlines in red and green on white plaster; panels framed by thin red lines; shepherds, figures with raised arms, banquets, doves, vines, fish; simple figures with little modelling.
styles.note: Funerary religious imagery; use respectfully.

styles.name: Dura-Europos wall painting
styles.features: Stacked horizontal panels of frontal figures in Parthian trousers and Greek robes with large staring eyes; narrative scenes with repeated characters; flat architecture, armies and crowds; reds, ochres and greys on pale ground.

styles.name: Palmyrene funerary relief
styles.features: Limestone slabs carved with frontal half-length portraits; wide-open eyes with incised pupils; stiff symmetrical poses; abundant jewellery, ornate headbands and veils; crisp linear drapery folds; short Aramaic inscriptions beside heads.

styles.name: Sumerian inlay, Royal Cemetery of Ur
styles.medium: shell, red limestone and lapis lazuli in bitumen
styles.features: White shell figures and red limestone accents set into bitumen against bright lapis blue; registers of small profile figures in fleece skirts, war carts, captives, banqueters, musicians and livestock; flat silhouettes, engraved details.

styles.name: Mesopotamian cylinder seal impressions
styles.features: Continuous repeating frieze rolled into clay; tiny figures in shallow relief; heroes wrestling lions and bulls, processions, enthroned figures; crisp drilled and cut forms; monochrome clay surface, sometimes a small cuneiform panel.

styles.name: Neo-Assyrian palace relief
styles.features: Crisp carved outlines and dense surface detail of curled beards, fringes and muscles; royal lion hunts, battles, sieges, river crossings and deportations in registers; bands of cuneiform; wounded lions carved with taut tension.

styles.name: Babylonian glazed brick relief, Ishtar Gate
styles.features: Moulded relief on glossy glazed bricks in deep cobalt blue; striding lions, bulls and snake-headed dragons in yellow, white and golden brown; rows of rosettes; flat profile animals repeated in friezes; visible brick joints.

styles.name: Achaemenid relief, Persepolis
styles.features: Long processions of profile tribute bearers on stairway walls, each delegation in distinctive dress with gifts and animals; neat curled beards; even rhythm; cypress trees between groups, rosette bands, lion attacking bull.

styles.name: Neo-Hittite orthostat relief
styles.features: Low, heavy relief on stone slabs lining walls; squat blocky figures with large heads and almond eyes; warriors, chariots, hunters, banqueters, winged composite creatures; rounded simple carving; hieroglyphic inscriptions in raised relief.

styles.name: Scythian animal style
styles.region: Eurasian steppe, Black Sea to Siberia
styles.features: Gold plaques and ornaments of contorted animals: crouching stags with branched antlers folded along the back, coiled panthers, griffins, animals locked in combat; bodies built from sharp bevelled planes and swelling curves; polished gold surfaces.

styles.name: Pazyryk felt appliqué, Altai
styles.medium: cut felt appliqué, carved wood and leather
styles.features: Cut coloured felt shapes stitched onto felt; bold stylised elks, tigers, griffins, swans and horsemen; twisted animal bodies marked with scroll and comma shapes; red, blue, yellow, black; flat silhouettes with lively contours.
styles.note: Avoid depicting human remains or tattooed burials.

styles.name: Celtic La Tène metalwork
styles.medium: bronze and gold repoussé, engraving, enamel
styles.features: Flowing curvilinear S-scrolls, triskeles, trumpet spirals and lyre shapes; stylised faces and animal heads melting into ornament; repoussé and engraved bronze, red enamel and coral inlay; asymmetric rhythmic balance.

styles.name: Maya mural painting, Bonampak
styles.features: Lime-plaster walls in stacked registers; figures with fine dark contour lines and flat fills of Maya blue, red ochre and yellow; towering feathered headdresses, jaguar pelts; profile faces, overlapping bodies in processions and battles; flat ground-lines, no perspective
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Maya codex-style vase painting, Late Classic
styles.medium: slip painting on cylindrical ceramic vessel
styles.features: Cream slip ground with calligraphic black brush lines that swell and taper; red rim bands; supple profile figures, lords and animals; small columns of hieroglyphs between figures; one continuous frieze wrapping around the cylinder
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Maya limestone relief carving, Yaxchilán and Palenque
styles.medium: carved limestone lintels and stucco panels
styles.features: Shallow carved relief with crisp incised outlines; profile figures with sloping foreheads, jade jewellery, cascading feather headdresses; densely filled surface framed by glyph blocks; grey-cream stone with traces of red pigment
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Teotihuacan mural painting
styles.medium: mineral pigment on burnished lime plaster
styles.features: Flat, symmetrical, frontal compositions on deep red grounds; dark red outlines; green, ochre and turquoise fills; stylised figures, flowering trees, curling speech scrolls, dotted water streams; many tiny figures playing among patterned borders
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Cacaxtla mural painting
styles.features: Maya-influenced naturalism on blue-black and red grounds; near life-size figures in bird and jaguar costumes; fluid anatomy, crowded battle scenes with spears; bright Maya blue, red, ochre, firm black outlines
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Battle murals show wounded bodies; keep violence implied.

styles.name: Mixtec screenfold codex painting
styles.features: Flat bright colour bounded by even black outlines; squat large-headed figures in profile with name glyphs attached; red guidelines zigzagging across the page; hill-shaped place signs, no ground plane or perspective
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Aztec codex imagery, Codex Mendoza
styles.medium: ink and watercolour on European paper
styles.features: Nahua pictographic figures in thin black outline with flat pale colour; profile people in white mantles, schematic temples and houses, shields, tribute bundles counted with flags and feathers; cream page, little shading, stacked registers
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Original pages carry Spanish glosses; leave out lettering.

styles.name: Florentine Codex illustration, Nahua painters of Tlatelolco
styles.features: Small framed vignettes blending Nahua outline figures with European cues: hatched hills, perspective buildings, leafy trees; muted ochre, green and red washes; people farming, weaving, trading, cooking and fighting
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Aztec (Mexica) stone sculpture
styles.features: Heavy compact volumes in grey volcanic stone; deep crisp relief with geometric framing bands, circular calendrical layouts, feathered serpents, eagles, jaguars; dense symmetrical surfaces, flat planes, traces of red and blue paint
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Mexican feather mosaic (amantecayotl)
styles.medium: iridescent feathers glued on paper and wood panel
styles.features: Shimmering mosaic of tiny cut feathers in turquoise, emerald, cobalt and gold; flat colour areas with sharp edges; round shields with animal emblems or colonial saints; surface shifting colour with light, thin gold outlines
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Olmec stone carving
styles.features: Smooth rounded masses with polished surfaces; faces with full downturned lips, almond eyes, broad flat noses, infant-like bodies; colossal grey basalt heads with helmets, small blue-green jade figures with fine incised lines
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: West Mexican shaft-tomb ceramics, Colima
styles.features: Hand-modelled hollow figures with glossy burnished red-orange slip; plump dogs, parrots, musicians, warriors and villagers in lively everyday poses; simplified rounded bodies, coffee-bean eyes, smooth swelling forms
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Originally tomb offerings; show as figurines or living scenes, not burials.

styles.name: Huichol yarn painting (nierika)
styles.medium: wool yarn pressed into beeswax on plywood
styles.features: Coloured yarn laid in tight parallel and concentric lines; saturated fluorescent pink, orange, turquoise, yellow on dark fields; deer, maize, eagles, suns, snakes and people haloed by contrasting yarn outlines; flat, crowded, symmetrical composition
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Imagery draws on Wixárika spiritual themes; use motifs decoratively, do not stage ceremonies.

styles.name: Huichol beadwork (chaquira)
styles.medium: glass seed beads pressed into beeswax on carved wood
styles.features: Carved animal forms and bowls covered in tiny glass seed beads; bright symmetrical patterns of flowers, deer, scorpions and suns on black grounds; dense dotted mosaic surface with outlined shapes
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Otomí tenango embroidery
styles.features: Satin-stitched flat silhouettes on white cotton; roosters, deer, rabbits, birds, flowering plants and small human figures filling the cloth; one colour per piece or rainbow multicolour; no outlines, mirrored compositions
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Nahua amate bark painting, Guerrero
styles.medium: acrylic or gouache on amate bark paper
styles.features: Rough brown bark-paper ground; bright flat-coloured birds, flowers and leaves in dense swirling layouts, or busy village scenes with tiny figures, churches and fiestas; black outlines, no perspective, layered horizontal bands
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Maya backstrap-woven huipil brocade, Guatemalan Highlands
styles.features: Dense supplementary-weft brocade on red or white cotton; rows of zigzags, diamonds, stylised birds, horses and trees; vivid red, purple, yellow and green; tiny stepped pixel-like motifs, embroidered rosette around the neck opening
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Tz'utujil Maya naïve painting, Lake Atitlán
styles.features: Bright flat oil colour with crisp detail; volcanoes and lake framing villages; tilted bird's-eye views of coffee harvests, markets and processions; many small figures in striped traditional dress working in neat rows
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Guna mola
styles.features: Several layers of cotton cut away to reveal colours beneath; thick parallel channels echoing each shape; red, black, orange, yellow, green; stylised fish, birds and animals with maze-like outlines, small slits and triangles filling space
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Coclé polychrome pottery, Sitio Conte
styles.features: Cream-ground plates painted in black and purple-red slip; crocodiles, birds and rays with hooked, curling scroll limbs packed into circular fields; bold outlines, whirling rotational symmetry around the centre
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Quimbaya goldwork
styles.features: Smooth gleaming cast gold with warm reddish tone; seated figures with calm closed eyes, rounded swelling bodies, flat heads; bottle-shaped flasks, nose and ear ornaments with fine wire-like edges
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Chavín stone relief
styles.features: Flat incised relief with continuous curving outlines; fanged feline mouths, serpent hair, eyes with eccentric pupils; ambiguous lines that read as several faces at once; dense, symmetrical, hard-edged design on grey stone
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Paracas embroidered mantles
styles.medium: camelid-wool stem-stitch embroidery on woven cloth
styles.features: Repeated flying figures arranged in a grid on dark grounds; stem-stitch embroidery in deep red, golden yellow, blue-green and olive; masked beings with streaming hair and staffs; colour sequences rotating diagonally across the cloth
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Nazca polychrome ceramics
styles.features: Highly polished vessels painted in many slip colours: cream, rust, ochre, grey, black, violet; flat outlined birds, fish, fruits, beans and masked beings; crisp black contours; symmetrical repeating bands around rounded bowls
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Moche fineline ceramic painting
styles.medium: red-brown slip on cream-slipped stirrup-spout vessels
styles.features: Two-colour drawing in red-brown on cream; slender lively profile figures running, fighting, hunting deer, fishing from reed boats; fine continuous lines, dotted fills, scenes wrapping around the vessel without ground lines
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Moche portrait vessels
styles.medium: mould-made earthenware with cream and red slip
styles.features: Lifelike modelled human heads forming stirrup-spout jars; individual faces with wrinkles, scars and calm gazes; patterned headbands and caps in red on cream; smooth burnished surface, quiet sculptural naturalism
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Wari tapestry tunics
styles.features: Bold vertical columns of profile heads and staff-bearing figures, compressed, stretched and mirrored until nearly abstract; stepped frets, split eyes; saturated red, gold, indigo and tan; hard rectilinear edges
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Chimú metalwork
styles.medium: hammered and repoussé gold and silver sheet
styles.features: Thin sheet gold and silver beaten into low relief; rows of repeated birds, fish and crested figures; beakers with embossed faces, crescent-bladed knives, dangling spangles; bright polished metal, frontal symmetrical figures with fan headdresses
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Inca tapestry tunic with tocapu
styles.medium: fine interlocked tapestry (cumbi) in camelid fibre and cotton
styles.features: Grid of small square blocks, each holding a different geometric sign: stepped crosses, checkerboards, diagonals, diamonds; strong red, black, white, yellow and blue; dense regular weave, hard rectilinear shapes
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Colonial Andean qero cups
styles.medium: carved wood with pigmented resin inlay
styles.features: Flaring wooden beakers with dark brown ground; horizontal registers of figures inlaid in glossy red, green, yellow and white; Inca lords, dancers, rainbows, flowering vines and tocapu bands; flat colour, slightly raised surface
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Cusco school painting
styles.medium: oil on canvas with gold-leaf brocade
styles.features: Flat frontal figures with triangular silhouettes; garments overlaid with stencilled gold-leaf brocade patterns; deep red and blue backgrounds, Andean birds and flowers; archangels with arquebuses; decorative pattern over volume
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Diego Quispe Tito
styles.features: Compositions adapted from Flemish engravings; deep luminous landscapes with dense trees, many birds and small figures; cool green-blue distances against warm foreground; careful small-scale detail, soft modelling
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Marcos Zapata
styles.features: Large crowded canvases with richly dressed figures; heavy gold brocade stencilled on robes; Andean flora, fauna and foods inserted into scenes; warm reds, ochres and browns; flattened, stage-like space with draped backdrops
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Ayacucho retablo
styles.medium: painted wooden box with modelled plaster-and-potato-paste figures
styles.features: Hinged wooden box with flower-painted doors; two or more stacked floors packed with tiny modelled figures: musicians, weavers, harvests, fiestas; bright pink, green and yellow paint; shallow theatrical diorama depth
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Peruvian carved gourd (mate burilado)
styles.features: Rounded gourd surface finely incised and darkened by burning; dense continuous scenes of village life, harvests, bullfights, trains in brown-black on tan; tiny cross-hatched figures spiralling around the curved surface
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Shipibo-Konibo kené design
styles.medium: painted and embroidered cotton, painted ceramic
styles.features: Dense labyrinthine grids of thick and thin lines, crosses, rhombi and meanders covering the entire surface; dark brown or black on cream cloth, or white on indigo; no figures, symmetrical maze-like flow
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Kené is linked to Shipibo song and healing; use only as decorative surface pattern.

styles.name: Tigua painting
styles.medium: enamel or acrylic on stretched sheepskin
styles.features: Flat bright colours on sheepskin within a painted border; steep Andean slopes with patchwork fields, volcanoes and condors; tiny Quichua villagers in red ponchos and felt hats at harvests, markets and fiestas; tilted, stacked space
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Marajoara pottery
styles.features: Large vessels with white slip painted in red and black; curving symmetrical scrolls and spiral meanders; deeply incised channels and excised relief; modelled faces with wide eyes; figurines covered in geometric patterns
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Large urns were funerary; show as vessels, not burials.

styles.name: Wayuu mochila weaving
styles.medium: single-thread crochet in cotton or acrylic yarn
styles.features: Tightly crocheted cylindrical bags; bands of geometric kanaas motifs: diamonds, zigzags, stepped lozenges in high-contrast saturated colours; long braided straps and tassels; tight pixel-like stitch texture
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Mapuche silverwork
styles.features: Large chest ornaments of hammered silver with stacked plates, cross shapes and stylised birds or paired heads; dangling discs and chains; punched dots and engraved lines; bright cold metal worn against dark wool
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Northwest Coast formline design
styles.medium: carved and painted cedar, painted hide
styles.features: Continuous swelling black primary formlines, red secondary lines, blue-green fills; ovoids and U-forms; split, symmetrical animal bodies filling the whole field; tapering cut-away lines, no background space
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Crest designs belong to specific families; render generic animals, not real crests.

styles.name: Bill Reid
styles.medium: carved cedar, bronze, gold and silver
styles.features: Haida creatures (raven, bear, killer whale, frog) interlocking in dense groups; smooth polished volumes with incised ovoids; deep green-black bronze or burnished gold; crisp, tight carving with bold silhouettes
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Mungo Martin
styles.features: Tall carved poles with deep sculptural relief; outstretched wings and projecting beaks; bright commercial paint in red, black, white, green and yellow; bold outlines, expressive faces with flaring brows
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Show carved poles and panels; avoid ceremonial masks in use.

styles.name: Charles Edenshaw
styles.medium: carved argillite, engraved silver and gold
styles.features: Glossy black argillite platters and chests with tightly interlocked figures; delicately engraved ovoids and formlines; silver bracelets with fluid split-animal designs; refined, compact compositions
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Nampeyo
styles.features: Wide low-shouldered jars in warm yellow-orange polished clay; black and red painted bird-wing, feather and scroll motifs in sweeping asymmetric designs; fine brush lines, generous open space
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Pitseolak Ashoona
styles.medium: felt-tip drawing, stonecut and stencil print
styles.features: Lively felt-pen line and flat colour; women in parkas with babies, hunters, dog teams, skin tents and spirits of old camp life; figures floating on white ground, simple outlines, warm gestures
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Jessie Oonark
styles.medium: stencil print, wool felt wall hanging with embroidery
styles.features: Bold symmetrical compositions in flat bright colour; women in parkas with braided hair, crescent ulu knives, facial tattoo lines; figures stacked in rows or radiating; felt appliqué shapes edged with stitching
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Helen Kalvak
styles.medium: stonecut and stencil print on paper
styles.features: Sparse prints with small dark figures on white paper; muted black, red and earth colours; hunters, drum dancers, people transforming into animals; minimal ground, simple rounded silhouettes, quiet narrative spacing
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Pudlo Pudlat
styles.medium: stonecut, lithograph, acrylic wash on paper
styles.features: Loose expressive line and translucent washes; airplanes, helicopters and umbrellas meeting muskox, birds and Arctic hills; open white space, playful shifts of scale, soft blue-greens and oranges
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Kananginak Pootoogook
styles.medium: stonecut and stencil print, coloured pencil drawing
styles.features: Closely observed Arctic birds and animals (ravens, gyrfalcons, owls, walrus) with precise feather and fur detail; firm outlines; natural greys, browns and whites set against plain paper
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Annie Pootoogook
styles.medium: coloured pencil and ink on paper
styles.features: Coloured-pencil drawings of present-day northern homes: televisions, kettles, linoleum floors, family at the table; flat, slightly tilted perspective; clean ink outlines, light pastel colour, candid everyday detail
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Kiowa Six flat-style painting
styles.features: Flat opaque colour on plain paper, no background or ground line; dancers in feather bustles, fringed buckskin and beadwork in crisp detail; fine outlines, graceful profile motion, strong decorative clarity
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas
styles.note: Some works show peyote ceremonies; prefer social dances and hunts.

styles.name: Plains ledger drawing
styles.medium: pencil, crayon and ink on ruled ledger-book paper
styles.features: Coloured-pencil and ink figures over printed ruled lines; mounted riders in profile, horses in flying gallop, hunts, courting couples, camp life; flat colour, simple contours, little or no setting
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Pablita Velarde
styles.medium: ground earth pigments and casein on board
styles.features: Flat Studio-style figures of Pueblo women baking bread, grinding corn, shaping pottery; clean outlines, soft earth tones from mineral pigments; matte gritty surface, orderly balanced compositions
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Maria Martinez
styles.features: Mirror-polished black clay vessels with matte black painted designs; feather bands, stepped geometric motifs and curving serpent forms, matte against gloss; full rounded, balanced shapes
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Daphne Odjig
styles.features: Heavy black outlines enclosing flowing curved planes of colour; interlocking figures of mothers, lovers and dancers embracing in rhythmic curves; vivid purple, orange and blue; Cubist-like fragmentation of forms
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Navajo weaving, Two Grey Hills and Ganado
styles.features: Tightly woven wool rugs with central diamonds, stepped terraces and serrated zigzags; natural white, grey, brown and black, or deep red with black; bordered, symmetrical layouts, crisp stepped edges
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Métis floral beadwork
styles.medium: glass seed beads embroidered on velvet and smoked hide
styles.features: Sprays of flowers, berries, leaves and curling tendrils in multicolour seed beads on black velvet or hide; outlined petals, two-tone shading, graceful stems, slightly raised beaded surface
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Seminole patchwork
styles.features: Narrow horizontal bands of tiny pieced geometric units (diamonds, sawteeth, crosses, checks) in bright red, yellow, blue, black and white, separated by solid stripes and rickrack on long skirts and jackets
styles.section: Pre-Columbian and Indigenous art of the Americas

styles.name: Diego Rivera
styles.features: Monumental rounded simplified figures with smooth volumes and clear contours, warm brown skin, earthy ochres, terracotta and leaf greens, calla lilies, workers and machinery packed into flattened, frieze-like stacked registers

styles.name: José Clemente Orozco
styles.features: Expressionist fresco with slashing angular contours, harsh chiaroscuro, contorted muscular figures, flames and broken bodies, fiery reds, blacks, ash greys and bone whites, violent diagonal compositions under vaulted ceilings

styles.name: David Alfaro Siqueiros
styles.medium: pyroxylin and acrylic on wall and panel, spray gun
styles.features: Dynamic extreme foreshortening, figures and fists thrusting toward the viewer, polyangular perspective on curved walls, sculptural muscular masses with metallic sheen, sprayed and poured paint, dark browns, blood reds and steel greys

styles.name: Rufino Tamayo
styles.medium: oil on canvas mixed with sand and marble dust
styles.features: Scraped gritty textured surfaces, intense watermelon pinks, magenta, turquoise and earth tones, simplified geometric figures with mask-like pre-Columbian heads, howling dogs, starry night skies, shallow flat space

styles.name: Juan O'Gorman
styles.medium: tempera on masonite; natural stone mosaic murals
styles.features: Meticulous miniature-like detail across wide panoramas, crisp outlines, countless tiny figures, cut-away buildings and fantastical architecture, deep valleys and volcanoes under clear cerulean skies, mosaic of coloured natural stones

styles.name: Jean Charlot
styles.features: Massive block-like rounded figures of kneeling indigenous women, mothers with children, tortilla makers, simple geometric volumes, heavy draped rebozos, few flat colours in lithographic crayon texture, calm compact compositions

styles.name: Dr. Atl (Gerardo Murillo)
styles.medium: Atl-colours (resin and wax crayons) on panel
styles.features: Vast aerial views of volcanoes and valleys, curvilinear bowed horizon as if seen through a fisheye, smoking craters, sweeping cloud bands, saturated blues, violet shadows and ochre earth in dry waxy strokes

styles.name: Saturnino Herrán
styles.features: Mexican modernismo blending Symbolism and Art Nouveau, idealised indigenous and mestizo figures in long decorative friezes, rebozos, baskets and flowers, warm golden light, honey browns and soft greens, graceful outlines

styles.name: Olga Costa
styles.features: Flat bright decorative colour, market women among heaps of tropical fruit, cut melons, pineapples and papayas, patterned baskets and textiles, simplified rounded forms, crowded tilted tabletops, naive-modern clarity

styles.name: Jesús Helguera
styles.medium: oil on canvas for printed calendars
styles.features: Glossy academic realism with saturated chromolithograph colour, idealised muscular Aztec warriors and princesses in feathers, smoking snow-capped volcanoes, charros and rural belles, dramatic sunsets, sentimental romantic poses
styles.note: Calendar-art look; can turn kitsch

styles.name: Leopoldo Méndez
styles.medium: linocut and wood engraving on paper
styles.features: Deep velvety black fields cut by fine white gouged lines, dramatic contrast, peasants, soldiers and revolutionaries, expressive faces, rhythmic engraved textures for earth and sky, cinematic compositions

styles.name: Taller de Gráfica Popular linocut poster, Mexico City
styles.medium: linocut on newsprint, black plus one colour
styles.features: Bold gouged black linocut figures of workers and campesinos, raised fists, simplified heavy forms, flat red or ochre second colour, blocky hand-cut lettering integrated into the image

styles.name: Emiliano Di Cavalcanti
styles.features: Sensual curvy mulata women, samba dancers, fishermen and carnival revellers, rounded heavy forms with cubist faceting, warm ochres, rusts, deep greens and blues, lush tropical backdrops

styles.name: Lasar Segall
styles.features: Angular expressionist figures with geometric faceting, melancholy emigrants on ship decks, women in doorways, banana plantations, muted greens, earth browns and greys, dense thinly layered surfaces

styles.name: Alfredo Volpi
styles.features: Rows of small triangular festival flags and simplified house façades, flat geometric rhythms, chalky soft colours with visible hand brushwork, pinks, blues, terracotta and lemon, no shadows

styles.name: Ismael Nery
styles.features: Elongated androgynous figures, fused and doubled bodies, surreal floating poses, smooth simplified anatomy, cool greys, blues and pale pinks, empty dreamlike spaces

styles.name: Vicente do Rego Monteiro
styles.features: Art Deco figures modelled like low-relief stone carvings, smooth rounded volumes, almond eyes, stylised indigenous bodies and Amazonian legends, ceramic-inspired geometric motifs, muted greys, browns and ochres

styles.name: Djanira
styles.features: Naive-modern flat colour planes, crisp outlines, rows of workers, miners and tea pickers, popular religious festivals and processions, clear bright blues, reds and greens, frontal orderly compositions

styles.name: Oswaldo Goeldi
styles.features: Dominant black woodcut with sharp white gouged lines, nocturnal fishing towns and rain-swept streets, lonely figures, vultures and fish, sudden small accents of red or yellow

styles.name: José Sabogal
styles.features: Indigenist Andean figures in ponchos and woven skirts, broad flat brushwork, firm dark contours, ochres, olive greens and slate blues, Cusco colonial streets and mountain backdrops

styles.name: Julia Codesido
styles.features: Stylised indigenous women and men with simplified block-like volumes, strong outlines, flat pure colour areas, saturated reds, blues and ochres, calm frontal poses, synthetic modern composition

styles.name: Oswaldo Guayasamín
styles.features: Anguished angular faces and huge bony hands, cubist-expressionist fragmentation, heavy black contour lines, palette of ochre, brown, grey and blood red, flat backgrounds, weeping and screaming figures

styles.name: Eduardo Kingman
styles.features: Bent indigenous labourers carrying loads, oversized expressive hands, rounded heavy volumes, thick dark outlines, earthy browns, olive and dusty blue, social-realist dignity

styles.name: Camilo Egas
styles.features: Stately frieze-like processions of Andean indigenous dancers and festival-goers, idealised rounded figures in ponchos and hats, smooth modelling, warm ochres, reds and deep blues

styles.name: Cecilio Guzmán de Rojas
styles.features: Stylised elongated Aymara figures with smooth polished volumes, Art Deco rhythms, cool blue-violet altiplano light, Lake Titicaca and snowy peaks, sharp geometric folds in shawls

styles.name: Peruvian retablo, Ayacucho
styles.medium: painted wooden box with plaster and potato-paste figurines
styles.features: Hinged wooden box with doors painted in bright flowers, interior tiers of small painted figurines, market, festival and village scenes, vivid pinks, reds and greens, tiny repeated figures
styles.note: Three-dimensional object; prompt as a photographed diorama

styles.name: Amelia Peláez
styles.features: Thick black curving outlines like leaded stained glass, colonial fanlight windows and wrought-iron grilles, fruit and flower still lifes, interlocking bright reds, blues, yellows and whites, dense decorative pattern

styles.name: Víctor Manuel García
styles.features: Gentle almond-eyed women with oval faces, soft simplified forms, muted greens, warm browns and dusty blues, calm frontal portraits, quiet coastal and village backgrounds

styles.name: Carlos Enríquez
styles.features: Transparent swirling veils of colour, overlapping translucent horses, riders and figures, rural Cuban romance and banditry, sensual movement, rose, green and gold tones blending into landscape

styles.name: René Portocarrero
styles.features: Dense baroque Havana cityscapes and cathedral façades woven from tangled lines, swirling ornament filling every surface, saturated reds, yellows and blues, carnival devils and flower-crowned women

styles.name: Haitian naive painting, Centre d'Art, Port-au-Prince
styles.features: Flat bright colours, lush layered vegetation, crowded market scenes with tiny figures and baskets, tin-roofed houses on green hills, no linear perspective, decorative repeated patterning of leaves and fruit
styles.note: Avoid specific religious ritual imagery

styles.name: John Dunkley
styles.features: Brooding dark tonal palette of browns, deep greens and black, stylised rhythmic plants and banana leaves, winding paths and tunnels, small animals and birds, smooth patient surfaces, mysterious enclosed landscapes

styles.name: Puerto Rican silkscreen poster, DIVEDCO
styles.features: Flat layered screenprint colours, rural jíbaro families, farmers and children, bold simplified shapes, textured overprinting, warm earth reds, greens and ochres, integrated hand-drawn display lettering

styles.name: Joaquín Torres-García
styles.medium: oil and tempera on board and wood
styles.features: Irregular hand-drawn grid of compartments each holding a pictogram, fish, anchor, clock, sun, house, stick figure, palette of ochre, brown, black and off-white, flat matte paint

styles.name: Pedro Figari
styles.features: Quick sketchy brushwork on cardboard, small doll-like figures dancing candombe or gathering at estancias, colonial patios, large soft skies, pastel and earth tones, nostalgic memory scenes

styles.name: Rafael Barradas
styles.features: Vibrationist fragmented city scenes, overlapping transparent planes, crowds, trams and cafés splintered into dynamic shards, prismatic colour, fragments of signage, sense of movement and noise

styles.name: Xul Solar
styles.features: Small luminous watercolours of floating fantastical cities, ladders, flags, serpents and winged beings, invented signs and grids, translucent jewel-like colour, flat mystical diagrammatic space

styles.name: Benito Quinquela Martín
styles.features: Thick impasto port scenes, hulls of ships, cranes, smoke and toiling stevedores, saturated oranges, reds, blues and yellows, energetic loaded brushstrokes, crowded docks under heavy skies

styles.name: Antonio Berni
styles.medium: collage of scrap materials and oil on board
styles.features: Large collage-paintings built from tin cans, wood scraps, fabric and metal, shantytown children and working-class figures, painted faces in expressive line, rusted textures, gritty urban edges

styles.name: Florencio Molina Campos
styles.features: Humorous caricature gauchos with bulbous noses and bowed legs, scrawny horses, wide pampa under big skies, pale washed colours, loose comic drawing, rural scenes of ranch life

styles.name: José Cúneo
styles.features: Huge glowing moons over rural ranchos, swirling expressionist skies, thick dragged paint, dark greens, inky blues and sulphur yellows, lonely low houses and twisted trees

styles.name: Raquel Forner
styles.features: Expressionist visions of suffering figures and later astronauts and mutant cosmic beings, fragmented bodies in floating space, intense reds, blues and blacks, dramatic brushwork, apocalyptic symbolic scenes

styles.name: Maori kowhaiwhai rafter painting
styles.medium: natural pigments on carved wooden rafter boards
styles.features: Flowing curvilinear scroll patterns built from koru (unfurling fern-frond hooks) in red ochre, black and white. Symmetrical repeats run along long narrow boards. Flat colour and crisp interlocking positive and negative shapes.

styles.name: Maori tukutuku lattice panels
styles.medium: flax and kiekie fibre stitched over wooden laths
styles.features: Geometric stitched wall panels of stepped zigzags, diamonds, small crosses and vertical bars in golden-yellow, black and red-brown fibre over a ground of slatted wooden rods. Tight, grid-like woven texture.

styles.name: Maori taniko weaving
styles.medium: finger-twined flax fibre borders on cloaks
styles.features: Dense geometric bands of triangles, diamonds and zigzags in black, red-brown, white and yellow with a tight twined texture. Worn as borders on soft fibre cloaks and headbands, with crisp stepped edges.

styles.name: Maori whakairo wood carving
styles.medium: carved and red-ochred timber, paua shell inlay
styles.features: Deep-relief wood carving covered in spirals, double spirals and notched chevron surface patterns. Stylised figures have large heads, poking tongues and glinting iridescent paua shell eyes. The timber is stained deep red ochre.
styles.note: Show as carved architecture or canoe decoration, not as specific ancestor figures

styles.name: Tongan ngatu barkcloth
styles.medium: beaten mulberry barkcloth, rubbed and painted
styles.features: Very large sheets of tan barkcloth are rubbed over relief pattern tablets, then overpainted in dark brown and rust-red. Bold grid panels hold geometric motifs, stylised leaves, and sometimes lions, crowns or doves.

styles.name: Samoan siapo mamanu
styles.features: Beaten barkcloth painted freehand in deep chocolate-brown dye on a light tan ground. A grid of squares and bands holds repeated motifs of pandanus, starfish, breadfruit leaves and trochus shell in thick, slightly irregular brushed lines.

styles.name: Fijian masi kesa stencilled barkcloth
styles.features: Stencil-printed barkcloth in sooty matt black and terracotta red on cream. Tight geometric repeats of triangles, stars, crosses and lattices sit in bordered rectangles, with crisp stencil edges and dense rhythmic pattern.

styles.name: Hawaiian kapa barkcloth
styles.medium: beaten wauke bark cloth, bamboo-stamped and dyed
styles.features: Thin, fine barkcloth with a ribbed watermark texture, stamped with small carved bamboo tools. Rows of chevrons, zigzags, tiny triangles and parallel lines appear in black, red, ochre and soft green on cream or dyed grounds.

styles.name: Niuean hiapo barkcloth
styles.features: Fine freehand brown-black lines on pale barkcloth. Naturalistic leaves, vines and flowers sit inside geometric frames and radiating borders, with occasional small human figures. The composition is airy, open and delicately drawn.

styles.name: Ömie barkcloth (nioge), Oro Province
styles.features: Soft beaten barkcloth painted with natural pigments in black, red-brown and ochre. Meandering wavy lines, circles, dots, zigzags and hooked forms evoke mountain ridges, rivers, vines and animal markings in asymmetric all-over designs.
styles.note: Evoke the general look rather than copying individual artists' clan designs

styles.name: Maisin tapa, Collingwood Bay
styles.features: Tan barkcloth with bold black curvilinear scrolls, spirals and meanders outlined in thin lines, the spaces filled with patches of brick-red. Swirling symmetrical layouts with a hand-painted, slightly uneven edge.

styles.name: Sepik storyboards, Kambot
styles.medium: carved and painted wooden relief panels
styles.features: Flat wooden panels carved in low relief with crowded rows of stylised people, crocodiles, birds, canoes and stilt houses. Outlines are picked out in white lime, red ochre, yellow and black, with figures arranged in narrative bands.

styles.name: Palauan storyboards
styles.features: Long low-relief carved wooden planks showing rows of small flat figures, palms, outrigger canoes, fish and high-gabled meeting houses in a continuous narrative strip. Natural wood or painted in red, yellow, black and white.

styles.name: Lapita dentate-stamped pottery
styles.features: Reddish-brown pots covered in bands of tiny comb-toothed stamp impressions forming intricate geometric meanders, arcs and stylised face motifs. White lime infill makes the dotted patterns glow against the clay.

styles.name: Solomon Islands shell inlay
styles.medium: nautilus mother-of-pearl inlaid in blackened wood
styles.features: Wood blackened with nut paste and inlaid with tiny cut slivers of iridescent nautilus shell. Rows, zigzags, chevrons, frigate birds and fish make a strong contrast of glossy black and shimmering white.

styles.name: Massim canoe splashboard carving, Trobriand Islands
styles.features: Flat wooden boards with crisp deep incisions forming flowing interlocking scrolls, spirals and stylised bird heads. Painted in red ochre, charcoal black and white lime, with a symmetrical, rhythmic layout.

styles.name: Cook Islands tivaevae
styles.features: Large bedcovers of bright cotton appliqué: oversized stylised hibiscus, leaves and vines cut as one symmetrical piece and stitched onto a contrasting ground, or embroidered pieced squares. Saturated pinks, yellows, reds and greens.

styles.name: Hawaiian appliqué quilt
styles.features: Two-colour quilts with one large symmetrical appliqué cut from folded fabric like a paper snowflake, showing breadfruit leaves, flowers or crowns. Echo-quilting lines ripple outward around the shape like waves.

styles.name: Hawaiian featherwork cloaks ('ahu'ula)
styles.medium: bird feathers tied onto netted plant fibre
styles.features: Densely packed tiny red and yellow feathers with touches of black on a netted fibre backing. Bold crescents, triangles and bands give a velvety, glowing surface on wide semicircular cloaks and crested helmets.

styles.name: Jacques Boullaire
styles.features: Crisp black-and-white wood engravings and light watercolours with fine parallel cutting lines and clear outlines. Islanders, outrigger canoes, palms and steep volcanic peaks sit under luminous, open, empty skies.

styles.name: William Hodges
styles.features: Warm hazy tropical light over coastlines with steep volcanic peaks, calm bays, war canoes and small figures. Loose, broken brushwork in luminous skies, with a golden ochre and blue-grey palette.

styles.name: Sydney Parkinson
styles.features: Precise natural-history studies of single plants, birds and fish isolated on white paper. Fine contour lines, with some leaves and flowers fully coloured and others left as delicate pencil outline.

styles.name: John Glover
styles.features: Luminous golden light over wide pastoral valleys. Twisting gum trees with sinuous thin trunks and sparse foliage are silhouetted against the sky. Tiny figures and fine, detailed brushwork in a picturesque manner.

styles.name: Conrad Martens
styles.features: Atmospheric watercolour washes with soft golden-pink skies over harbour coves, sailing ships at anchor, sandstone headlands and small colonial buildings. Hazy, glowing light and gentle receding distances.

styles.name: Eugene von Guérard
styles.features: Meticulous, detailed oils of mountains, fern gullies, waterfalls and volcanic plains with crisp topographic precision. Clear even light, tiny figures dwarfed by vast terrain, and cool greens and blues.

styles.name: Charles Conder
styles.medium: oil on panel; watercolour on silk
styles.features: Delicate pastel sunlit beaches and bays with small sketchy figures under parasols, in thin creamy paint. Also watercolour on silk fans with whimsical figures in soft pinks, lilacs and pale blues.

styles.name: Jane Sutherland
styles.features: Soft plein-air oils of open grassy paddocks with children and women gathering flowers or crossing streams. Gentle, diffuse sunlight, pale greens and straw yellows, and delicate small brushwork.

styles.name: Margaret Preston
styles.features: Bold black-outlined woodcuts hand-coloured in flat, clear hues. Banksia, waratah and gum blossom are packed into vases, cropped close, with angular modernist simplification and strong decorative pattern.
styles.note: Keep to her native-flower prints; her later borrowing of Aboriginal motifs should not be imitated

styles.name: Grace Cossington Smith
styles.features: Radiant interiors and city scenes built from separate short square brushstrokes of clear colour. Luminous yellows, pinks and blues, with light pouring through open doors and windows onto furniture and flowers.

styles.name: Ethel Spowers
styles.features: Colour linocuts with bold flat shapes and rhythmic curving lines conveying movement. Children playing, and figures leaning into wind or rain, in a limited palette of three or four colours with strong stylised silhouettes.

styles.name: Hans Heysen
styles.features: Towering river red gums with massive pale trunks in dusty golden light, cattle or sheep grazing beneath. Rugged ochre ranges in the distance, crisp light-and-shadow modelling and detailed bark texture.

styles.name: Albert Namatjira
styles.features: Crisp watercolours of central Australian country: ghost gums with brilliant white trunks, purple and red rocky ranges, and vivid blue skies. Precise detail, strong dry light and clear saturated washes.
styles.note: Secular Western-style landscapes only

styles.name: Russell Drysdale
styles.features: Drought-stricken outback with red-ochre earth, dead trees, empty horizons and small corrugated-iron buildings. Elongated, stick-like figures stand in eerie, surreal stillness, painted in thin dry layers.

styles.name: Fred Williams
styles.features: Sparse, flattened landscapes seen from above, often without a horizon. Scattered dabs, blobs and short calligraphic marks stand for trees and scrub on broad ochre, grey or yellow grounds.

styles.name: Ian Fairweather
styles.medium: synthetic polymer and gouache on cardboard
styles.features: Intricate webs of scratchy calligraphic line over matt layered paint, with interlocking figures emerging from near-abstract tangles. Earthy ochres, greys, chalky whites and black, and a dense all-over surface.

styles.name: Brett Whiteley
styles.features: Sinuous curving lines and large fields of saturated ultramarine harbour water. Swift calligraphic drawing of palms, birds and boats, with sensual curved shorelines, generous empty space and occasional collage elements.

styles.name: Ida Rentoul Outhwaite
styles.features: Slender winged fairies among Australian flowers, koalas and possums. Art Nouveau curving silhouettes, fine black pen line and pale luminous washes, often set against moonlit or misty grounds.

styles.name: Ellis Rowan
styles.features: Lush, detailed paintings of native flowers with birds, butterflies and insects arranged together naturally. Rich saturated colour, carefully modelled petals and leaves, on plain or softly tinted grounds.

styles.name: James Northfield
styles.features: Bold flat-colour travel posters with simplified beaches, mountains and stylised gum trees. Strong silhouettes and a vivid sunlit palette, with Art Deco lettering integrated into the design.

styles.name: Gottfried Lindauer
styles.features: Highly detailed realist oil portraits with a smooth finish against dark neutral backgrounds. Sitters wear flax and feather cloaks and greenstone pendants, with precise rendering of fabric texture and skin.
styles.note: Depict generic figures; do not reproduce facial moko or real ancestors

styles.name: Charles Heaphy
styles.features: Clear, detailed topographic watercolours of panoramic harbours, bush-covered hills and volcanic cones. Fine pen outlines under bright washes, with small canoes, huts and early settlements.

styles.name: Petrus van der Velden
styles.features: Dark, turbulent oils of narrow mountain gorges, rushing torrents, tumbled boulders and storm clouds. Heavy impasto and dramatic chiaroscuro in deep browns, greys and slate blues.

styles.name: Frances Hodgkins
styles.features: Loose modernist still lifes set outdoors, with jugs, flowers and shells against fields and farm buildings. Chalky, earthy colours, free scribbled line and flattened, tilted space.

styles.name: Rita Angus
styles.features: Clean-edged regionalist landscapes of smooth rounded hills, small farm buildings and railway sheds under clear hard light. Precise flat forms in cool greens, ochres and blues, and frontal, still portraits.

styles.name: Colin McCahon
styles.features: Brooding landscapes of broad dark hill bands meeting luminous skies. Hand-painted words and numerals in white run across black or brown grounds, with raw, urgent brushwork and stark contrast.
styles.note: Hand-painted lettering is central to the look

styles.name: Gordon Walters
styles.features: Hard-edged horizontal stripes ending in round bulbs, abstracted from the koru, in black and white or blue. The stripes alternate in rhythmic positive-negative patterns, painted flat with no visible brushwork.
styles.note: Abstract; his use of the koru motif has been debated

styles.name: Madge Tennent
styles.features: Monumental Hawaiian women with massive rounded, sculptural bodies built from thick sweeping brushstrokes. Warm browns, terracotta, rose and turquoise give a sense of weight and repose.

styles.name: Eugene Savage
styles.features: Lush decorative scenes of Hawaiian feasts, voyages and ceremonies with idealised stylised figures. Dense tropical flowers and leis, bright Art Deco colour and crowded frieze-like compositions.

styles.name: Hawaiian aloha-shirt textile prints
styles.features: Dense all-over repeats of hibiscus, palm fronds, outrigger canoes, surfboards and ukuleles. Flat screen-printed colour in bold contrasting hues on dark or bright grounds, with crisp graphic outlines.

styles.name: Mathias Kauage
styles.features: Bright flat acrylic figures with large heads and bodies filled with dense dots, stripes and zigzags. Airplanes, helicopters and cars appear alongside people in frontal symmetrical compositions of saturated red, yellow and blue.

styles.name: Timothy Akis
styles.medium: pen and ink on paper; screenprint
styles.features: Black pen-and-ink drawings on white paper of humans, cassowaries, possums and pigs merged into fantastical forms. Flat silhouette shapes filled with fine hatching and stippled texture.

styles.name: Gothic stained glass, Chartres Cathedral school
styles.medium: leaded pot-metal glass with painted grisaille
styles.features: Deep cobalt blue and ruby red glass pieces held by thick black lead lines, iron bars dividing round medallions, flat frontal figures with painted grisaille faces and drapery folds, no perspective, glowing translucent colour

styles.name: Marc Chagall, stained glass windows
styles.medium: leaded stained glass with painted grisaille
styles.features: Broad fields of one saturated colour, deep ultramarine, red or yellow, spreading across many panes, loose painted black linework, floating figures, angels, animals and flowers, lead lines cutting freely across forms

styles.name: Byzantine mosaic, Ravenna
styles.medium: glass and gold smalti tesserae on wall plaster
styles.features: Small glass cubes set at slight angles so they glint, shimmering gold ground, frontal symmetrical figures with large dark eyes and white robes, processions of saints, stylised palms and sheep, shallow flat space

styles.name: Roman floor mosaic, North Africa
styles.medium: stone and marble tesserae on floor mortar
styles.features: Small natural stone cubes in ochre, terracotta, grey, black and cream, hunting, fishing and farm scenes, fish and sea creatures, rounded modelling with graded tesserae rows, white ground with dark outlines

styles.name: Trencadís broken-tile mosaic, Antoni Gaudí
styles.medium: broken glazed ceramic and glass shards in mortar
styles.features: Irregular shards of glossy broken tile and crockery covering curved, undulating surfaces, wide white grout seams, bright blues, greens, yellows and white, organic rippling forms, lizards, waves and swirling flowers

styles.name: Soviet monumental smalt mosaic
styles.medium: smalt glass mosaic on building facades
styles.features: Huge wall panels of coarse smalt cubes, simplified heroic figures of cosmonauts, workers and scientists, angular geometric planes, bold contours, wide flat zones of red, gold, blue and ochre, rockets, atoms and suns

styles.name: Bayeux Tapestry
styles.features: Long horizontal strip, laid and couched wool in terracotta, ochre, sage green and blue-black on bare linen, profile figures with outlined bodies, horses with differently coloured legs, animal-filled border bands, Latin captions above scenes

styles.name: Millefleur tapestry, Franco-Flemish
styles.features: Dense deep red or dark blue ground strewn with hundreds of small flowering plants, rabbits, birds and dogs floating without depth, elegant ladies in brocade gowns, unicorns and lions, flat decorative space

styles.name: Jean Lurçat
styles.features: Black or deep blue grounds, limited palette of bright flat colours, bold stylised roosters, suns, stars, fish and foliage, hatched stepped colour transitions in the weave, cosmic emblematic compositions

styles.name: Hannah Ryggen
styles.features: Woven freehand without cartoon, uneven plant-dyed wool in rust, ochre, indigo and moss, flat simplified figures with mask-like faces, crowded narrative compositions, irregular colour patches, visible coarse weave texture

styles.name: Norwegian billedvev pictorial weaving, Gudbrandsdal
styles.features: Stiff frontal stylised figures in rows wearing period costume, wise and foolish virgins or Magi on horseback, flat dark ground, red, yellow, blue and green, stepped geometric shapes, star and lozenge borders

styles.name: Opus Anglicanum
styles.medium: silk and gold thread embroidery on linen
styles.features: Faces stitched in spiralling split stitch, shimmering gold underside-couched backgrounds in diaper patterns, saints and angels under Gothic arcades and vines, rich silks in red, green and blue, slender swaying figures

styles.name: Hmong story cloth (paj ntaub)
styles.features: Many small embroidered figures in rows across a solid ground, villagers farming, carrying baskets, crossing rivers, stilt houses, trees and animals in bright thread, simple outlined bodies, panoramic narrative bands
styles.note: Often includes small English captions; omit them unless wanted.

styles.name: Nakshi kantha embroidery
styles.features: Layered soft white cotton rippled by dense running stitch, central lotus medallion, scattered elephants, fish, peacocks, boats and dancers, red, blue, black and yellow thread, outlines filled with parallel stitch lines

styles.name: Harriet Powers
styles.medium: cotton appliqué quilt, hand and machine stitched
styles.features: Grid of square blocks, each with flat cut-cloth silhouettes of people, animals, stars and suns on plain grounds, Biblical and folk scenes, simple shapes in faded red, green, ochre and cream

styles.name: Guna mola, reverse appliqué
styles.features: Stacked layers of red, black, orange and yellow cotton cut away to reveal colours beneath, maze-like parallel channels outlining birds, fish, turtles and figures, background filled with slits and zigzags

styles.name: Chinese papercut (jianzhi)
styles.features: Single sheet of red paper, often folded symmetrical, lace-like positive linework all connected, sawtooth and crescent cuts for texture, fish, roosters, zodiac animals, children, peonies, set on white ground

styles.name: Polish wycinanki, Łowicz
styles.features: Symmetrical cut-outs built from stacked layers of bright glossy paper, roosters, peacocks, tree-of-life bouquets, circular star rosettes, saturated magenta, green, yellow and blue on black or white

styles.name: Henri Matisse, gouache cut-outs
styles.features: Scissor-cut shapes of flat painted paper, saturated ultramarine, emerald, red and yellow, seaweed, leaf and star forms, simplified dancing figures, slight brush texture in paint, layered pinned arrangement on white

styles.name: Mexican papel picado

styles.name: Italian Renaissance intarsia, Urbino studiolo
styles.features: Inlaid wood pieces in natural honey, walnut and ash tones, trompe-l'oeil cupboards with half-open latticed doors, books, lutes, armillary spheres and birds, strict linear perspective, visible wood grain

styles.name: Charles Spindler
styles.features: Pictorial marquetry panels of Alsatian villages, vineyards and figures in regional costume, wood grain used to suggest sky, water and fields, warm browns, golds and greens, Art Nouveau framing

styles.name: Chinese cloisonné enamel, Ming Jingtai period
styles.features: Thin gilt wire cells filled with opaque enamel, turquoise ground, lotus scrolls, dragons and phoenixes in red, yellow, cobalt and white, slightly pitted glossy surface, gilded rims and bands

styles.name: Namikawa Yasuyuki
styles.medium: cloisonné enamel with silver and gold wire
styles.features: Hair-fine silver wires, mirror-polished translucent enamels on glossy black ground, butterflies, birds, chrysanthemums and miniature landscapes, minute even detail, gold-rimmed small vessels

styles.name: Limoges painted enamel, grisaille
styles.features: Scenes modelled in white enamel over black or deep blue ground giving grey tonal shading, touches of flesh tint and gold highlights, classical mythological figures and portraits, glossy vitreous surface on small plaques

styles.name: Feodor Rückert
styles.medium: filigree cloisonné and painted enamel on silver gilt
styles.features: Raised twisted-wire filigree cells filled with shaded enamels in muted olive, mauve, cream and teal, inset enamel miniatures of Russian fairy-tale and bogatyr scenes, ornate gilded silver boxes and caskets

styles.name: Japanese maki-e lacquer
styles.medium: gold and silver powder on urushi lacquer
styles.features: Sprinkled gold and silver powder on deep black or gold-flecked lacquer, slightly raised relief, autumn grasses, deer, waves, cranes and moon, asymmetric composition with large empty black space

styles.name: Nguyễn Gia Trí, Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer painting
styles.medium: layered and polished lacquer on wood panel
styles.features: Deep black and cinnabar red lacquer sanded to reveal layers, gold and silver leaf, crushed eggshell textures, slender women in long tunics among gardens and bamboo, glowing polished surface

styles.name: Javanese batik pesisir, Pekalongan
styles.features: Fine canting-drawn lines with faint crackle veining from wax, bouquets of flowers, birds and butterflies, dotted and hatched fills inside shapes, bright and pastel dyes, dense patterned borders

styles.name: Sumba hinggi ikat
styles.features: Motifs with soft blurred feathery edges from resist-dyed warp, symmetrical horizontal bands of horses, deer, roosters, prawns and lions, indigo and rusty red on cream, mirrored top and bottom halves

styles.name: Kalamkari, Srikalahasti
styles.features: Black outlines drawn with bamboo pen, madder red, indigo, mustard and green, epic scenes stacked in horizontal registers, figures with large eyes and ornate jewellery, floral border bands

styles.name: Portuguese azulejo tile panels
styles.features: Large walls of square white tiles painted in cobalt blue washes, visible grid joints, hunting, garden and battle scenes, Baroque scrollwork and acanthus frames, soft tonal shading

styles.name: Delft tiles
styles.features: Small square white tiles each with a single blue sketch, ship, windmill, playing child, soldier or tulip, inside a ring, small corner ornaments, quick fluid brushwork, wide white space

styles.name: Iznik tile and ceramic painting
styles.features: Glossy white ground, cobalt, turquoise, green and raised tomato red, tulips, carnations, hyacinths and serrated saz leaves, thin black outlines, swirling arabesques and repeating panels

styles.name: Qajar haft-rangi tiles, Shiraz
styles.features: Multicoloured tiles dominated by pink roses, yellow, turquoise and cobalt, courtly figures in Qajar dress, hunts and royal scenes, birds among blossoms, clear outlined forms on glossy surface

styles.name: Russian glazed stove tiles (izraztsy), Yaroslavl
styles.features: Moulded relief tiles in green, ochre, cobalt, white and brown glazes, framed birds, lions, unicorns, flowers and vines, thick glossy pooled glaze, tiles assembled into stoves and church walls

styles.name: Gzhel porcelain painting
styles.features: Cobalt blue on bright white, single loaded brushstrokes shading dark to pale within each petal, large roses, birds, small village scenes and figures, glossy glaze, white background

styles.name: Italian maiolica istoriato, Urbino
styles.features: Whole plate surface painted with narrative scenes, classical figures in landscapes with buildings and hills, ochre, yellow, cobalt, green and manganese brown, glossy glaze, small dense brushwork

styles.name: Clarice Cliff, Bizarre ware
styles.features: Thick bold brushed colours in orange, yellow, green, blue and black outlines, stylised cottages, lollipop trees, crocuses and geometric triangles, visible brush streaks, Art Deco plates and jugs

styles.name: Mughal pietra dura (parchin kari)
styles.medium: semi-precious stone inlay in white marble
styles.features: White polished marble inlaid with cut lapis, carnelian, jade, onyx and agate, symmetrical flowering plants, vases and arabesque borders, seamless joints, flat surface, natural veining in stones

styles.name: Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer
styles.features: Glossy black lacquer inlaid with iridescent shell pieces, some deliberately crackled, peony scrolls, cranes, pines, deer, chrysanthemums and longevity symbols, shimmering pink-green sheen

styles.name: Scrimshaw
styles.medium: incised whale tooth and bone, ink-rubbed
styles.region: United States and Britain, whaling ships
styles.features: Cream ivory surface scratched with fine needle lines rubbed with black or red ink, whaling ships, whale hunts, harbours and portraits, dense cross-hatching, curved tooth shape

styles.name: Pierre-Joseph Redouté
styles.features: Single flower stems on blank paper; soft stipple dots instead of outlines, translucent petals with velvety gradations, dewy greens, rose pinks and lily whites, no cast shadows or background, gentle balanced placement.
styles.section: Natural history, botanical, scientific and anatomical illustration from the 16th to 20th c.

styles.name: Ernst Haeckel
styles.features: Radiolarians, jellyfish, diatoms and corals arranged symmetrically to fill the plate; razor-fine contour lines, ornamental repetition, crystalline lattices, soft tinted colour or sepia on pale or black grounds, specimens floating without any setting.
styles.section: Natural history, botanical, scientific and anatomical illustration from the 16th to 20th c.

styles.name: Albrecht Dürer nature studies
styles.features: Close-up studies of a hare, birds' wings, clumps of grass and weeds; hair-by-hair fine brush hatching, opaque white highlights, earthy greens and browns, isolated on bare paper, low viewpoint, unflinching close observation.
styles.section: Natural history, botanical, scientific and anatomical illustration from the 16th to 20th c.
styles.note: Specify the watercolour nature studies, not his engravings or portraits.

styles.name: Vesalian anatomical woodcut, Basel
styles.features: Black-line woodcut of skeletons and flayed muscle figures standing in classical poses before rolling Italian hills and ruins; firm parallel hatching, muscles peeled back in layers, monochrome, small reference letters beside structures.
styles.section: Natural history, botanical, scientific and anatomical illustration from the 16th to 20th c.
styles.note: Anatomical subject; keep it clinical rather than gory.

styles.name: Jan Wandelaar
styles.features: Copperplate engraving of upright skeletons and muscle figures posed elegantly before baroque garden landscapes with urns, trees, cherubs or a rhinoceros; dense fine hatching, silvery grey tones, sharp anatomical precision.
styles.section: Natural history, botanical, scientific and anatomical illustration from the 16th to 20th c.
styles.note: Anatomical subject; keep it clinical rather than gory.

styles.name: Jacques-Fabien Gautier d'Agoty
styles.features: Colour mezzotint with velvety tonal grain; dissected living-looking figures with peeled-back skin in fleshy pinks, carmine and olive against deep brown-black backgrounds; soft blended modelling, no outlines, poised elegant posture.
styles.section: Natural history, botanical, scientific and anatomical illustration from the 16th to 20th c.
styles.note: Graphic anatomy; keep the treatment restrained.

styles.name: Henry Vandyke Carter
styles.features: Clean black wood-engraved line on white; muscles, bones and vessels shown with parallel hatching and minimal shading, names of structures lettered directly onto the parts, cut-away views, no background, didactic clarity.
