styles.features: Facades and domes covered with glazed tiles in cobalt blue, yellow, orange and green on white; repeating floral, star and vase motifs; tiles set among herringbone red brick; glossy colourful surfaces under strong sun.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Aurora Reyes Flores
styles.features: Mexican muralist fresco with sturdy rural teachers, peasants, children and armed attackers; dramatic diagonal compositions of struggle; rounded solid forms, strong outlines; earth browns, ochres, muted reds and blues on plaster.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide
styles.note: Only a few murals survive; the description carries the look.

styles.name: New Deal post office mural, American Scene
styles.features: Lunette-shaped panels above doorways; local farmers, mail carriers, harvests, rivers and small towns; smooth simplified rounded forms; muted earthy palette with soft blues and wheat golds; orderly calm compositions.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Marion Greenwood
styles.features: Robust rounded workers, market women and children in rhythmic interlocking groups; influence of Mexican muralism; earthy reds, ochres and olive greens; solid sculptural modelling; tools, produce and machinery filling a shallow space.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Soviet modernist monumental mosaic
styles.medium: smalt and ceramic mosaic on building facades
styles.features: Huge facade panels of glass smalt tesserae; stylised geometric figures of cosmonauts, scientists, workers and mothers; atoms, rockets, wheat, sun discs; flat bold blocks of red, ultramarine, gold and ochre; strong contour lines.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide
styles.note: Avoid political slogans and emblems unless needed.

styles.name: Aleksandr Deineka
styles.features: Athletic figures seen from below against open blue sky; parachutists, aircraft, swimmers, workers; smooth simplified bodies; crisp clean edges; airy palette of sky blue, white, warm flesh and red; strong diagonals.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Pavel Korin
styles.medium: smalt and gold mosaic ceiling panels
styles.features: Heroic figures in armour or uniform with banners on glittering gold mosaic ground, set in ornate white stucco frames on a pale yellow vault; severe faces, solid volumes, deep reds and blues.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Alla Horska
styles.medium: smalt, ceramic and stone mosaic; murals
styles.features: Folk-rooted monumental mosaics with stylised frontal figures, trees, birds and suns; flat bold shapes; deep reds, ochres, black and white; chunky irregular tesserae; strong symmetry and rhythm.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Walter Womacka
styles.medium: glass, enamel and ceramic mosaic; murals
styles.features: Long continuous band frieze wrapping a building; stylised modernist figures of workers, families, scientists and students; flat bright fields of red, blue, yellow and white; geometric facets, clear outlines, optimistic rhythm.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Athos Bulcão
styles.medium: glazed ceramic tiles and painted wall panels
styles.features: Modular square tiles with simple geometric motifs—arcs, triangles, stripes, dots—set in deliberately random rotations to create shifting patterns over large walls; limited palette of blue, white and black, sometimes yellow.
styles.section: Mural, fresco and public art traditions worldwide

styles.name: Ivan Bilibin, opera designs
styles.medium: watercolour, ink and tempera on paper
styles.features: Precise black outlines filled with flat watercolour; Old Russian boyar costumes and carved wooden terem palaces; dense ornamental borders framing the scene; earthy tones with red, gold and blue; fairy-tale tsars, firebirds and roosters
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Nicholas Roerich, stage designs
styles.features: Primeval Slavic landscapes of rounded green hills, standing stones and log huts; layered flat zones of deep blue, violet, ochre and moss green; matte tempera surface; simplified ancient figures in embroidered linen and furs
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Konstantin Korovin, scene painting
styles.medium: tempera and oil on canvas and paper
styles.features: Broad, loose impressionistic scene painting; flickering vibrant strokes of colour; fairy-tale palaces, northern forests and seas; shimmering atmospheric light dissolving outlines; wide panoramic backdrops in glowing blues, greens and golds
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Alexander Golovin
styles.medium: tempera and gouache on paper and cardboard
styles.features: Dense mosaic-like surface built from tiny ornamental strokes; rich red-gold and blue-green harmonies; draped curtains and portals framing deep stages; fairy-tale gardens of stylised foliage; figures flattened into tapestry-like pattern
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Mikhail Larionov, ballet designs
styles.features: Costumes and sets broken into angular Cubo-Futurist facets and rays; crude folk buffoon figures with exaggerated proportions; clashing red, yellow and blue; diagonal force lines; tilting collage-like scenery
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Lyubov Popova, constructivist stage set
styles.medium: gouache and ink on paper; wooden stage construction
styles.features: Bare skeletal scaffold of unpainted wood; ladders, ramps, platforms, doors and spinning wheels with no painted backdrop; actors in identical loose blue work overalls; flat geometric planes; diagrammatic clarity
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: El Lissitzky, theatre figurines
styles.features: Mechanical marionette figures assembled from circles, rectangles, arcs and stripes; flat Suprematist planes overlapping transparently; red, black and white with grey and metallic tints; collage-like construction floating on a blank ground; dynamic diagonals
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Boris Kustodiev, theatre designs
styles.features: Merchant-town fairground world; onion domes, painted signboards and gingerbread houses; plump rosy characters in bright red, blue and green; snow and festivity; toy-like lubok simplification; dense cheerful pattern
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Alexander Tyshler
styles.features: Figures crowned with tall stacked headdresses carrying miniature towns, ladders and birds; wooden booths, carts and galleries; earthy ochre, red and deep blue; flattened, stacked theatrical space; fairy-tale and shtetl motifs
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Marc Chagall, theatre murals and ballet designs
styles.medium: tempera, gouache and oil on canvas
styles.features: Weightless fiddlers, goats, acrobats and lovers floating upside down; vivid blue, red and green over shifting geometric colour planes; shtetl folk motifs; dreamlike changes of scale; fluid loose brush; luminous backdrops
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design
styles.note: Aim for the theatre-mural and ballet-backdrop phase, not his stained glass

styles.name: Simon Virsaladze
styles.features: Monumental ballet spaces against dark velvety backgrounds; jewel-toned silks with gold accents; Persian-miniature and medieval motifs; sweeping drapery; elongated dancers arranged in rhythmic lines
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Oskar Schlemmer, Triadic Ballet
styles.medium: gouache and collage on paper; padded and lacquered costumes
styles.features: Figurines built from padded geometric volumes: spheres, cones, spirals and hoops; mask-like heads; stiff wooden and metallic surfaces; primary colours with black, white and gold; frontal symmetrical poses on an empty dark stage
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Sonia Delaunay, ballet costumes
styles.medium: gouache and watercolour on paper; appliqué textiles
styles.features: Simultaneous colour contrasts of concentric discs, arcs and stripes; saturated orange, blue, pink, green and black in flat patches; costumes like moving colour wheels; patchwork textiles; geometricised dancing figures
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Erté
styles.medium: gouache with gold and silver on board
styles.features: Elongated sinuous female figures in towering headdresses and sweeping trains; often on black grounds; stylised fringes, pearls, peacock and sunburst motifs; precise symmetrical Art Deco line; flat decorative space; jewel-like detail
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Adolphe Appia
styles.features: Bare stages of monumental stairs, platforms, pillars and ramps; dramatic shafts of light and deep shadow; tiny solitary figures; no painted scenery; strict rhythmic geometry; soft monochrome greys
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Edward Gordon Craig
styles.features: Towering blank screens and vertical planes; immense scale against minute figures; stark light falling from above; strong tonal contrast like woodcut; austere black, grey, white and ochre; abstract architecture
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Galli Bibiena family, Baroque stage design
styles.medium: pen, brown ink and wash on paper
styles.features: Vast baroque palace interiors and courtyards seen at a diagonal angle; colonnades receding endlessly; arches, balustrades and coffered vaults; illusionistic architecture in brown ink washes; tiny figures dwarfed by the space
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Inigo Jones, masque designs
styles.medium: pen and brown ink with wash on paper
styles.features: Spirited quick hatching; fantastical masquing costumes with plumed helmets, winged sleeves and scalloped tunics; cloud machines bearing deities; Italianate perspective architecture; light brown wash
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Jean Berain the Elder
styles.features: Court ballet costumes covered with lambrequins, plumes, ribbons and symbolic attributes; grotesque ornament of arabesques, canopies and baldachins; symmetrical frontal figures; crisp engraved line; Louis XIV baroque flourish
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Louis Jean Desprez
styles.medium: pen, ink and watercolour on paper
styles.features: Dramatic neoclassical stage scenes of ruined temples, caverns and dark halls; deep perspective with strong chiaroscuro; small agitated figures; muted browns, greys and ochre broken by bursts of firelight
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Pietro Gonzaga
styles.medium: pen and ink with grey and brown wash on paper
styles.features: Neoclassical colonnades, palaces, prisons and gardens in deep linear perspective; clean architectural lines; soft atmospheric gradations of grey wash; few or no figures; painted perspective scenery
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Karl Friedrich Schinkel, stage designs
styles.features: Dark blue vaults studded with regular rows of stars; crescent-moon platforms; Egyptian temples, sphinxes and palms; strict neoclassical symmetry; cool moonlit palette; solemn architectural stillness
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Pavel Tchelitchew, ballet designs
styles.features: Neo-romantic stage of translucent veils, nets and projected light; elongated dreamlike figures; cool blue, violet and white luminescence; figures merging with webs, branches and clouds
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Christian Bérard
styles.features: Loose rapid brush; shadowy washed interiors with heavy drapery and candlelight; melancholy figures in romantic costume; muted greys and blacks with flashes of rose and white; dreamlike haze
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Eugene Berman
styles.features: Crumbling Baroque and Renaissance architecture: arcades, broken columns, ruined palaces hung with drapery and banners; earthy brown, ochre and dusky blue; fine cross-hatching; small melancholy figures; theatrical capriccio
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Oliver Messel
styles.features: Airy Rococo fantasy palaces of garlands, gauze and lace; pastel pinks, pale blues, silver and white; trompe-l'œil ornament; light confectionery architecture; elegant period costumes
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Leslie Hurry
styles.features: Dense surreal theatre designs in brooding dark reds, blacks and purples; distorted architecture; looming shadowy figures; feverish line and textured surfaces; nightmarish Elizabethan atmosphere
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Caspar Neher
styles.features: Quick scratchy ink sketches of actor groupings in bare spaces; scaffolds, half-height curtains and placards; muted grey, brown and sepia washes; gritty realism; figures in worn everyday clothing
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Joseph Urban
styles.medium: gouache and watercolour on paper; painted scenery
styles.features: Viennese Secession stage design; stylised curving trees and rhythmic decorative patterns; stippled pointillist blues and violets for luminous skies; symmetrical framing arches; lavish revue palaces with gold and turquoise accents
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Lila de Nobili
styles.medium: painted gauze and tulle; watercolour and gouache on paper
styles.features: Romantic painterly scenography; layered gauzes painted with hazy 19th-century architecture; soft brown, grey and sepia; smoky muted light; faded silk costumes; drawing-like softness
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Jacques Callot, commedia dell'arte etchings
styles.features: Fine etched lines that swell and taper; agile commedia figures leaping in pairs in the foreground with masks, long noses, feathered hats and swords; tiny crowds and street stages in the distance; black on white; contorted dynamic poses
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Maurice Sand, commedia dell'arte costume plates
styles.features: A single commedia character per plate, standing full-length on a plain ground; detailed historical costumes such as Harlequin's lozenges, Pierrot's white blouse and Pantalone's red; crisp line; soft watercolour tints
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Wayang kulit, Javanese shadow puppets
styles.medium: perforated painted buffalo hide on horn rods
styles.features: Flat hide figures in extreme profile; intricate lace-like chiselled perforations; elongated arms on thin rods, long noses, slender necks; gilding with red, black and blue details; shadows on a white screen lit by an oil lamp
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design
styles.note: Show it as puppetry, either the figures or the lit screen, not as worship

styles.name: Wayang golek, Sundanese rod puppets
styles.features: Three-dimensional carved wooden rod puppets; stylised faces in gold, red, white or black; batik sarong bodies; elaborate crowns and headdresses; slender arms on rods; glossy painted surfaces
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Wayang beber, Javanese painted scroll
styles.medium: natural pigments on bark paper or cloth scroll
styles.features: Horizontal scroll of continuous scenes; flat wayang-profile figures with elongated limbs; dense ornamental fill of trees, rocks and flowers; earthy ochre, red, black and white; no perspective
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Kamasan painting, Bali
styles.features: Flat wayang-like profile figures with elaborate headdresses; dense continuous scenes divided by flame and rock motifs; fine black outline; limited ochre, red, blue, black and white palette; no perspective
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Karagöz, Ottoman shadow theatre
styles.features: Translucent coloured figures glowing on a backlit white screen; saturated red, green, yellow and blue; jointed limbs with visible pivot points; profile figures with large heads, turbans and pointed beards; Ottoman costumes
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Sbek thom, Khmer large shadow puppets
styles.medium: perforated leather panels on bamboo poles
styles.features: Large rigid leather panels with no movable limbs, each a character or scene framed by foliage; dense lace-like cut patterns; dark silhouettes against a firelit white screen; Ramayana heroes and demons
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Tholu bommalata, Andhra leather puppets
styles.medium: translucent painted goat or deer hide
styles.features: Large translucent leather puppets painted vivid red, yellow, green, blue and black; jointed limbs; dotted and floral perforations; finely detailed jewellery and crowns; colour glowing with light behind; epic heroes
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Bunraku puppet theatre
styles.medium: carved painted wooden heads, silk costumes
styles.features: Half-life-size puppets with white-painted carved faces and glossy black hair; rich layered kimonos; three black-hooded puppeteers visible behind; dark stage; tense dramatic Edo-period poses
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Opera dei pupi, Sicilian marionettes
styles.medium: carved wood, embossed metal armour, velvet
styles.features: Armoured marionettes with shining embossed breastplates, plumed helmets and heraldic shields; carved painted faces; red, gold and blue velvet; painted backdrops of castles and battlefields; frozen combat poses
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Yoke thé, Burmese marionettes
styles.medium: carved lacquered wood, sequinned velvet and silk
styles.features: Wooden string marionettes with lacquered faces; sequinned appliqué velvet costumes with flaring hems; gold, red and emerald; ornate pointed crowns; dancing poses with visible strings; palace or forest backdrops
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Vietnamese water puppetry
styles.features: Glossy lacquered wooden figures in red, gold, green and black, standing waist-deep in water before a pagoda-roofed pavilion with bamboo screen; farmers, buffalo, dragons and fish; splashes and reflections
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Kathputli, Rajasthani string puppets
styles.features: String puppets with large painted faces, almond eyes and thick black brows; legless bodies in long flared skirts of bright mirrorwork cloth; red, yellow, green and pink; turbans and veils; folk-tale kings and dancers
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: English toy theatre sheets, 'penny plain, tuppence coloured'
styles.features: Stiff stock characters in melodramatic poses; bold engraved outlines; flat bright vermilion, yellow, blue and green; cut-out scenery wings, borders and proscenium arch; paper figures on tin slides
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Jiří Trnka, puppet film
styles.features: Carved wooden puppets with simple serene oval faces and painted eyes; textured fabric costumes; miniature fairy-tale sets in soft light; earthy greens, browns and warm reds; Czech folk motifs; quiet poetic stillness
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Torii school kabuki prints
styles.features: Muscular actors in bombastic aragoto poses; thick swelling 'gourd-leg' contours and 'wriggling worm' lines; bold black outline; hand-applied orange-red and lacquer-like black; large family crests on costumes
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Peking opera facial painting (lianpu) and costume
styles.medium: painted face make-up; embroidered silk costumes
styles.features: Faces painted symmetrically about the nose in bold red, black, white, blue and gold; swirling brows and butterfly shapes; exaggerated eyes; pennant flags on the back; pheasant-feather headdresses; heavily embroidered silks
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Kathakali costume and make-up
styles.medium: painted face make-up, carved gilded headdress, layered cloth
styles.features: Vivid green painted faces framed by a white ridge along the jaw; red-and-black eye make-up; huge flaring white skirts; towering gilded crowns set with mirrors; red and gold costumes; wide eyes and expressive hand gestures
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design
styles.note: Present as stage performance

styles.name: Noh theatre masks and costume
styles.medium: carved lacquered wood masks, silk brocade robes
styles.features: Carved masks with ivory-white faces and ambiguous serene expressions; heavy brocade robes woven with gold thread; bare cypress-wood stage with a painted old pine on the back wall; slow stately postures; dark muted ground
styles.section: Theatre and costume design, ballet design

styles.name: Jim Flora
styles.features: Angular distorted figures with jagged elbows and pointed noses, multiple eyes and spinning limbs, flat colour in muted ochre, teal, black and red, floating abstract shapes, jazzy rhythmic composition, crisp ink edges

styles.name: Charley Harper
styles.features: Wildlife reduced to flat geometric shapes, birds built from circles, triangles and arcs, no outlines, clean hard edges, flat bright colour fields, symmetry and repetition, dot eyes, simplified foliage patterns

styles.name: Miroslav Šašek
styles.medium: gouache, watercolour and ink on paper
styles.features: Cheerful city panoramas with flat gouache buildings in slightly tilted naive perspective, lively ink line, many small stylised figures with dot faces, buses and taxis, warm muted palette with bright accents, textured dry-brush skies

styles.name: Saul Steinberg
styles.features: Wiry continuous pen line, playful diagrammatic drawings, figures made from doodles, fingerprints, rubber stamps and fake handwriting, sparse white space, distorted maps and perspectives, occasional flat watercolour washes

styles.name: Bernie Fuchs
styles.features: Painterly oils with soft blurred edges, glowing backlit sunshine, figures dissolved into hazy golden light, loose impressionistic brushwork, cropped photographic compositions, warm amber and pastel palette, sports and leisure scenes

styles.name: Coby Whitmore
styles.features: Glamorous fashionable figures rendered smoothly, high-key pastel and coral palette, large flat graphic background shapes, bold cropping, dramatic negative space, sleek mid-century interiors and cars, glossy magazine romance mood

styles.name: Bob Peak
styles.medium: oil, pastel and gouache on board
styles.features: Dynamic layered montage compositions, intense blended magenta, violet and orange, glowing light streaks, fragmented overlapping figures, expressive slashing strokes, heroic faces, cinematic diagonal energy

styles.name: Alice and Martin Provensen
styles.features: Folk-art naive figures in profile, flat gouache with soft dry-brush textures, muted earthy palette of ochre, sage and rust, decorative patterned farmhouses and medieval motifs, compressed stacked space

styles.name: Tibor Gergely
styles.features: Busy picture-book scenes, round-faced cheerful figures, bright saturated gouache with soft modelling, toy-like trucks and fire engines, dense town views filled with activity, clear outlines

styles.name: Richard Scarry
styles.features: Anthropomorphic animals in clothes, cutaway buildings and busy streets packed with tiny detailed activity, clean ink outlines, bright cheerful watercolour, small labelled vehicles, flat orthographic town views

styles.name: Ronald Searle
styles.features: Spidery scratchy nib line, spindly grotesque figures with long noses, spattered ink blots, loose splashes of watercolour, crumbling detailed architecture, satirical caricature of manners

styles.name: Edward Gorey
styles.features: Fine dense crosshatching, monochrome black and white, Edwardian figures in long coats and fur, gloomy wallpapered interiors, small figures in large empty spaces, deadpan macabre mood

styles.name: Milton Glaser
styles.medium: ink and flat colour, offset print
styles.features: Flat psychedelic colour fields, Art Nouveau and Victorian revival curves, profile silhouettes with swirling rainbow hair, even rapidograph outlines, decorative borders, playful pop shapes

styles.name: John Alcorn
styles.medium: pen, ink and flat colour, offset print
styles.features: Woodcut-like flat shapes, Victorian and Art Nouveau ornament, decorative stylised figures, bright limited flat palette, playful patterned surfaces, bold black line

styles.name: UPA-style limited animation design, 1950s American
styles.features: Flat colour fields with colour slipping off outlines, angular asymmetric characters, minimal props, abstracted backgrounds of floating shapes, bold graphic modernist composition, limited muted palette with bright accents

styles.name: John Hubley
styles.features: Loose wobbly crayon and pen lines, soft watercolour washes bleeding over outlines, childlike drawings, transparent overlapping colours, textured paper grain, dreamy nocturnal skies

styles.name: Zagreb school of animation
styles.medium: painted cels and flat gouache backgrounds
styles.features: Minimal geometric characters, reduced flat shapes, stark white or single-colour backgrounds, spare modernist design, thin lines, absurdist humour, limited palette of black, grey and a few bright tones

styles.name: Albín Brunovský
styles.features: Extremely fine etched lines, intricate surreal fantasy figures, mannerist elongated women, hybrid creatures and ornament, delicate soft colour washes, dreamlike layered space

styles.name: Werner Klemke
styles.features: Lively humorous pen line, crisp black-and-white wood engraving, stocky folk figures, light watercolour accents, cheerful rural and town scenes, playful animals

styles.name: Kukryniksy (Soviet satirical trio)
styles.features: Bold brush-and-ink caricature, exaggerated grotesque figures, fluid ink washes, satirical exaggeration, magazine cartoon framing, limited colour, energetic gestural line
styles.note: avoid propaganda content

styles.name: Yevgeny Rachev
styles.features: Naturalistic animals with expressive faces wearing Russian peasant costume, earthy muted palette, soft watercolour, detailed fur and feathers, folk patterns, forest and village settings

styles.name: Nika Goltz
styles.features: Delicate fine pen line, elongated graceful figures, muted watercolour washes, fairy-tale castles and Nordic towns, lacy details, quiet melancholic atmosphere, generous white space

styles.name: Viktor Chizhikov
styles.features: Humorous cartoon drawings, round friendly faces, clean ink outlines, bright cheerful watercolour, lively playful animals and children, detailed comic background gags

styles.name: Andrei Sokolov (Soviet space art)
styles.features: Glowing planets and spacecraft, deep cosmic blues and violets, luminous sunbursts, sci-fi realism, crisp hardware detail, alien landscapes, magazine-cover drama

styles.name: Soviet space-age posters, 1960s
styles.features: Bold diagonal compositions, cosmonauts and rockets, red and deep blue, starbursts, heroic upward gazes, flat graphic shapes, simplified figures, large slogans
styles.note: keep slogans short or omit

styles.name: Edgar Valter
styles.features: Detailed humorous pen drawings, whimsical forest creatures, mossy textures, soft watercolour, intricate nature details, gentle earthy greens and browns, playful anthropomorphic animals

styles.name: Celestino Piatti
styles.features: Thick black brush outlines, bright patches of colour, owls and stylised faces, chunky rounded shapes, simple geometric composition, bold contrasts

styles.name: Raymond Savignac
styles.features: Single visual gags, cartoon figures with simple rounded bodies, flat bright colour on plain grounds, thick brush outlines, product humour, playful lettering

styles.name: Bernard Villemot
styles.features: Bold flat colour shapes, gestural brush strokes, sunny Mediterranean palette, elegant simplified figures, large colour planes, joyful energy

styles.name: David Klein
styles.features: Vibrant flat colour, abstracted city landmarks, mosaic-like geometric shapes, overlapping translucent planes, night lights, energetic travel imagery

styles.name: Stan Galli
styles.features: Painterly stylised scenes, warm tropical light, flat decorative shapes, local figures and landscapes, rich jewel colours, travel poster drama

styles.name: Lucien Boucher
styles.features: Decorative world maps with mythic creatures, animals, planes and ships, flat colour, ornamental borders, soft blues and ochres, playful labelled geography

styles.name: Dong Kingman
styles.features: Loose wet watercolour washes, crisp white paper highlights, bright accents, busy city streets, bridges and harbours, lively small figures

styles.name: Jean-Michel Folon
styles.features: Soft watercolour gradients, small hatted silhouetted man, dreamy skies, floating arrows and birds, quiet poetic mood, pastel tones

styles.name: Low-poly 3D render
styles.features: Faceted surfaces of large flat-shaded triangles, each a single solid colour; simplified geometric terrain, trees and animals; soft gradient sky; pastel or saturated palette; no textures, crisp hard facet edges, gentle ambient lighting

styles.name: Isometric pixel art
styles.features: Scenes on a 2:1 isometric grid with no vanishing point; hard-edged square pixels without anti-aliasing; limited palette with dithered shading; cutaway buildings and rooms, tiny figures a few pixels tall; stepped diagonal outlines

styles.name: Papercraft diorama
styles.medium: cut and folded coloured card, photographed
styles.features: Layered cut paper and folded card shapes standing in shallow stage-like depth; visible paper grain, crisp cut edges, scored folds; small soft shadows between layers; matte pastel and bright solid colours; close macro photo lighting

styles.name: Tilt-shift miniature photography
styles.medium: photograph, tilt-shift lens or simulated blur
styles.features: Real scene photographed from a high vantage point with a narrow horizontal band of sharp focus and strong blur at top and bottom; boosted saturation and contrast make streets, cars and people look like toy models

styles.name: Claymation stop-motion still
styles.medium: plasticine figures and handmade sets, photographed
styles.features: Rounded plasticine figures with visible thumbprints and tool marks, slightly lumpy surfaces; bulging eyes and wide mouths; handmade miniature sets and props; warm studio lighting with soft shadows; saturated colours; shallow depth of field

styles.name: Needle-felted wool craft
styles.features: Soft fuzzy fibre surfaces with stray hairs and a halo of fluff; rounded chubby animals and figures with bead or embroidered eyes; muted natural wool colours with bright accents; felt sheet backdrops; diffuse window light

styles.name: Voxel art
styles.features: Everything built from equal-sized cubes on a grid like three-dimensional pixels; stepped blocky silhouettes; flat-coloured cube faces with soft ambient occlusion; small floating island or diorama compositions; bright cheerful palette; isometric camera

styles.name: Cel-shaded 3D render
styles.features: 3D models shaded in two or three hard-stepped tonal bands instead of smooth gradients; thick black ink outlines around silhouettes; flat saturated colours; cartoon proportions; clean skies; looks hand-drawn yet has true perspective

styles.name: Digital matte painting
styles.medium: digital painting blended with photographic elements
styles.features: Wide cinematic establishing view with photoreal detail; immense cliffs, cities or ruins dwarfing tiny figures; atmospheric haze layering depth; volumetric light shafts; muted desaturated palette with warm highlights; seamless painted and photographic textures

styles.name: Risograph zine print
styles.medium: risograph stencil print on uncoated paper
styles.features: Two or three flat spot colours such as fluorescent pink, teal and yellow overlapping into new tones; grainy halftone texture; slight misregistration between colour layers; uneven ink coverage; simple bold shapes on off-white paper
styles.note: Zine pages often carry lettering; keep text optional

styles.name: Flat vector illustration
styles.features: Clean geometric shapes in solid flat colours with no outlines or thin uniform ones; no texture or only subtle grain; simplified figures with minimal facial features; limited harmonious palette; shadows as single darker shapes; airy compositions

styles.name: 8-bit console sprite pixel art
styles.features: Very low resolution with chunky visible square pixels; a few saturated colours per sprite; black or flat-coloured skies; strict side view; blocky characters with big heads; repeating tile-based ground, bricks and clouds

styles.name: 16-bit parallax pixel art
styles.features: Detailed pixel scenes with larger palettes and hand-placed dithered gradients; layered parallax backgrounds of mountains, forests and clouds receding in bands; rich sunset skies; expressive sprite characters; crisp pixels without blur

styles.name: 1-bit dithered bitmap graphics
styles.features: Only pure black and white pixels; grey tones built from checkerboard and ordered dither patterns; crisp jagged diagonals; early desktop computer look; small clean icons and detailed stippled scenes on white

styles.name: Late-1990s 32-bit console 3D graphics
styles.features: Blocky low-polygon models with blurry low-resolution textures that warp and wobble; visible pixelated texture seams; dithered colour; dark fog hiding the distance; simple vertex lighting; eerie, slightly unsettling atmosphere
styles.note: Do not name console brands

styles.name: Vaporwave collage
styles.features: Pink and cyan gradient skies and purple sunsets; marble classical busts, palm trees, checkerboard floors and early computer windows; glitch scanlines; nostalgic lo-fi blur; pastel chrome highlights
styles.note: Often includes lettering; keep it optional

styles.name: Synthwave retro-futurism
styles.features: Neon magenta and cyan glow; wireframe grid floor running to the horizon; huge striped setting sun; chrome sports cars, palm silhouettes and night skylines; deep purple-black starry sky; bloom and lens flares

styles.name: Glitch art, datamosh
styles.features: Pixel-sorting streaks, horizontal slice displacement, red, green and blue channels split into ghost copies; blocky compression artefacts; scanlines and noise; a recognisable image fragmented and smeared sideways

styles.name: Layered paper-cut shadow box
styles.medium: laser-cut paper layers in a backlit frame
styles.features: Many stacked silhouetted paper layers receding in depth, lit from behind so each layer glows in a graded tone from dark front to pale back; lacy cut-out foliage; deep tunnel-like compositions

styles.name: Pop-up book paper engineering
styles.features: Paper structures rising from an open book spread at right angles; folds, tabs and slots visible; printed illustrations on the cut pieces; stage-set depth in front, middle and back planes; soft studio light

styles.name: Paper quilling
styles.medium: rolled paper strips glued on edge onto card
styles.features: Images built from narrow coloured paper strips coiled into tight spirals, teardrops and scrolls standing on edge on flat card; filigree outlines; bright solid colours; tiny shadows inside every coil

styles.name: Origami folded paper
styles.features: Figures folded from single square sheets with sharp creases and faceted angular planes; geometric animals, birds and cranes; plain or patterned paper; strong side lighting revealing folds; minimal backgrounds

styles.name: Corrugated cardboard diorama
styles.features: Brown corrugated cardboard with visible fluted edges, torn top layers and kraft paper texture; handmade buildings, vehicles and trees; glue joints; mostly monochrome brown with occasional painted accents; warm photo light

styles.name: Stop-motion puppet animation still
styles.medium: armature puppets with fabric costumes and miniature sets
styles.features: Small jointed puppets with sculpted faces and tiny real fabric clothes showing visible weave; handmade miniature props and sets; moody theatrical lighting; slight handmade imperfections; shallow focus

styles.name: Amigurumi crochet
styles.features: Rounded toy figures crocheted in tight spiral stitches with visible yarn loops; oversized heads, bead eyes, small embroidered mouths; soft pastel and candy colours; plump stuffed forms; simple cosy backdrops

styles.name: Punch-needle tufted rug art
styles.medium: tufted yarn pile on backing cloth
styles.features: Dense cut and looped yarn pile in thick bold shapes; soft fuzzy edges between colour zones; flat graphic motifs; bright saturated or earthy colours; wavy irregular outlines; plush tactile surface seen from above

styles.name: Contemporary hoop embroidery
styles.medium: hand embroidery on linen in a wooden hoop
styles.features: Thread stitches on natural linen framed by a round wooden hoop; satin-stitch fills, French-knot dots, backstitch outlines; botanical and landscape motifs; raised textured thread; muted fabric ground with bright floss

styles.name: Patchwork fabric appliqué
styles.medium: cut fabric pieces stitched onto cloth
styles.features: Scenes assembled from cut cloth shapes in printed florals, checks and plain cottons; visible running-stitch edges and frayed borders; flat layered space; simplified folk-like houses, trees and animals

styles.name: Plastic toy brick diorama
styles.features: Scenes built from glossy plastic bricks with round studs on top; stepped blocky curves; bright primary colours; small figures with cylindrical heads and claw hands; macro photography with shallow focus
styles.note: Do not name the toy brand; describe as plastic building bricks

styles.name: Scale model diorama photography
styles.features: Hand-built miniatures with weathered paint, static-grass fields, tiny model trees and hand-painted figures; exaggerated rust and grime textures; macro lens with shallow focus; dramatic small-scale lighting

styles.name: Photoreal architectural visualisation
styles.features: Clean physically based rendering of buildings and interiors; perfectly straight verticals and wide lens; soft global illumination and sunlight through glass; reflective floors; motion-blurred passers-by; golden-hour sky

styles.name: Clay render, untextured white model
styles.features: Every object in uniform matte white or light grey material with no textures; soft ambient occlusion darkening corners and contacts; gentle shadows under studio sky light; form read only through light and shade

styles.name: Soft 3D icon render, claymorphism
styles.features: Rounded inflated shapes with glossy or matte soft-plastic surfaces; pastel gradients; smooth bevels and gentle inner glow; floating objects with soft drop shadows; cheerful simplified characters and props on plain backgrounds

styles.name: Isometric 3D room cutaway
styles.features: A single cube-shaped room or tiny building cut away on two sides and seen at an isometric angle; detailed miniature furniture, plants and gadgets; soft warm lighting; pastel stylised materials; floating on a plain background

styles.name: Hand-painted-texture stylised 3D game art
styles.features: Chunky exaggerated 3D shapes covered in painted brush-stroke textures instead of photographic detail; baked highlights and warm-cool colour shifts; oversized props and thick tree trunks; bright saturated fantasy palette; soft rim light

styles.name: Corporate Memphis
styles.features: Flat vector people with elongated bendy limbs, tiny heads and oversized hands and feet; skin in non-naturalistic blues and purples; no outlines; bright flat colours; abstract blobs and potted plants around; cheerful office-like scenes

styles.name: Flat isometric vector illustration
styles.features: Buildings, devices and tiny figures drawn on isometric axes with flat colours and two-tone shading on each face; clean geometric edges; airy white or pastel ground; diagram-like city, port and factory layouts

styles.name: Die-cut sticker art
styles.medium: printed vinyl sticker with white border
styles.features: Bold cartoon motif with thick clean outline surrounded by a wide white die-cut border; glossy vinyl sheen and slight drop shadow; bright flat colours with simple highlights; isolated on a plain background

styles.name: Retro vector wireframe graphics
styles.features: Thin glowing lines on a black screen forming wireframe 3D objects, terrain grids and spheres with no filled surfaces; green, cyan or amber phosphor colour; slight bloom; geometric precision; see-through hidden edges

styles.name: Generative flow-field art
styles.features: Thousands of thin curving lines or particles following invisible vector fields, forming swirling currents and eddies; dense layered translucent strokes; limited curated palette; machine precision; no recognisable objects
styles.note: Abstract; best for wind, water and flow themes

styles.name: Pen plotter drawing
styles.features: Machine-drawn ink lines of uniform weight on white paper; tones built from dense parallel hatching and concentric contour lines; tiny ink blobs at line starts; precise geometric repetition; one or two pen colours

styles.name: Digital concept art speedpaint
styles.features: Loose broad textured brush strokes and blocky shapes defining large forms; strong value contrast and readable silhouettes; atmospheric perspective; dramatic lighting; detail concentrated at the focal point while edges stay rough

styles.name: Japanese anime background painting
styles.features: Highly detailed painted scenery with saturated blue skies, towering cumulus clouds, lens flare and glowing light; crisp architectural lines; lush green foliage; sparkling reflections; flat cel-coloured figures if present
styles.note: Describe the look; do not name studios or directors

styles.name: Rotoscoped animation look
styles.features: Figures traced from filmed motion, giving realistic proportions and gestures but flat cartoon colour fills; wobbly shifting contour lines; posterised colour regions; slightly dreamlike, unstable surfaces

styles.name: Double exposure photography
styles.features: Two images merged in one frame: the silhouette of a head or figure filled with forest, city or sky; bright white or pale backgrounds; transparent overlaps; muted monochrome or soft desaturated colour

styles.name: Light-painting long-exposure photography
styles.features: Night scene with glowing streaks, spirals and loops of light drawn through the air; sharp static background under dark sky; trailing car lights; vivid neon colours against deep blue-black

styles.name: Infrared false-colour photography
styles.features: Green foliage turned vivid pink, magenta and red; skies deep saturated blue; water nearly black; skin pale and smooth; surreal yet photographic landscape detail; visible film grain

styles.name: Instant film snapshot
styles.features: Square image in a white frame with a wider bottom border; soft focus, faded washed-out colours with a warm yellow or cyan cast; low contrast; vignetting; flash-lit foregrounds; casual candid framing

styles.name: Xerox punk collage zine
styles.features: High-contrast black and white photocopied images with heavy toner grain and streaks; cut-and-paste fragments with visible tape and paper edges; cut-out ransom-note letters; degraded halftones; raw crowded layouts

styles.name: Screen-printed gig poster
styles.features: Bold hand-drawn illustration in three to six flat opaque inks; split-fountain colour gradients; halftone dots; slight misregistration; hand-lettered title band; cream vintage paper tone

styles.name: Knolling flat-lay photography
styles.features: Objects laid on a plain surface, seen from directly above, aligned parallel or at right angles in a tidy grid; even near-shadowless lighting; consistent spacing; colour-coordinated sets of tools or everyday items

styles.name: Thermal imaging look
styles.features: False-colour heat map with warm bodies glowing white, yellow and orange and cold areas deep blue and purple; soft blurred edges, no fine surface texture; ghostly silhouettes of people, animals and buildings

styles.name: Top-down drone aerial photography
styles.features: Straight-down bird's-eye view flattening the world into patterns; tiny people, cars and their long shadows; geometric fields, coastlines and rooftops; crisp detail; saturated colour under low sun

styles.name: Y2K chrome and iridescent render
styles.features: Liquid chrome and holographic iridescent surfaces reflecting rainbow gradients; blobby organic shapes and bubbles; pale silver and baby-blue backdrops; glossy translucent plastic; small lens sparkles

styles.name: ASCII art
styles.features: Image built entirely from typed characters in a fixed-width grid; tones made by character density from dots and commas to hash and at signs; green or white characters on a black terminal screen; blocky outlines
styles.note: Generators struggle with exact characters; keep the subject simple

styles.name: Ancient Egyptian sunk relief, New Kingdom
styles.features: Figures cut into pale limestone with crisp recessed outlines, composite profile pose with frontal eye and shoulders, flat horizontal registers on baselines, hierarchic scale, flat ochre, red, blue and green paint
styles.note: Columns of hieroglyphs often fill gaps; treat them as carved ornament, not readable text

styles.name: Assyrian palace reliefs, Nineveh and Nimrud
styles.features: Low relief on grey stone slabs, stiff profile figures with braided beards and patterned robes, striated muscular limbs, lion hunts, sieges and chariots in crowded registers, stylised trees and rippled water, monochrome stone

styles.name: Achaemenid stair reliefs, Persepolis
styles.features: Crisp low relief on stair façades, long processions of profile figures in pleated robes carrying gifts and leading animals, repeated identical guards, cypress trees dividing groups, rosette borders, rhythmic even spacing, polished grey stone

styles.name: Classical Greek marble frieze relief, Athens
styles.features: White marble low relief, horsemen and robed figures in continuous procession, naturalistic anatomy, clinging drapery with deep flowing folds, overlapping figures in shallow depth, plain background, weathered warm-white stone

styles.name: Roman sarcophagus high relief
styles.features: Deep undercut white marble packed edge to edge with figures in overlapping tiers, battle and myth scenes, drill-cut hair and dark shadow pockets, almost no background visible, garlands and masks at corners

styles.name: Etruscan painted terracotta sculpture
styles.features: Reclining couple on a banquet couch, almond eyes and archaic smiles, long braided hair, smooth simplified bodies, elongated expressive hands, warm reddish-buff clay with faded red, black and cream paint

styles.name: Tanagra figurines
styles.features: Small terracotta figures of draped women holding fans, wearing wide-brimmed sun hats, softly modelled cloak folds, slender relaxed poses, matt chalky surface with traces of pale pink, blue and gilding, single figures on low bases

styles.name: Han dynasty pictorial bricks and stone reliefs
styles.medium: moulded fired-clay brick and incised stone
styles.features: Flat low relief like a rubbing, silhouetted profile figures, galloping horses and chariots, banquets, hunters, salt miners and farmers scattered across bare ground, minimal overlap, grey clay or stone surface

styles.name: Haniwa terracotta figures, Kofun period
styles.features: Hollow cylindrical hand-built bodies in reddish-orange clay, simple faces with cut-out hole eyes and mouth, warriors, dancers, horses and houses, smooth surfaces, minimal detail, calm naive expressions

styles.name: Tang dynasty sancai glazed figures
styles.features: Earthenware horses, Bactrian camels, court ladies and foreign grooms in lively poses, amber, green and cream glazes running and pooling in drips, unglazed painted faces, buff clay showing at bases

styles.name: Borobudur narrative stone reliefs
styles.features: Rectangular framed panels in grey volcanic stone, graceful rounded figures in gentle sway, courtly and village scenes, ships, trees and pavilions in balanced crowded compositions, soft weathered surfaces with moss and lichen

styles.name: Khmer bas-relief galleries, Angkor
styles.features: Long galleries of shallow relief, hundreds of repeated soldiers, chariots and elephants in dense horizontal tiers, tapestry-like patterning, crowned dancers with jewellery, polished dark grey-green stone

styles.name: Bengal terracotta temple panels, Bishnupur
styles.features: Brick walls covered with small square terracotta tiles in grids, warm orange-red clay, lively epic scenes, boats, hunts and processions, rounded doll-like bodies, floral and geometric border bands

styles.name: Classic Maya carved stela
styles.features: Tall limestone slab in deep relief, frontal ruler in towering feathered headdress and jade ornaments, swirling plumes and scrolls filling every space, glyph blocks along sides, dense curvilinear detail, grey weathered stone
styles.note: Glyph panels are ornamental; do not attempt readable script

styles.name: Romanesque portal tympanum sculpture, France
styles.features: Semicircular relief above a church door, large central enthroned figure, elongated angels and apostles, rows of small figures in registers, flat stylised drapery with parallel ridged folds, distorted gestures, warm limestone

styles.name: Gothic ivory carving, Paris
styles.features: Small creamy relief panels under pointed arches and tracery, slender S-curved figures, courtly lovers and religious scenes in stacked registers, delicate drapery folds, smooth yellowing surface

styles.name: Lorenzo Ghiberti
styles.features: Gilded bronze squares, foreground figures in high relief fading into flattened buildings and hills in linear perspective, graceful elongated drapery, crowded narrative groups, warm glowing gold surface

styles.name: Luca della Robbia
styles.features: Milky white glazed figures against a flat cobalt-blue ground, wreaths of lemons, pinecones, fruit and green leaves as frames, soft rounded modelling, glossy ceramic sheen, tender mother-and-child groups

styles.name: Benin bronze plaques, Edo court
styles.features: Rectangular cast plaques, frontal chiefs and warriors in symmetrical groups with hierarchic scale, coral-bead collars and helmets, punched quatrefoil and leaf pattern background, dark greenish-brown patina
styles.note: Historical royal court art; depict respectfully

styles.name: Tilman Riemenschneider
styles.features: Honey-brown unpainted wood, slender figures with melancholy faces, deeply cut crinkled drapery, curling hair, delicate hands, lacy Gothic tracery canopies, figures grouped in shallow shrine boxes

styles.name: Grinling Gibbons
styles.features: Pale unpainted limewood carved in deep undercut cascades of fruit, flowers, leaves, birds, shells and musical instruments, petals and leaves cut paper-thin, swags framing panels and mirrors, warm cream wood

styles.name: Norwegian acanthus carving
styles.features: Deeply gouged scrolling acanthus leaves in vigorous C- and S-curves, dense curling foliage, ale bowls, cupboards, chair backs and church altars, natural pine or painted red, green and blue
styles.note: Mostly ornament; best used as a frame or on objects

styles.name: Russian carved window frames (nalichniki)
styles.medium: carved and painted wood on log houses
styles.features: Pierced openwork boards with lace-like scrolls, sun rosettes, birds and mermaids around windows, painted white, sky blue or green against dark weathered logs, layered carved gables, flat sawn silhouettes

styles.name: Bogorodskoye carved wooden toys
styles.features: Pale limewood figures with visible knife facets, bears, peasants and blacksmiths, mechanical toys moving on sliding slats or pendulum balls, chunky simple forms, smooth light wood, humorous everyday scenes

styles.name: Dymkovo clay toys
styles.medium: painted fired clay with white slip
styles.features: Hand-modelled figures covered in chalk-white slip, painted with bright red, orange, blue, yellow and green circles, dots, stripes and checks, gold-leaf accents, plump ladies in bell skirts, turkeys, goats, horses

styles.name: Filimonovo clay whistles
styles.features: Clay figures with stretched elongated necks and tiny heads, cone-shaped skirts, long-legged horses and deer, cream base painted with stripes, sprigs and herringbones in raspberry red, green and yellow

styles.name: Lithuanian folk wood carving (dievdirbiai)
styles.features: Rough-hewn weathered figures, seated pensive man with head resting on hand, blocky simplified anatomy, large hands, sorrowful faces, faded paint or bare grey wood, roadside crosses with sun-ray tops and small roofed shrines

styles.name: Erzgebirge wooden folk figures, Seiffen
styles.features: Lathe-turned figures painted in glossy primary colours, nutcrackers with big jaws, miners and candle-holding angels, tiered rotating Christmas pyramids, ring-turned animals, simple cylindrical bodies, miniature snowy villages

styles.name: Inuit stone carving, Kinngait (Cape Dorset)
styles.features: Polished grey-green and black stone, compact massive forms, dancing bears, owls, walrus, hunters and mothers carrying children in parkas, smooth rounded surfaces beside rough chisel areas, minimal incised detail

styles.name: Japanese netsuke carving
styles.features: Palm-sized carvings, animals curled into compact rounded forms, rats, monkeys, tigers and folk characters, minute engraved fur and fabric, polished warm patina, dark inlaid eyes

styles.name: Johann Joachim Kändler
styles.features: Glossy white porcelain figures in lively rococo poses, harlequins, crinoline lovers, birds and monkey musicians, bright enamel colours and gilding, scrolled bases with applied flowers, crisp small-scale modelling

styles.name: Staffordshire flatback figures
styles.features: Earthenware figures modelled for frontal view with flat unpainted backs, pairs of spaniels, sailors, shepherds and royals, white glaze with cobalt blue, black and gilt touches, naive simplified faces, oval bases

styles.name: Neapolitan presepe figures
styles.medium: terracotta heads, wired bodies, silk costumes
styles.features: Elaborate miniature tableaux with dozens of figures, terracotta heads with glass eyes, wired bodies in silk and lace, market vendors with tiny food, shepherds and musicians among ruined classical arches, theatrical lighting

styles.name: Bertel Thorvaldsen
styles.features: Neoclassical white marble reliefs, calm idealised figures in profile, smooth unbroken surfaces, shallow relief against flat ground, roundels and friezes, sparse drapery, quiet balanced compositions of classical myths

styles.name: Ernst Barlach
styles.features: Massive blocky figures wrapped in heavy cloaks, simplified planes cut with broad chisel strokes, cloth falling as single slabs, peasants and beggars leaning into wind, tilted heads, closed compact silhouettes

styles.name: Lee Lawrie
styles.medium: carved limestone and gilded architectural relief
styles.features: Art Deco architectural reliefs, muscular streamlined figures, radiating sun rays, zigzag and wave bands, sharply cut planes, symmetrical compositions above doorways, figures merging with building mass, gilt accents on stone

styles.name: Makonde blackwood carving
styles.features: Dark polished wood, tall columns of intertwined elongated figures climbing over each other, or twisted fantastical creatures, contrast of black heartwood and pale sapwood, smooth glossy finish

styles.name: Puerto Rican santos de palo
styles.features: Small hand-carved wooden figures, stiff frontal posture, oversized heads, simple painted faces, flat bright red, blue and gold robes, Three Kings on horses, niche boxes, visible tool marks

styles.name: Peruvian retablo ayacuchano
styles.medium: painted wooden box with plaster figures
styles.features: Wooden box with hinged doors painted with flowers, inside two stacked levels crowded with small modelled figures of plaster and potato paste, village fiestas, markets and workshops, bright pink, green and yellow, doll-like faces

styles.name: Metepec tree of life ceramics
styles.features: Clay sculpture shaped like a branching tree, branches crowded with tiny modelled flowers, leaves, birds, angels and figures, first couple at the trunk, saturated pink, turquoise and yellow, glossy, tiered symmetrical profusion

styles.name: Pedro Linares
styles.features: Papier-mâché fantasy creatures mixing animals with wings, horns, scales and claws, covered in dense patterns of dots, stripes and zigzags in vivid saturated colours, wiry armatures, skeletal festival figures

styles.name: Helen Cordero
styles.features: Seated clay figure with open singing mouth and closed eyes, many tiny children clinging to lap and shoulders, cream slip painted with black and brick-red lines, matte surface, rounded simple forms

styles.name: Kraków szopka (nativity cribs)
styles.features: Tall symmetrical miniature church façades with many spires and domes, covered in shiny coloured foil, tinsel and glitter, Gothic and Baroque details, small puppet figures in arched niches, lit windows

styles.name: Akira Yoshizawa
styles.features: Animals, birds and figures folded from a single uncut sheet, wet-folding giving soft rounded volumes and sculptural curves instead of sharp creases, visible paper fibres, matte washi or kraft colours

styles.name: White paper sculpture illustration
styles.medium: scored and curled white card relief
styles.features: Scored, curled and folded white card forming shallow relief scenes, crisp edges and curved planes, raking side light casting soft grey shadows, stylised figures, buildings and animals, monochrome white or pale pastel paper

styles.name: Victorian toy theatre
styles.features: Miniature cardboard proscenium stage, layered cut-out scenery wings, flat engraved character figures on wire slides, melodramatic poses, bright stencilled colours, painted backdrop with deep perspective, footlights

styles.name: German clockwork tinplate toys, Nuremberg
styles.features: Printed tinplate in bright glossy colours, clockwork cars, trams, ships, carousels and figures, tab-and-slot construction, visible seams and rivets, simplified proportions, worn chipped edges

styles.name: Mexican hojalata tin folk art
styles.features: Hand-cut tinplate with punched dots and embossed lines, shiny silver surface tinted with transparent red, green and yellow lacquer, stars, hearts, roosters and mermaids, flat silhouettes with crimped edges

styles.name: Coloured wax portrait relief
styles.medium: tinted beeswax relief in box frames
styles.features: Small profile portraits and multi-figure tableaux modelled in tinted wax on dark glass or slate, translucent flesh tones, real lace, hair and tiny pearls embedded, shallow glazed box frames, soft waxy sheen

styles.name: Ojibwe floral beadwork
styles.medium: glass seed beads on velvet and hide
styles.features: Curving floral vines in glass seed beads on black velvet or smoked hide, stylised leaves, buds and berries, bright pink, blue and green, outlined petals, symmetrical bags and vests
styles.note: Living Indigenous tradition; show floral decorative work only, avoid ceremonial regalia

styles.name: Ndebele beadwork
styles.features: Dense glass bead panels in bold geometric designs, white ground with black-outlined blocks of red, blue, green and yellow, stepped triangles and house shapes, beaded aprons, neck hoops and dolls

styles.name: Władysław Starewicz
styles.medium: stop-motion puppets with real fur and wire armatures
styles.features: Articulated insect and animal puppets with real fur and glass eyes, textured costumes, detailed miniature towns and forests, grotesque humorous characters, crowded scenes, sepia or black-and-white film grain

styles.name: Ende, Mozarabic Beatus illuminator
styles.features: Flat horizontal bands of saturated red, yellow, green and purple instead of background depth, frontal stylised figures with large almond eyes, patterned drapery, bold dark outlines, horseshoe arches, fantastic apocalyptic beasts with scaled ornamental bodies.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious
styles.note: Pages may carry Latin inscriptions; keep lettering out of the prompt.

styles.name: Ma Shouzhen
styles.medium: ink on paper, hanging scroll and handscroll
styles.features: Monochrome ink orchids and bamboo beside rocks, swift calligraphic leaf strokes thickening and tapering, graded ink tones from pale grey to black, large areas of empty paper, small red seal marks.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious
styles.note: Avoid requesting written poems; seals only.

styles.name: Ikeno Gyokuran
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper or silk
styles.features: Nanga literati landscapes, rounded mountains built of soft dotted and hemp-fibre texture strokes, pale washes of blue-green and ochre, twisted pines, tiny thatched huts and scholars, relaxed loose brushwork.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious

styles.name: Uemura Shōen
styles.features: Elegant women in kimono, precise thin ink outlines, flat pale backgrounds with ample empty space, soft gradations of mineral colour, detailed hair ornaments and fabric patterns, quiet poses.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious

styles.name: Elizabeth Keith
styles.features: Daily life of Korea and China in traditional dress, markets, gates, snowy courtyards, flat colour areas with subtle bokashi gradation, clear black keyline, soft muted palette.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious

styles.name: Emily Carr
styles.medium: oil on canvas; thinned oil on paper
styles.features: Swirling rhythmic rainforest, towering cedars and spruce as sculptural green masses, sweeping sky brushwork, light breaking through trees, deep greens, blues and ochres.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious
styles.note: Avoid totem pole subjects; use forest and sky.

styles.name: Helen Frankenthaler
styles.features: Thinned paint soaked into raw canvas, translucent pools of colour with soft halo edges, bare canvas areas, flowing veils of pink, ochre, blue and green, landscape-like openness.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious
styles.note: Abstract; landscape only as atmosphere.

styles.name: Marie Laurencin
styles.features: Soft pastel pinks, greys and blues, girls with oval faces and black almond eyes, no shadows, flat dreamy figures with ribbons, flowers, dogs and does, misty undefined backgrounds.
styles.section: Women artists across history not already obvious

styles.name: Ramon Casas
styles.medium: oil on canvas, charcoal, colour lithograph
styles.features: Muted grey, ochre and black palette with sudden red or white accents; fluid, rapid brushwork; elegant fashionably dressed figures against plain or sketchy grounds; Barcelona streets, cafés and interiors; flat silhouettes in poster designs.

styles.name: Joaquim Mir
styles.features: Dense, almost abstracted landscapes in saturated orange, violet, emerald and gold; thick swirling broken strokes; cliffs, coves, caves and orchards dissolving into shimmering colour fields; sunlight rendered as heat; little or no horizon line.

styles.name: Isidre Nonell
styles.features: Hunched seated women wrapped in shawls, heavy blocky forms; thick dark outlines; dense parallel strokes of blue, green and brown impasto; faces barely indicated; dim empty backgrounds; compact, monumental, sombre poses.
styles.note: Depict ordinary figures with dignity, avoid caricature

styles.name: Trencadís mosaic, Catalan Modernisme
styles.medium: broken glazed ceramic tile and glass set in mortar
styles.features: Surfaces covered in irregular shards of broken glazed tile, plates and glass set in white mortar; undulating organic curves on benches, chimneys, roofs and animal sculptures; bright blue, green, yellow and white fragments in loose glittering patterns.
styles.note: A surface treatment; depict buildings or objects clad in it

styles.name: Portuguese azulejo, Baroque blue-and-white panels
styles.features: Large wall panels of square tiles painted in cobalt blue on white; brushed washes and fine hatching; visible grid seams; elaborate scrolled Baroque frames with cherubs, acanthus and shells; hunting, pastoral and courtly scenes in graded blues.

styles.name: Portuguese carpet azulejos (azulejos de tapete)
styles.features: Repeating pattern tiles covering whole walls like carpets; cobalt blue, yellow ochre and green on white; stylised flowers, stars, interlace and diamond lattices formed by modules of four or sixteen tiles; framed by ornamental friezes.
styles.note: Pattern-based; best for walls, interiors and decorative surfaces

styles.name: Jorge Colaço
styles.features: Monumental figurative tile murals in cobalt blue on white with illusionistic depth; historical battles, royal processions and rural labour; academic realist drawing translated into graded blue washes; ornate painted frames; tile grid visible across scenes.

styles.name: Maria Keil
styles.features: Mid-century modernist tile walls: rhythmic geometric patterns of squares, stripes, arcs and grids; muted ochre, blue, grey and white glazes; slight hand-glazed variations between tiles; whole station walls covered in repeating modular designs.
styles.note: Abstract pattern; best applied to walls, passages and interiors

styles.name: José de Almada Negreiros
styles.features: Crisp flat outlines; simplified monumental figures with almond eyes and stylised hands; clear flat colour areas; geometric framing; fishermen, women of the coast and harlequins; graphic drawing close to mural and poster design.

styles.name: Rafael Bordalo Pinheiro faience
styles.features: Glossy earthenware moulded into realistic cabbage leaves, frogs, lobsters, snails, fish and vegetables; rich green, brown and cream glazes; trompe-l'oeil relief textures; plates, jugs and tureens encrusted with naturalistic creatures.
styles.note: Ceramic objects; depict tableware or sculpted ware

styles.name: Károly Ferenczy, Nagybánya colony
styles.features: Plein-air figures in dappled sunlight under trees; broad smooth patches of warm green and gold; strong blue cast shadows; calm people bathing, reading or riding; Impressionist light combined with solid, clearly drawn modelling.

styles.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka
styles.features: Visionary panoramic landscapes in glowing unnatural colour: blazing orange, turquoise and violet; sharp-edged ruins, solitary cedars and cliffs under intense light; tiny figures on vast terrain; naive yet precise drawing; hallucinatory clarity.

styles.name: Gödöllő artists' colony, Hungarian Arts and Crafts
styles.features: Flat stylised figures in folk dress with strong contour lines; muted earthy greens, ochres and reds; woven and painted legends and peasant life framed by Secession-style plant ornament and decorative borders.

styles.name: Vilmos Aba-Novák
styles.features: Crowded rhythmic compositions of fairs, markets and processions; hard bright colour planes in tempera; angular stocky figures with sharp outlines; geometric simplification; flattened stage-like perspective in the manner of decorative murals.

styles.name: Kalocsa folk painting
styles.medium: paint on whitewashed walls and furniture, embroidery
styles.features: Dense freehand flowers on white walls, furniture and fabric: roses, tulips, paprika pods, buds and small leaves in bright red, pink, blue, yellow and green; no depth; symmetrical sprays and garlands like embroidery.

styles.name: Bohumil Kubišta, Czech Cubo-Expressionism
styles.features: Angular faceted forms and sharp crystalline planes; dramatic diagonal lighting; intense complementary colour with deep blues against reds and oranges; figures, still lifes and city views compressed into tense geometric structures.

styles.name: Jan Zrzavý
styles.features: Dreamlike quiet scenes of soft rounded doll-like figures; smooth enamel-like surface; even glow without cast shadows; muted rose, blue and lilac harmonies; simplified boats, harbours and hills floating in stillness.

styles.name: Ľudovít Fulla
styles.features: Slovak modernism fusing folk art and abstraction: flat bright fields of red, yellow and blue; stylised peasant figures with mask-like faces; ornamental rhythm drawn from embroidery and painted ceramics; bold contours.

styles.name: Martin Benka
styles.features: Mountain landscapes with blue-violet peaks, vast billowing clouds and green meadows; simplified monumental peasants in folk dress; strong contours and broad flat brushstrokes; clear cool light.

styles.name: Stanisław Wyspiański, Young Poland
styles.features: Pastel portraits of children with soft blended faces and sinuous contour lines; decorative flowers such as nasturtiums, cornflowers and poppies; stained glass with bold leading and intense jewel colours; Kraków views.

styles.name: Józef Mehoffer
styles.features: Art Nouveau stained glass in glowing ruby, violet, gold and emerald; dense plant ornament and flowing leading lines; elongated saints and allegorical figures; rich patterning filling every space.

styles.name: Olga Boznańska
styles.features: Hushed portraits in muted grey, beige and violet tones; dry matte surface on unprimed board; soft scumbled strokes; figures emerging from misty interiors; large melancholy eyes; restrained veiled light.

styles.name: Julian Fałat
styles.features: Snowy winter landscapes with broad white expanses, meandering dark rivers, birch and pine woods; wet washes; low horizons; hunting parties and sleighs; cool blue and pink light on snow.

styles.name: Zofia Stryjeńska
styles.features: Folk Art Deco: stocky dancing peasants in striped costumes and flower wreaths; flat bold reds, greens and yellows; dynamic swirling rhythm; Slavic gods and seasonal rituals; dense decorative stylisation.

styles.name: Polish wycinanki, Łowicz papercut
styles.features: Symmetrical multi-layered paper cut-outs: roosters, flowers, trees of life and peacock tails; bright magenta, green, orange and blue layered on black or white; crisp scissor edges; circular medallions and tall vertical compositions.

styles.name: Nicolae Grigorescu
styles.features: Rural plein-air scenes: ox-carts on dusty roads, peasant girls in white embroidered blouses; soft luminous ochres, whites and greens; quick light brushstrokes; open bright skies; airy sketch-like finish.

styles.name: Ștefan Luchian
styles.features: Flowers in simple vases—anemones, carnations, cornflowers—in luminous fresh colour; quick broken strokes; pale airy backgrounds; modest suburban and rural scenes rendered with vibrant hues.

styles.name: Nicolae Tonitza
styles.features: Children's faces with huge dark almond eyes; simplified oval heads; delicate harmonies of pink, pale blue and white; broad flat strokes; decorative, softly lit compositions.

styles.name: Moldavian painted churches of Bukovina
styles.features: Exterior walls covered in horizontal fresco tiers; intense cerulean blue grounds with red and green; elongated Byzantine figures in registers; vast multitudes, sieges and judgment panoramas; weathered pigment.

styles.name: Transylvanian reverse glass icon painting
styles.medium: paint on the back of glass
styles.features: Naive devotional images painted behind glass: bold black outlines; flat bright red, blue, yellow and green; gilded haloes; frontal stylised figures; floral corner ornament; glossy glass sheen.

styles.name: Vladimir Dimitrov – Maistora
styles.features: Frontal peasant women and girls amid apples, quinces, corn and flowers; ornamental carpet-like compositions; intense warm reds, oranges and greens; icon-like symmetry; flat decorative patterning and golden glow.

styles.name: Zlatyu Boyadzhiev
styles.features: Crowded swirling village panoramas teeming with tiny grotesque figures, animals, carts and houses; thick churning impasto; deep reds, browns and golds; distorted fairground perspective; folk fantasy.
styles.note: Describes his late period

styles.name: Zahari Zograf
styles.features: Bulgarian Revival murals: bright tempera colours; clear outlines; figures in local folk costume within post-Byzantine compositions; lively devils, sinners and everyday scenes; ornamental bands; flat landscapes.

styles.name: Theophilos Hatzimichail
styles.medium: oil on canvas and plaster murals
styles.features: Naive folk scenes of village life, myths and independence heroes; flat bright colours; childlike perspective; figures in fustanellas and embroidered vests; painted name captions; plain skies.

styles.name: Yannis Tsarouchis
styles.features: Sailors, soldiers and dancers in plain cafés; smooth calm faces like ancient funerary portraits; clear outlines; flat areas of pink, blue and olive; still frontal poses; sparse interiors.

styles.name: Nikos Hadjikyriakos-Ghika
styles.features: Cubist structure of Aegean light: interlocking planes of white walls, stairs, windows and olive trees; warm ochre, blue and terracotta; layered linear grids; sunlit island architecture fractured into geometry.

styles.name: Lado Gudiashvili
styles.features: Sinuous elongated figures with almond eyes; fantastic creatures; flowing ornamental line; muted greens, ochres and rose; old Tbilisi revelry with echoes of Persian miniatures; rhythmic compositions.

styles.name: Elene Akhvlediani
styles.features: Old Tbilisi streets with carved wooden balconies, tiled roofs and steep narrow lanes; slightly naive simplified drawing; warm earthy palette; houses stacked on hillsides; small passers-by.

styles.name: Martiros Saryan
styles.features: Sunlit landscapes and still lifes in saturated flat colour: orange, violet, cobalt and emerald; strong light-shade contrasts; bold contours; mountains, fruit and flowers simplified into clear forms.

styles.name: Minas Avetisyan
styles.features: Flat bands of burning red, orange and yellow; simplified village figures; stylised mountains and trees; landscape compressed into colour planes; strong contours; matte fresco-like surface.

styles.name: Cilician Armenian manuscript illumination
styles.features: Gospel pages with gold grounds, ultramarine and carmine; delicate expressive figures; ornate canon tables with arches, birds and plants; marginal ornaments; Armenian script integrated into the page.

styles.name: Paja Jovanović
styles.features: Academic realism with photographic detail; Balkan costumes, weapons and ornaments; dramatic group scenes in sunlit landscapes; clear brilliant colour; precise anatomy; folk rituals and historical episodes.

styles.name: Nadežda Petrović
styles.features: Expressionist-Fauvist landscapes and figures; thick vigorous strokes; heavy blues, greens and reds; dark contours; women in folk dress; rough dramatic colour masses.

styles.name: Hlebine naive reverse glass painting, Ivan Generalić
styles.medium: oil on the reverse of glass
styles.features: Croatian naive painting behind glass; tiny precise details; flat bright colours; stylised red trees, villages, harvests and processions; deep dark skies; frontal childlike perspective.

styles.name: Ivana Kobilca
styles.features: Realist genre scenes and portraits: women ironing, sewing or resting in summer gardens; luminous whites; soft broad brushwork; flower still lifes.

styles.name: Vlaho Bukovac
styles.features: Academic realism with Impressionist light; Adriatic coast; family portraits; lively open brushwork; warm cheerful colour; later pointillist touches.

styles.name: Italian Renaissance 'Ideal City' panel, Urbino
styles.medium: tempera and oil on poplar panel
styles.features: Deserted piazza in strict one-point linear perspective, central round domed temple, symmetrical classical palazzi with arcades and pilasters, inlaid geometric marble pavement, pale cool sky, soft even light, precise ruled outlines, almost no figures.
styles.note: Figures are rare or absent; keep squares empty and still.

styles.name: David Roberts, tinted lithograph
styles.region: Britain; subjects in Egypt and the Holy Land
styles.features: Monumental ruined temples, columns and mosques dwarfing tiny robed figures, fine crayon-grain lithographic texture, warm buff and ochre tint, sparse hand-coloured accents of blue and red, hazy luminous sky, precisely drawn carved reliefs.

styles.name: Vienna Secession architectural drawing (Otto Wagner)
styles.medium: ink, watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Frontal elevations and perspectives in crisp ink line, flat watercolour washes of white, pale green and grey, gilded laurel wreaths and stylised ornament, clipped geometric trees, tiny elegant figures, symmetrical decorative framing borders.

styles.name: Mir iskusstva graphics (Mstislav Dobuzhinsky, Anna Ostroumova-Lebedeva)
styles.medium: colour woodcut, ink and watercolour on paper
styles.features: Quiet city views of granite embankments, canals, bridges and classical facades cut into clean flat woodcut planes; muted slate grey, ochre, pale green and dusk blue; firm outlines, wide skies, small solitary figures, melancholic stillness.

styles.name: Yakov Chernikhov, architectural fantasies
styles.medium: ink, gouache and airbrush on paper
styles.features: Imaginary industrial and constructivist complexes of interlocking cylinders, cantilevers, girders, bridges and towers, sharp axonometric or dramatic low perspective, flat saturated red, black, ochre and blue, ruled precise edges, no people.

styles.name: Mario Sironi, urban peripheries
styles.features: Desolate industrial outskirts with heavy blocky tenements, factory chimneys, a lone tram or truck, very few small figures; thick dense brushwork, dark earthy brown, ochre, black and grey, compressed space, sombre silent mood.

styles.name: Ashcan School (John Sloan)
styles.features: Gritty city life with tenement rooftops, elevated trains, saloons and crowded sidewalks; loose dark brushwork, muddy browns and greys with warm lamp-lit accents, quick gestural figures in ordinary clothes, candid snapshot composition.

styles.name: Maurice Utrillo
styles.medium: oil on canvas, sometimes mixed with plaster
styles.features: Quiet narrow Montmartre streets and churches, chalky thickly painted white facades, carefully ruled rooflines, shutters and chimneys, leaden grey sky, bare trees, receding lanes, tiny stiff figures, slightly naive askew perspective.

styles.name: Maria Helena Vieira da Silva
