styles.features: Dense labyrinthine grid of small tile-like strokes building receding scaffolds, libraries or cityscapes, shifting multiple perspectives, muted grey, ochre, blue and white palette, flickering mosaic surface, vertiginous depth without figures.

styles.name: Ben Nicholson
styles.medium: oil and pencil on carved, scraped board
styles.features: Overlapping flat geometric planes, circles and rectangles; scraped, sanded, rubbed surfaces; thin pencil outlines of jugs, cups and bottles; muted stone grey, ochre and white with one bright accent; shallow low-relief layering.

styles.name: Friedensreich Hundertwasser
styles.medium: watercolour, egg tempera and metallic foil on paper or canvas
styles.features: Wavering hand-drawn lines with no straight edges, concentric spirals, onion domes, rows of many small irregular windows, trees growing on roofs; vivid red, green and blue with metallic silver and gold patches, flat patterned bands.

styles.name: Grosvenor School colour linocut (Cyril Power)
styles.features: Dynamic Art Deco motion: swirling curves, elongated rhythmic figures, escalators, trains, racing crowds; three or four overlapping flat colour blocks, visible linoleum gouge texture, translucent overprinting, strong rhythmic repetition of shapes.

styles.name: hand-painted poster-colour backgrounds of 1980s–90s Japanese animation
styles.medium: poster colour gouache on illustration board
styles.features: Opaque matte gouache with softly blended skies, towering cumulus clouds, lush layered greenery, detailed everyday streets and interiors, crisp edges on foreground objects, painterly foliage texture, saturated summer blues and greens, no outlines.
styles.note: Do not name studios, directors or films; describe as hand-painted background art.

styles.name: 1950s American modernist cartoon, flat limited animation
styles.features: Flat unmodulated colour shapes offset from loose black outlines, angular stylised figures and furniture, sparse abstract backgrounds with spatter texture, simple geometric buildings, bold limited palette of mustard, teal, coral and black.
styles.note: Describe as a period style; avoid studio and character names.

styles.name: 1940s American feature animation watercolour backgrounds (Gustaf Tenggren)
styles.medium: transparent watercolour and gouache on paper
styles.features: Storybook European village and forest with steep gabled half-timbered houses and gnarled trees, soft transparent washes, fine brown contours, glowing golden-ochre and muted green palette, deep hazy atmosphere, warm amber light.
styles.note: Avoid naming the studio or its films.

styles.name: Soviet cut-out animation, 1970s
styles.medium: painted paper and celluloid cut-outs on multiplane glass
styles.features: Flat jointed paper figures with hinged limbs, textured paper and fabric surfaces, painted folk-like or graphic backgrounds on layered glass planes, soft diffuse depth, muted earthy ochre palette, slightly stiff stylised poses.
styles.note: Do not name living animators or the studio.

styles.name: puppet stop-motion animation with cardboard, wood and felt set
styles.medium: hand-made puppets and miniature set: cardboard, carved wood, felt, wire, wool
styles.features: Miniature tabletop world: cardboard houses with visible seams and paint, carved wooden puppets with painted faces, felt clothing and grass, wool trees, warm spotlight with soft shadows, shallow depth of field, tactile handmade imperfections.

styles.name: classic cinema matte painting on glass
styles.medium: oil or gouache on glass panes combined with live-action film
styles.features: Vast painted vistas of castles, cities and canyons blending seamlessly into a small live-action foreground, soft atmospheric perspective, dramatic skies, slightly glowing painted light, near-photographic realism with brushwork visible up close.

styles.name: 16-bit era pixel art, limited palette
styles.medium: digital pixel art, low resolution, indexed palette
styles.features: Visible square pixels at low resolution, hand-placed dark outlines, dithering patterns for gradients, limited palette of saturated colours, tiled side-view or top-down scenes, parallax background layers, small chunky sprite characters.
styles.note: Avoid naming games, consoles or characters.

styles.name: Polish School of Posters
styles.features: Painterly hand-drawn image built on a single surreal visual metaphor, loose brushstrokes and collage, expressive hand-lettered titles merged with the image, ironic distorted faces and objects, bold contrasts, generous empty background.

styles.name: Stenberg brothers, Constructivist film posters
styles.features: Dynamic diagonal compositions, enlarged drawn faces copied from film stills, figures in plunging perspective, spinning circles and spirals, flat red, black, ochre and blue, bold geometric sans-serif Cyrillic lettering.

styles.name: mid-century travel poster (David Klein)
styles.medium: gouache illustration for offset lithograph poster
styles.features: City landmarks reduced to bright angular flat shapes, overlapping translucent colour planes, saturated red, magenta, yellow and blue, slightly rough painterly texture, simple silhouetted figures, bold lettering band at bottom.
styles.note: Avoid airline brand names.

styles.name: Art Deco railway poster (Tom Purvis)
styles.features: Large flat colour areas without outlines, simplified seaside figures and landscapes, bold silhouettes, almost no shading, clear bright blues, oranges and greens, strong decorative design, block capital lettering.
styles.note: Avoid railway company names.

styles.name: two- or three-colour risograph print
styles.medium: risograph stencil print on uncoated paper
styles.features: Two or three flat spot colours such as fluorescent pink, teal and yellow, translucent overlaps creating extra colours, grainy halftone texture, slight misregistration, simplified bold silhouettes, flat fills, no outlines or modelling.
styles.note: Describe the graphic language: flat fills, limited palette, simplified silhouettes.

styles.name: jiehua ruled-line painting (Zhang Zeduan)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk handscroll
styles.features: Precise ruled ink lines for bridges, boats, gates and timber buildings with bracketed eaves, oblique parallel projection, continuous horizontal panorama, hundreds of tiny busy figures, pale brown silk tone with light mineral colour.

styles.name: blue-green landscape with palaces (Qiu Ying)
styles.medium: ink and mineral pigments on silk
styles.features: Jagged mountains in bright azurite blue and malachite green with fine ink and gold contours, palace pavilions with red pillars among pines, drifting white mist bands, elegant tiny figures in flowing robes.

styles.name: Suzhou (Gusu) city woodblock print
styles.medium: woodblock print with hand colouring on paper
styles.features: Panoramic city, canal and garden views combining Chinese motifs with European linear perspective and engraving-like cross-hatching, deep receding streets, crowds in Qing dress, hand-coloured pinks, greens and blues.

styles.name: Japanese emaki handscroll, fukinuki yatai (blown-off roof)
styles.medium: ink and opaque colour on paper handscroll
styles.features: Interiors seen from above with roofs and ceilings removed, steep oblique parallel projection, flat opaque mineral colours, sliding screens and tatami, courtiers in layered robes with line eyes and hook noses, sweeping diagonals.

styles.name: rakuchū-rakugai-zu folding screens
styles.medium: ink, colour and gold leaf on paper folding screens
styles.features: Bird's-eye panorama of city streets, temples and festivals glimpsed between bands of raised gold-leaf clouds, oblique parallel projection, thousands of tiny figures, bright mineral green, white and vermilion, flat patterned roofs.

styles.name: Joseon court palace painting, Donggwoldo type
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk, album or screen
styles.features: Vast palace compound seen from a high oblique angle in parallel projection without vanishing point, meticulously ruled tiled roofs and halls, blue-green mountains and pines framing courtyards, soft mineral colours, no figures.

styles.name: Persian miniature, Herat school (Kamāl ud-Dīn Behzād)
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Flat jewel-coloured page with tilted stacked space, intricate tiled architecture and courtyards, lively small figures at work, lapis blue, turquoise, vermilion and gold, fine outlines, densely patterned carpets and walls.

styles.name: Mughal miniature
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Fine brush detail, naturalistic profile portrait faces, subtle shading, atmospheric distant landscapes, courts, hunts and gardens, closely observed animals and flowers, rich greens and saffron, gold-flecked borders with floral motifs.

styles.name: Rajput miniature, Mewar school (Udaipur palaces)
styles.features: Large flat panoramas of white lakeside palaces, ghats and processions, bold saturated red, yellow and green, schematic patterned water, rows of small profile figures, several moments shown at once, minimal shading.

styles.name: Ottoman topographical miniature (Matrakçı Nasuh)
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Map-like bird's-eye city views without people, buildings as flat frontal elevations folded outward, domes, minarets and walls arranged around rivers and harbours, stylised trees, clear outlines, bright pinks, greens and blues.
styles.note: Typically no human figures.

styles.name: Iznik tiles
styles.features: Glossy white ground painted with tulips, carnations, hyacinths, serrated saz leaves and rosettes; cobalt blue, turquoise, sage green and raised tomato red, fine black outlines, symmetrical repeating panels.
styles.note: Best for decorative plant motifs, not narrative scenes.

styles.name: Tibetan thangka, monastery and mountain landscape
styles.medium: mineral pigments on sized cotton with silk brocade mount
styles.features: Flat mineral colours, rolling green hills and blue-green rocky peaks, monastery buildings perched on slopes, stylised swirling clouds and water, fine gold outlines, small robed monks, deep azure sky darkening upward.
styles.note: Religious art: depict monasteries, landscapes and pilgrims; do not invent deity iconography.

styles.name: Thai temple mural painting
styles.medium: mineral pigments and gold leaf on plaster wall
styles.features: Flat panoramic wall scenes divided by zigzag lines, gilded pavilions with tiered roofs and flame finials, graceful elongated figures with curved fingers, village life among them, dark red or blue grounds, gold-leaf accents.
styles.note: Religious setting; avoid casual depiction of the Buddha.

styles.name: Jain pilgrimage map painting (tirtha pata)
styles.features: Sacred hill shown as a map: dense grid of white temple shrines with spires inside walled enclosures, paths, tanks and gates laid flat, tiny pilgrims, bright red, yellow and green ground.
styles.note: Religious subject; keep respectful and focus on architecture and pilgrims.

styles.name: Balinese painting, Batuan style
styles.medium: ink and tempera or acrylic on paper or canvas
styles.features: Crowded compositions filling every surface, tiny figures, trees and animals in repeated patterns, fine ink line with layered grey-brown washes, near-monochrome tones with dark shadows, little sky, village life, dances and demons.

styles.name: Ethiopian traditional painting
styles.medium: tempera on canvas, parchment or church walls
styles.features: Flat bright red, yellow, green and blue figures with large almond eyes and frontal faces, heavy black outlines, patterned robes, strip-like narrative registers, minimal plain background, villains shown in profile.
styles.note: Rooted in church art; secular feasts, battles and markets also exist.

styles.name: Préfète Duffaut, Haitian naive painting
styles.features: Imaginary vertical cities on mountains with roads spiralling upward, crowded pastel houses, chapels and bridges, small figures, flat bright saturated colours, decorative patterning, naive perspective, sometimes a giant figure merging into hills.

styles.name: Aztec and Mixtec codex
styles.medium: mineral and organic pigments on gesso-coated deerskin or amate screenfold
styles.features: Flat bright red, turquoise, ochre and black figures with thick uniform outlines, profile bodies, no depth or shading, figures on red guide lines, pictographic day-signs and place-signs, footprints marking travel.
styles.note: Glyphs are pictorial signs; avoid fake inscriptions.

styles.name: Cusco School
styles.medium: oil on canvas with gold leaf
styles.features: Stiff frontal figures in triangular robes covered with dense gold-leaf brocade patterns, dark backgrounds, Andean birds and flowers, rich red and deep blue, flattened space, lace and jewel ornament.
styles.note: Mostly religious subjects; also suits processions.

styles.name: Diego Rivera, Mexican muralism
styles.features: Monumental mural with rounded, solid figures in earthy ochres, terracotta, indigo and maize greens; dense friezes of workers, farmers and machines stacked in shallow layered space; firm contour lines, simplified volumes, flat matte fresco surface.

styles.name: Andean textile, Peruvian and Bolivian weaving tradition
styles.features: Tightly woven wool and cotton with stepped geometric grids; llamas, birds, condors and humans reduced to angular pixel-like blocks; repeating bands and diamonds in cochineal red, indigo, mustard yellow, black and cream; flat, no depth.

styles.name: Inuit stonecut and stencil print, Cape Dorset (Kinngait)
styles.medium: stonecut and stencil print on Japanese paper
styles.features: Bold flat silhouettes of owls, seals, birds, fish and hunters on wide areas of blank cream paper; few saturated colours, black, red, blue, orange; feathers and fur as decorative comb-like patterns; no ground line or perspective.
styles.note: Refer to the regional print tradition of the 1960s–80s, not to the still-operating studio or living printmakers.

styles.name: Russian icon painting, Novgorod and Moscow schools
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold leaf on gessoed wooden panel
styles.features: Flat gold ground; elongated figures with thin dark contours and layered white highlights on faces and drapery; reverse perspective with tilted tables, boxy architectural chambers and stepped rocky hills; cinnabar, ochre, malachite green, lapis blue.
styles.note: Religious tradition: do not place sacred figures in trivial or comic scenes; borrow the structure and painting manner.

styles.name: Byzantine mosaic, Ravenna and the Madaba Map
styles.features: Small glass and stone tesserae laid in visible rows following contours; shimmering gold or deep blue grounds; frontal, stiff figures with large eyes and flat robes; schematic buildings, trees and walled towns seen from above; little depth.

styles.name: Limbourg brothers, Gothic book of hours
styles.features: Jewel-like miniature: ultramarine skies deepening toward the top, gold details, turreted white castles rising behind fields; tiny elegant figures in courtly dress or peasants at seasonal work; fine stippled brushwork, high horizon, tilted landscape.

styles.name: Ambrogio Lorenzetti, Sienese painting
styles.medium: fresco and tempera on gold-ground panel
styles.features: Panoramic townscapes of pink and ochre towers, crenellated walls and loggias packed with small figures dancing, trading and riding; rolling cultivated hills in bird's-eye view; soft pastel palette, graceful elongated figures, gentle lyrical line.

styles.name: Giotto
styles.features: Solid block-like figures with heavy rounded drapery and grave gestures; shallow stage-like space with boxy buildings and bare rocky hills; deep ultramarine sky; clear compositions with few figures, soft modelling in muted earth tones and rose.

styles.name: Romanesque fresco, Catalan and French churches
styles.features: Bold black outlines around flat colour fields; stylised frontal figures with large staring eyes, symmetrical faces and striped drapery folds; plain horizontal bands of ochre, red, blue and white as background; no depth; rhythmic decorative borders.

styles.name: Gothic stained glass, Chartres and Sainte-Chapelle
styles.features: Small pieces of saturated ruby red and cobalt blue glass held by thick black lead lines; figures painted with brown grisaille contours; scenes framed in medallions and roundels; glowing transmitted light; flat stacked narrative panels without perspective.

styles.name: Toros Roslin, Armenian manuscript illumination
styles.features: Bright lapis blue, vermilion and gold; slender graceful figures with fine linear drapery folds and expressive faces; ornate arches, interlaced bands, stylised birds and plants in margins; flat gold or plain grounds.

styles.name: Roman wall painting, Second Pompeian Style (Boscoreale)
styles.features: Illusionistic painted architecture opening the wall: columns, balconies, gateways and receding city buildings in intuitive perspective; deep cinnabar red and ochre panels; fruit bowls, masks and garlands; soft brushwork, cracked aged plaster surface.

styles.name: Hand-coloured woodcut town view, Nuremberg Chronicle
styles.features: Thick black woodcut contours and parallel hatching; walled town crowded with towers, gabled roofs and spires seen from a raised viewpoint; loose watercolour washes of red, green, ochre and blue over the lines; stylised hills, wavy river.
styles.note: Take the technique and town-view structure only, not religious subjects.

styles.name: École des Beaux-Arts architectural wash rendering
styles.medium: Indian ink and watercolour wash on stretched paper
styles.features: Strict orthographic façade elevation in fine ruled ink lines; graded transparent washes model shadows cast at 45 degrees; columns, cornices and arches crisply detailed; pale sky gradient; sepia, grey and soft blue tones; no perspective.

styles.name: Architectural perspective section
styles.features: Building sliced open, cut walls and floors solid black or densely hatched; one-point perspective revealing rooms, stairs and furniture behind the cut plane; fine uniform ruled lines, tiny figures for scale, monochrome.

styles.name: Vue d'optique, 18th-century optical view print
styles.features: Exaggerated one-point perspective down long streets, squares, canals and palace courtyards toward a central vanishing point; ruled architectural lines; tiny strolling figures and carriages; bright translucent hand-colouring in blue, pink, green and yellow; tall open sky.

styles.name: Architectural model in cardboard and balsa wood
styles.medium: card, balsa wood and foam board
styles.features: Miniature buildings of white or grey card and pale balsa with clean knife-cut edges; visible glue seams, stepped layered terrain, sponge-ball trees, tiny white figures; soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field.

styles.name: Solarpunk
styles.features: Bright optimistic cities with terraced gardens, vine-covered towers, solar panels, wind turbines and glass greenhouses; curved organic architecture; warm sunlight, lush greens, white and gold; people cycling, tending rooftop farms, clear canals.
styles.note: Contemporary genre; do not cite living illustrators.

styles.name: 1950s retrofuturism, Googie and atomic-age design
styles.features: Boomerang roofs, upswept cantilevered canopies, starbursts, atom-orbit motifs and flying-saucer buildings; chrome cars and finned rockets; turquoise, coral, mustard and cream palette; airbrushed gradients, clear sunny skies, cheerful suburban people.

styles.name: Photochrom print
styles.medium: photolithographic colour print from a photographic negative
styles.features: Photographic detail softened by flat transparent tints; pastel sky blues, chalky greens, dusty pinks and ochres; slightly unnatural colour patches on streets, harbours, mountains and people in period dress; fine grain, matte paper.

styles.name: Portuguese azulejo tile panel, blue and white
styles.features: Large scene painted in cobalt blue on white glaze across a grid of square tiles with visible joints; loose brushy washes and hatching; baroque scroll and acanthus frames; glossy surface with slight crazing; figures in gardens and landscapes.

styles.name: Nabis, Pierre Bonnard and Édouard Vuillard
styles.medium: oil and distemper on canvas or board
styles.features: Intimate interiors and gardens dissolved into patterned surfaces; wallpaper, tablecloths and dresses merge in mottled dabs; flattened space with half-hidden figures; warm muted reds, mauves and ochres with sudden glowing violets and oranges.

styles.name: Fauvism, André Derain and early Henri Matisse
styles.features: Pure unmixed colour: vermilion trees, green faces, violet shadows, orange water; broad separate strokes and dabs with bare canvas showing; flattened space; simplified boats, hills and figures under intense Mediterranean light.

styles.name: Carl Rungius
styles.features: Moose, bighorn sheep, elk and grizzly in mountain terrain; bold square brushstrokes building planes of rock and fur; strong sunlight with blue-violet shadows; high-key palette; anatomically exact animals.

styles.name: Wilhelm Kuhnert
styles.features: Lions, elephants and antelopes in sunlit savanna; accurate anatomy, loose confident brushwork in grass and dust; golden ochres, dry greens and hazy blue distance; animals seen at eye level in wide open space.

styles.name: Henri Matisse, late paper cut-outs
styles.features: Flat shapes cut freehand with scissors from paper painted saturated ultramarine, coral, lemon yellow and emerald; wavy leaves, seaweed, stars and dancing figures on white or coloured grounds; slightly irregular edges, visible overlaps.

styles.name: Arthur Dove
styles.medium: oil and wax emulsion on canvas or board
styles.features: Abstracted nature built from swelling rounded forms, concentric bands and pulsing rings radiating from sun, hills, trees or animals; earthy browns, olive greens, deep blue and pale yellow; soft matte paint, rhythmic flowing contours.
styles.note: Keep the subject recognisable: silhouette, two or three telling features, rhythm and colour.

styles.name: Early 20th-century colour woodcut (Allen W. Seaby, Norbertine Bresslern-Roth)
styles.medium: colour woodcut and linocut on Japanese paper
styles.features: Birds and animals in natural settings printed in a few soft overlapping colour blocks; visible wood grain and slight registration shifts; minimal key line; flat muted greens, ochres, greys and blues; generous negative space.

styles.name: 1930s American cel animation with watercolour backgrounds
styles.medium: ink and paint on cel over watercolour background
styles.features: Rubbery rounded characters with black outlines and flat cel colours over soft transparent watercolour backgrounds; meadows, flowers and cottages in delicate washes; pastel greens, pinks and sky blues; bouncy anthropomorphic animals and plants.
styles.note: Do not name the studio, its film series or characters; describe period and technique.

styles.name: WPA National Park poster, 1930s screen print
styles.features: Flat layered silkscreen colours in a limited palette; mountains, geysers, cliffs, forests and lakes as bold simplified shapes; banded sunset skies; strong silhouettes; block capital lettering naming the park along the bottom.

styles.name: Art Deco animalier (Paul Jouve, Jean Dunand lacquer panels)
styles.medium: lacquer on wood with gold leaf and eggshell inlay; gouache
styles.features: Panthers, elephants, fish, birds and deer as sleek stylised silhouettes; black or red lacquer grounds with gold and silver leaf and crackled eggshell textures; strong rhythmic contours, simplified musculature, decorative repetition, high polish.

styles.name: Japanese mid-century graphic design (Yusaku Kamekura, Ikko Tanaka)
styles.features: Flat geometric shapes, circles and grids in bold red, black, gold and bright primaries on white; traditional motifs reduced to modernist forms; generous empty space, precise alignment, crisp typography balancing the image.

styles.name: Late 19th-century chromolithograph (seed catalogue, fruit crate label)
styles.features: Rich saturated colour layers printed from stones with fine stipple; glossy oversized fruits, vegetables and flowers; idealised farm landscapes; ornate borders and ribbon banners; smooth gradients, slight misregistration, warm varnished look.

styles.name: Mid-century Scandinavian printed textile (Josef Frank, Maija Isola)
styles.features: Repeat patterns on cotton: dense fanciful flowers, leaves and birds in clear colours, or giant flat poppy-like blooms; bold screen-printed shapes, slight ink misregistration, white grounds, saturated reds, greens, blues and black.
styles.note: Do not use the names of active textile brands.

styles.name: 1960s American psychedelic poster art (Milton Glaser era)
styles.features: Swirling Art Nouveau curves and melting balloon lettering filling the frame; vibrating complementary colours, orange against blue, magenta against green; flat outlined shapes, profile silhouettes, flowers and paisley; Victorian woodtype mixed with pop illustration.
styles.note: The Push Pin studio name is avoided because a co-founder is living and the group is still active.

styles.name: Song dynasty bird-and-flower painting, gongbi (Emperor Huizong's academy)
styles.medium: ink and mineral colours on silk
styles.features: Meticulous fine-line drawing of a single bird on a blossoming branch; delicate layered colour washes; feathers stroked hair by hair; aged amber-brown silk ground left empty; asymmetrical composition, quiet balance, small red seal marks.

styles.name: Lang Shining (Giuseppe Castiglione)
styles.features: European shading and perspective merged with Chinese silk painting; horses, hunting dogs and cranes modelled with soft volume and accurate anatomy; detailed pines, rocks and blossoms; light ground, precise brushwork, no cast shadows.

styles.name: Rinpa school (Ogata Kōrin, Sakai Hōitsu)
styles.medium: ink, mineral pigments and gold leaf on folding screens
styles.features: Bold decorative flowers, waves and grasses against flat gold or silver leaf; pooled ink blooms (tarashikomi); large simplified shapes, rhythmic repeated irises and plum branches; malachite green, azurite blue, white; empty asymmetric space.

styles.name: Kachō-e bird-and-flower woodblock print (Hokusai, Hiroshige)
styles.features: A single bird, insect or fish with a flowering branch in a tall narrow format; crisp black key lines, flat colour blocks and soft bokashi gradients; Prussian blue, pink and soft green; visible wood grain texture.

styles.name: Korean minhwa folk painting and chochungdo (grass-and-insect painting)
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper or silk
styles.features: Cheerful flat compositions of plants, flowers and insects: butterflies, grasshoppers, cucumbers, eggplants and peonies; stylised folk drawing in bright red, green, yellow and blue; little depth, decorative symmetry, playful simplified animals.

styles.name: Ustad Mansur, Mughal natural history painting
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: A single bird, animal or flower rendered with naturalist precision on a plain cream or pale ground; minute brushstrokes for each feather; subtle natural colours; small tufts of grass or rock; ornamental gold-flecked border.

styles.name: Rajput and Pahari miniature painting
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Bright flat colours, saffron, crimson, peacock green and lapis, with fine outlines; profile faces with large almond eyes; tilted terraces, pavilions and stylised trees; night scenes, monsoon clouds and lightning; decorative red borders.

styles.name: Gond painting, Pardhan Gond of Madhya Pradesh
styles.features: Flat bright silhouettes of animals, birds and trees filled entirely with fine repeating dots, dashes, fish-scale and crosshatched lines; plain white or single-colour ground; no perspective; crisp decorative outlines

styles.name: Warli painting, Maharashtra
styles.medium: white rice-paste paint on mud-plastered wall or ochre cloth
styles.features: White pictograms on earthy red-brown ground; humans as two joined triangles with circle heads and stick limbs; spiral dance circles, trees, huts and animals in small scattered rows; no depth; monochrome line

styles.name: Iznik ceramic tilework, Ottoman
styles.features: Glossy white ground with cobalt blue, turquoise, sage green and raised tomato-red; stylised tulips, carnations, hyacinths, serrated curling saz leaves and rosettes in symmetrical scrolling arrangements; thin dark outlines; flat, unshaded

styles.name: Balinese painting, Batuan and Ubud schools
styles.medium: tempera or acrylic and ink on cloth or paper
styles.features: Densely packed surface with no empty space; countless small figures, animals and layered tropical foliage; fine ink outlines and many grey shading washes (Batuan dark, Ubud lighter and more colourful); stacked high-viewpoint space

styles.name: Northwest Coast formline art, Haida and Tlingit
styles.medium: paint on carved cedar; also silkscreen on paper
styles.features: Swelling black primary formlines with red secondary lines, sometimes blue-green tertiary; ovoids and U-forms tightly fill the animal outline; split, symmetrical frontal creatures with eye motifs at joints; flat, no background depth
styles.note: Show generic animals; specific family and clan crests and ceremonial regalia belong to their communities.

styles.name: Mexican amate bark-paper painting, Nahua of Guerrero
styles.features: Mottled brown fibrous bark-paper ground; flat saturated pinks, oranges, greens, blues and yellows; birds, flowers and village life in dense frontal arrangements with bold dark outlines; small dotted and striped details; no perspective

styles.name: Ancient American painted pottery, Mimbres and Nazca
styles.medium: mineral slip paint on burnished earthenware
styles.region: Southwestern North America (Mimbres) and southern Peru (Nazca)
styles.features: Matte slip painting on smooth curved clay; Mimbres: crisp black-on-white animals, fish and figures with hatched geometric bodies inside a ringed bowl centre; Nazca: polychrome cream, ochre, red, grey and black creatures with bold outlines
styles.note: Two distinct looks; name only one per prompt. Mimbres bowls are funerary objects for Pueblo descendants: avoid the punched 'kill hole' and burial scenes.

styles.name: Paracas embroidery and Andean textile
styles.medium: camelid-wool embroidery and weaving on cotton or wool cloth
styles.era: Paracas c. 200 BC–AD 200; Andean weaving to the 16th century
styles.features: Rows of repeated flat figures on dark red, indigo or black cloth; densely stitched in gold, green, blue and pink; stepped stair-like contours; frontal flying beings, birds and felines; colours rotating across a grid; no depth
styles.note: Paracas mantles come from burials; prefer animals and pattern grids over mortuary figures.

styles.name: Medieval bestiary illumination
styles.medium: tempera and burnished gold leaf on parchment
styles.features: Flat burnished gold or patterned ground inside a coloured painted frame; animals and birds with stylised outlines, symbolic rather than accurate; ultramarine, vermilion, green, white highlights; no perspective; creatures overlapping the frame
styles.note: Animals look deliberately unrealistic; ask for the framed miniature without lines of script.

styles.name: Mille-fleurs tapestry
styles.features: Deep dark-blue or red ground strewn with hundreds of small separate flowering plants seen flat; animals, birds and figures float on it without horizon; visible woven texture; soft muted reds, greens, blues and cream

styles.name: Roman garden fresco, Villa of Livia
styles.features: Continuous wall of dense garden seen at eye level behind a low lattice fence; quince, pomegranate, oak, laurel, palms, flowers and many small birds; airy blue-green background; soft loosely painted leaves fading into depth; matte plaster surface

styles.name: Roman floor mosaic, marine and Nilotic scenes
styles.features: Small square tesserae in visible rows following contours; fish, octopus, eels, lobsters, ducks, hippos, papyrus boats and reed huts; off-white or dark ground; muted ochre, terracotta, grey, green; shading by graded tesserae; geometric border
styles.note: Ancient Nile scenes often include ethnic caricatures; keep to animals, boats, plants and buildings.

styles.name: Insular illuminated manuscript, Book of Kells
styles.medium: mineral and plant pigments on vellum
styles.features: Dense knotwork of interlaced elongated animals, birds and snakes biting each other; spirals, triskeles, step patterns; yellow, purple, green and red with red-dot outlines; flat frontal stylised figures with large eyes inside framed panels
styles.note: Insular script appears naturally; for a picture without letters ask for a carpet-page panel.

styles.name: Gothic book of hours with marginalia
styles.medium: tempera, ink and gold on vellum
styles.features: Small framed miniature with gilded or diapered background; gothic script block surrounded by thin ivy-leaf border vines; margins full of tiny hybrid creatures, rabbits, knights, snails and musicians; slender swaying figures; bright blue, red, gold

styles.name: Tacuinum Sanitatis, Lombard illustrated health handbook
styles.medium: pen, ink and tempera on vellum
styles.features: One framed scene per page: a single large plant or tree with peasants harvesting, cooking or selling; plain parchment background over a simple ground strip; fresh greens, reds, browns; delicate pen outlines, flat washes; oversized schematic leaves and fruit
styles.note: Original pages carry a short caption; ask for the scene only.

styles.name: Ancient Egyptian tomb painting
styles.features: Flat matte colour on pale ochre ground in horizontal registers; people and animals in strict profile with clean contours; dense vertical papyrus thickets, birds, fish, geese walking in rows; earth red, ochre, blue, green, black; no shadows or perspective
styles.note: Hieroglyph bands often appear; ask for none if unwanted.

styles.name: Aegean Bronze Age fresco, Akrotiri (Thera)
styles.features: Pale plaster ground with bold fluid outlines; swallows in flight, red lilies on undulating rocky hills banded red, ochre and blue; leaping dolphins; flat colour areas without shading; rhythmic curving lines; worn, flaking fresco surface
styles.note: Borrow the technique and composition, not religious or ritual subjects.

styles.name: John Gould and Edward Lear, hand-coloured lithographs
styles.features: Life-size birds and parrots perched on a branch against blank white paper; soft grainy lithographic crayon modelling; precise feathers tinted in clear watercolour, glossy plumage highlights; minimal sketched foliage, no background scene

styles.name: Cyanotype photogram, Anna Atkins
styles.features: Deep Prussian-blue field with white to pale-blue silhouettes of seaweeds, ferns and feathers laid flat; fine translucent edges and veins; no perspective; mottled brushed edges and visible paper texture

styles.name: Natural history museum diorama
styles.medium: taxidermy and sculpted foreground before a curved oil-painted backdrop
styles.features: Three-dimensional foreground of real rocks, grasses and mounted animals blending seamlessly into a curved painted landscape with deep perspective and wide sky; warm theatrical lighting; glass-case framing; frozen stillness

styles.name: Macro photography, shallow depth of field
styles.features: Extreme close-up of an insect, droplet, petal or moss; razor-thin plane of sharp focus with creamy blurred bokeh in front and behind; magnified surface textures; soft natural light; rich saturated colour; isolated subject

styles.name: Barbizon school
styles.features: Intimate forest edges, ponds and meadows; feathery silvery-grey foliage with soft blurred edges; dense dark oaks against luminous sky; earthy greens, browns, pearl greys; small peasants and cattle; loose broken brushwork

styles.name: Gustav Klimt, landscapes
styles.features: Square format with high or absent horizon; flat tapestry-like surface; meadow flowers, birch trunks and lakeside facades built from countless small dabs and dots; dense greens, blues, yellows; sky a thin strip or missing; mosaic-like pattern

styles.name: Art Nouveau decorative panel
styles.features: Tall narrow format; elongated figure or plants framed by an ornamental arch or halo; flowing whiplash curves; clear dark contour lines; flat muted pastels with gold, olive, ochre; stylised flowers, swirling hair, symmetrical borders
styles.note: Ask for no lettering; similar designs often appear as posters.

styles.name: Der Blaue Reiter (Franz Marc, early Kandinsky)
styles.features: Saturated non-naturalistic colour: blue horses, red cows, yellow hills; curved rhythmic forms; broad flat patches with dark outlines; faceted crystal-like overlapping planes; simplified Bavarian village and mountain landscape

styles.name: Kazimir Malevich, late peasant cycle
styles.features: Faceless frontal peasant figures with blank egg-shaped heads and stiff symmetrical poses; bodies split into flat bands of red, white, black and yellow; striped multicoloured fields to a low horizon; empty sky; smooth matte paint
styles.note: Faces stay blank; the earlier 1912 peasant works were tubular cubo-futurist instead.

styles.name: Georges Braque, L'Estaque cubism
styles.features: Houses reduced to stacked windowless ochre cubes interlocking with angular green trees; muted ochre, olive, grey-green and brown; edges dissolving into shaded passages; tilted planes, no single viewpoint, little or no sky; short directional brushstrokes

styles.name: Orphism (Robert Delaunay)
styles.features: Concentric circles and disc segments of pure contrasting colour; prismatic overlapping arcs of orange, blue, green, red and violet; city and window views broken into faceted colour planes; luminous, rhythmic, flat brushwork

styles.name: Mexican landscape painting, Dr. Atl and Diego Rivera
styles.features: Volcanoes and wide valleys seen from high above with a curved bending horizon; strong saturated blues, ochres, greens; solid rounded hills; simplified agaves and trees; dry crisp light; firm rounded peasants and flowers in Rivera's manner

styles.name: Group of Seven (Lawren Harris, Tom Thomson)
styles.features: Wind-bent pines, rocky lakeshores, icebergs; thick bold strokes and simplified rhythmic forms; saturated autumn reds, oranges, deep blues; in Harris's manner smooth stylised mountains under luminous radiating skies, almost geometric

styles.name: Precisionism (Charles Sheeler)
styles.features: Factories, silos, ships and machinery in crisp clean geometry; smooth invisible brushwork; sharp edges; flattened planes of light and shadow; cool clear sky; no people; muted greys, creams, blues and rust

styles.name: Wood engraving (Thomas Bewick, Lynd Ward)
styles.medium: end-grain wood engraving, black ink on paper
styles.features: Black-and-white image of white lines cut from a black ground; fine parallel hatching and stippling build tone; dense dramatic contrast; small format; birds and rural vignettes, or angular expressive figures and night cities

styles.name: Soviet Constructivist graphic design
styles.medium: photomontage, letterpress and lithograph on paper
styles.features: Strong diagonals and bold geometric blocks of red, black and white on cream paper; cut-out photographs of workers and machines; sans-serif lettering in bars; circles, arrows, dramatic low-angle perspective; flat printed colour

styles.name: Mid-century airline travel poster
styles.features: Flat simplified shapes in bright gouache colours, turquoise, orange, mustard; airliner silhouette over a stylised destination landmark; screenprint texture and cut-paper look; playful geometry; bold sans-serif title band

styles.name: Risograph print, two or three spot colours
styles.features: Two or three bright spot inks such as fluorescent pink, blue and yellow; flat fills with grainy texture and halftone dots; slight misregistration; overlapping translucent inks making third tones; simplified silhouette shapes
styles.note: Call it a print or illustration, not a poster, to avoid stray lettering.

styles.name: Monumental Northern Song landscape (Fan Kuan, Guo Xi)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, hanging scroll
styles.features: Towering central mountain mass rising above misty valleys; dense textured strokes, raindrop dots and cloud-like curls, build the rock; gnarled crab-claw trees; tiny travellers and temples; brown-grey ink on aged silk; distances layered by mist

styles.name: Mi Fu and Mi Youren, 'Mi dot' landscape
styles.features: Rounded misty hills built from horizontal blots of wet ink laid side by side; soft bleeding edges; dissolving clouds and fog bands; few trees; no hard contour lines; monochrome greys to black on paper

styles.name: Chinese blue-and-green landscape (qinglü shanshui), Tang dynasty
styles.medium: mineral pigments and ink on silk
styles.features: Jagged stacked mountains in azurite blue and malachite green, fine ink contour lines, gold highlights along ridges, tiny pavilions, horsemen and travellers, stepped receding peaks, flat ochre-toned silk ground, ribbon-like cloud bands

styles.name: Japanese haboku splashed-ink landscape, Sesshū Tōyō
styles.features: Wet blots and pools of grey-black ink suggest mountains and trees, a few sharp dry strokes mark a roof or boat, wide blank paper reads as mist, soft tonal gradation, near-abstract, tall vertical format
styles.note: Loose splashed-ink counterpart to the separate outlined Sesshū ink-landscape entry.

styles.name: Rinpa school folding screen on gold ground
styles.medium: mineral pigments and gold leaf on paper, folding screen
styles.features: Flat gold-leaf ground, bold simplified irises, waves, plum trees and grasses in saturated malachite and ultramarine, pooled ink blooms (tarashikomi), rhythmic repeated motifs, asymmetrical composition across panel folds, no horizon

styles.name: Japanese ukiyo-e landscape print, Hokusai and Hiroshige
styles.features: Crisp black keyblock outlines, flat colour areas, Prussian blue bokashi gradations in sky and water, stylised curling waves, rain as fine diagonal lines, small travellers, high viewpoint, boldly cropped foreground objects

styles.name: Korean true-view landscape (jingyeong sansu), Jeong Seon
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper
styles.features: Real Korean mountains rendered with vigorous vertical ink strokes for pale granite peaks, dense dark dots for forested slopes, pale wash mist, tiny pavilions and scholars, light indigo and ochre tints, bird's-eye panorama

styles.name: Vietnamese silk painting (tranh lụa)
styles.medium: ink and watercolour washes on silk
styles.features: Soft translucent washes soaked into silk, muted ochre, brown, pale green and indigo, delicate dark outlines, women in áo dài, children and villagers in calm everyday scenes, minimal background, matte gentle surface

styles.name: Pahari miniature painting, Kangra school
styles.features: Fine lyrical line, slender graceful figures with oval faces, cool greens and soft pinks, rolling hills with feathery rounded trees, flowering vines, winding rivers, dark monsoon skies with lightning, painted red or patterned border
styles.note: Prefer romantic, courtly or seasonal scenes over devotional subjects.

styles.name: Mixtec codex painting, Postclassic Mesoamerica
styles.features: Flat bright red, yellow, turquoise and black on white ground, thick even black outlines, profile figures with oversized heads, pictorial date and place signs, red guidelines dividing zigzag registers, no shading or depth
styles.note: Treat as historical narrative; avoid sacrifice imagery.

styles.name: Polynesian tapa bark cloth (ngatu, siapo)
styles.medium: beaten bark cloth with rubbed and painted plant dyes
styles.features: Beige fibrous beaten-bark surface, repeating geometric bands and grid panels, rubbed brown, rust and black dyes, stencilled triangles, stylised leaves, fish, turtles and stars, crisp freehand overpainted lines, flat symmetrical layout

styles.name: Medieval mappa mundi and portolan chart
styles.features: Vellum sheet with rhumb lines radiating from compass roses, red and black hand-lettered place names, coastlines fringed with tiny walled towns and towers, wavy blue seas with ships and sea monsters, gold accents, flat schematic geography
styles.note: Use the cartographic layout and technique; omit religious figures and scenes.

styles.name: Space-age retrofuturist concept illustration, 1960s–70s
styles.medium: gouache and airbrush on illustration board
styles.features: Smooth airbrushed gradients, gleaming white rocket ships, domed lunar colonies and monorails, wide cinematic perspective, glowing orange and teal skies, tiny figures in spacesuits, clean optimistic geometry, painted board finish
styles.note: Kept distinct from the 1950s atompunk and 1980s cassette futurism entries.

styles.name: Mid-century gouache children's book illustration
styles.features: Opaque matte gouache with visible brush texture, flat simplified shapes, limited warm palette of mustard, tomato red, teal and cream, rounded cheerful figures and animals, dry-brush details, slightly naive perspective, white margins

styles.name: 19th-century topographic atlas and geological cross-section
styles.features: Fine engraved hachures and contour lines for relief, pale hand-washed colour bands for rock strata, cutaway section showing layered, folded and faulted earth, neat serif labels, scale bars, legend boxes, cream paper

styles.name: Ernst Haeckel scientific plates
styles.features: Symmetrical arrangements of radiolarians, jellyfish, diatoms and corals floating on a plain or dark ground, intricate lace-like geometric structure, fine stippling, muted sepia, teal and coral tints, ornamental Art Nouveau rhythm

styles.name: Embroidered and patchwork quilt landscape
styles.medium: cotton patchwork, appliqué and hand embroidery
styles.features: Fields built from stitched fabric patches of gingham, calico and linen, visible seams and running-stitch outlines, French-knot trees and flowers, satin-stitch sky, quilting lines forming hills, raised soft thread texture

styles.name: Jean-Siméon Chardin
styles.features: Quiet still lifes and kitchen scenes, granular soft-edged brushwork, warm earthy browns, creamy whites and muted greens, diffuse window light, humble copper pots, fruit and glasses, absorbed servants and children, plain dark backgrounds

styles.name: Peredvizhniki (The Wanderers), Russian realism
styles.features: Sober naturalistic oil, broad confident brushwork, earthy ochres, greys and birch greens, wide plains, muddy roads, spring thaw, rivers under overcast skies, log villages, peasants and townsfolk with expressive weathered faces

styles.name: Russian Constructivism, Rodchenko and El Lissitzky
styles.features: Diagonal dynamic compositions, bold red, black and white, heavy sans-serif block letters, geometric circles, bars and wedges, photomontage cutout figures, steep low-angle views, industrial machinery, flat printed colour
styles.note: Keep slogans short.

styles.name: Brandywine School illustration, Howard Pyle and N.C. Wyeth
styles.medium: oil on canvas for book and magazine illustration
styles.features: Dramatic narrative oil painting, strong silhouettes, rich warm palette with deep shadows and sunlit golds, theatrical lighting, pirates, knights and frontiersmen in vigorous action, broad painterly strokes, clear storytelling composition

styles.name: Soviet children's book illustration, 1920s–30s Leningrad (Vladimir Lebedev, Vladimir Konashevich)
styles.features: Flat bold colour shapes on white pages, few inks such as red, black, ochre and blue, simplified geometric animals and people, cut-paper collage silhouettes, lively loose ink line, generous white space, playful hand-drawn lettering

styles.name: 1930s rubber-hose cartoon animation with watercolour backgrounds
styles.medium: ink and paint on celluloid over watercolour backgrounds
styles.features: Cel characters with bendy boneless rubber-hose limbs, white gloves, pie-cut eyes and round heads, bouncing exaggerated poses over soft watercolour backgrounds of crooked houses and trees, gentle early colour, slight film grain
styles.note: Do not use studio or character names.

styles.name: WPA silkscreen poster, Federal Art Project
styles.features: Flat silkscreened colour fields in three to five inks, simplified shapes without outlines, stylised national parks, mountains and civic buildings, graphic clouds and sun rays, bold sans-serif headline lettering, slight ink texture

styles.name: 1960s psychedelic poster and Art Nouveau-revival graphics
styles.features: Vibrating complementary colours, swirling melting hand-drawn lettering filling the sheet, Art Nouveau curves, flat decorative figures with thick outlines, Victorian woodcut revival elements, op-art contrasts, dense ornament
styles.note: Push Pin Studio's surviving co-founder is living; describe the look by period and technique only, without studio or artist names.

styles.name: Chinese gongbi fine-line painting
styles.medium: ink and mineral colour on silk
styles.features: Meticulous even-weight ink outlines, layered flat washes of mineral colour, precise feathers, petals and fabric patterns, no visible brushstrokes, birds on flowering branches, court ladies, plain silk background, crisp detail

styles.name: Dunhuang cave murals, Mogao Grottoes
styles.features: Flying celestial dancers with swirling ribbons, flowing red-brown line, malachite green, lapis blue and earth reds, oxidised darkened skin tones, dense repeating figures, cloud scrolls, musicians, faded cracked plaster surface
styles.note: Use musicians, dancers and secular scenes rather than Buddhist icons.

styles.name: Korean minhwa folk painting
styles.features: Bright flat colours, naive humorous tigers with magpies, peonies, carp and cranes, bookshelf still lifes (chaekgeori) in reverse perspective, bold black outlines, decorative symmetry, cheerful folk character

styles.name: Japanese ink landscape (suibokuga), Sesshū Tōyō, Muromachi period
styles.medium: ink and light wash on paper
styles.features: Strong angular black contour strokes for cliffs, crisp axe-cut texture strokes, layered planes receding into grey mist, gnarled pines, small pavilions and huts, sparing pale washes, monochrome ink on paper
styles.note: Structured, outlined counterpart to the separate haboku entry.

styles.name: Yamato-e handscroll (emaki), Heian period, roofless-house view (fukinuki yatai)
styles.medium: ink and mineral colour on paper handscroll
styles.features: High oblique view into roofless interiors, slanting parallel beams and screens, figures with line-eyes and hook noses, layered stiff robes, opaque mineral colours, golden cloud bands, horizontal continuous narrative

styles.name: Ottoman miniature painting with Iznik ceramic ornament
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper; underglaze-painted fritware
styles.features: Flat bird's-eye cityscapes and processions, figures in tall turbans and patterned kaftans, gold sky, bright pigments, borders of Iznik tulips, carnations and saz leaves in cobalt, turquoise and tomato red on white

styles.name: Ndebele wall painting
styles.medium: mineral and acrylic paint on plastered house walls
styles.features: Bold geometric panels with thick black outlines, bright blue, red, yellow, green and pink on white, stepped triangles and chevrons, stylised house facades and lamps, strict symmetry, flat paint on smooth rendered walls

styles.name: Sienese gold-ground painting, Ambrogio Lorenzetti
styles.medium: tempera and gold leaf on panel; fresco
styles.features: Tooled gold-leaf grounds, tempera with fine hatched modelling, elegant elongated figures, pink, ultramarine and vermilion, compact rose-coloured hill towns, stacked buildings in tilted perspective, terraced fields with labourers
styles.note: Prefer civic and rural scenes over devotional subjects.

styles.name: Ottonian and Carolingian manuscript illumination
styles.features: Burnished gold and purple grounds, flat horizontal colour bands for landscape, solemn figures with large staring eyes and emphatic gestures, nervous linear drapery folds, column-and-arch frames, interlace borders, shallow space
styles.note: Use structure and technique for secular or historical subjects; avoid religious scenes.

styles.name: Atomic-age retrofuturism (atompunk), 1950s
styles.features: Chrome-finned rocket cars, flying saucers, boomerang and starburst motifs, upswept Googie roofs, atom-orbit symbols, turquoise, pink and coral with cream, glossy airbrushed highlights, cheerful families, tidy optimistic suburbs

styles.name: Cassette futurism
styles.medium: painted concept art of 1970s–80s analogue hardware
styles.features: Chunky beige and grey plastic consoles, toggle switches and knobs, CRT monitors glowing green or amber, cassette decks, ribbed cables, utilitarian industrial interiors, scan lines, muted greys with orange and teal accents
styles.note: Keep on-screen text sparse.

styles.name: Risograph print in two or three colours
styles.medium: risograph stencil print on uncoated paper
styles.features: Two or three translucent inks such as fluorescent pink, blue and yellow, overprints creating new colours, grainy halftone texture, slight misregistration, flat shapes, speckled uneven coverage, uncoated paper tooth

styles.name: Botanical illustration, Pierre-Joseph Redouté and Georg Dionysius Ehret
styles.medium: watercolour on vellum; stipple engraving finished in watercolour
styles.features: Single plant specimen centred on white ground, precise botanical accuracy, soft stippled gradations, translucent watercolour petals, fine veins, dissected flower parts and seeds placed beside, no background or cast shadow

styles.name: John James Audubon bird plates
styles.medium: hand-coloured engraving and aquatint, large folio
styles.features: Life-size birds in dramatic twisting poses on branches, crisp engraved feather detail, watercolour washes, sparse plant and landscape vignettes, strong silhouettes on cream paper, naturalistic colour, small caption line below
styles.note: Haeckel is covered in a separate entry.

styles.name: Letterpress wood-type poster
styles.medium: letterpress with wood type on paper
styles.features: Stacked lines of mixed wood-type faces, heavy slab serifs, condensed gothics and ornamented Tuscan letters, two or three inks, worn wood-grain texture, uneven inking, printer's rules and ornaments, small woodcut cuts
styles.note: Lettering is the image; keep words few and large.

styles.name: Hand-painted sign writing and reverse glass gilding
styles.medium: enamel sign paint on wood; gold leaf on glass
styles.features: Shop windows with mirror-bright gold-leaf letters, black outlines and drop shadows, matte and burnished areas, flourished scrolls, painted script and block capitals with visible brush-stroke ends, enamel on wooden fascia boards

styles.name: Vintage railway travel poster, 1920s–30s
styles.features: Flat colour lithography, simplified sunlit coasts, mountains and stations, smooth gradient skies, bold Art Deco sans-serif destination headline, crisp shapes in few tones, small idealised holiday figures

styles.name: Mid-century paperback cover illustration
styles.medium: gouache or oil on board, offset printed
styles.features: Painted dramatic scene with one or two figures, strong chiaroscuro, saturated reds and yellows, bold condensed title block, small price corner, slightly coarse halftone dots, worn creased cover edges

styles.name: Matchbox and crate label
styles.medium: chromolithograph and letterpress on thin paper
styles.features: Small rectangular label with bold border, central emblem such as an animal, ship or fruit, flat bright colours, strong outlines, framed lettering, decorative ribbons and medals, slight misregistration
styles.note: Invent neutral label wording; no real brand names.

styles.name: Vintage vitreous enamel signs and stencil lettering
styles.medium: vitreous enamel on pressed steel; spray stencil on wood and plaster
styles.features: Glossy fired enamel on steel with chipped edges exposing dark rusted metal, rounded corners and screw holes; flat solid colours, bold block or sans-serif letters; stencil letters with bridged gaps and soft overspray on crates and walls.

styles.name: Calligraphic manuscript page with illuminated initial
styles.medium: ink, tempera and gold leaf on vellum
styles.features: Dense columns of black gothic or rounded script on cream vellum, faint ruled lines, wide margins, one large initial in red, blue and burnished gold with vine tendrils curling into the margin, small red rubrics.

styles.name: Early modern engraved map with decorative cartouche
styles.medium: hand-coloured copperplate engraving on laid paper
styles.features: Fine engraved coastlines with hatched shading, hills as small molehill profiles, pale green, rose and yellow washes along borders, ornate strapwork cartouche with allegorical figures framing the title, compass roses, rhumb lines, ships and sea monsters.

styles.name: Engraved natural-history atlas plate with caption
styles.features: Specimens arranged on a white plate as numbered figures, crisp engraved lines and stipple modelling, delicate hand-applied watercolour, thin ruled plate border, small engraved caption and Latin names beneath, plate number in the corner.

styles.name: Hand-lettered chalkboard menu or neon shop sign at night
styles.medium: chalk on slate blackboard; bent glass neon tubing
styles.features: Either matt black slate with dusty white and coloured chalk script, smudged erasures and a worn wooden frame; or glowing bent-glass neon letters in pink, red and cyan, with halo bloom on wet night street and brick.
styles.note: Choose one of the two, chalkboard or neon; legible lettering must appear in the frame.

styles.name: Dutch and Flemish letter-rack trompe-l'oeil (Cornelis Gijsbrechts, Samuel van Hoogstraten)
styles.features: Flat wooden board with red leather straps tacked across, tucked letters with wax seals, quills, combs, scissors, pamphlets; very shallow depth, small sharp cast shadows, illusionistic paper and wood textures, muted brown, cream and red.

styles.name: American trompe-l'oeil still life (William Harnett, John F. Peto)
styles.features: Life-size objects against a shallow wooden door or dark wall: pipes, mugs, worn books, violins, horseshoes, torn paper and nails; hard edges, raking light, crisp cast shadows; Peto softer and dustier, with worn ochres and greens.

styles.name: Synthetic Cubist still life (Juan Gris, Georges Braque)
styles.features: Guitar, bottle, glass, pipe and newspaper broken into overlapping flat planes, several viewpoints at once, simulated wood grain and wallpaper, stencilled letter fragments, crisp black contours, browns, greys, greens and slate blue.

styles.name: Purism (Amédée Ozenfant, Fernand Léger)
styles.features: Bottles, carafes, glasses, pipes and guitars as smooth standardised silhouettes, interlocking flat profiles and plan views, clean contours, cool even light, muted greys, ochres and soft blues; Léger adds black outlines and tubular forms.

styles.name: Jack of Diamonds group (Ilya Mashkov, Pyotr Konchalovsky)
styles.features: Heavy still lifes of bread loaves, fruit, trays and jugs: thick dense paint, dark outlines, tabletops tilted up flat, Cézanne-like volumes, saturated reds, ochres and greens, crude vigour borrowed from shop signboards and popular prints.

styles.name: Scottish Colourists (Samuel Peploe)
styles.features: Roses, tulips, fans, fruit and white jugs on draped tables; fluid confident strokes, firm dark contours, bright high-key colour against white cloth and grey or orange grounds, shallow space, clear light.

styles.name: David Shterenberg
styles.features: Tabletop seen from straight above as a flat tilted plane, few objects such as herring, bread, lamp or bottle drawn in strict profile or plan, matte sandy textures, large empty areas, muted blacks, whites and ochres.

styles.name: Giorgio de Chirico, metaphysical interiors
styles.features: Cramped rooms with steeply tilted floors, stacked wooden frames, set squares, maps, biscuits and boxes, windows onto empty arcaded squares; flat dry paint, hard shadows, conflicting perspectives, greens, browns, ochres, dark green sky.

styles.name: Joseph Cornell
styles.medium: shadow-box assemblage: wood, glass, found objects
styles.features: Small glass-fronted wooden boxes with weathered white-painted interiors holding cork balls, clay pipes, marbles, cut-out birds, star charts and cordial glasses; compartments, shallow stagelike depth, soft faded colours.

styles.name: Neue Sachlichkeit (Alexander Kanoldt, Georg Scholz)
styles.features: Cool sharp-focus still lifes and small towns: potted rubber plants, jugs, guitars on folded cloths, smooth enamel-like surface, hard outlines, simplified volumes, frozen stillness, muted greys, olive, brick red and slate.

styles.name: Filippo de Pisis
styles.features: Quick broken strokes and sketchy calligraphic touches over pale grounds, bare canvas showing through, fish, shells, flowers or bottles on a sill before sea or city, silvery light, airy whites, soft greys, small bright accents.
styles.note: Take composition, light and quiet; objects stay real and stand where they plausibly could.

styles.name: Gwen John
styles.features: Quiet single women seated in plain rooms, chalky dry layered paint, closely related muted tones of grey, dove pink, umber and soft blue, simple frontal poses, sparse interiors with chair, window or teapot.

styles.name: William Nicholson
styles.features: Still lifes of silver jugs, glass, lustreware, tulips and mushrooms on reflective tables, deft economical brushwork, rich dark or warm grounds, gleaming highlights, restrained palette, simple uncluttered arrangements.

styles.name: Vladimir Stozharov
styles.features: Village still lifes of rye bread, salt cellars, wooden spoons, birch-bark boxes, linen and painted bowls; thick dense impasto, broad strokes, deep browns, earthy ochres and whites; northern log houses and snowy landscapes.

styles.name: Stuart Davis
styles.features: Flat hard-edged shapes in saturated red, blue, yellow, green and black, jazzy interlocking forms from storefronts, signs, gas pumps and coffee pots, thick outlines, scattered words and letters, no modelling.
styles.note: Words often appear as graphic shapes.

styles.name: William Scott
styles.features: Frying pans, saucepans, bowls, beans and fish reduced to flat outlines on a tabletop seen from above, thick scumbled matt paint, few objects in sparse rhythm, greys, blacks, whites and earthy reds.
styles.note: Keep objects recognisable: silhouette, two or three telling details, rhythm and colour.

styles.name: Edward Bawden
styles.features: Crisp carved lines and white-cut textures, flat interlocking areas in two to four inks, patterned roofs, foliage and brickwork, decorative views of buildings and gardens, gentle humour, strong black-and-white design.

styles.name: Plasticine stop-motion animation
styles.medium: modelling clay figures and miniature sets, stop-motion
styles.features: Chunky handmade clay figures with visible thumbprints and tool marks, rounded faces with wide mouths and bead eyes, miniature sets of cardboard and felt, soft tabletop lighting, saturated colours, waxy sheen.
styles.note: Avoid recognisable studio characters.

styles.name: Sachplakat object poster (Lucian Bernhard)
styles.features: One product such as a matchbox, shoe, lamp or typewriter drawn large in flat colour with simple outline on an empty solid background, a single bold brand word in heavy hand-drawn letters, three or four colours.

styles.name: Swiss object poster (Niklaus Stoecklin, Herbert Leupin)
styles.features: Single everyday object rendered hyperreal, such as razor blades, cigar, cheese or bottle, smooth airbrush-like modelling, crisp highlights, plain flat background, short product name in clean letters; later work looser and playful.

styles.name: Soviet Constructivist advertising (Alexander Rodchenko)
styles.features: Diagonal compositions in red, black and white, heavy sans-serif Cyrillic slogans in blocks, geometric bars and circles, photomontage heads and products, arrows, rhythmic repetition, flat colour with crisp photographic cut-outs.

styles.name: 1950s cookbook gouache illustration
styles.medium: gouache and ink on illustration board
styles.features: Cheerful plates of food, jellies, roasts and fruit, opaque flat gouache with dry-brush texture, loose ink outlines, colour slightly off-register, pastel turquoise, mustard and tomato red, playful kitchenware and cooks.

styles.name: Korean chaekgeori screen painting
styles.medium: ink and mineral colours on paper or silk, folding screen
styles.features: Tall bookshelves across folding-screen panels crammed with stacked books, bronze vessels, porcelain, brushes, fruit and coral; reverse and shifting perspective, tilting shelves, flat bright colours with fine outlines.

styles.name: Chinese bogu 'hundred antiques' painting
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper or silk, hanging scroll or screen
styles.features: Arrangements of ancient bronzes, jade discs, porcelain vases, scholar's rocks and flowering branches on carved stands, floating on a plain light ground, fine ink outlines, soft mineral colour, precise surface detail.

styles.name: Japanese woodblock print, shin-hanga and sōsaku-hanga
styles.features: Shin-hanga: fine carved outlines, soft bokashi gradients, moonlight, snow and rain over temples and lakes in deep indigo and dusk tones; sōsaku-hanga: artist-carved prints with visible chisel marks, flatter colour, simpler shapes.

styles.name: Qajar painting
styles.features: Frontal life-size figures with almond eyes, joined eyebrows and rouged cheeks, brocade and pearl-studded costume, flat decorative surfaces, dark grounds with arches and curtains, fruit still lifes, glossy reds, gold and black.

styles.name: Iznik ceramics and Ottoman miniature
styles.medium: underglaze-painted fritware; gouache and gold on paper
styles.features: Iznik: glossy white ground with cobalt, turquoise, sage and raised tomato red, tulips, carnations, saz leaves, black outlines; miniatures: flat bright colour, many small figures, no shadows, schematic architecture, gold accents.

styles.name: Javanese batik
styles.features: Wax-resist cloth with fine crackle veins, dense repeating motifs of parang diagonals, kawung circles, birds and flowers drawn in dots and fine lines, indigo, soga brown and cream or coastal pinks and greens.

styles.name: Hermenegildo Bustos
styles.features: Small meticulous fruit, vegetables, frogs and scorpions laid out in rows on a flat ground, plain dark background, naive hard precision, minute detail, no atmospheric depth; frank frontal portraits with stiff poses.

styles.name: Mexican ex-voto painting on tin
styles.features: Small tin panel showing an accident, illness or rescue in a room or street, naive stiff figures, flat bright colours, a protective figure in a cloud corner, handwritten thanksgiving text in a band below.
styles.note: Handwritten text band beneath the scene is part of the form.

styles.name: Kuba raffia cloth and kente strip weaving
styles.medium: raffia embroidery and cut pile; handwoven silk and cotton strips
styles.region: Central and West Africa (DR Congo, Ghana)
styles.features: Kuba: natural raffia with interlocking angular brown and black geometric mazes, cut-pile velvet squares, deliberately shifting patterns; kente: narrow woven strips sewn edge to edge, blocks of gold, green, red and black bars and zigzags.

styles.name: Roman xenia fresco, Pompeii
styles.features: Small square panels with ledges or niches holding game birds, fish, eggs, fruit and glass bowls of water, quick loose brushwork, soft cast shadows, earthy ochres and greens, red framing bands, cracked plaster surface.

styles.name: Roman 'unswept floor' mosaic (asarotos oikos)
styles.medium: floor mosaic of stone and glass tesserae
styles.features: White tesserae floor scattered with meal leftovers: fish bones, shells, chicken legs, nutshells, grapes, each with a tiny cast shadow, a mouse nibbling, fine gradated coloured tesserae, objects strewn without a central scene.

styles.name: Ghent-Bruges book of hours with trompe-l'oeil border
styles.features: Script page or small miniature framed by an illusionistic border of flowers, pearls, insects, snails and badges strewn over gold or coloured ground with cast shadows, as if lying on the page, fine stippled modelling, jewel colours.
styles.note: Religious subject is optional; borders work with secular scenes.

styles.name: Renaissance intarsia, Urbino studiolo
styles.features: Cupboards with half-open lattice doors revealing books, instruments, armour, hourglasses and caged birds, built from inlaid wood in honey, brown and near-black tones, sharp linear perspective, geometric precision, flat grain textures.

styles.name: Blue-and-white tin-glazed tiles (Portuguese azulejo, Delft)
styles.features: Square tile grid with visible joints, glossy white tin glaze, cobalt blue brushwork in washes and fine lines, slight running of blue, ornamental frame borders, ships, windmills, landscapes and people at work.
styles.note: Take technique and composition, not religious subjects.

styles.name: Autochrome colour photograph, 1910s
styles.features: Soft-focus colour image with fine starch-grain speckle like pointillism, muted pastel reds, greens and violets, dim warm light, long-exposure stillness, slight vignetting, gentle low saturation.

styles.name: 1950s Kodachrome colour slide photography
styles.features: Saturated warm reds, deep blues and sunny yellows, rich dense shadows, fine grain, crisp clear daylight, slightly warm cast, glossy slide-like clarity, casual everyday scenes with period clothing, cars and signage
styles.note: Kodachrome is a discontinued film stock; describe the colour look, not the brand.

styles.name: museum catalogue object photography
styles.features: Single object centred on a seamless neutral grey or white backdrop, soft diffused even lighting, gentle shadow beneath, true-to-life colour, sharp focus on surface texture and wear, no props, frontal or three-quarter view
styles.note: Works only for a single object or a small group of objects.

styles.name: engraved plate from Diderot's Encyclopédie, tools laid out on the sheet
styles.features: Upper band shows a small workshop scene with craftsmen at work; below, tools and parts drawn separately in rows on blank paper, numbered figures, fine black hatching, no colour, ruled border and plate title
styles.note: Emphasis on the plate layout; see the separate copper-engraving entry for the technique alone.

styles.name: Northern Song monumental landscape painting (shan shui)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, hanging scroll
styles.features: Towering central mountain mass, dense raindrop and axe-cut texture strokes, mist separating near, middle and far distance, gnarled pines, thin waterfalls, tiny travellers and mule trains on paths, monochrome ink with faint brown wash

styles.name: Ming dynasty woodblock book illustration (Huizhou school)
styles.medium: woodblock print in black ink on paper
styles.features: Fine even black outlines cut in wood, dense patterns of roof tiles, balustrades and garden rocks, architecture in oblique parallel lines, figures in flowing robes, decorative cloud scrolls, no shading, framed page-sized scenes

styles.name: Siyah Qalam ('black pen') album paintings
styles.medium: ink and opaque watercolour on paper
styles.features: Bold calligraphic brush-and-ink contours, muted washes of ochre, brick red and grey-blue, plain buff paper ground with no setting, horned demons dancing, bearded nomads with horses, strong twisting movement
styles.note: Keep demons folkloric and playful.

styles.name: Yahya al-Wasiti, Baghdad school Maqamat illustration
styles.medium: opaque pigments and gold on paper
styles.features: Plain buff paper background with little landscape, figures in patterned robes with gold-banded sleeves and turbans, round faces, decorative gold nimbuses, lively gestures, rows of camels and horsemen, strong reds, blues and greens
styles.note: Gold nimbuses are decorative here, not marks of holiness.

styles.name: Abomey appliqué cloth, Kingdom of Dahomey
styles.features: Flat cut-cloth silhouettes stitched onto black or golden ground, bright red, blue, green, yellow and white, emblematic animals, warriors and weapons scattered across the field, no perspective, visible hem stitching

styles.name: Classic Maya mural and polychrome vase painting (Bonampak)
styles.features: Profile figures with sloping foreheads and tall feathered headdresses, jade ornaments, confident red-brown contour line, flat fields of Maya blue, ochre and red on cream, stacked registers, processions of nobles and musicians
styles.note: Avoid captive and sacrifice scenes.

styles.name: Plains ledger art
styles.medium: coloured pencil, ink and watercolour on ruled ledger paper
styles.features: Profile figures and horses in flat coloured pencil over printed ruled lines and faded handwritten accounts, no horizon or ground, figures floating on the page, detailed clothing and shields, horses in flying gallop
styles.note: Secular historical drawing; avoid ceremonial or sacred subjects.

styles.name: Russian hagiographic icon with border scenes (vita icon)
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold leaf on gessoed wooden panel
styles.features: Large central figure framed by a grid of small rectangular narrative panels, reverse perspective with tilted buildings, stepped stylised rocky hills, gold ground, elongated flat figures, ochre, cinnabar, olive and white highlights
styles.note: Use the panel grid and reverse perspective for secular stories; do not depict sacred figures.

styles.name: Dionisius, Ferapontov Monastery frescoes
styles.features: Light airy palette of pale azure, rose, soft ochre, pistachio green and white, very elongated weightless figures with small heads, gentle rhythmic contours, flat architectural backdrops, soft unmodelled colour planes
styles.note: Take the palette and figure proportions, not the religious subject.

styles.name: Illustrated Chronicle of Ivan the Terrible (Litsevoy letopisny svod) miniatures
styles.medium: pen and watercolour on paper, manuscript
styles.features: Small framed pen drawings tinted with light watercolour, many figures in groups, continuous narration, stepped slide-like hills, buildings as tilted cutaway chambers, armies with spears and banners, ochre, green, red and blue

styles.name: Ottonian manuscript illumination (Reichenau school)
styles.features: Burnished gold or purple grounds, flat bands of colour instead of landscape, large-eyed figures with outsized expressive hands and emphatic gestures, solemn frontal poses, small symbolic towers, pale green, mauve and gold
styles.note: Use the composition and gestures for secular subjects.

styles.name: English bestiary illumination, 13th century
styles.medium: ink, tempera and gold leaf on parchment
styles.features: Stylised real and fabulous beasts in framed panels, burnished gold or diapered backgrounds, firm black outlines, flat red, blue and green, schematic trees, creatures arranged heraldically, Gothic text columns around the image

styles.name: Bayeux Tapestry style embroidery
styles.features: Continuous horizontal frieze on bare linen, laid-and-couched woollen stitches in terracotta, ochre, olive, sage and dark blue, stem-stitch outlines, profile figures, horses in unnatural colours, beast-filled borders, Latin captions above
styles.note: Take the technique and frieze structure; the subject comes from the theme.

styles.name: mid-20th-century picture-book illustration (Alice and Martin Provensen, Miroslav Šašek)
styles.medium: gouache, ink and limited-palette offset print
styles.features: Flat stylised shapes, crisp ink lines, limited palette of ochre, teal, red and black, slightly naive geometric people with dot eyes, dry-brush and crayon textures, patterned buildings, cheerful busy street views

styles.name: ligne claire (Hergé, Edgar P. Jacobs)
styles.medium: ink and flat colour, printed comic page
styles.features: Uniform clean black outline of equal weight, flat bright colour without hatching or cast shadows, detailed realistic backgrounds, vehicles and machines, slightly simplified cartoon figures, even lighting, clear readable panels
styles.note: Do not reproduce existing comic characters; the franchise is still commercially active.

styles.name: dark academia interior aesthetic
styles.features: Dim libraries and studies with dark wood panelling, brass fittings, green-shaded banker's lamp light, green baize, leather-bound books, warm low-key chiaroscuro, muted brown, oxblood and bottle green, tweed and wool textures
styles.note: A contemporary aesthetic, not a historical style; best for interiors.

styles.name: Magic Realism (Magischer Realismus)
styles.medium: oil or tempera on panel, smooth matte surface
styles.features: Smooth matte surface with invisible brushwork, sharp-edged objects in still airless light, frozen silence, over-clear detail, simplified volumes, muted cool palette, empty streets or tabletop objects with uncanny calm

styles.name: collage of antique engravings and coloured paper
styles.features: Cut-out fragments of black-and-white 19th-century engravings combined with flat sheets of coloured paper, visible cut edges, slight paper shadows, abrupt scale jumps, surreal juxtapositions, hatching and halftone textures

styles.name: risograph print in two or three spot colours
styles.features: Two or three flat soy-ink colours such as fluorescent pink, teal and yellow, overprints making new hues, grainy speckled texture, slight misregistration, halftone dots, matte uncoated paper, simplified drawing
styles.note: The style sets the drawing manner and palette; period and objects come from the theme.

styles.name: copperplate line engraving with a burin
styles.medium: engraving on copper, printed on laid paper
styles.features: Black lines that swell and taper, dense parallel and cross-hatching for shadow, dot-and-lozenge patterns in midtones, precise contours, crisp plate mark, white paper for highlights, no colour
styles.note: The technique alone, for any subject; distinct from the Encyclopédie layout entry.

styles.name: hand-coloured woodcut
styles.medium: woodcut on paper with hand-applied watercolour
styles.features: Bold black woodcut outlines with sparse hatching, translucent washes of red, green, yellow and brown brushed loosely, colour spilling over lines, simplified figures, buildings and trees, plain backgrounds

styles.name: antique map with cartouche and marginal figures
styles.features: Engraved coastlines and rivers with hatched molehill mountains, borders washed in pale green, rose and yellow, ornate scrollwork title cartouche, compass roses, ships and sea monsters, costumed figures and city views along the margins

styles.name: illuminated manuscript page with historiated initial and marginal drolleries
styles.medium: ink, tempera and gold on vellum
styles.features: Columns of black Gothic script, large decorated initial in blue, red and burnished gold enclosing a small scene, ivy tendrils along margins, small comic animals and figures, ruled lines, warm vellum tone
