styles.name: naturalist's field journal page
styles.medium: pen, ink and watercolour on paper
styles.features: Quick sepia or black pen sketches with light watercolour washes, several studies on one page, handwritten notes, dates and arrows, unfinished vignettes fading into cream paper, small measured details

styles.name: charcoal and red chalk (sanguine) on toned paper
styles.medium: charcoal, sanguine and white chalk on toned paper
styles.features: Mid-tone grey, blue or buff paper, forms modelled in charcoal and red chalk, white chalk highlights, soft rubbed shading with directional hatching, unfinished edges, figure and drapery studies

styles.name: gouache on coloured paper
styles.medium: opaque gouache on toned or coloured paper
styles.features: Opaque matte paint in flat velvety patches over grey, brown or blue paper left visible between strokes, light colours laid over a dark ground, simplified shapes, crisp edges

styles.name: Portuguese blue-and-white azulejo panel
styles.features: Grid of glossy square tiles painted in cobalt blue on white, graded blue brush shading, baroque scroll and acanthus frames, scenes of hunts, gardens and harbours, visible tile joints, painted inscription band
styles.note: Inscription in frame is mandatory (see 'Text in frame' section).

styles.name: Maurice Prendergast
styles.features: Mosaic-like patches of bright colour, blotted watercolour dabs, crowds of women with parasols and children on beaches, parks and promenades, flattened decorative rhythm, dark outlines, jewel-like palette

styles.name: Filipp Malyavin
styles.features: Peasant women in whirling red skirts and headscarves filling the canvas, broad sweeping impasto strokes, fiery scarlet, crimson and orange, faces and figures dissolving into swirling fabric, energetic rhythm

styles.name: Miguel Covarrubias
styles.medium: gouache, ink and watercolour on paper
styles.features: Smooth stylised figures with elongated limbs and rounded sculptural volumes, simplified faces, crisp outlines, airbrush-like soft modelling, warm earth tones, caricatural exaggeration, decorative pictorial-map compositions

styles.name: Hlebine school naive painting on glass (Ivan Generalić)
styles.features: Enamel-smooth surface painted behind glass, meticulous detail, village scenes with peasants, oxen and roosters, bare trees with fine branches, snowy fields, deep blue or green skies, flat clear colour

styles.name: Nahua amate bark-paper painting (Guerrero)
styles.features: Brown fibrous bark paper, bright pink, orange, turquoise and yellow flowers and birds, black outlines, densely packed village scenes with tiny figures, no perspective, decorative borders
styles.note: Secular painted amate, not Otomi ritual cut-paper figures.

styles.name: Senegalese reverse glass painting (sous-verre)
styles.features: Flat bright colour behind glass, bold black outlines, glossy surface, frontal figures in boubous and headwraps, market and daily-life scenes, decorative borders, red, yellow, green and blue
styles.note: Avoid religious portrait subjects.

styles.name: Jinshan peasant painting
styles.features: Bright saturated flat colours, embroidery and indigo-print textile patterns, dense compositions of village life, fish, ducks and harvests, high viewpoint, no shadows, decorative repetition

styles.name: Cuban silkscreen poster, 1960s
styles.features: Flat unmodulated colour fields, bold contrasting magenta, orange, green and black, simplified silhouettes, pop and op art patterns, hand-cut stencil edges, strong graphic typography
styles.note: Avoid political slogans.

styles.name: Zhang Zeduan, Northern Song handscroll
styles.medium: ink and light colour on silk, handscroll
styles.features: Long horizontal panorama in fine even ink line, elevated oblique view, hundreds of tiny figures, boats, bridges, shops and carts, faint brown and green tints, shifting viewpoint, buildings in parallel projection

styles.name: Yangliuqing New Year print (nianhua)
styles.features: Woodblock outline with hand-painted colour, chubby children with lotus and carp, bright pink, red, green and yellow, smooth blushed cheeks, decorative symmetry, auspicious symbols, fine patterned detail

styles.name: Korean genre painting (Kim Hong-do, Shin Yun-bok)
styles.medium: ink and light colour on paper or silk
styles.features: Quick lively ink line, minimal or empty background, figures in hanbok and gat hats at work, wrestling, dancing and travelling, earthy humour or elegant figures with delicate red and blue accents

styles.name: Vietnamese Đông Hồ folk woodcut print
styles.medium: woodblock print on dó paper coated with seashell powder
styles.features: shimmering pearly white paper with seashell coating, bold black keyblock outlines, flat unshaded blocks of earthy red, ochre yellow, leaf green and indigo, plump rounded pigs, roosters, frogs and children, symmetrical compositions on a plain ground
styles.note: Prints often carry short Hán-Nôm inscriptions; these are optional.

styles.name: Ottoman court miniature, Surname festival procession scenes
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: high bird's-eye view onto a tilted ground without perspective, rows of small guild members parading floats and banners past a tiered viewing pavilion, figures in kaftans and tall turbans, saturated red, green and lapis with gold, crisp outlines

styles.name: Oshogbo school
styles.medium: ink and oil on board, batik on cloth
styles.features: dense all-over patterned surface with no empty space, flat outlined spirits, people and animals interlocking, bodies filled with hatching, dots and stripes, earthy browns and ochres with bright blue and red accents

styles.name: East African kanga and West African wax print textile design
styles.features: bold repeated motifs in large flat shapes, wide border framing a central medallion, saturated contrasting colours, fine crackle veining from wax resist, stylised birds, leaves, shells, circles and concentric rings
styles.note: Kanga traditionally includes a printed Swahili proverb line; leave it out if text is unwanted.

styles.name: Poto-Poto school painting
styles.medium: gouache or oil on paper and canvas
styles.features: slender elongated stick-like silhouettes with tiny heads, dancing, drumming, fishing or hunting in rhythmic rows, figures as dark flat shapes over bright banded backgrounds, decorative dots and stripes, strong sense of movement

styles.name: Cook Islands tivaevae quilt
styles.medium: appliqué and patchwork quilt, cotton with embroidery
styles.features: large symmetrical floral motifs such as hibiscus and frangipani cut from one bright fabric and appliquéd on a contrasting ground, kaleidoscope fold symmetry, embroidered outlines and leaf veins, vivid red, yellow, green, white

styles.name: Bayeux Tapestry-type Romanesque wool embroidery frieze
styles.features: long continuous horizontal frieze on unbleached linen, laid-and-couched wool in terracotta, ochre, sage green, blue-black, stem-stitch outlines, flat profile figures, horses and longships, upper and lower borders with beasts, no depth
styles.note: The original carries Latin captions above the scenes; optional.

styles.name: Russian vita icon with border scenes (klejma)
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold leaf on gessoed wood panel
styles.features: large central figure framed by a grid of small rectangular panels each holding a narrative episode, inverse perspective, stepped rock ledges, schematic buildings, elongated figures, gold ground, cinnabar red, ochre, olive green
styles.note: Use the panelled composition and technique for secular or folk stories; avoid sacred figures.

styles.name: Romanesque fresco painting (Catalan and French churches)
styles.features: thick black contour lines, flat zones of ochre, red earth and deep blue in horizontal bands, frontal stiff figures with large staring eyes, drapery folds as parallel stripes, no perspective, matte chalky plaster with cracks
styles.note: Borrow technique and composition only, not the religious subject.

styles.name: Chilean arpillera
styles.medium: fabric appliqué and embroidery on burlap
styles.features: small scene cut from scrap cloth stitched onto burlap, blanket-stitched woollen border, Andes as stacked fabric hills, large round sun, tiny padded cloth dolls, simple houses, bright cotton patches, visible hand stitches

styles.name: Wixárika (Huichol) yarn painting
styles.medium: yarn pressed into beeswax on board
styles.features: tightly coiled lines of yarn pressed side by side in beeswax, each shape outlined by concentric bands, fluorescent pink, orange, turquoise, yellow on dark ground, stylised deer, maize, birds, sun, no shading
styles.note: Commercial folk art; keep subjects secular (animals, plants, sun) rather than ceremonial imagery.

styles.name: Central Asian suzani embroidery
styles.features: large circular sun and moon medallions, scrolling vines, rosettes and palmettes in chain and couched stitch, crimson, madder red, indigo and saffron on ivory cotton, dense symmetrical layout

styles.name: African American story quilt (Harriet Powers tradition)
styles.features: grid of square panels each with an appliquéd narrative scene, flat cut-cloth figures, animals, suns and stars as simple silhouettes, solid fabrics on contrasting ground, visible hand stitches, pieced borders

styles.name: Bengali kantha embroidery
styles.medium: running-stitch embroidery on layered cotton saris
styles.features: soft layered white cotton rippled by dense running stitches, central lotus medallion, corner trees, scattered figures, fish, elephants and boats outlined in red, blue and black thread, ground filled with wavy stitch lines

styles.name: Hmong embroidered story cloth
styles.medium: cross-stitch, satin stitch and appliqué on cotton
styles.features: crowded panorama of tiny embroidered figures farming, carrying baskets and crossing rivers, stilt houses, rows of mountains, bright thread on dark or pale cloth, no perspective, border of triangles
styles.note: Some cloths carry stitched English captions; optional.

styles.name: Ali Mitgutsch
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, picture book
styles.features: wide high-angle panorama packed with hundreds of small figures in separate mini-scenes, no single focal point, clean dark outlines, flat bright colours, simple cheerful faces, streets, harbours, beaches and snowy hills

styles.name: Trencadís broken-tile mosaic (Catalan modernisme)
styles.medium: broken ceramic tile and glass mosaic
styles.features: irregular shards of glazed tile and glass set with white grout lines, covering undulating curved benches, chimneys and organic forms, cobalt, white, yellow, green, glossy reflections, patterned fragments mixed freely

styles.name: Alexei Savrasov
styles.features: low horizon under a large damp overcast sky, thawing snow and puddles, bare birches, rooks, small wooden churches and village houses, muted browns, greys and pale blue, soft modelling

styles.name: Fyodor Vasilyev
styles.features: dramatic cloudy skies, wet meadows after rain, thaw and mist, deep greens and silvery greys, strong light-and-shadow contrasts, puddles reflecting the sky, romantic open spaces

styles.name: Alexei Venetsianov and his school
styles.features: calm peasants at field work and in rooms, smooth enamel-like finish, soft diffused light, high horizon over golden fields, clear perspective of interiors, gentle pastel and golden tones

styles.name: Apollinary Vasnetsov
styles.features: panoramic views of medieval Moscow streets with timber walls, wooden towers and onion domes, small figures in kaftans, also vast taiga and Ural landscapes, muted ochre, grey-blue and green

styles.name: Stanislav Zhukovsky
styles.features: sunlit old manor interiors with mahogany furniture and portraits, windows opening on snowy or autumn parks, spring thaw rivers, warm golden light, impressionist brushwork

styles.name: Konstantin Yuon
styles.features: bright festive provincial towns and monasteries, sunny snow, red and white churches with domes, small busy figures, sledges and horses, clear saturated colour, elevated viewpoints

styles.name: Arkady Rylov
styles.features: wide windy river spaces, swift white clouds in deep blue skies, saturated greens and blues, decorative clarity of forms, flying birds, birches and steep banks

styles.name: Nikolai Krymov
styles.features: quiet provincial towns at evening, harmonious warm and cool tonal values, simplified rounded trees and houses, soft greens, pinks and ochres, calm low light

styles.name: Sergei Vinogradov
styles.features: bright sunny manor gardens and estate interiors, blooming lilac and flower beds, village women at work, warm light, broken impressionist strokes, fresh greens and soft whites

styles.name: Leonard Turzhansky
styles.features: horses in snowy village yards, broad rough brushstrokes, simple wooden barns and fences, grey winter light, warm browns against blue-white snow

styles.name: Maria Yakunchikova
styles.medium: oil and watercolour on paper, pyrography on wood
styles.features: Muted, quiet palette of grey-green, dusty blue and soft lilac; flat simplified silhouettes of wooden churches, fir trees and fences; decorative outlines; twilight stillness; some panels burned into wood with tinted pyrography.

styles.name: Boris Zvorykin
styles.medium: gouache, ink and gold on paper
styles.features: Intricate ornamental frames and borders modelled on Old Russian manuscripts; flat colour with gold; fine black outlines; figures in richly patterned medieval costume; stylised trees, towers and domes; jewel-like red, green, blue and gold.
styles.note: Ornamental borders are part of the look; decorative Old Russian lettering is optional, not required.

styles.name: Evgeny Rachev
styles.features: Naturalistically drawn foxes, wolves, bears and cats standing upright in Russian peasant costume: sarafans, kaftans, bast shoes; watercolour and gouache with careful fur detail; muted earthy palette; village and forest settings.

styles.name: Wassily Kandinsky, Murnau landscapes
styles.features: Thick, glowing patches of unmixed colour; simplified houses, church towers, hills and roads; dark loose contours; vivid blue, orange, emerald and pink; flattened space; forms beginning to dissolve toward abstraction.
styles.note: Early landscapes only, not the later abstract compositions.

styles.name: Mikhail Larionov
styles.features: Crude, childlike drawing with scratchy, graffiti-like lines; provincial soldiers, barbers and strollers; muddy greens, browns and pinks; deliberately clumsy proportions; loose, translucent brushwork; scrawled marks and signs within the image.
styles.note: Neo-primitivist period, not the Rayonist abstractions.

styles.name: Pavel Kuznetsov
styles.features: Pale, hazy palette of lilac, turquoise, rose and sand; flat frieze-like compositions of nomads, yurts, sheep and camels on endless steppe; soft rounded contours; dreamy stillness; matte tempera surface.

styles.name: Robert Falk
styles.features: Dense, layered colour built from many small overlapping strokes; deep, glowing muted harmonies of umber, olive, grey-lilac and wine red; solid Cézanne-like forms; still lifes, portraits and quiet landscapes with melancholic mood.

styles.name: Nikolai Romadin
styles.features: Lyrical, intimate landscapes in fine tonal gradations; misty riverbanks, flooded meadows, birch groves and dusk; soft silvery, grey-green and violet harmonies; delicate brushwork; small solitary figures and huts.

styles.name: Nikolai Andronov
styles.features: Severe style: heavy, flattened forms in a muted earth palette of dark brown, ochre, grey-green and dull red; rough brushwork with visible texture; northern villages, horses, river people; rhythmic, restrained, monumental compositions.

styles.name: Sergei Gerasimov
styles.features: Fresh plein-air painting with broad, juicy strokes; rainy summer gardens, wet greenery, village streets and rivers; fleeting light and weather; rich greens, silver greys and warm earth tones; spontaneous loose handling.
styles.note: Sergei Gerasimov the landscape painter, not Alexander Gerasimov.

styles.name: Efrem Zverkov
styles.features: Small, intimate landscapes in thick, energetic impasto; grey northern skies, wooden villages, rivers, rain and snow; muted silvery-brown and grey palette with glowing accents; quiet, melancholic mood.

styles.name: Permogorye painting, Northern Dvina
styles.features: White ground with fine black contour drawing; scrolling vines and tulip-like flowers in red, green and yellow; Sirin birds and lions; small genre scenes of spinning, tea parties and sleigh rides set among foliage.

styles.name: Russian lubok, hand-coloured popular print
styles.medium: hand-coloured woodcut or engraving on paper
styles.features: Bold black woodcut outline filled with hand-applied flat patches of red, yellow, green and blue that often miss the lines; naive figures and animals; inscription panels; crowded, humorous narrative scenes.

styles.name: Efim Chestnyakov
styles.features: Soft hazy oil painting in muted earthy greens, ochres and pale golden light; round-faced peasant children and villagers in long homespun shirts; dreamlike fairy-tale village scenes; figures crowded in a shallow frieze-like space; gently blurred edges.

styles.name: Russian naive painting, Pavel Leonov
styles.features: Bright flat naive painting in saturated pure colours; many small doll-like figures with near-identical faces set in rows; buildings, trees and animals drawn frontally without true perspective; symmetrical decorative compositions; sunny idyllic mood.

styles.name: Bogorodskoye carved wooden toy
styles.features: Pale unpainted linden-wood figures with crisp knife facets and flat cut planes; bears, peasants and blacksmiths on flat boards and slats; simple chunky shapes; small chip-carved textures for fur and cloth; warm honey-white wood tone.

styles.name: Russian village patchwork quilt
styles.medium: pieced cotton fabric scraps, hand quilting
styles.features: Pieced scraps of calico, chintz and gingham in faded reds, blues, ochres and browns; geometric squares, triangles and log-cabin strips; visible seams and running stitches; small floral prints jostling side by side on a flat surface.
styles.note: Render subjects as shapes assembled from fabric patches.

styles.name: Russian Northern red-thread embroidery on linen
styles.medium: red cotton thread on white homespun linen
styles.features: Single-colour red cross-stitch and counted satin stitch on coarse white linen; geometric stylised birds, horses, trees of life and women with raised arms; strict mirror symmetry; rhomboid borders; stepped, pixel-like contours.

styles.name: Russian indigo resist block print (kubovaya naboika)
styles.medium: hand block-printed resist on linen, indigo dye
styles.features: Deep indigo-blue cloth with pale white or light-blue patterns left by resist paste; repeats from carved wooden blocks with slight misregistration; small flowers, berries, leafy sprigs and dotted grounds; flat, crisp shapes on uneven woven texture.

styles.name: Russian wooden house carving and gingerbread board relief
styles.features: Deep-cut relief in warm brown wood; stylised lions, bird-maidens, horses, suns and twisting vines inside geometric borders; flat raised figures with incised details; chip-carved rosettes; mirror symmetry; mould-like negative space.

styles.name: Moscow school of icon painting, Andrei Rublev
styles.features: Luminous transparent tempera layers in soft cornflower blue, pale golden ochre, rose and sage green; elongated gentle figures arranged in rhythmic circular compositions; calm downcast faces; flowing contours; light ochre ground.
styles.note: Use the painting language, not specific holy images.

styles.name: Siberian map drawing, Semyon Remezov
styles.features: Hand-drawn map-pictures in ink with pale watercolour washes; winding blue rivers as the main axes; tiny forts, churches and yurts drawn in elevation; little trees and hills; handwritten Cyrillic place names scattered across; no fixed scale, often south at top.

styles.name: Russian polychrome glazed tiles (izraztsy)
styles.features: Raised-relief tiles under thick shiny glazes of emerald green, cobalt blue, mustard yellow, brown and white; stylised flowers, birds, lions and unicorns in square frames; repeating modules forming friezes; slightly uneven pooled glaze.

styles.name: Old Russian pictorial embroidery in silk and gold thread (litsevoe shitie)
styles.medium: silk and couched gold thread on silk
styles.features: Faces and hands shaded with fine split-stitch silk; garments and backgrounds of couched gold and silver thread forming patterned grids; deep red or blue silk ground; pearl-studded borders; flat hieratic figures.
styles.note: Use the technique for legends or secular scenes; do not reproduce specific holy images.

styles.name: Alexei Kravchenko
styles.features: Romantic black-and-white wood engraving with dramatic contrasts of deep night black and flashing white; swirling expressive cuts; flickering light; small figures under vast skies; old-town and Venetian architecture; fairy-tale gothic atmosphere.

styles.name: Etching
styles.medium: etching on copper plate, intaglio print on paper
styles.features: Fine wiry black or sepia lines bitten into copper; cross-hatching and stippling for shadow; soft plate tone and wiped ink haze; crisp white paper highlights; detailed architectural views, landscapes and figures.

styles.name: Soviet colour linocut of the 1960s
styles.features: Bold flat shapes cut from linoleum in two to five colours: ochre, slate blue, rust red and black; chunky gouged edges; visible white paper; simplified monumental workers, building sites and northern landscapes; strong graphic rhythm.

styles.name: Georgy Vereisky, lithograph
styles.medium: lithographic crayon on stone, printed on paper
styles.features: Grainy lithographic crayon drawing with soft velvety blacks and silvery greys; confident contour lines; delicate tonal modelling with white paper breathing through; restrained realistic portraits and quiet city and river views.

styles.name: Artur Fonvizin, wet-on-wet watercolour
styles.features: Loose wet-on-wet watercolour where colours bloom and bleed together; soft hazy edges; luminous transparent rose, violet, blue and gold; a few quick dark accents; performers, circus riders, horses and flowers dissolving into the paper.

styles.name: Soft pastel drawing
styles.medium: soft pastel on tinted textured paper
styles.features: Powdery pastel strokes on textured tinted paper; chalky velvety colour; blended passages beside visible directional hatching; paper tone showing through; soft diffused light, pale luminous highlights, matte surface.

styles.name: Charcoal and sanguine drawing
styles.medium: charcoal, red chalk and white chalk on toned paper
styles.features: Black charcoal and warm red-brown sanguine on cream or grey paper; smudged soft shadows and sharp hatched contours; white chalk highlights; academic modelling of figures and faces; unfinished edges fading into bare paper.

styles.name: Gouache sketch on toned paper
styles.medium: gouache on grey, brown or blue toned paper
styles.features: Opaque matte gouache laid in flat, confident patches on toned paper; paper colour left as the midtone; dry-brush edges; crisp white highlights; quick plein-air studies with simplified forms.

styles.name: Elizaveta Kruglikova, cut-paper silhouette
styles.medium: black paper cut-out on white paper
styles.features: Crisp black silhouettes cut with scissors and laid on white; profile figures and portraits; delicate lace-like detail in hair, branches and iron railings; no interior shading, the outline carries all expression; city views with bridges and embankments.

styles.name: Soviet multiplane cut-out animation of the 1970s
styles.medium: hand-cut paper figures on stacked glass layers, multiplane camera
styles.features: Hand-cut paper figures with textured painted surfaces on stacked glass planes; soft milky fog and diffused light between layers; muted ochre, grey-blue and umber; trembling grainy texture; deep layered space; dim nocturnal atmosphere.
styles.note: Do not name animators; describe the technique.

styles.name: Hand-painted backgrounds of 1950s Soviet animated films
styles.medium: gouache and watercolour backgrounds under painted cels
styles.features: Lush realistic gouache backgrounds: soft volumetric forests, wooden fairy-tale towers, snowy villages; warm painterly light and gentle gradients; detailed foliage; realistically proportioned characters in clean ink outlines with flat colour over the painted depth.
styles.note: Do not name the studio; describe the period and technique.

styles.name: Soviet puppet animation with felt, wood and cotton wool
styles.medium: felt, carved wood, cotton wool and fabric puppets on miniature sets
styles.features: Small handmade puppets with felt bodies, carved wooden faces and bead eyes; cotton-wool snow, clouds and smoke; miniature sets of painted wood and fabric; soft studio lighting; tactile fibrous textures; shallow depth of field.

styles.name: Soviet flat stylised animation of the 1960s
styles.medium: cel animation with flat gouache shapes
styles.features: Flat geometric characters and backgrounds without shading; angular bodies, oversized heads, thin lines; limited palette of turquoise, orange, mustard and black; textured paper patches; mid-century modernist stylisation.

styles.name: Silhouette animation, cut-paper shadow film
styles.medium: jointed black card cut-outs on backlit glass
styles.features: Jointed black cut-out figures with lacy, intricate profiles against glowing backlit gradients; delicate scissor-cut foliage and ornament; theatrical frontal staging; action shown in profile; amber, teal or rose background light.

styles.name: Theatre set design sketch in gouache
styles.features: Gouache sketch of a stage set seen from the auditorium; framing side wings, hanging borders and a painted backdrop receding in planes; proscenium edge; small figures for scale; saturated decorative colour; loose confident brushwork.

styles.name: Soviet filmstrip illustration of the 1960s (diafilm)
styles.medium: colour film transparency of painted originals, projected
styles.features: Projected frame with slightly faded colour and soft film grain; gouache or watercolour illustration with clear outlines; faint magenta-cyan colour shift; darkened rounded vignette edges; simple readable compositions above a caption band.
styles.note: The caption band may be left blank or omitted.

styles.name: Chukchi and Yupik walrus ivory engraving, Uelen
styles.medium: engraving and tinting on walrus tusk
styles.features: Fine incised line drawings along long creamy walrus tusks, filled with black, red and brown pigment; narrative friezes of hunters in skin boats, walruses, whales, reindeer sledges and yarangas; tiny figures spread along the curved surface without a horizon.

styles.name: Konstantin Pankov
styles.medium: oil and gouache on canvas and paper
styles.features: Naive flat painting in bright pure colours on light grounds; tundra and taiga with tiny reindeer, hunters, fishermen and tents set in decorative rows; trees and animals as patterned silhouettes; ornamental rhythm; high bird's-eye view.

styles.name: Tyko Vylka
styles.medium: oil and watercolour on canvas and paper
styles.features: Naive Arctic painting: cold blue-grey seas, icebergs, white snow and low polar light; small Nenets hunters, boats, walruses and tents; simple outlines and plain flat colour; wide empty spaces; plain documentary detail.

styles.name: Yakut linocut of the 1960s
styles.medium: black and colour linocut on paper
styles.features: Bold black-and-white or two-colour linocut with heavy cut contours; horses, reindeer, herders in fur clothing, birch trees, conical tents and log dwellings, summer round dances; northern ornamental borders; strong graphic stylisation.
styles.note: Specialist school; rely on the description.

styles.name: Nanai and Udege ornament, Amur peoples
styles.medium: birch-bark and paper cut-outs, appliqué on fish skin and cloth
styles.features: Flowing symmetrical spirals and curling scrolls ending in stylised fish, bird and dragon heads; cut-out birch-bark or paper stencils; appliqué on fish skin or cloth in blue, red, black and white; dense rhythmic curvilinear patterns.
styles.note: Use as decorative framing or stylised animals; avoid shamanic ritual objects.

styles.name: Khanty and Mansi fur and cloth mosaic
styles.medium: pieced reindeer fur and wool broadcloth
styles.features: Mosaic of interlocking light and dark reindeer fur or red, blue and black broadcloth; geometric positive-negative ornament of antlers, birds, birch branches and hare-ear motifs; stepped zigzags; strong contrast; fine stitched seams.

styles.name: Buryat Buddhist thangka painting
styles.medium: mineral pigments on primed cotton, silk mount
styles.features: Precise fine outlines; flat saturated malachite green, lapis blue, cinnabar red and gold; stylised curling clouds, curly rocks, flaming halos; symmetrical hierarchical compositions; tiny detailed landscapes with steppe horses and yurts.
styles.note: Sacred art: use its painting language for landscapes and secular scenes; do not depict deities.

styles.name: Felt appliqué of the steppe and Altai (shyrdak, syrmak)
styles.features: Thick dyed felt cut into bold curling ram's-horn and plant motifs, inlaid in contrasting red, blue, brown and cream; corded outlines; positive-negative symmetry; soft fuzzy edges; dense stitched contours.
styles.note: Mostly ornamental; best for stylised animals and decorative scenes.

styles.name: Tatar leather mosaic
styles.features: Pieces of soft dyed leather in red, green, yellow, blue and black sewn edge to edge with gold or silk thread; tulips, carnations, curling stems and hearts; flat bright inlaid patterns on boots, slippers and bags.

styles.name: Karelian and Vepsian folk embroidery
styles.medium: red cotton and linen thread on white linen, counted-thread
styles.region: Karelia and Vepsian lands, north-west Russia
styles.features: White linen ground worked in deep red thread with small black or blue accents; counted double-running and cross stitches form stepped geometric diamonds, rosettes, tree-of-life, stylised birds and long-skirted female figures with raised arms, set in symmetrical horizontal bands
styles.note: Works best as a pattern, border or embroidered towel. Not suited to detailed narrative scenes.

styles.name: hand-coloured photographic postcard, 1900s
styles.medium: collotype or halftone print tinted with watercolour
styles.features: Monochrome sepia or grey photographic base with thin transparent washes of pale pink, sky blue, leaf green and ochre laid loosely over areas; soft focus, flat tones, colours spilling past edges, cream card margin
styles.note: A short printed caption is typical but optional.

styles.name: 1930s travel poster
styles.features: Large flat areas of clean colour with airbrushed gradients in sky and sea, simplified geometric landforms, strong silhouettes and long shadows, dramatic low viewpoint, streamlined trains, ships and planes, bold sans-serif title band
styles.note: Needs a short destination title. Keep lettering minimal.

styles.name: Soviet gouache greeting postcard, 1950s–1960s
styles.features: Opaque matte gouache with soft rounded forms, gentle volume and sparkling white highlights; cheerful warm reds, sky blues and snow whites; tidy scenes of children, animals, snowy towns, fir trees and festive lights
styles.note: Greeting lettering is optional. Leave it out unless required.

styles.name: 1960s two- and three-colour magazine illustration
styles.medium: ink drawing with flat spot colours, offset print
styles.features: Loose expressive ink line and dry-brush marks combined with two or three flat spot colours, often red, ochre and teal, printed as blocks slightly out of register; stylised angular figures, open white paper, simple shapes

styles.name: Soviet Constructivist graphic design, 1920s
styles.features: Red, black and white on off-white paper; strong diagonals, circles and bars, sans-serif block letters, cut-out photographic figures and machines combined at sharply contrasting scales, flat colour, dynamic asymmetric layout
styles.note: Avoid propaganda slogans. Use neutral words.

styles.name: smalt glass mosaic
styles.medium: smalt and gold-leaf glass tesserae set in mortar
styles.features: Image built from small irregular glass cubes with visible grout lines, rows following contours; intense deep blues, reds, greens and a glittering gold ground; simplified frontal figures with dark outlines, flattened space, uneven glinting light

styles.name: stained glass window
styles.medium: coloured glass, lead cames, painted grisaille
styles.features: Translucent jewel colours of ruby, cobalt, emerald and amber divided into pieces by thick black lead lines; faces and folds painted in brown grisaille; backlit glow, flattened space, figures inside arched or round frames, iron bars

styles.name: hot-wax batik on silk
styles.medium: wax resist and dyes on silk or cotton
styles.features: Dyed fabric with pale wax-resist lines and areas, fine dark crackle veins where the wax broke, layered transparent dye colours deepening stage by stage, slightly blurred edges, flowing stylised flowers, birds, fish and landscapes

styles.name: three-colour screenprint
styles.features: Exactly three flat opaque ink colours plus paper white, overlapping to create an extra tone; crisp stencil edges, slight misregistration halos, faint ink texture, no gradients, bold simplified shapes and silhouettes

styles.name: Japanese sumi-e ink painting
styles.features: Black ink in graded washes from dense black to pale grey on white absorbent paper; swift single brushstrokes, dry-brush texture, wet bleeding edges, large empty spaces, misty depth, sparse bamboo, birds, mountains and huts

styles.name: Georges Seurat, pointillism
styles.medium: oil on canvas, dots of pure colour
styles.features: Surface of tiny uniform dots of unmixed colour placed side by side, complementary halos along edges, hazy shimmering light, stiff stylised profile figures, calm geometric composition, parks, rivers and promenades

styles.name: Norwegian Neo-Romantic landscape (Harald Sohlberg, Nikolai Astrup)
styles.medium: oil on canvas and colour woodcut
styles.features: Luminous northern twilight in deep blues and glowing turquoise skies, crisp contours, flattened decorative patterns of fields, birches and rhubarb leaves, mountain lakes, wooden farmhouses, midsummer bonfires, deep stillness

styles.name: Lucas van Valckenborch
styles.features: Panoramic landscapes with craggy river valleys, iron mines and castles, also snowy winter villages and markets; many small busy figures, Flemish three-zone colour with brown foreground, green middle ground and blue distance

styles.name: David Vinckboons
styles.features: Lively village fairs and forest landscapes crowded with small animated figures in red, blue and yellow; dense trees with feathery foliage, winding paths, inns, dancing peasants, anecdotal incidents scattered across the scene

styles.name: Sebastiaen Vrancx
styles.features: Small-scale figures in action, such as cavalry skirmishes, ambushes, travellers, skaters and Antwerp squares; bright local reds and blues, elegant slender horses, smoke and dust, detailed city or roadside settings in cool tones

styles.name: Esaias van de Velde
styles.features: Early Dutch realist landscapes with low horizons, wide grey skies, flat polders and frozen canals full of skaters; small sketchy figures, tonal browns and greys, quick fluid brushwork, also cavalry skirmishes and garden feasts

styles.name: 360-degree painted panorama rotunda, 19th century
styles.features: Continuous circular view from a central high point with the horizon at eye level, meticulous topographic detail of city roofs, streets, river and countryside, soft daylight, tiny figures, illusionistic depth fading into hazy distance
styles.note: Very wide horizontal format with slight curved distortion.

styles.name: steel engraving after Thomas Allom
styles.region: Britain; views of the Ottoman Empire, China and Britain
styles.features: Fine monochrome engraved lines and dense hatching, rich silvery tonal range, dramatic shafts of light, theatrical architecture, picturesque crowds in local costume, deep perspective, sometimes light hand tinting

styles.name: Rudolf von Alt
styles.features: Precise architectural watercolour views of streets, churches and interiors, crisp perspective, luminous transparent washes, warm sunlight and cool shadows, fine detail, small strolling figures and carriages, untouched paper highlights

styles.name: Xu Yang, Prosperous Suzhou handscroll
styles.medium: ink and colour on paper, handscroll
styles.features: Very long continuous horizontal panorama in oblique bird's-eye view without a vanishing point; thousands of tiny figures, boats on canals, shops, bridges, city walls, blue-green mountains, fine outlines, pale mineral colour washes
styles.note: Very wide format.

styles.name: Suzhou Gusu woodblock print, Taohuawu
styles.features: Large prints mixing Chinese line with European-style cross-hatching and one-point perspective imitating copperplate engraving; dense city streets, bridges and canals, many costumed figures, black outlines, bright pink, green and yellow

styles.name: Korean court painting, Donggwoldo palace panorama
styles.features: Palace compound seen from above in parallel oblique projection with no vanishing point; precisely ruled buildings with grey-blue tiled roofs, red pillars, walls and courtyards, rounded green hills, clustered pines, drifting stylised clouds
styles.note: Traditionally has no human figures.

styles.name: Mewar court painting, Udaipur place paintings
styles.features: Large views of a whole palace and lake from several viewpoints at once; flat white palaces, blue water with boats, tiny repeated ruler figures, processions and hunts, bright flat colours, crisp outlines, high horizon

styles.name: Levni, Ottoman miniature
styles.medium: opaque watercolour and gold on paper
styles.features: Soft pastel tones, slender graceful figures with individual faces and swaying poses, flat green or tan ground with little depth, decorative tents and costumes, festival processions of guilds and acrobats, gold accents

styles.name: Limbourg brothers, illuminated book of hours
styles.features: Bright ultramarine and vermilion with gold detail, small elegant figures at courtly pastimes and peasant labours, fairy-tale white castles behind fields, tilted landscape, fine miniaturist precision, arched page format

styles.name: Gentile Bellini
styles.features: Broad ceremonial processions in squares before ornate facades, rows of many small figures in red robes and turbans, clear even daylight, careful architectural perspective, detailed marble and mosaic surfaces, calm frieze-like order

styles.name: hand-coloured woodcut city views, Nuremberg Chronicle
styles.features: Bold black outlines with simple parallel hatching, cities packed with towers, spires, walls and gates on hills, schematic perspective, loose watercolour washes of red roofs, green and ochre, no consistent human scale
styles.note: A city-name banner is optional.

styles.name: millefleur tapestry with genre scenes
styles.features: Dark blue or green ground densely strewn with small flowering plants, rabbits and birds; elegant figures hunting, reading or working wool float without perspective; woven hatching, muted reds, blues and ochres, visible weave

styles.name: Mexican amate bark painting
styles.medium: acrylic or gouache on amate bark paper
styles.features: Fibrous brown bark-paper ground, flat vivid colours with black outlines, stylised birds, flowers and leafy vines filling all space, village fiestas and daily scenes in small rows, no perspective

styles.name: Ali Mitgutsch, wimmelbook illustration
styles.features: Busy double-page spread from a high viewpoint with no horizon, hundreds of small round-headed figures in bright flat colours with firm outlines, harbours, towns, fairs and building sites, many tiny parallel stories

styles.name: Currier & Ives hand-coloured lithograph
styles.features: Lithographed line with smooth crayon tonal shading and cheerful hand-applied watercolour; sleighs in snowy villages, trains, steamboats and farms, tidy small figures, pale sky, rectangular or oval vignette
styles.note: A title line under the image is typical but optional.

styles.name: American panoramic bird's-eye town map, 19th-century lithograph (Augustus Koch)
styles.features: Whole town seen from an imagined high oblique angle, every house, church and factory drawn small, regular street grid, tiny trees and trains, river with steamboats, soft tinted colours, numbered key and title cartouche
styles.note: Lettering is limited to a title and a key. Keep it short.

styles.name: Japanese woodblock print, shin-hanga
styles.features: Western-influenced light and shadow rendered in woodblock: soft bokashi gradations, visible baren rubbing and wood grain, refined keyblock lines, women in kimono, actors, birds and flowers, moody landscapes in rich muted colour

styles.name: paper tunnel book, layered cut-paper diorama
styles.features: Several cut-paper layers stacked one behind another, each a silhouette frame with a central opening; cast shadows between layers, depth receding into the centre, flat printed colours, crisp paper edges, folded side bellows

styles.name: Isometric pixel art, limited palette
styles.features: Hard square pixels on a 2:1 isometric grid, no anti-aliasing, 16–32 colour palette, flat shaded faces, one-pixel dark outlines, dithered gradients, diamond floor tiles, tiny sprite figures.

styles.name: Model railway diorama photography, H0 scale (1:87)
styles.medium: macro colour photograph of a scale model
styles.features: Macro view of a 1:87 layout: tiny painted plastic figures frozen mid-gesture, static-grass flock, foam trees, plaster rocks, shallow depth of field, slightly glossy plastic surfaces, small lamps, painted sky backdrop.

styles.name: Tilt-shift miniature-effect photography
styles.medium: colour photograph, tilt-shift lens or selective blur
styles.features: High viewpoint over a real place, narrow horizontal band of sharp focus with strong blur above and below, boosted saturation and contrast, bright daylight, people and cars looking like small painted toys.

styles.name: Walter Mittelholzer, 1920s aerial photography
styles.medium: gelatin silver print, oblique aerial photograph
styles.features: Oblique black-and-white views from biplane height, soft silvery grey tones, fine grain and slight vignetting, glaciers, ridges, lakes and villages far below, hazy horizon, warm-toned paper.
styles.note: May include a wing strut or aircraft edge in frame.

styles.name: Contemporary top-down aerial photography (nadir drone view)
styles.medium: digital colour photograph from drone or aircraft
styles.features: Camera pointing straight down, no horizon, flattened geometry of fields, roads, roofs and shorelines, long low-sun shadows revealing form, crisp digital detail, saturated colour, graphic patterns, tiny people and vehicles.

styles.name: Sebastião Salgado
styles.features: High-contrast black-and-white with visible film grain, deep inky shadows, glowing silvery highlights, backlight through mist, dust or smoke, workers and herders in vast landscapes, sweeping compositions.
styles.note: Prefer dignified scenes of labour and land rather than suffering.

styles.name: Albumen print, sepia-toned
styles.features: Warm brown-purple to sepia tones, soft sheen, fine detail with faded highlights, yellowing and foxing, long exposures blurring moving figures, stiff posed people, arched or oval card mounts.

styles.name: 1970s American large-format colour photography, 8×10 view camera
styles.features: Frontal, level, deadpan views of ordinary streets, motels, gas stations and intersections, sharp from foreground to distance, flat midday light, faded warm colour, clear blue sky, parked cars, few people.
styles.note: Reference photographer Stephen Shore is living; described as period technique only.

styles.name: Braun & Hogenberg, Civitates orbis terrarum
styles.features: Elevated bird's-eye views of walled cities, finely engraved roofs and streets, soft hand-washed green, ochre, rose and blue, costumed townsfolk in the foreground, ribbon banners and cartouches with Latin titles.

styles.name: Turgot plan of Paris, drawn by Louis Bretez, engraved by Claude Lucas
styles.features: Oblique axonometric bird's-eye view without vanishing points, every façade, roof, courtyard, garden and tree drawn in crisp black line, dense parallel hatching for shadow, uniform scale, river with boats, small street labels.
styles.note: Monochrome black ink only.

styles.name: Japanese folding-screen city map, Edo period (byōbu)
styles.medium: ink, mineral pigments and gold leaf on paper folding screen
styles.features: Bird's-eye panorama across several panels, golden clouds cutting the view into pockets, roofs, temples and bridges in fine ink with malachite green, azurite blue and white, tiny figures in streets, deep blue rivers.
styles.note: Some map screens carry place labels; lettering optional.

styles.name: Chinese river map handscroll, Ming–Qing
styles.medium: ink and colour on silk or paper, handscroll
styles.features: Long horizontal scroll following a river, water in ribbed wave lines, blue-green mineral-coloured hills, walled towns as small square enclosures, dikes, bridges, boats, labels in cartouches, shifting viewpoint without single perspective.

styles.name: Isometric cutaway illustration of a city block, ink and watercolour
styles.medium: pen and ink with watercolour wash on paper
styles.features: Parallel-projection view of a block with roofs and front walls removed, rooms, stairs, furniture and residents visible, crisp technical-pen line, light transparent washes, cut wall edges shown in solid tone.

styles.name: Medieval mappa mundi, detail of one city and its surroundings
styles.medium: ink, pigments and gold on vellum
styles.features: Flat schematic parchment map, city as a cluster of towers inside circular walls, rivers as wavy blue-green ribbons, no scale or perspective, tiny animals and figures, faded red, green and gold, brown Latin script labels.

styles.name: Hölzel school wall charts (Hölzels Wandbilder), Vienna
styles.features: Large didactic panoramas in clear chromolithographic colour, many small activities shown at once in farmyards, fields and towns through the seasons, even daylight, crisp outlines, soft greens and earth browns, precise tools and buildings.

styles.name: Painted plaster terrain relief model
styles.medium: carved and painted plaster relief, photographed
styles.features: Physical mountain model with sculpted plaster terrain, hand-painted forest greens, grey rock, white snow and blue lakes, tiny painted villages and roads, raking light casting real shadows, matte chalky surface, slightly exaggerated relief.

styles.name: Portolan chart
styles.features: Coastlines in fine ink densely lined with place names written perpendicular to the shore, web of rhumb lines radiating from compass roses in black, red and green, flags over ports, ships on blank sea, gilded towns.

styles.name: Benin court brass plaque relief
styles.features: Rectangular cast plaque with figures in high relief, frontal and symmetrical, hierarchical scale, detailed regalia and coral-bead collars, background incised with quatrefoil leaf pattern, dark brown-green patina.
styles.note: Royal court art with a looting history; render court and ceremonial scenes respectfully.

styles.name: Embroidered needlework sampler
styles.medium: silk or wool cross-stitch on linen
styles.features: Counted cross-stitch on visible linen weave, bands of alphabets and numerals, a stitched verse, symmetrical house, trees, birds, baskets and strawberries, meandering vine border, faded silk colours.

styles.name: Smalti glass mosaic
styles.medium: smalti glass and gold-leaf tesserae set in mortar
styles.features: Small irregular cubes of opaque coloured glass and gold leaf, visible grout gaps, rows of tesserae flowing along contours, shimmering uneven surface catching light, flat gold grounds, strong dark outlines.

styles.name: Russian lacquer miniature, Palekh and Mstyora
styles.medium: egg tempera and gold on papier-mâché, lacquered
styles.features: Glossy lacquered box surface; Palekh: deep black ground, elongated slender figures, fine gold hatching, jewel-bright reds and greens; Mstyora: no black, warm landscape grounds, softer tones; ornamental gold borders.

styles.name: Faith Ringgold, story quilt
styles.medium: acrylic on canvas with pieced fabric borders
styles.features: Painted canvas centre framed by patchwork squares, flat bright colour, simplified figures, city rooftops and bridges, handwritten text panels running along the borders, visible quilting stitches.

styles.name: Delftware, cobalt blue on tin-glazed earthenware
styles.features: Cobalt blue brushwork on milky white glaze, brushy outlines and tonal washes, windmills, canals, ships, flowers and Chinese-inspired motifs, tiles with corner ornaments, glossy slightly pooled glaze.
styles.note: Delftware is earthenware, not porcelain.

styles.name: Northern Dvina painting, Permogorye
styles.features: White ground with thin black outlines, dominant red with green, yellow and touches of blue, flat decorative figures in horizontal registers, tea drinking, sleigh rides, Sirin birds, tulip-like flowers and curling vines.

styles.name: Pattachitra, Odisha cloth painting
styles.medium: natural pigments on primed cotton cloth
styles.features: Flat opaque colour on red or ochre ground, crisp black outlines, figures in profile with large almond eyes and ornate jewellery, dense floral and leaf fill, multiple decorative borders, no perspective.
